chapters.title: Chapter 4801: Exterminated
paragraphs: The strongest Saint of all eternity!

Zong Yuze and the others all inhaled sharply. If Ling Han really had battle prowess on the level of Pseudo-Emperor, then the title of the strongest Saint in all eternity was indeed not the slightest bit arrogant.
"Alright, now that the puzzle-solving segment is over, I’m about to make my move," Ling Han said with a smile.
Zong Yuze and the others all smirked coldly.

When Ling Han was a Saint, he already possessed battle prowess on the level of Pseudo-Emperor. This was indeed amazing, but no matter how strong you were, you would only be comparable to a One Star Pseudo-Emperor, right?
Thus, if this guy made a move, that would simply be courting death.
The eight of them exchanged a look, and reached a concensus.

—If Ling Han took the field, they would join forces to kill Ling Han. In this way, the rock golem would become an ownerless Source Spirit. Without command, it could only fight based on instincts, and would be much easier to deal with.
’Come on, you arrogant brat.’
Ling Han leaped out, and charged towards Zong Yuze.
"You’re seeking death!" Zong Yuze smirked coldly, and countered Ling Han with a palm strike.
He wanted to send Ling Han flying with a single strike. Then, his companions would naturally continue and follow up with another attack, dealing a fatal blow to Ling Han.
A Pseudo-Emperor was indeed not easy to kill, but who asked Ling Han to be so arrogant?
If he wanted to seek death, who could he blame?
Ling Han smiled, and his iron fists clenched, blasting towards Zong Yuze.
Right until the instant when the fist and palm were about to make contact, only then did Ling Han suddenly channel out Destructive Energy and light of great dao.

Zong Yuze had a first impression of Ling Han, and thought that since Ling Han was a Saint, Ling Han’s battle prowess definitely wouldn’t be all that strong. Thus, his mind was filled with plans to send Ling Han flying, and shatter his defenses. Then, his companions would follow up with another attack, easily dealing with Ling Han.
Thus, how could he possibly be on guard at this moment?
Peng! The fist and palm collided, and Zong Yuze was instantly sent flying. Moreover, his right arm had abruptly disappeared.
Ning Xuelin and the others were all shocked.
Indeed, someone had been sent flying, but why wasn’t it Ling Han but rather Zong Yuze?
Were they seeing things?
Impossible! They were Pseudo-Emperors, so how could they have blurred vision?
Boom!
The rock golem attacked aggressively, shattering their idle thoughts.
Ling Han activated the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. With a quick stride, he caught up to Zong Yuze and threw another punch.
It was too fast!
It should be known that aside from cultivation level, Ling Han was superior to Zong Yuze in all aspects. Since the initiative was already in his hands, how could Zong Yuze block him?
Peng! Peng! Peng!

Ling Han threw a few consecutive punches, and each punch landed solidly. It could be clearly seen that Zong Yuze’s body was continuously disappearing, and in the end, his head was blasted apart with a single punch, both form and spirit destroyed.
Hiss, this was too terrifying!
Ning Xuelin and the others all felt a chill run down their spines, and they couldn’t help but tremble.
Saints were hard to kill, and Pseudo-Emperors were even harder to kill.
However, in Ling Han’s hands, with just a few punches, Zong Yuze was beaten to burst.
Just what kind of colossal power gap was this?
"Run!" They didn’t hesitate any longer. If Ling Han and the rock golem formed a pincer attack, they wouldn’t be able to resist at all. They would only be defeated one by one.
However, if the seven of them fled together, Ling Han and the rock golem would only be able to catch up to one each, at most. There were still five people who could escape.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "You guys are really thinking too much."
With a leap, he stood on the shoulder of the rock golem, and set off in pursuit of Ning Xuelin and the others.

The rock golem wasn’t skilled in speed, and normally speaking, there was not much of a gap in terms of speed among Pseudo-Emperors, so theoretically speaking, the rock golem couldn’t possibly catch up to Ning Xuelin and the others.
But the problem was, what was this place?

The mountain was too slippery, and once one slipped, it was possible that he would crash into the icicles, which would pierce into his body, and the strong poison would invade, directly taking his life.
Hence, they all had to be careful, and walk slowly.
However, the rock golem didn’t need to do that.
It barged around, and soon caught up to a person.
Ling Han and the rock golem attacked together, so how many strikes could that person block?
In less than a hundred moves, that person was blasted into smithereens.

Ling Han sighed. Pseudo-Emperors were really hard to kill. He had a great advantage in battle prowess, and also possessed such deadly weapons like Destructive Energy and light of great dao, but it still actually took him over a hundred moves to be able to kill his target.
Even when he was at the Venerate Tier, killing low-level Saints wasn’t as difficult as this.
—If this kind of lament was known to others, they would definitely roll their eyes at him, and reprimand him for showing off.

In theory, as long as a Pseudo-Emperor wanted to flee, even a Great Emperor would find it very difficult to kill him. You, a Saint, only used a hundred over moves to succeed, so what else do you want?
"Big Rock, let’s continue the chase!" Ling Han jumped onto the rock golem’s body and began their hunt again.
Taking advantage of this little bit of time, Ning Xuelin and the others had already run very far away, but they could not hold up against Ling Han, who had the reckless rock golem.
Peng, peng, peng! The rock golem didn’t care about the icicles. It simply barged through, and not long after, it caught up to another person.
However, the price for this was that its body had shrunk again.
It was fine. He could hold on.
Ling Han and the rock golem joined forces. If they battled in such a dangerous place, what Pseudo-Emperor would be able to withstand it?
The two of them continued their pursuit, leaving behind a trail of corpses.
However, after killing seven people, the rock golem shrunk back to a normal size, and could no longer be injured. Otherwise, its core would be exposed, and that would be too dangerous.
Ling Han turned around to grab the rock golem, and travelled on his own.
In this way, his speed naturally decreased greatly, but it was all right. He was still running faster than Yang Deyu, who was in front of him.
A hint of delight appeared on Yang Deyu’s face. This was because the plains were within sight.
He had already rushed down the mountain.
He hurriedly used all his movement techniques, and ran madly for his life.
A while later, Ling Han also came down from the mountain, and had the rock golem wait for him at the foot of the mountain. He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and his speed began to spike madly.
Three days later, he finally caught up to Yang Deyu.
Boom!
Without another word, Ling Han directly threw a punch.
This punch was so terrifying that Yang Deyu had no choice but to turn around to parry it.
However, after blocking a punch, he turned around and fled.
He was already fully aware of Ling Han’s battle prowess. He was completely no match for him, and if he fought him head-on, he would definitely die.
However, faced with Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, his speed was too slow.
Ling Han instantly caught up to him, and continued to attack madly.
"Ling Han, what enmity do you have with us? Why are you so ruthless?" Yang Deyu shouted harshly.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before asking, "Because you guys are ugly?"
Pei, what kind of reason was that?
Yang Deyu was filled with grief and indignation. ’It’s already come to this, and you still want to humiliate me?’
I am ugly, and you are good-looking?
Ling Han made another move, then said calmly, "Our positions are different. Ultimately, there will be a bloody battle."
Yang Deyu was rendered speechless upon hearing this.
That was because he had also recalled that he had once received a death command. As long as an outsider entered, there was no need for any reason at all. He was to kill the other party.
Thus, there were no grievances or anything of the sort. It was simply a matter of position.
Boom!
The two of them fought fiercely, and Yang Deyu still didn’t give up on the idea of fleeing. However, in front of Ling Han, how could he possibly succeed?
After several hundred moves, he was also killed.

chapters.title: Chapter 4802: Repelling Great Emperors
paragraphs: Without the restrictions of the environment, a Pseudo-Emperor was really too hard to kill.
If Ling Han hadn’t grasped the fastest movement technique in the world, Yang Deyu would have definitely fled.
Even so, it still took him a few hundred moves.
Ling Han turned around and didn’t let the rock golem follow him. He went up the mountain peak alone, then filled a large amount of Cold Water of Death into a vessel.
Without a Spatial Spirit Tool, he could only carry it physically.
Thankfully, the vessel was sealed. Otherwise, it would really be difficult to deal with.
Ling Han descended the snowy mountain. After confirming that he was safe, he then went to think of a way to better carry this liquid.
This thing could bring death, and was incredibly frightening. If one was not careful, even a Great Emperor could possibly be affected.
Hence, this could be used as a secret weapon.
However, vessels could only be carried physically. If he had to carefully take out the vessel and then open the seal when facing a Great Emperor... Uh, what Great Emperor would still be affected?
Could he draw it into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower?
Ling Han was a little worried. This thing could cause any existence to die and wilt. Who knew if it would affect the Origin Gold.
After all, there was a sliver of Ling Han’s divine sense in this. If it was destroyed, it would still cause some damage to Ling Han.
He would give it a try.
He controlled the Origin Gold, and absorbed a little bit of the Cold Water of Death into the tower.
It seemed like... there was nothing wrong with it.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. This was good.

He drew all the Cold Water of Death into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. This way, when fighting enemies, he only had to suddenly activate the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and the Cold Water of Death would spill out. In a moment of carelessness, it could cause great damage.
"Big Rock, let’s go."

Ling Han brought the rock golem to the plains. Although there weren’t large swathes of rocks here, the rock golem didn’t mind. It absorbed one here, followed by another there, and after a few months, it still recovered to its largest size.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

This big guy stepped on the ground, releasing a loud boom. There was really nothing that could be done. Its weight was clear to see, so even if it wanted to be light, it couldn’t be light. After all, the gravity fields here were too terrifying.
The two of them began to wander around again, searching everywhere for Genesis Substance.
Many years later, Ling Han suddenly stopped.
He sensed that unique aura of Genesis Substance.
He hurriedly followed the trail. True enough, there was a Celestial medicine ahead of him, and it was gently swaying in the breeze.
However, Ling Han’s eyes instantly narrowed.
That was because beside the Celestial medicine, there was presently a massive beast lying prostrate.
He had seen it before.
Qiong Qi Emperor!
This was a trap set up against him, using Genesis Substance to lure him out.
At this moment, Qiong Qi Emperor slowly stood up and said, "You’ve come."
His voice was calm, and there wasn’t a shred of killing intent in it.
In the eyes of a Great Emperor, Ling Han was nothing but an ant, regardless of how powerful he was.
Killing a mere ant, what need was there for killing intent?
He could just casually stomp him to death.
Now that things had come to this, Ling Han relaxed instead. He first sent out a message through divine sense, and had the rock golem flee.
Qiong Qi Emperor didn’t pay any heed to this at all. He only wanted to kill Ling Han.
Ling Han appeared even calmer, and said with a smile, "I’m here. Can you give me that Celestial medicine?"
The Qiong Qi Emperor faltered upon hearing this. It was as if he hadn’t expected Ling Han to be so calm.
Shua, he waved a paw, and that Celestial medicine flew towards Ling Han.
So what if he gave it to him? Would he still be able to eat it? F***!
Even the Great Emperor couldn’t help but gape.

That was because Ling Han had really begun to gnaw on the Celestial medicine after he had gotten hold of it. Furthermore, his speed was extremely fast. In just a few moves, he had swallowed the whole Celestial medicine.
This!
Qiong Qi Emperor felt like he had underestimated the shamelessness of this young man in front of him. That was practically shameless to the point of having no pride at all.
However, Qiong Qi Emperor immediately withdrew his slightly fluctuating emotions.
So what if I feed you a Celestial medicine?
Could it be that you could immediately break through to become a Great Emperor?
He moved directly, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
Boom, a colossal hand appeared, bringing with it rolling black Qi.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all. He immediately turned around and fled.
Fighting head-on with a Great Emperor?
Hehe, he was not that stupid.
However, he had just turned around, when he saw another Great Emperor appear.
Bi Fang.
The two Great Emperors attacked from the front and back.
Where could Ling Han flee to?
Weng, the Clear Bamboo Sword revived, and Ling Han immediately slashed at Bi Fang Emperor.
"You’re like a mantis trying to stop a chariot," Bi Fang Emperor sneered. Wanting to stop him with just an Imperial Weapon?
How naive!
Peng! With a single strike, the Clear Bamboo Sword was were immediately sent flying. Meanwhile, Ling Han also activated his second layer of defense, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Under the shockwave of the terrifying power, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower continued to emit booming sounds as if it couldn’t hold on any longer and was about to collapse.

There was no need to be afraid. Origin Gold was completely capable of withstanding the barrage of attacks from a Great Emperor, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower had been strengthened by the Metal of Creation, which was considerably stronger than the normal Origin Gold, so there was even less need to worry.

However, relying on an Imperial Weapon and a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, even if Ling Han managed to cope with the strike of a Great Emperor, the shockwave still caused streams of blood to spray from all over his body.
Only one Great Emperor would appear in an era, so how could he not be inconceivably strong?
Ling Han didn’t have time to make any adjustments. Behind him, the Qiong Qi Emperor had already charged over.
"Go!"
Ling Han unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and a water screen instantly swept toward the two Great Emperors.

"Cold Water of Death!" the two Great Emperors exclaimed in astonishment. They hadn’t expected that Ling Han would possess such a powerful weapon, and they definitely wouldn’t be guarded against a Saint. They had simply charged over without any preparation at all, and their speed was astonishingly quick.
This caused the Cold Water of Death to pour so much that it directly arrived in front of them.

They hurriedly pushed out their claws, setting up a defense in front of them. At this moment, the terror of the Cold Water of Death was completely clear. A small portion actually penetrated their defense, and spilled on their claws.
Instantly, the two Great Emperors groaned in pain, their vitality dropping drastically.

However, this also revealed the strength of a Great Emperor. Even if they were touched by the Cold Water of Death, they did not die immediately. Instead, they were only severely injured, but they still possessed a terrifying battle prowess, far superior to a Pseudo-Emperor.
Ling Han sighed. It was clearly impossible to truly kill Emperors with this.
He didn’t stop at all, and he continued to sprint forward.
After suffering such a blow, even the two Great Emperors had to rest and recuperate, and no longer had the time to pursue Ling Han.
Weng, a terrifying divine sense surged around Ling Han, as if warning him that even if he managed to escape this time, his fate was still destined.
Ling Han was unmoved, and merely ran madly. Very soon, he had rushed out of the area that was affected by the divine sense of the Great Emperors.

He secretly called himself lucky. If it was not for the fact that the Divine Beasts in the Primitive Abyss did not have any Imperial Weapons, then the two Great Emperors would definitely not have been injured by the Cold Water of Death, as they would be protected by the Imperial Weapons.
—He himself was using a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon to store the Cold Water of Death.

This was truly a blessing in disguise. This time, the Great Emperors had set a trap for him. Thankfully, he had previously obtained the Cold Water of Death. Otherwise, how would he have been able to resolve this situation?
And now, not only had he come out, he had even eaten a Genesis-level Celestial medicine.
Ling Han hurriedly sat down in a cross-legged position, and began to refine the medicinal power. This was something that definitely could not be wasted.

Meanwhile, Ling Han also activated his second layer of defense, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Under the shockwave of the terrifying power, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower continued to emit booming sounds as if it couldn’t hold on any longer and was about to collapse.
There was no need to be afraid.

Origin Gold was completely capable of withstanding the barrage of attacks from a Great Emperor, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower had been strengthened by the Metal of Creation, which was considerably stronger than the normal Origin Gold, so there was even less need to worry.

However, relying on an Imperial Weapon and a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, even if Ling Han managed to cope with the strike of a Great Emperor, the shockwave still caused streams of blood to spray from all over his body.
Only one Great Emperor would appear in an era, so how could he not be inconceivably strong?
Ling Han didn’t have time to make any adjustments.
Behind him, the Qiong Qi Emperor had already charged over.
"Go!"
Ling Han unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and a water screen instantly swept toward the two Great Emperors.
"Cold Water of Death!" the two Great Emperors exclaimed in astonishment.
They hadn’t expected that Ling Han would possess such a powerful weapon, and they definitely wouldn’t be guarded against a Saint.
They had simply charged over without any preparation at all, and their speed was astonishingly quick.
This caused the Cold Water of Death to pour so much that it directly arrived in front of them.
They hurriedly pushed out their claws, setting up a defense in front of them.
At this moment, the terror of the Cold Water of Death was completely clear.
A small portion actually penetrated their defense, and spilled on their claws.
Instantly, the two Great Emperors groaned in pain, their vitality dropping drastically.
However, this also revealed the strength of a Great Emperor.
Even if they were touched by the Cold Water of Death, they did not die immediately.
Instead, they were only severely injured, but they still possessed a terrifying battle prowess, far superior to a Pseudo-Emperor.
Ling Han sighed.
It was clearly impossible to truly kill Emperors with this.
He didn’t stop at all, and he continued to sprint forward.
After suffering such a blow, even the two Great Emperors had to rest and recuperate, and no longer had the time to pursue Ling Han.
Weng, a terrifying divine sense surged around Ling Han, as if warning him that even if he managed to escape this time, his fate was still destined.
Ling Han was unmoved, and merely ran madly.
Very soon, he had rushed out of the area that was affected by the divine sense of the Great Emperors.
He secretly called himself lucky.

If it was not for the fact that the Divine Beasts in the Primitive Abyss did not have any Imperial Weapons, then the two Great Emperors would definitely not have been injured by the Cold Water of Death, as they would be protected by the Imperial Weapons.
—He himself was using a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon to store the Cold Water of Death.
This was truly a blessing in disguise.
This time, the Great Emperors had set a trap for him.
Thankfully, he had previously obtained the Cold Water of Death.
Otherwise, how would he have been able to resolve this situation?
And now, not only had he come out, he had even eaten a Genesis-level Celestial medicine.
Ling Han hurriedly sat down in a cross-legged position, and began to refine the medicinal power.
This was something that definitely could not be wasted.

chapters.title: Chapter 4803: Success is at hand
paragraphs: Half a day later, Ling Han refined all the medicinal effects.
His improvement wasn’t great, and he had only raised the number of Regulations he could absorb to 87.

It could not be helped. The higher the cultivation level, the more difficult it was to improve. Moreover, the level of Celestial medicine that the Qiong Qi Emperor had used to lure him into a trap was also a little low. It was already quite impressive that he could grasp one more Regulation with it.
"Qiong Qi , Qiong Qi. No wonder, its name has the word ’poor’, so how could it possibly be <anno data-annotation-id="cc2c5e8b-be7b-445b-8e4a-8022ab0c5bc7" data-title="generous?">generous?1</anno>"
Ling Han murmured to himself.
Not long after, the rock golem returned.
The two of them continued onwards, and began a very long roundabout journey.
By now, the Divine Beast Emperors would definitely be looking for Ling Han. Thus, he definitely could not take the "normal" route. He could only circle around, circle around, and circle around again.

However, all the Great Emperors in the entire second level moved for Ling Han’s sake. In fact, even the Great Emperors in the first level actually appeared as well. Such a great commotion was merely for the sake of finding and killing a Saint.
No one would believe this if they heard about it. Since when had Great Emperors become so cheap? A whole group of them had actually been mobilized to kill a measly Saint?

However, Ling Han knew that if the Divine Stone corresponding to the Genesis World was a part of the Stone of Life, then he, Ding Shu and the others were seeds that the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others had released many years ago.
Perhaps this was a step that had changed the structure of the Primitive Abyss. Thus, the thirty-six Divine Beasts were doing their best to stop his "return".
Ling Han had been channeling the Strange Shadow Steps the entire time, and the rock golem had stayed far away from him, so it wouldn’t expose him.

On the long journey, Ling Han discovered multiple Divine Beast Emperors streaking through the skies. They released their divine sense to search for him, but such a "rough" search method naturally could not possibly find him.
After all, he too had Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess.
However, after a few more years, the search of the Great Emperors became even more meticulous. It was clear that they were determined to find him even if they had to dig three feet deep.
Under such circumstances, Ling Han didn’t dare to bring the rock golem along with him anymore.
This would very easily expose him.
He had the rock golem enter a stone forest, and wait there for his return.
Originally, the rock golem couldn’t possibly obey commands, but after Ling Han revived it, Ling Han’s influence on it increased several levels, and it was very easy to command it.
Ling Han once again advanced alone. Now that there was no longer any burden on him, his heart and spirit also relaxed.

Seven years later, he was finally discovered by a Great Emperor, who began to hunt him down. However, Ling Han used his full strength, and also summoned the Cold Water of Death, and finally managed to escape successfully.

He had repeatedly escaped from the hands of Great Emperors. If there was a record that was specifically targeted at this number, Ling Han reckoned that he would be able to reach the position of number one.
In the process of fleeing, Ling Han accidentally barged into a valley, and actually discovered a Genesis-level Celestial medicine.
"Does this mean that one will definitely have good fortune after surviving a great disaster?"
Ling Han laughed loudly, and naturally plucked the Celestial medicine without any reservations. Then, he began to refine the Celestial medicine.
This Celestial medicine contained a considerable amount of Genesis Substance, causing the number of Regulations that Ling Han had grasped to instantly increase to as many as 90.
"How strong is my present battle prowess?" Ling Han murmured. Even if it was conventional battle prowess, he should still be superior to Buddha Doga, and could overwhelm all Pseudo-Emperors.
"But to match a Great Emperor... it is still a little lacking."
Because this was not the first time he had come into contact with a Great Emperor, Ling Han was deeply aware of how strong a Great Emperor was.
Right now, he was still no match for a Great Emperor.
However!
Because his whereabouts had been discovered, even more Great Emperors had come to the vicinity these few days, and began a thorough search, forcing Ling Han to appear again.
Ling Han once again charged out of the siege, and moved unhindered in the vast Primitive Abyss.
Previously, when he had broken free from the pursuit of the Great Emperors, he had paid the price of severe injury, but this time, the injuries he had sustained were clearly much lighter.
This proved that his strength was steadily improving.
In the following few thousand years, Ling Han was constantly being hunted down and forced to break out of a siege.

He was continuously injured. At times, it would only be light injuries, but at other times, he would be severely injured. Under the tempering of such extremely arduous battles, his willpower had been tempered to an incredibly tough state, and his battle prowess was also stronger than ever before.

And in these few thousand years, it was not that he had not gained anything. Occasionally, he would still encounter Genesis-level Celestial medicines, and they would elevate his cultivation level step by step.
91 flashes, 92 flashes, 93 flashes... the number of Regulations he could accommodate was getting closer and closer to the limit, and he had still only undergone Silent Destruction four times.
This meant that once he broke through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, in terms of cultivation level, he would be a five-star Pseudo-Emperor.
And in terms of battle prowess, hoho, that was definitely a true Emperor!
Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open, an expression of both excitement and disappointment appearing on his face.

Previously, he had also harvested another Genesis-level Celestial medicine. At first, he had thought that after refining the Celestial medicine, he would be able to rush up to the height of 99 Regulations, but after refining the Celestial medicine, he discovered that he was still a step away.
However, as long as he had the slightest bit of improvement now, he would reach the true limit of the Silent Destruction Tier.
He was only one step away.
Ling Han stood up abruptly. Not far ahead of him, a city that looked like a giant fish was in sight.
It looked like a fish, but also had a pair of wings, as if it could flap its wings and fly at any time, turning into a bird.
Roc?
No, it was Luoyu, one of the thirty-six Divine Beasts.
After so many years, Ling Han finally arrived at the third level.

He didn’t disguise himself, and he simply ran over. However, under the effects of the Strange Shadow Steps, even if he walked in front of Saints, it was guaranteed that no one would be able to see him.
Just like that, he boldly entered into Luoyu City.
At first, he only wanted to pass through, but after entering into the city, he discovered that this place was extraordinarily lively.

He listened to the discussions of the masses, and only then did he know that the disciple of the Great Emperor, Jiang Ling, had just returned. It was said that he had harvested a Genesis-level Great Herb. When the news spread out, it made all the people in Luoyu City excited.
This was a Genesis-level Great Herb, so it naturally would cause a commotion.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel a jolt in his heart. If he could snatch this Celestial medicine, wouldn’t he be able to reach the peak stage of Saint Tier?
What a good person.
Hidden in the shadows, he listened to the praises of the masses, and soon found out where Jiang Ling was.
Then, he moved out.
It wasn’t long before the manor of the disciple of the Great Emperor appeared before him.
Ling Han climbed over the wall and entered silently.
Similar to the residences of other disciples of Great Emperors, this manor occupied a large area, but its layout was simple.

Because he couldn’t alert the Great Emperor, Ling Han didn’t even release his divine sense to probe the surroundings. Instead, he retracted his aura and acted like a ghost, using the Strange Shadow Steps.
After spending some time, he finally located Jiang Ling’s location.
This person was presently seated in a cross-legged position, and there was a Celestial medicine placed in front of him.
He was adjusting his condition. Only when he had reached his optimal condition would he consume the Celestial medicine, maximizing its effects.
After all, this was a Genesis-level Celestial medicine, and it was difficult to harvest even a single stalk in tens of thousands of years.
Ling Han smiled. This was really a great help to him.
He quietly set up a formation, imprisoning this area, preventing any commotion from being heard.
Then, he appeared, pushed open the doors and entered.

chapters.title: Chapter 4804: Consummate level of Saint Tier
paragraphs: "You?" Jiang Ling suddenly recovered from his state of calm, his eyes bursting with an astonishing divine light.
He was truly stunned. Someone had actually entered his room, and only now did he come to his senses?
Who was this person, and what cultivation level was he at?
He was too unfamiliar. There was definitely no such person in the city.
"Who allowed you to come in?" He immediately suppressed the fluctuation in his heart. As a dignified Pseudo-Emperor, what did he have to fear?
Ling Han cracked a smile, and pointed at that Celestial medicine, "It."
Anger involuntarily flashed across Jiang Ling’s face. Would a Celestial medicine summon you in?
Are you a Flower Fairy?
In an instant, countless grievances surged in his heart.
"Who are you?" he asked.
"My name is Ling Han," Ling Han said with a smile.
Jiang Ling’s expression instantly changed drastically, "You are Ling Han!"
"Yi, you’ve heard of me?" Ling Han appeared slightly surprised.

"Humph, being able to escape the Great Emperors’ pursuit time and time again, I thought you had three heads and six <anno data-annotation-id="bdd78b5a-eda4-47f1-bd29-70ffb0d8caf8" data-title="arms">arms1</anno>. As it turned out, you are nothing more than this!" Jiang Ling said disdainfully. He could sense Ling Han’s aura; he was clearly a Saint.
He could crush a measly Saint with a single finger.
Being able to repeatedly escape from the hands of Great Emperors, it could only be said that this person’s ability to escape was top-notch.
Ling Han chuckled and said, "My cultivation level is too low. I’m truly sorry about that."
Jiang Ling raised a brow, "You are really arrogant!" He was actually still in the mood to show off at a time like this. Just how confident was this person?
"Ya, isn’t that modesty?" Ling Han scratched his head, and said, "Alright, then I’ll tell the truth. I can deal with trash like you with a single move, so I’m naturally filled with confidence."
Jiang Ling couldn’t help but raise his brow again. "Your cultivation level isn’t high, yet you’re spouting nonsense. Fine, after I capture you, I’d like to see how arrogant you can be!"
He stretched out a hand, and grabbed out at Ling Han.
Pa!

Ling Han sent out a palm strike, and Jiang Ling did not even have the chance to dodge or parry. He was heavily sent flying, and crashed into the wall. Then, he bounced back, and after rolling seven or eight times on the ground, he finally lay still.
The force of this slap was so great that even a groove appeared on the wall, which was a ghastly sight.
However, the structure of heaven and earth in the Primitive Abyss was too sturdy. Even such a heavy impact did not destroy the rooms.
Jiang Ling was dizzy, and everything he saw was blurry. His vision was completely spinning around in circles.
However, a Pseudo-Emperor was a Pseudo-Emperor, after all. In an instant, he bounced up again, faced Ling Han, and assumed a defensive posture.
Ling Han didn’t think much of it, and said with a smile, "How about it? I’m strong enough, right? Can I do as I please?"
How arrogant!

However, Jiang Ling had completely lost his fighting spirit. Whether he was skilled or not, he would know with a single try. He didn’t even know how Ling Han attacked, and he had already collapsed. Just how wide was the gap in strength between them?
He finally knew that the fact that Ling Han could repeatedly escape from the hands of the Great Emperors was not only because of luck, but also because of his abilities.
He glanced at the door. As long as he rushed out, he would be saved.
It should be known that this was the Luoyu City, where there was a Great Emperor overseeing things.
No matter how strong you were, could you be stronger than a Great Emperor?
Sou, he immediately rushed out.
Yet Ling Han merely smiled, and made no move to stop him.
Haha, then just wait to die.
Jiang Ling broke into a grin, "Ling Han, you are arrogant—"
Peng!
He suddenly crashed into a wall of air, and then was immediately bounced back. However, cracks also began to appear on the wall of air, and it slowly crumbled.
This was a restriction that Ling Han had set up. It could block a Pseudo-Emperor. However, being crashed into by a Pseudo-Emperor like this, the restriction was also immediately destroyed.
After all, he was a Pseudo-Emperor, so how could he be so weak?
However, Ling Han had already moved. Pa, a palm strike descended, incredibly heavy.

Jiang Ling was forcefully imprisoned, and he felt as if he couldn’t even move a single finger. In fact, his divine sense was also operating at an exceedingly slow pace, and he couldn’t even send out a signal for help.

"What did you say just now?" Ling Han asked with a smile. He pressed down with his palm, completely restricting Jiang Ling’s cultivation level. Then, he picked Jiang Lingup and pressed him onto the ground.
Jiang Ling was speechless, and ten thousand curse words raced through his mind.
—You are so strong, so why didn’t you just directly move to subdue him? Is there any meaning to toying around with others like this?
Ling Han tossed Jiang Ling aside, then looked towards that Celestial medicine, revealing an excited expression.
As long as he refined this Celestial medicine, he would be able to cultivate Saint Tier to consummate level.
"Thank you," he said to Jiang Ling.
’Holy f*ck!’
If it wasn’t for the fact that Jiang Ling’s cultivation level had been sealed, he would definitely have fought Ling Han to the death at this moment.
He had gone too far!

Killing someone was only a matter of having his head touch the <anno data-annotation-id="e8d325f2-8e80-4ba2-b26b-66f7ebb54cc9" data-title="ground">ground1</anno>. You have humiliated him time and time again; you can’t play around like this.
Ling Han picked up the Celestial medicine and washed it with Regulations.
This made Jiang Ling even more depressed. ’Do you think I’m dirty?’
However, when he saw Ling Han begin to chew on the Celestial medicine in large mouthfuls, he felt even worse.
That was something that he had spent a great deal of effort to obtain.
You b@stard!

He forcibly endured it, because he had previously reported to Luoyu Emperor that he would only be in seclusion for three years this time. Thus, if he did not come out of seclusion by then, the Great Emperor would definitely send someone over to check on him.
Humph, by then, you would be in deep trouble.
Of course, the prerequisite was that Ling Han had to stay here long enough.
Ling Han sat down cross-leggedly, and began to refine this Celestial medicine.
Weng, the Genesis Substance surged within his body, and then a streak of great dao surged out from the top of Ling Han’s head.
What!
When Jiang Ling saw this, he couldn’t help but stare in shock and disbelief.
Was that... the Dao of Heaven and Earth?
But why could it surge out of a person’s body?
They had both ingested Genesis-level Celestial medicines, so why had such an unusual phenomenon never happened to him before?

The pillar of light soared into the sky, but Ling Han wasn’t worried. Everyone knew that it was Jiang Ling who had ingested the Celestial medicine, so they would definitely think that it was him who had caused this strange phenomenon.
However, seven days later, the Genesis Substance was exhausted, and the Dao of Heaven and Earth disappeared.
True enough, not one person came over.
The disciple of the Great Emperor was presently cultivating in seclusion. Who would dare come and disturb him?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and breathed a long sigh of relief.
99 Regulations formed.
He had finally reached the consummate level of the Silent Destruction Tier. Meanwhile, he had only experienced five times of Silent Destruction. This was definitely unprecedented.

Theoretically speaking, he was a Five-Star Saint, but had the ability to suppress all Pseudo-Emperors with battle prowess, and once he became a Pseudo-Emperor, he would directly reach the level of five stars. This was like a dream.
"Now that I am here, it’s truly begun."

Ling Han’s gaze was resolute. Ahead of him was a group of Great Emperors. If he didn’t cultivate to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, he wouldn’t even be qualified to match them, so how could he stop them?
Again!
He was still in seclusion, continuing to break through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor.
As long as he could cultivate to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, so what if he was discovered by the Luoyu Emperor? He was completely capable of facing him head-on.
Seeing that Ling Han was still in seclusion, Jiang Ling couldn’t help but sneer.

’Very good, very good. You can continue to waste your time like this. As long as you delay it until the deadline of three years, you will be discovered. At that time, when the Great Emperor makes his move, who knows how terrible your fate would be.’
He waited and waited. In fact, he was even a little excited, and hoped that this day would come soon.

I’m truly sorry about that."
Jiang Ling raised a brow, "You are really arrogant!" He was actually still in the mood to show off at a time like this.
Just how confident was this person?
"Ya, isn’t that modesty?" Ling Han scratched his head, and said, "Alright, then I’ll tell the truth.
I can deal with trash like you with a single move, so I’m naturally filled with confidence."
Jiang Ling couldn’t help but raise his brow again.
"Your cultivation level isn’t high, yet you’re spouting nonsense.
Fine, after I capture you, I’d like to see how arrogant you can be!"
He stretched out a hand, and grabbed out at Ling Han.
Pa!
Ling Han sent out a palm strike, and Jiang Ling did not even have the chance to dodge or parry.
He was heavily sent flying, and crashed into the wall.
Then, he bounced back, and after rolling seven or eight times on the ground, he finally lay still.
The force of this slap was so great that even a groove appeared on the wall, which was a ghastly sight.
However, the structure of heaven and earth in the Primitive Abyss was too sturdy.
Even such a heavy impact did not destroy the rooms.
Jiang Ling was dizzy, and everything he saw was blurry.
His vision was completely spinning around in circles.
However, a Pseudo-Emperor was a Pseudo-Emperor, after all.
In an instant, he bounced up again, faced Ling Han, and assumed a defensive posture.
Ling Han didn’t think much of it, and said with a smile, "How about it?
I’m strong enough, right?
Can I do as I please?"
How arrogant!
However, Jiang Ling had completely lost his fighting spirit.
Whether he was skilled or not, he would know with a single try.
He didn’t even know how Ling Han attacked, and he had already collapsed.
Just how wide was the gap in strength between them?
He finally knew that the fact that Ling Han could repeatedly escape from the hands of the Great Emperors was not only because of luck, but also because of his abilities.
He glanced at the door.
As long as he rushed out, he would be saved.
It should be known that this was the Luoyu City, where there was a Great Emperor overseeing things.
No matter how strong you were, could you be stronger than a Great Emperor?
Sou, he immediately rushed out.
Yet Ling Han merely smiled, and made no move to stop him.
Haha, then just wait to die.
Jiang Ling broke into a grin, "Ling Han, you are arrogant—"
Peng!
He suddenly crashed into a wall of air, and then was immediately bounced back.
However, cracks also began to appear on the wall of air, and it slowly crumbled.
This was a restriction that Ling Han had set up.
It could block a Pseudo-Emperor.
However, being crashed into by a Pseudo-Emperor like this, the restriction was also immediately destroyed.
After all, he was a Pseudo-Emperor, so how could he be so weak?
However, Ling Han had already moved.
Pa, a palm strike descended, incredibly heavy.
Jiang Ling was forcefully imprisoned, and he felt as if he couldn’t even move a single finger.
In fact, his divine sense was also operating at an exceedingly slow pace, and he couldn’t even send out a signal for help.
"What did you say just now?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
He pressed down with his palm, completely restricting Jiang Ling’s cultivation level.
Then, he picked Jiang Lingup and pressed him onto the ground.
Jiang Ling was speechless, and ten thousand curse words raced through his mind.
—You are so strong, so why didn’t you just directly move to subdue him?
Is there any meaning to toying around with others like this?
Ling Han tossed Jiang Ling aside, then looked towards that Celestial medicine, revealing an excited expression.
As long as he refined this Celestial medicine, he would be able to cultivate Saint Tier to consummate level.
"Thank you," he said to Jiang Ling.
’Holy f*ck!’
If it wasn’t for the fact that Jiang Ling’s cultivation level had been sealed, he would definitely have fought Ling Han to the death at this moment.
He had gone too far!
Killing someone was only a matter of having his head touch the <anno data-annotation-id="e8d325f2-8e80-4ba2-b26b-66f7ebb54cc9" data-title="ground">ground1</anno>.
You have humiliated him time and time again; you can’t play around like this.
Ling Han picked up the Celestial medicine and washed it with Regulations.
This made Jiang Ling even more depressed. ’Do you think I’m dirty?’
However, when he saw Ling Han begin to chew on the Celestial medicine in large mouthfuls, he felt even worse.
That was something that he had spent a great deal of effort to obtain.
You b@stard!
He forcibly endured it, because he had previously reported to Luoyu Emperor that he would only be in seclusion for three years this time.
Thus, if he did not come out of seclusion by then, the Great Emperor would definitely send someone over to check on him.
Humph, by then, you would be in deep trouble.
Of course, the prerequisite was that Ling Han had to stay here long enough.
Ling Han sat down cross-leggedly, and began to refine this Celestial medicine.
Weng, the Genesis Substance surged within his body, and then a streak of great dao surged out from the top of Ling Han’s head.
What!
When Jiang Ling saw this, he couldn’t help but stare in shock and disbelief.
Was that... the Dao of Heaven and Earth?
But why could it surge out of a person’s body?
They had both ingested Genesis-level Celestial medicines, so why had such an unusual phenomenon never happened to him before?
The pillar of light soared into the sky, but Ling Han wasn’t worried.
Everyone knew that it was Jiang Ling who had ingested the Celestial medicine, so they would definitely think that it was him who had caused this strange phenomenon.
However, seven days later, the Genesis Substance was exhausted, and the Dao of Heaven and Earth disappeared.
True enough, not one person came over.
The disciple of the Great Emperor was presently cultivating in seclusion.
Who would dare come and disturb him?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and breathed a long sigh of relief.
99 Regulations formed.
He had finally reached the consummate level of the Silent Destruction Tier.
Meanwhile, he had only experienced five times of Silent Destruction.
This was definitely unprecedented.

Theoretically speaking, he was a Five-Star Saint, but had the ability to suppress all Pseudo-Emperors with battle prowess, and once he became a Pseudo-Emperor, he would directly reach the level of five stars.
This was like a dream.
"Now that I am here, it’s truly begun."
Ling Han’s gaze was resolute.
Ahead of him was a group of Great Emperors.
If he didn’t cultivate to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, he wouldn’t even be qualified to match them, so how could he stop them?
Again!
He was still in seclusion, continuing to break through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor.
As long as he could cultivate to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, so what if he was discovered by the Luoyu Emperor?
He was completely capable of facing him head-on.
Seeing that Ling Han was still in seclusion, Jiang Ling couldn’t help but sneer.
’Very good, very good.
You can continue to waste your time like this.
As long as you delay it until the deadline of three years, you will be discovered.
At that time, when the Great Emperor makes his move, who knows how terrible your fate would be.’
He waited and waited.
In fact, he was even a little excited, and hoped that this day would come soon.

This is a Chinese idiom meaning an action is excessive, crossing limits, or too much.</annotations>

chapters.title: Chapter 4805: Found
paragraphs: One year, two years...
Though Ling Han had just stepped onto the limits of Saint Tier, he definitely did not lack accumulation.

Before this, he had continuously battled with the Great Emperors. Though he had always been on the run, under such heavy pressure, his potential had also been completely unleashed. His battle prowess had similarly been tempered to an incredibly pure level.
He really did not need to accumulate any more experience.

Furthermore, aside from him, a Pseudo-Emperor would be able to break through when he had cultivated about twenty Regulations. Even if it was the Great Emperors of the past, they would only be able to reach thirty Regulations at most, right?
Yet Ling Han had 99 streaks, which was three times more than the Great Emperors of the past.
Just how terrifying was his accumulation?
"From Venerate Tier to Saint Tier, that is the process of Silent Destruction of one’s body, assimilating with heaven and earth."
"However, Saint-level to Pseudo-Emperor is a process of resuscitating the body and becoming a self-contained body."
"For me, this shouldn’t be too difficult."

Even for the past generations of Great Emperors, the step from Saint-level to Pseudo-Emperor-level was something that could not be accomplished without accumulating for a few hundred or a few thousand years.
However, Ling Han was different.
That was because becoming a self-contained body was something that he had long since accomplished.
With the Genesis World inside him, wasn’t this self-contained?
Thus, what he had to do now was to revive his body, which was as simple as that.
However, even if it was only this one step, this was not something that could be resolved in a short while.
Silent Destruction of one’s body was difficult, but recovering his body was even more difficult!
Throughout history, just how many had managed to become Saints? And just how many had managed to become nine-star Saints?
However, compared to the quantity of Pseudo-Emperors, the number of Nine-Star Saints would have to be a hundred times, or even a thousand times more than that, right?
Thus, it was difficult for one’s body to undergo Silent Destruction, and even more difficult to revive it.

Ling Han was extremely calm, and merely focused on reviving his own body. Once he revived, it would trigger a qualitative change, allowing him to advance into the position of Pseudo-Emperor in a single stroke.
There were still nine months.
There were still eight months.
There were still seven months.
And...
Jiang Ling counted the days on the sidelines. Because Ling Han was in a state of ’cultivation’, he didn’t hide it at all, so he saw the holy flame several times.
Green.
This meant that Ling Han was a Five-Star Saint.

He smirked coldly. Though Ling Han’s strength was practically heaven-defying, a Five Star Saint being able to easily subdue a Three Star Pseudo-Emperor like him, if a Pseudo-Emperor compared with a Great Emperor, they were from two completely different worlds.
Thus, as long as the Great Emperor made a move, a Five-Star Saint would be trash.
Soon, the time was getting closer and closer.
Six months, five months... one month.
Three years had passed.
Jiang Ling breathed a sigh of relief, and then a cold smirk appeared at the corners of his lips.
Now, it was possible that someone would come to check on the situation at any time, so, hoho.
As expected, after half a month, someone came to the door.
"Lord Jiang, Lord Jiang," that person called out softly.
However, Jiang Ling could not make any sound, and could only lie down and stare blankly.

However, he was in no hurry. He was sure that this servant was not an idiot. If he did not get a response from him, then even if he did not guess that he had been kidnapped, he would definitely realize that something had happened, such as going mad.
That person called out a few more times, and when he still did not get a response from Jiang Ling, he became a little anxious.
"Lord Jiang, this subordinate is coming in." That person pushed open the doors, and with a creak, the doors were pushed open.
W-what?
When he saw Ling Han sitting cross-legged in his room, and Jiang Ling lying on the ground, that person was shocked. His mouth was half-gaping, and there was no reaction at all.
Jiang Ling was extremely anxious. Idiot, couldn’t you have shouted first?
Right at this moment, Ling Han suddenly opened his eyes. Weng! An incredibly powerful aura surged out. Peng! That person was sent flying.

Jiang Ling was anxious, but after just barely sensing for a while, he discovered that the person who had been sent flying had only fainted temporarily, and had not died. Only then did he he heave a sigh of relief.
Of course, he was not worried about that person, but rather that if the other party had not died, he would be able to quickly spread the news. Otherwise, he would have to wait for a few more days.
Ling Han had no intention of attacking at all, and closed his eyes again.
He had already reached the most crucial moment.
After countless attempts, he directly viewed his body as another Genesis World, reviving his body just like how he had revived the rock golem.
Success was close at hand.
Thus, Ling Han would rather take a risk at this moment than stop.
If he did not grasp this kind of enlightenment, who knew when he would be able to grasp it again.
A whole five days later, that servant that had been knocked unconscious finally regained consciousness. He glanced at the house, and hurriedly broke into a run and fled.
Only when he could no longer sense this person’s aura did Jiang Ling heave a sigh of relief.
Very good, the reinforcements should arrive soon.
True enough, after only a while, a great many people ran over. They were all Saints that were wearing Bronze Battle Armors.
"Who are you? Hurry up and release Lord Jiang!" the Saints roared.

They had only thought that Jiang Ling had been careless in his defense when he had been cultivating in seclusion, and that was why he had been captured by Ling Han. Thus, they were not too wary about Ling Han’s strength.
After all, cultivators were the weakest when they were cultivating.
Ling Han completely ignored them, and merely focused on cultivating.
Jiang Ling watched anxiously from the sidelines. ’You idiots, can’t you save me first?’
Seeing that Ling Han was only sitting in a cross-legged position and not responding, a Saint couldn’t help but take a few steps forwards to test the waters.
Ling Han still had no reaction.
He stepped forward again, again, again. However, Ling Han still didn’t respond.
The Saint became even bolder. He shot forward, and grabbed Jiang Ling. Xiu! He immediately leaped back.
"Charge!" The remaining seven Saints moved in unison. They drew their battle spears, and stabbed them towards Ling Han.

Jiang Ling couldn’t speak, and he naturally couldn’t stop them either. However, he still held onto a sliver of hope that Ling Han was truly immersed in cultivation. His defenses would be weak, and he couldn’t resist at all.
Though this was a little annoying, it was still acceptable to be able to personally witness Ling Han being killed.
Boom!

The seven Saints were dressed in Battle Armors, which boosted their battle prowess by around five stars, and added with the Saint Tool in their hands, the combined power was enough to kill a Pseudo-Emperor who was not resisting.
Pu, pu, pu, pu, seven spears stabbed down at the same time.
Good!
Jiang Ling wanted nothing more than to jump up and applaud. However, his cultivation level had been sealed, so not only was he unable to jump up, he couldn’t even call out ’good’.
He was dead, dead, dead!
However, what followed was a numbing shock. That was because the spears had pierced into Ling Han’s body, yet were completely unable to penetrate through his skin.
F***, what kind of skin do you have, how could you be so thick?
To say nothing of Jiang Ling, the seven Saints who had attacked him were naturally even more stunned. In fact, they even felt a powerful chill rise up in their hearts.
Was the person in front of him... really human?
Why did they feel like it was a primitive great beast? It was only napping now, but the moment it opened its eyes, it could explode with endless killing intent, causing them to die on the spot.
However, they were duty-bound, so how could they retreat now?
They raised their battle spears once more, and once again stabbed down heavily.
Once, twice, thrice. They stabbed endlessly, but the expressions on their faces became more and more fearful.

chapters.title: Chapter 4806: Pseudo-Emperor!
paragraphs: F***, how could there be such a freak?

Stab, stab, stab. At this moment, the seven Saints were all mechanically stabbing the battle spears in their hands. Due to their overwhelming shock, their minds had already gone completely blank. They couldn’t think of anything else.
Weng! Right at this moment, a nine-colored divine light suddenly erupted from Ling Han’s body. It was indescribably dazzling.
Then, an exuberant vitality surged, as if all life had revived.
At this moment, everyone was rendered speechless.
What was going on?
What kind of bizarre phenomenon was this?
Right at this moment, Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open. Nine-colored divine light flickered in his pupils, as if his gaze could penetrate the heaven and earth.
He had a feeling that he was severing his connection with the heaven and earth, becoming a self-contained entity.
Pseudo-Emperor!
No, there was still a slight gap. It was not complete, and he needed to further stimulate it, but at most, it would only take half a day’s time.
Peng!
A battle spear suddenly stabbed down, striking Ling Han’s body.
Ling Han turned around to look. That was a Saint, but his hands were trembling.
"You still haven’t had your fill of stabbing?" he asked.
The Saint’s face had already turned pale, and he said weakly, "My hand slipped."
Really, he was too nervous, and accidentally stabbed out the battle spear.
This infuriated Jiang Ling to death. ’Why are you explaining to him?’
We are enemies, and since we are enemies, so what if we attack you? Do we still need to apologize or give a reason?
This was too humiliating!
Ling Han smiled, "Do you want to continue stabbing?"
"No, no, no. I wouldn’t dare," the Saint hurriedly said with a shake of his head.
"All right, step aside," Ling Han said.
The Saint gave an "oh", and obediently retreated.
"What about you guys?" Ling Han looked towards the other six Saints, his expression calm, without the slightest bit of anger.
Even so, the six Saints were still trembling with fear. They felt that Ling Han’s aura was like that of a Great Emperor, and they didn’t dare to look at him directly.
Involuntarily, they all retreated. Moreover, they didn’t dare to retreat too quickly, as if they were afraid of being disrespectful to Ling Han.
"You guys—" Jiang Ling forced out through gritted teeth. The moment the words left his mouth, he couldn’t help but be startled. Yi, he could speak now?
He raised his hand again. Not only did he raise his hand, but his power was also unbound.
He had recovered the cultivation level of Pseudo-Emperor.
"Ao!" He roared towards the sky, sending a message to Luoyu Emperor, as he looked coldly at Ling Han.

"I have to say, you are really outrageously bold!" he declared, "After snatching my Celestial medicine, you still boldly refined the Celestial medicine here, and actually broke through to become a Six Star Saint!"
"However, the Great Emperor has already received news, and will immediately come out of seclusion to kill you."
"No matter how heaven-defying you are, how can you stand against a Great Emperor while you yourself are only a Saint?"
Just now, Ling Han’s body was glowing with nine-colored divine light, and his aura was like an ocean. It was obvious that he had broken through.
In that case, he had only been a five-star Saint previously. If he broke through now, wouldn’t he be a six-star Saint?
Even an idiot could think of this.
What!
When the others heard Jiang Ling’s words, they all paled in shock.
This freakishly powerful guy was actually only a six-star Saint?
This, this, this, who could believe this?
But would the disciple of the Great Emperor speak without thinking?
Weng, right at this moment, an indescribably powerful aura suddenly descended, causing everyone to involuntarily bow.
There were only two exceptions—Ling Han and Jiang Ling.
Jiang Ling was a Pseudo-Emperor. Since he had the word ’Emperor’, he naturally could resist Imperial Might.
A giant fish with wings appeared in the air, exuding an astonishing imperial might.
One of the 36 Divine Beasts, Luoyu Emperor.
"You have broken through to Pseudo-Emperor!" Luoyu Emperor spoke up, his voice booming like thunder.
What!
Everyone was once again numb with shock. This, this, this, this, why was he a Pseudo-Emperor now?
Hadn’t Jiang Ling said that this guy was a six-star Saint?
However, between Pseudo-Emperor and Great Emperor, which would they believe?
The Great Emperor was definitely to be believed.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ling was shocked, humiliated, and confused. He was 100% sure that Ling Han had been a Five-Star Saint before. Then, after breaking through once, shouldn’t he be a Six-Star Saint?
How did he become a Pseudo-Emperor?
Was there anyone that had jumped from a Five-Star Saint to become a Pseudo-Emperor in a single step?
That was impossible.
Without going through the Silent Destruction nine times, how could one possibly come back to life from the brink of death, and advance into the level of Pseudo-Emperor?
However, how could it be that the Great Emperor would speak without thinking?
Thus, Ling Han must be a Pseudo-Emperor.

However, he had just been boasting, saying that Ling Han was only a six-star Saint, and there was no way he could match the Great Emperor. But in the blink of an eye, the Great Emperor had personally proven that Ling Han was a Pseudo-Emperor.
Just how painful was this slap to his face?
However, so what if he was a Pseudo-Emperor? With the word "Pseudo", how could he possibly be a match for a real Great Emperor?

Ling Han smiled slightly, and shook his head, "I am still a sliver away from the level of Pseudo-Emperor. Why don’t you go back first, and come back later? I should be a complete Pseudo-Emperor by then."
He had already revived a portion of his body, but it was not complete yet. Thus, his present state was very delicate, somewhere between the Saint Tier and Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
But at most, in less than half a day, he would become a real Pseudo-Emperor.
"Do you think that I will give you such an opportunity?" Luoyu Emperor smirked coldly.
Ling Han smiled, "Why not? You are a Great Emperor, so what would you be afraid of?"
"Humph, fancy words!" Luoyu Emperor did not waste any more words. With a flap of his wings, xiu, xiu, xiu, countless streaks of light descended towards Ling Han.
These were scales, and there were nine-star Regulations entwined around each scale. These were the supreme Regulations that could crush all life.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and shot out a punch at the skies.
This punch was entwined with 99 flashes of Regulations, as well as an indescribable power.
Peng!
The power of the punch soared, and a jaw-dropping scene appeared. Scales shattered one after another, fluttering in the air.
Under the attack of Luoyu Emperor, all the buildings on the ground were destroyed. However, the area where Ling Han was standing was completely unaffected.
It was his punch that had dispersed the attack that this area had sustained.
Hiss!
Everyone couldn’t help but inhale sharply, revealing expressions of complete disbelief.
The Great Emperor had made his move, yet he had actually failed?
’F*ck!’
Jiang Ling directly cursed. It could be said that he had exchanged blows with Ling Han before. However, he was 100% sure that Ling Han definitely hadn’t been this strong back then.
This guy... had really directly jumped from a Five Star Saint to a become a Pseudo-Emperor.
Heavens! Heavens! Heavens!
"Humph!" Luoyu Emperor attacked again. Xiu, xiu, xiu! More fish scales fell from the sky, and their might was even more domineering.
This time, Luoyu Emperor was finally getting serious.
Ling Han roared loudly, and Destructive Energy and light of great dao channeled at the same time, greeting the incoming attack.
Peng, peng, peng! The attacks that filled the sky all disappeared, but Ling Han was also gritting his teeth, feeling immense pressure.
He was still no match for Luoyu Emperor.

If he had to rank his strength, then Imperial Weapon would be the weakest grade. The unawakened Lords of Death would be the second last grade, followed by the 36 Divine Beasts and the strongest would be the awakened Lords of Death.
Ling Han was presently in the weakest level, which was about the same level as the Imperial Weapon.
Was that weak?

sentences.text: F***, how could there be such a freak?
Stab, stab, stab.
At this moment, the seven Saints were all mechanically stabbing the battle spears in their hands.
Due to their overwhelming shock, their minds had already gone completely blank.
They couldn’t think of anything else.
Weng!
Right at this moment, a nine-colored divine light suddenly erupted from Ling Han’s body.
It was indescribably dazzling.
Then, an exuberant vitality surged, as if all life had revived.
At this moment, everyone was rendered speechless.
What was going on?
What kind of bizarre phenomenon was this?
Right at this moment, Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open.
Nine-colored divine light flickered in his pupils, as if his gaze could penetrate the heaven and earth.
He had a feeling that he was severing his connection with the heaven and earth, becoming a self-contained entity.
Pseudo-Emperor!
No, there was still a slight gap.
It was not complete, and he needed to further stimulate it, but at most, it would only take half a day’s time.
Peng!
A battle spear suddenly stabbed down, striking Ling Han’s body.
Ling Han turned around to look.
That was a Saint, but his hands were trembling.
"You still haven’t had your fill of stabbing?" he asked.
The Saint’s face had already turned pale, and he said weakly, "My hand slipped."
Really, he was too nervous, and accidentally stabbed out the battle spear.
This infuriated Jiang Ling to death. ’Why are you explaining to him?’
We are enemies, and since we are enemies, so what if we attack you?
Do we still need to apologize or give a reason?
This was too humiliating!
Ling Han smiled, "Do you want to continue stabbing?"
"No, no, no.
I wouldn’t dare," the Saint hurriedly said with a shake of his head.
"All right, step aside," Ling Han said.
The Saint gave an "oh", and obediently retreated.
"What about you guys?" Ling Han looked towards the other six Saints, his expression calm, without the slightest bit of anger.
Even so, the six Saints were still trembling with fear.
They felt that Ling Han’s aura was like that of a Great Emperor, and they didn’t dare to look at him directly.
Involuntarily, they all retreated.
Moreover, they didn’t dare to retreat too quickly, as if they were afraid of being disrespectful to Ling Han.
"You guys—" Jiang Ling forced out through gritted teeth.
The moment the words left his mouth, he couldn’t help but be startled.
Yi, he could speak now?
He raised his hand again.
Not only did he raise his hand, but his power was also unbound.
He had recovered the cultivation level of Pseudo-Emperor.
"Ao!" He roared towards the sky, sending a message to Luoyu Emperor, as he looked coldly at Ling Han.

"I have to say, you are really outrageously bold!" he declared, "After snatching my Celestial medicine, you still boldly refined the Celestial medicine here, and actually broke through to become a Six Star Saint!"
"However, the Great Emperor has already received news, and will immediately come out of seclusion to kill you."
"No matter how heaven-defying you are, how can you stand against a Great Emperor while you yourself are only a Saint?"
Just now, Ling Han’s body was glowing with nine-colored divine light, and his aura was like an ocean.
It was obvious that he had broken through.
In that case, he had only been a five-star Saint previously.
If he broke through now, wouldn’t he be a six-star Saint?
Even an idiot could think of this.
What!
When the others heard Jiang Ling’s words, they all paled in shock.
This freakishly powerful guy was actually only a six-star Saint?
This, this, this, who could believe this?
But would the disciple of the Great Emperor speak without thinking?
Weng, right at this moment, an indescribably powerful aura suddenly descended, causing everyone to involuntarily bow.
There were only two exceptions—Ling Han and Jiang Ling.
Jiang Ling was a Pseudo-Emperor.
Since he had the word ’Emperor’, he naturally could resist Imperial Might.
A giant fish with wings appeared in the air, exuding an astonishing imperial might.
One of the 36 Divine Beasts, Luoyu Emperor.
"You have broken through to Pseudo-Emperor!" Luoyu Emperor spoke up, his voice booming like thunder.
What!
Everyone was once again numb with shock.
This, this, this, this, why was he a Pseudo-Emperor now?
Hadn’t Jiang Ling said that this guy was a six-star Saint?
However, between Pseudo-Emperor and Great Emperor, which would they believe?
The Great Emperor was definitely to be believed.
Meanwhile, Jiang Ling was shocked, humiliated, and confused.
He was 100% sure that Ling Han had been a Five-Star Saint before.
Then, after breaking through once, shouldn’t he be a Six-Star Saint?
How did he become a Pseudo-Emperor?
Was there anyone that had jumped from a Five-Star Saint to become a Pseudo-Emperor in a single step?
That was impossible.
Without going through the Silent Destruction nine times, how could one possibly come back to life from the brink of death, and advance into the level of Pseudo-Emperor?
However, how could it be that the Great Emperor would speak without thinking?
Thus, Ling Han must be a Pseudo-Emperor.
However, he had just been boasting, saying that Ling Han was only a six-star Saint, and there was no way he could match the Great Emperor.
But in the blink of an eye, the Great Emperor had personally proven that Ling Han was a Pseudo-Emperor.
Just how painful was this slap to his face?
However, so what if he was a Pseudo-Emperor?
With the word "Pseudo", how could he possibly be a match for a real Great Emperor?

Why don’t you go back first, and come back later?
I should be a complete Pseudo-Emperor by then."

Thus, his present state was very delicate, somewhere between the Saint Tier and Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
But at most, in less than half a day, he would become a real Pseudo-Emperor.

With a flap of his wings, xiu, xiu, xiu, countless streaks of light descended towards Ling Han.
These were scales, and there were nine-star Regulations entwined around each scale.
These were the supreme Regulations that could crush all life.

This punch was entwined with 99 flashes of Regulations, as well as an indescribable power.

chapters.title: Chapter 4807: Battling the Great Emperor
paragraphs: In terms of Ling Han’s expectations, this was a little weak. After all, he was still unable to truly stand against the Great Emperor.
However, from any person’s point of view, Ling Han’s strength was unreasonable.
He had just advanced into the level of Pseudo-Emperor, and could just barely match a Great Emperor already. What justice was there left in this world?
However, Ling Han wasn’t disappointed, because... his revival wasn’t over yet. His abilities could still be improved.

Furthermore, there was another more important point, and that was though Ling Han had touched the threshold of Emperor Tier, because he was in the Primitive Abyss, he was unable to cultivate the Nine Star Regulations.
How was an Emperor so powerful?
Wasn’t it because he had grasped the Nine Star Regulations? This was something that could crush everything.
The Great Emperor’s words were like the decree of heaven and earth. This was the power of the Nine Star Regulations.
Now, Ling Han was unable to come into contact with the Nine Star Regulations, so he was naturally unable to grasp it either, which led to him, a Pseudo-Emperor, being slightly weaker.
It didn’t matter. As long as he stabilized his cultivation level and grasped the Nine Star Regulations, even if it was just a little bit, his strength would still experience a leap.
At that time, he may be able to leap into the third level, and match a Lord of Death who had not awakened yet.
Furthermore, even if Ling Han had really advanced into Pseudo-Emperor Tier, that would still only be Five Stars, so there was still a lot of room for improvement.
If he could beat up a Great Emperor just by being a middle level Pseudo-Emperor, hoho, then a Great Emperor Spirit was really too cheap.
An overlord could only appear once in an era!
But even if Ling Han was no match for the Great Emperor, just the fact that he could fight back and survive was already enough to make everyone go numb with shock. They could not believe this.
Heavens, what kind of monster was this?

Luoyu Emperor unleashed a barrage of attacks, unleashing the full might of the Great Emperor. However, Ling Han’s battle prowess was extraordinary, and his physique was also powerful. He could definitely hold on for a very, very long time.
By this time, Ling Han finally possessed the strength to face the Great Emperor head-on, though he was still at a disadvantage.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
A great battle broke out between the two characters with Emperor-level battle prowess. Even with the strength of this city, it was still on the verge of collapse.

This could withstand the shockwaves of Pseudo-Emperor-level battles. In fact, under the direct bombardment, it would only be the matter of breaking one or two walls, at most. However, against genuine Emperor Tier-level battle prowess, it was completely useless.
Emperor, the strongest in the world!
The shockwave rolled over mercilessly, and one after another, buildings collapsed, destroying everything in their path.

Logically speaking, the strength of Luoyu Emperor far surpassed Ling Han. At that time, when the True Dragon Emperor moved, he practically beat up the Lord of Death. Now, Ling Han’s strength was inferior to the unawakened Lord of Death, so he was even less of a match for Luoyu Emperor.

In theory, that was indeed the case, but Ling Han had grasped the Destructive Energy and light of great dao. Even against a Great Emperor, this was still a great deterrent. Added with the fact that Luoyu Emperor also knew that Ling Han still had the Cold Water of Death in his possession, he also had to distance himself from Ling Han, and did not dare to force him too far.

This gave Ling Han enough space to move around. Furthermore, as time passed, he was getting closer and closer to becoming a real Pseudo-Emperor, and his abilities were naturally steadily improving, so his condition was also naturally steadying.
Thus, a miracle that had never happened before in history happened.
A Pseudo-Emperor could match a Great Emperor, and did not did in a head-on confrontation!
Heavens!
Everyone was watching dumbly. All of them were numb with shock, their minds blank.
Boom, boom, boom, the whole city was collapsing.
Ling Han felt extremely pleased. Now that things had come to this, he finally no longer had to fear anyone.
Even if he was still no match for his opponents in terms of battle prowess, there was already no need for him to be able to only flee in disarray when he encountered them.
However, after only two days, a powerful aura swept over.
Another Great Emperor had arrived.
The Divine Beast, Jiaodan, belonging to the third level.
Boom! The moment the new Great Emperor appeared, he immediately launched an attack at Ling Han without saying another word.
Two Great Emperors had appeared!

No matter how freakish Ling Han was, he had only just advanced into Pseudo-Emperor-level, and his cultivation level hadn’t even stabilized yet, so how could he possibly stand against two Great Emperors?
Thus, he did not hesitate any longer, and directly turned around and fled.
When he stabilized his cultivation level and cultivated the Nine Star Regulations, he would truly be able to compete with the Great Emperor.
Retreat.

The two Great Emperors set off in pursuit at the same time. However, after advancing into the position of Pseudo-Emperor, the extreme speed brought by Phoenix Wings Divine Flight also soared to another level. In fact, he was actually slightly faster than these two Great Emperors.
Thus, as soon as Ling Han broke out of the siege, though the two Great Emperors pursued him relentlessly, the distance between them and Ling Han was widening.
Unless a storm of heaven and earth appeared, it was absolutely impossible for them to catch up to Ling Han.
Unfortunately, this kind of thing did not happen.
It wasn’t long before they lost Ling Han.
Ling Han stopped, found a place, and continued his seclusion.
He needed to completely stabilize his cultivation level.
In less than half a day, a part of Ling Han’s body was completely revived.
A Five-Star Pseudo Emperor!
This breakthrough brought him directly to the level of Five Star Pseudo-Emperor. Throughout history, Ling Han should be the only one.
He did not rush to stand up, but rather continued to sit in a cross-legged position, because he had discovered a very big problem.
Er, perhaps it should not be called a problem.
When a Saint reached Pseudo-Emperor Tier, his body that had gone through Silent Destruction would awaken, and correspondingly, the holy flame would also be extinguished.
This wasn’t a regression, but rather a complete fusion of the holy flame and his body, further improving his battle prowess.

It should be known that as the Saint approached step by step, and his body went through Silent Destruction, this was actually nurturing and strengthening the holy flame. Thus, when the holy flame completely fused with his body, it would naturally increase his own strength greatly.
However, Ling Han’s holy flame was still there.
Yi?

No, it shouldn’t be said that the holy flame was still there. He was certain that he had indeed extracted the energy of the holy flame and fused it with himself. However, there was a part that could not be fused with him.
Was this because this was the Seed of the Holy Flame?
Ling Han waved his hand. Boom! The holy flame started to burn on his fist. However, this time, he didn’t feel any signs of the holy flame decreasing.
In other words, this was an endless supply, and could be channeled continuously.
Then, with the addition of Destructive Energy and light of great dao, how much might would he be able to unleash?

With a thought from Ling Han, he channelled out the Destructive Energy and the light of great dao. Now, he could cast his trump cards without any scruples. Just how terrifying could their might reach?
Ah!
When Destructive Energy was used, a strange thing happened. It actually fused with the holy flame.
In an instant, the initially green holy flame immediately turned black.
No, no, no. This was not black, but rather more like darkness itself, representing endless destruction.
Ling Han could clearly sense that the fused Destructive Energy had become even more terrifying.
It seemed to be even purer.

Ling Han pondered for a moment, and thought that the Seed of the Holy Flame and the Destructive Energy should come from the same source. Thus, they could be fused together, and after fusing, they would also be closer to the source, and only then would their might become stronger.
This kind of source was... Destruction!
Ling Han suddenly recalled that the Dao of Heaven and Earth was actually formed from four foundations—creation, destruction, life, and death.
Now, could it be that what he had grasped was the element of destruction in the foundation stones of heaven and earth?
