chapters.title: Chapter 4808: Arrival
paragraphs: This kind of energy was entwined around Ling Han’s hand. He lightly touched the ground, and wherever he passed, a groove would immediately appear in the ground.
And in this process, Ling Han actually didn’t use any power himself. He simply pressed down casually.
Such terrifying corrosive power!
No, this shouldn’t be called corrosive power, because corrosion would turn an object into liquid or gas, but this was only a change in physical form.
And with the new version of Destructive Energy, it directly turned objects into nothing, as if they had disappeared into thin air.
Creation corresponded to... destruction!
What kind of power was this?
En, this had already surpassed the range of power, and had also surpassed Regulations. Instead, it was a foundation stone of heaven and earth, a key element.
Ling Han was a little excited. This should be an ability that even a Great Emperor could not grasp, and now, he could use it even before he had become a Great Emperor.

He had a feeling that this was still not the strongest power of the "essence" of destruction. It was like a main branch that had many forks. Only by obtaining all the forks would he be able to piece together the appearance of the main branch.
Destructive Energy Energy and Seed of the Holy Flame were both two of these branches.

Ling Han couldn’t help but think. The Stone of Life and Destructive Energy should have been created by the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others, while the Seed of Holy Flame had been obtained from Empress Qing Zhu. The similarity between these different elements were that they all originated from the Primitive Abyss, and were all meant to resolve the great crisis of this era.
In other words, ordinary Great Emperors would no longer be able to suppress the darkness. They would have to become even stronger!
Ling Han nodded. Though he had never thought of himself as a hero, at this kind of moment, he had to step out bravely, and shoulder his responsibilities.
"Now... let’s continue forward!"
He stood up, and gazed into the distance.
He wanted to pass through these levels and enter into the core area of the Primitive Abyss. He wanted to find the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others.
He wanted to know who the enemy of the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others was.

Moreover, there were no Regulations of heaven and earth here, so Ling Han wanted to obtain some Genesis Substance as well. He wanted to comprehend the Nine Star Regulations and elevate his battle prowess to another level.
Even if he couldn’t comprehend the Nine Star Regulations, allowing him to awaken a portion of his body, reaching Six Star or Seven Star Pseudo-Emperor would still be good.
Ling Han believed that if he became a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor, he wouldn’t be inferior to the Divine Beast Emperors, at least. His battle prowess would be enough to soar into the second level.
This time, he did not circle around. Even if he encountered the Great Emperors again, he would still be able to confront it head-on, and retreat calmly.
Since he was at the level of Emperor, wouldn’t it be easy for him to leave?
However, in the Primitive Abyss, the Great Emperor was definitely not the greatest threat.
It was the storm of heaven and earth.

In just a few days, a storm fell without any prior warning. Even if Ling Han already had battle prowess on par with a Great Emperor, he could only defend with all his might in the face of such a natural storm, and search for a place of protection.
This was too terrifying. Every drop of rainwater was extraordinarily heavy, causing Ling Han to cry out in pain.
He could only summon the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, to protect himself within.
For the moment, he was still unable to compete with the Origin Gold in physique.
While dodging the wind and rain, Ling Han continued to temper the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
He already possessed the cultivation level of a Great Emperor, so could he upgrade the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to become a genuine Imperial Weapon?

However, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was not versed in Destructive Energy, nor could it grasp the light of great dao. Without these two factors, even if the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower barely possessed Emperor-level battle prowess, it still belonged to the bottom tier of Imperial Weapons.
"Even if I have grasped a sliver of the Nine Star Regulations, because there is only a sliver, I am still unable to fully unleash the might of the Origin Gold. Its might is still limited."
"This is enough to suppress Pseudo-Emperors, but it is still a bit lacking against Great Emperors."

It should be known that the Imperial Weapon was only ranked fourth in terms of Emperor-level battle prowess, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower’s might was the weakest among the Imperial Weapons, so it was definitely even weaker.

"Unless there is enough Metal of Creation, and when I become a Great Emperor, I can upgrade the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to become a Transcendent Weapon. Then, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower will complement me, and can be considered the best partner."
This kind of fateful opportunity could only be obtained from the core of the Primitive Abyss.

Using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he was at least ten times faster than before.

This was the Primitive Abyss, so where did so many architects come from?
Ling Han clasped his hands behind his back and strolled forward.
Undoubtedly, this was the time for him to show off.
Unfortunately, the big doggy and the others were not here.
Sigh, he felt a little regret at having to travel at night in embroidered clothes, with no one to admire his brilliance.

"Who are you?" someone immediately chided. This was a Saint-level guard.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I’m here to crash the party."
W-what?
The guard faltered, completely stupefied.
This was a place where the Great Emperor was keeping watch, and you have come to crash the party?
’I really don’t know whether you’re brave or stupid.’
"Who exactly are you!" the guard reiterated loudly.
Ling Han pointed at himself and said, "Logically speaking, I should be very famous by now. Why do I still need to introduce myself?"

"Disciple of a Great Emperor?" The guard followed Ling Han’s words. After all, Ling Han wasn’t wearing any armor, yet he could still come from outside the city. It was clear that his cultivation level was Pseudo-Emperor-level.
Ling Han shook his head, "Wrong."
He couldn’t be bothered to waste his breath. With a tap of his finger, peng, the entire city gate was instantly sent flying.
Boom! Terrifying explosions rang out repeatedly, and the city walls also collapsed one after another, fully displaying the might of Emperor Tier.
"How, how dare you!" That guard called out loudly, but his voice was trembling.
Heavens, what kind of terrifying power was this?
Xiu, xiu, xiu. Multiple figures flew out of the city, landing at the city gates.
Yi, there was no Great Emperor?
Ling Han found this strange. It seemed like every time something happened, the Great Emperor would be the last to arrive.
Of course, this was unless he used his divine sense to alert the Great Emperor.
What did the Divine Beast Emperors usually do? Sleeping?
"Who are you?" A young man walked out. His aura was clearly not obvious, but he had an indescribable domineering aura, that others would revere.
Pseudo-Emperor!
He was the disciple of the Great Emperor of this place, Zhuang Xueshi.
"Me?" Ling Han smiled faintly, "Ling Han."

"You are Ling Han!" Zhuang Xueshi was first stunned, then looked pleasantly surprised, "Hahaha, all the Great Emperors have searched everywhere for you. I never thought that you would actually walk right into a trap."
"Er, isn’t your news a bit behind schedule?" Ling Han was a little depressed. He clearly had Emperor Tier battle prowess, so why was he still looked down on by others?
These Divine Beast Emperors were really too much. They did not even help him spread out the information. Wasn’t that deliberately asking him to show off?
But it was also very boring to keep showing off.
In this instant, Ling Han’s mind was very active.

Such terrifying corrosive power!

chapters.title: Chapter 4809: True Phoenix City
paragraphs: "Since you’re already here, there’s no need for you to leave," Zhuang Xueshi said calmly.
He was not just saying this. He stretched out a hand, and grabbed out at Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, "Do you know the consequences of disrespecting an Emperor?"
"Humph, we’re both Pseudo-Emperors, so what do I have to fear?" Zhuang Xueshi said disdainfully.
According to the information he knew, Ling Han had Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, and to him, didn’t Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess mean that he was a Pseudo-Emperor?
Could it be that a Saint could also possess Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess?
Hehe, what a joke.
Boom, the large hand formed by Regulations had already grabbed onto Ling Han. All five fingers were made up of eight-star Regulations, but there was also a thin line of nine-star Regulations.

Don’t underestimate this nine-star Regulations that was as thin as a hair. It was precisely because of its existence that a Pseudo-Emperor had surpassed the Saint Tier, and could claim the title of "Emperor".

"Haha, nothing more than this!" Zhuang Xueshi had already grabbed hold of Ling Han, and couldn’t help but laugh loudly. This kind of idiot actually caused the Great Emperors to fail to catch him time and time again?
Er, he really did not know what was going on with those Great Emperors.
"As expected of Lord Zhuang!"
"Lord Zhuang is mighty!"
"Haha, in front of our Lord Zhuang, even those heaven-defying freaks have to bow down."
The people in the area were all sucking up to him. However, this was a Pseudo-Emperor with overwhelming battle prowess.Their praise was no exaggeration.
Ling Han also waved his hands and began clapping. Pa, pa, pa! The sound was crisp and clear.
This!
Everyone thought that this person was a little crazy. You are a prisoner, so why are you joining in on the excitement?
"Yi, did I cause the silence?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
"Humph, you still dare to speak cheekily?" Zhuang Xueshi smirked coldly. His fingers tightened, wanting to give Ling Han a little suffering.
Peng! However, as he clenched his hand, cold sweat immediately appeared on his forehead.
That was because the five fingers that he had manifested had all shattered!
What!
This scene was naturally seen by the others as well. All of them looked stunned, completely unable to believe their eyes.
How was this possible?
Hadn’t Ling Han already been restrained?
But why had Zhuang Xueshi’s fingers been broken?
Though they was only manifested from Regulations.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Are you very surprised?"
"You—" Zhuang Xueshi frowned. This was something that he could not imagine. How could a Pseudo-Emperor Pthat was the same as him be so strong?
"Sigh!" Ling Han sighed. He summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and casually smashed it onto Zhuang Xueshi’s body.

"Ah!" Zhuang Xueshi released a terrible scream, and instantly sprawled out on the ground. He wanted to get up, but the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was extraordinarily heavy, and he couldn’t turn over at all.

It should be known that the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was already an Imperial Weapon, and with the Imperial Weapon closing in on him from such a close distance, would a Pseudo-Emperor be able to make a comeback?
What a joke.
This!
Everyone’s scalps went numb, and they were extremely confused.
There was only a tower pressing down on Zhuang Xueshi’s back, so why couldn’t he turn the tables?
Hiss, who exactly was this guy?
Zhuang Xueshi was both furious and shocked, but more than that, he was terrified.
This opponent was simply unbelievably strong!
He had no choice but to send out a wave of divine sense to ask for help from the Great Emperor.
Weng, suddenly, a frightening aura swept over, causing reverence to rise up from deep within one’s bones.
The Divine Beast Emperor finally appeared.
Ling Han glanced over, and only then did he know which Divine Beast was standing guard here.
Heaven Breaker.

"I never thought that you would still dare to run here!" the Heaven Breaker Emperor said calmly. With a flap of his wings, he lashed out at Ling Han. The Nine Star Regulations entwined around him, and this attack was indescribably terrifying.
After all, this was the second level.
Ling Han raised his fist to parry. He wanted to test out the might of the new version of Destructive Energy.
Peng!
The two parties with Emperor Tier battle prowess clashed, and Ling Han was instantly sent flying. However, the tail of the Heaven Breaker Emperor was also missing!
This... everyone’s heads were about to explode from watching.
That was a Great Emperor, and he had actually been wounded!
Though his injuries weren’t severe, and couldn’t even be considered serious, it was still shocking.
Who had ever seen a Great Emperor wounded before?
Moreover, the one who had wounded the Great Emperor... was actually a Pseudo-Emperor.
Since when did a Pseudo-Emperor become a match for a Great Emperor?
Meanwhile, Zhuang Xueshi was directly stunned. Only now did he know why he couldn’t even block a single move from Ling Han.
—It would be strange if he could block a single move from Ling Han, whose battle prowess was Emperor Tier-level.
The Heaven Breaker Emperor frowned, and said, "Damn it! You’ve actually mastered a portion of the element of destruction!"
"These damn old guys, always causing trouble!"
He roared loudly, and continued to attack Ling Han. However, this time, he deliberately increased the distance between them, and no longer engaged in close-quarter combat with Ling Han.
It was fine. With how strong the Great Emperor was, even if there was some distance between them, its might was still overwhelming. It could easily suppress a Pseudo-Emperor.
Unfortunately, though Ling Han’s cultivation level was Pseudo-Emperor-level, Ling Han’s battle prowess was Great Emperor-level.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ling Han continued to block the chaotic attacks of the Heaven Breaker Emperor. Although he was at a disadvantage, the situation wasn’t too dire.
After all, even the Heaven Breaker Emperor was wary of his power of destruction. In fact, there was still the Cold Water of Death.
Ling Han frowned, and beckoned with his hand, "Come!"
Weng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower instantly flew into the air, unleashing blazing white lightning at Heaven Breaker Emperor.
Now, it was equivalent to the combined attack of two Great Emperors.

However, the strength of these two Great Emperors was too weak. They both had battle prowess at the fourth and third levels. Even if the two of them worked together, they were still no match for the Heaven Breaker Emperor. They only managed to turn the tables slightly.
Ling Han shook his head. He couldn’t do this, as his abilities hadn’t been greatly boosted. He was still unable to fully oppose the Divine Beast Emperor.
It was the second level, after all.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and began to break out of the siege.
"You can’t escape!" Heaven Breaker Emperor said in a baleful voice as he set off in pursuit.
"Haha, if you’re dissatisfied, just come and chase me," Ling Han said with a smile. Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was used, and his speed was astonishingly fast.
Though the Heaven Breaker Emperor was in pursuit, the distance between him and Ling Han was getting larger and larger.
In the end, he could only stop reluctantly.
He stood still and motionless, but his eyelids were trembling slightly, exuding an unknown fluctuation, capable of communicating with an endless distance.
Ling Han walked forwards, looking everywhere for Genesis Substance.

As long as he obtained some more Genesis Substance and the great dao reappeared, he would be able to extract the Nine Star Regulations from within. Then, his battle prowess would soar, and he may even be able to advance into the level of Six Star Pseudo-Emperor.
Unfortunately, Genesis Substance was pitifully rare, and he was fully focused on charging forward, so how could he possibly find it?
After passing through one area after another, experiencing all kinds of storms of heaven and earth, Ling Han broke through the third level and arrived in front of the first city of the fourth level.
"True Phoenix!" Ling Han looked ahead in surprise. A city that looked like a phoenix that was spreading its wings and soaring high was presently standing tall.
Er, would he encounter the True Phoenix here?
He couldn’t help but think that if he encountered the True Phoenix Emperor, he would be no match for the True Phoenix in terms of mastery of Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
After all, it was the True Phoenix that had created the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
If he was detained by the True Phoenix Emperor, and then sandwiched by the other Divine Beast Emperors, that would not be a good thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 4810: Encountering Emperor’s corpse again
paragraphs: Yi?
Just as Ling Han was considering how he should pass through this True Phoenix City, he saw two people dressed in Bronze Battle Armor walk out of the city.
After a while, these two people had already arrived near him.
Ling Han coughed, and jumped down from a large rock.
"You—" The two of them got a scare, then immediately became respectful, and clasped their hands together, "Greetings, Lord!"
To be able to travel in the wild without wearing a Battle Armor, this must be a Pseudo-Emperor.
Disciple of a Great Emperor?
Ling Han smiled and said, "Take off your Battle Armor."
Ah!
The two of them were very confused. What was going on?
’You’re the disciple of a Great Emperor, so what do you need Battle Armor for?’
Thankfully, neither of them thought that Ling Han was a pervert.
"Lord, without the Battle Armor, we won’t be able to withstand the extreme weight of this place at all. We’ll die," a Saint said weakly.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "My name is Ling Han, an outsider. I need your Battle Armor to sneak into the city."
The two Saints looked at each other, shock on their faces.
Recently, this name called "Ling Han" could be said to have been bombarding their ears. This was a person that the Great Emperors wanted to kill at all costs, which showed how terrifying he was.
And now, this person had actually appeared in front of them, alive and well. How could they not be shocked?
"Run!"

The two of them hurriedly ran in the direction of the True Phoenix City. Even the Great Emperors could not kill this kind of existence, so they naturally were even less qualified to resist. They could only run.
With a single thought from Ling Han, peng, peng! The two Saints collapsed to the ground, dead.

Ling Han walked over and removed their Battle Armors. He then wore one of them.
After becoming a Pseudo-Emperor, this Battle Armor couldn’t increase his battle prowess in the slightest.
It was fine. This was only used to conceal his identity.
As he walked, Ling Han’s appearance also changed, becoming the same as one of the two people just now.

After all, if he was facing other Great Emperors, he could still flee if he was no match for them. However, if he was facing the True Phoenix Emperor, the outcome would be in doubt.
Even if there were problems with the Great Emperors here, they all had their own unique traits. Perhaps the True Phoenix still retained his extreme speed.

He was filled with anticipation. He had already broken through the blockade of the fourth level. Then, what lay ahead of him should be the core area of the Primitive Abyss. Soon, he would be able to see the Great Emperor Wu Ya, the Battle Saint Emperor, the Canopy Demon Emperor, and so on.
All the questions could now be answered.

At least, in these five days, he was still walking on a desolate plain.
Just how fast was the speed of a Great Emperor? And Ling Han’s speed was also second to none among Great Emperors.
The desolate plain was filled with an air of death. To say nothing of life, not even a single rock could be seen.

The aura of a Great Emperor!

It was not a Pseudo-Emperor, but a real Great Emperor.
He sped up, and arrived in front of the head of this corpse.

Yi?
Ling Han discovered that there was actually a sliver of remnant soul inside the body of this Great Emperor.

It should be known that once the Great Emperor died, his soul would directly fuse with the heaven and earth, and could not possibly enter into the Netherworld, and if he wanted to leave behind a sliver of his soul, he would have to pay an extremely great price.
Logically speaking, this Great Emperor had clearly died when his lifespan had dried up. Then, at the end of his lifespan, he actually still had the ability to leave behind a remnant soul?
That’s not right.

Ling Han discovered that this remnant soul wasn’t something that the Great Emperor wanted to leave behind for future generations. Instead, it was a true remnant soul that was exuding an aura of chaos.
But right at this moment, this Great Emperor actually moved.
F***, he had come back to life!
Ling Han knew that this was because that remnant soul had sensed his existence, and aroused the instincts of this Great Emperor.
Boom, a large hand immediately swatted over, really covering the skies and covering the earth.
Ling Han threw a punch, and they exchanged a blow.
Peng! The hand of the Great Emperor was immediately sent flying. Meanwhile, Ling Han remained unmoving.
This was only the corpse of a Great Emperor, after all. There was a remnant soul inside, but there was pitifully little of it. How much of the past strength of the Great Emperor could it unleash?
One thousandth? Ten thousandth?
It was more than enough to suppress a Pseudo Emperor, but against Ling Han, hoho.
However, this Great Emperor’s corpse was only left with its battle instincts. Even if it lost, it would not shrink back. Instead, it began to attack madly again.

If Ling Han attacked with his full strength, with the standard of the Great Emperor’s corpse that was only left with its instincts, he could completely use Destructive Energy to eliminate it completely.
However, it was too difficult to become a Great Emperor. That was an overlord of an era, and Ling Han did not want to desecrate the corpse of such an existence either.
Thus, he merely parried, and did not counterattack.
However, there were only wisps of remnant soul inside the Great Emperor’s corpse in the first place, so how could it withstand such a high-intensity resistance?
Merely half a day later, this remnant soul had exhausted all its Spiritual Power, and returned to the heaven and earth.
Boom! The colossal Emperor’s corpse collapsed to the ground.
Ling Han sighed, and stretched out a hand in a grab. A large amount of yellow sand swept over from either side, covering this Great Emperor.
The Great Emperor had been invincible all his life, and he couldn’t die in such a miserable manner, with his corpse left out in the wilderness like this.

Unfortunately, when this Great Emperor died, he was already indescribably old. Furthermore, he did not bring the Imperial Weapon with him. Thus, Ling Han was unable to match him with any Great Emperor in history.
"Rest in peace." Ling Han buried this Great Emperor, offered condolences for a while, then continued on his way.
He felt rueful. The Great Emperor, who had once been invincible in the world, had been buried here all alone. When he died, there was no one by his side to send him off.

chapters.title: Chapter 4811: Element Developing
paragraphs: After walking for a short while, a black sandstorm suddenly appeared ahead of him.
’Holy f*ck!’
Ling Han couldn’t help as his expression darkened, because every grain of sand in this sandstorm contained Destructive Energy.
This was too terrifying.
It should be known that the grains of sand here were comparable to stars. Merely an ordinary sandstorm was already terrifying enough, and now added with Destructive Energy?
Who could block it?
Even a Great Emperor would be in trouble, all right?
Retreat, retreat, retreat. Ling Han hurriedly retreated. Even if he too had grasped Destructive Energy, he did not dare to take it head-on at this time.
Thankfully, his speed was fast enough. His figure retreated rapidly, faster than the corrosive speed of the sandstorm.
He retreated all the way until a limit was reached, and the sandstorm finally stopped advancing, and merely wreaked havoc on the spot. Then, its might slowly subsided, and finally ended completely.
Ling Han continued to advance, his heart filled with surprise.
Destructive Energy, no, the element of Destruction!
Was this approaching the core of heaven and earth? Thus, the basic elements that formed the core of heaven and earth had appeared.

He walked out of this area, and a plain appeared ahead of him, filled with exuberant vitality. In this place, there were all kinds of animals and plants, and Ling Han was only looking from afar, and shockingly discovered that these animals were actually Pseudo-Emperor-level.
Then, when he got closer, he saw that all these animals had instantly fallen to the ground, and the plants had also completely dried and wilted.
All of them had died.
With a single thought, heaven and hell, life and death.
Ling Han did not dare to rashly walk into that area. Though his cultivation level was Emperor-level, even Pseudo-Emperors had died in such a strange manner. He had no wish to take such a risk.

However, it was only an instant again. Those animals that had fallen to the ground previously all got back to their feet, once again glowing with vitality, and the plants were the same. They were all colourful, and had boundless vitality.
This... Ling Han was truly stunned.
This was not the evolution of time that was occurring too quickly, but rather the evolution of the two extremes of life and death.
Life and death, the two fundamental elements of heaven and earth, converged here. At times, endless vitality would be brought, and at other times, it would be withering and death.
Ling Han couldn’t help but think, ’What if I walk in on my own?’
In an instant, he would colapse, but in the next instant, he would get back up, and the cycle repeats?
However, hopping between life and death, would he still be able to retain his original memories?
Was he going to become a walking corpse, forever trapped in that place?
Imprisoning a Great Emperor?
This sounded ridiculous, but this was the Primitive Abyss, so it was completely possible that something like this would happen.
Ling Han circled around. He felt that unless he could completely grasp the element of Destruction, he should not be able to resist this kind of life and death.
He circled around and continued to advance.
He had only taken a few steps, when he suddenly felt a strong sense of danger. He suddenly retreated rapidly, pushing his speed to the extreme.
Even if he was a Pseudo-Emperor, he still felt like his body was about to fall apart. It was clear just how terrifyingly fast his retreat had been. It had also placed a huge burden on his body.
Ahead of him, there was shockingly a mountain, whose height was unknown.
It had suddenly appeared just like that, without the slightest sign.
If Ling Han hadn’t retreated in time, he would definitely be inside the mountain by now.
With the sturdiness of the heaven and earth here, how terrifying would the pressure be if he was sandwiched in the mountain?
It should be known that an ordinary sandstorm would need a Pseudo-Emperor to summon an Imperial Weapon to stand against it. Then, what kind of concept was a mountain pressing down on them?
A Pseudo-Emperor would definitely die on the spot, and even a Great Emperor could possibly be severely wounded as well.
The Primitive Abyss was extremely terrifying.
But why would such a colossal mountain appear so abruptly?
Even someone as powerful as Ling Han actually only became alert at the last instant?
Ling Han looked at the great mountain ahead of him. This was definitely not an illusion, but rather a real existence, extraordinarily tall and steep.
This was even stranger.
Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position, calmly observing.
Three days later, without any prior warning, this mountain had completely disappeared. Not only that, even the original plain had disappeared, turning into a massive sinkhole.
This!
Ling Han gritted his teeth. It had disappeared.
It had come so suddenly, and disappeared just as suddenly.
A thought flashed in his mind. Was this the essence of Creation and Destruction?
By the looks of it, he was really close to the core of the universe. Otherwise, the four elements could not possibly evolve so frequently in front of him.
He waited for a few more days, and saw that this sinkhole had suddenly disappeared, and what lay before him was a plain.
Looks like the next step would be to have the tall mountain appear, and this process would be repeated endlessly.
As expected, four days later, the great mountain appeared once more.

Ling Han climbed the mountain. Though the gravity field on the mountain was extraordinarily strong, and the mountain rocks were incredibly sharp, as if it was laden with weapons, for the present Ling Han, this was no big deal.
He threw a punch, and Destructive Energy swept over. Any mountain rock would be shattered, so how could it cause any damage to him?

This mountain was too big. With Ling Han’s speed, he actually didn’t make it to the top in three days. Then, this mountain suddenly disappeared. Ling Han missed a step, and instantly fell from the sky.
However, with a thought, he was already standing in midair.
This was only expending some power.
Ling Han took a few steps, and landed on the ground. Then, he continued onwards.
He didn’t run in the pit. Obviously, this place would become a plain in a few days, so it was best not to take risks.
As expected, five days later, the plain appeared once more.
This was irregular, Ling Han thought.
Sometimes, it would take three days to change. Sometimes, it would take four days to change. Sometimes, it would take five days. There was no fixed pattern.
Thankfully, he had also finally walked out of this area.
Ahead of him, there was a pillar of light that pierced through the heavens and earth, exuding a fluctuation that would cause one’s heart to palpitate. It was extremely powerful.
However, there was still a vast ocean separating Ling Han and this pillar of light.
He didn’t rashly cross the sea. Instead, he wanted to see if the seawater had any destructive power.
He walked to the coast, wanting to grab some seawater for observation, but when he saw his own reflection, he was suddenly shocked.
It wasn’t him, but a skeletal figure.
Could it be that there was something at the bottom of the sea?
Ling Han looked again, and saw that this skeleton was also staring at him.
He waved his hand, and the skeletal figure also waved back at him. It was exactly the same.
What the hell was this?
The skeletal person was his future?

Ling Han didn’t believe it. He sifted through the distracting thoughts and used the Regulations as his palm. He wanted to scoop up some seawater, but when this hand touched the seawater, it immediately "died".
In fact, an indescribable power was transmitted through a sliver of his divine sense, wanting to enter his body.
Ling Han hurriedly took a step back, then severed this sliver of divine sense from himself.
At this time, that power immediately lost its direction. Boom, it retreated back into the great ocean.
Ling Han couldn’t help but inhale sharply. If that power entered his body, his body would instantly become dead, and he would become a corpse.
Even if he had the cultivation level of a Great Emperor!
This was a sea of death? Was this all Cold Water of Death?
That’s not right.
The two were indeed very similar. They both destroyed vitality, but there was a very great difference.
However, Ling Han couldn’t explain clearly how the two were different.

Even if he had the cultivation level of a Great Emperor!
This was a sea of death?
Was this all Cold Water of Death?
That’s not right.
The two were indeed very similar.
They both destroyed vitality, but there was a very great difference.
However, Ling Han couldn’t explain clearly how the two were different.

chapters.title: Chapter 4812: Battle Saint Emperor
paragraphs: After Ling Han tried a few more times, he could confirm that there was some kind of power hidden under this great ocean, causing these waters to also possess the power of death.
That was because after he had filled his vessel with some seawater, he discovered that the seawater was actually normal, and did not pose much danger.
Thus, that boundless power of death originated from beneath the ocean waters.
Ling Han didn’t want to figure it out, because with his current strength, he was still not qualified.
He had to cross first.
Ling Han leaped up, and walked through the air.
Though the gravity fields were powerful, the restrictions on him were already very weak.
He was Emperor-level, after all!
Boom!
In the distance, a pillar of water suddenly shot into the sky at an extraordinarily fast speed, like a fountain.
Ling Han felt a chill in his heart. If he was hit by the pillar of water, he would suddenly lose a large amount of vitality, and even he could possibly fall into the sea.
And once he fell into the ocean waters... he would definitely be done for.
He raised his alertness, and was extremely cautious.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The deeper he went into the sea, the more frequent the water pillars shooting out would be.

Ling Han tried to fly higher into the sky, but he immediately discovered that the sky seemed to bear the weight of the entire universe. It was so heavy that even he couldn’t resist it. He couldn’t fly high at all.
Thus, he could only be extremely careful, guarding against those pillars of water that were soaring into the sky.
Just how fast was the speed of a Great Emperor?

However, the pillar of light in the distance didn’t seem far, but it was actually extremely far. Ling Han flew for half a month, yet he felt that he hadn’t closed the distance between himself and this pillar of light at all.
He naturally wouldn’t give up. Instead, he continued to charge forward with all his might.
One month, two months... Time passed, and Ling Han finally discovered that the pillar of light was getting closer.
Heavens, just how far away was this?

At this moment, Ling Han was already spiritually and mentally exhausted. At every moment, he had to guard against the water pillars that surged up from below. If this lasted too long, even a Great Emperor would feel tired.

It should be known that when these pillars of water shot out, it was equivalent to the attack of a Great Emperor. Furthermore, it would only be "him" attacking, while he himself could only defend passively. The moment he was hit, he would die immediately.
How could such pressure not be heavy?
Thankfully, Ling Han’s spirit had long since been tempered to become incredibly tough. Though it was tiring, he was completely capable of holding on.
One year, two years, three years, time flew by. Ling Han also flew above this sea for a whole nine years.
He was really tired.
However, that pillar of light was also really getting closer.
He saw that a massive island had appeared ahead of him. That pillar of light originated from the centre of the island.
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure landed on the ground. After landing on the ground, he hurriedly began to recuperate.
It was too tiring. It was as if he had never been so tired in his entire life. Even Ling Han only wanted to collapse and sleep now.
Half a day later, Ling Han suddenly woke up from his rest.
He could sense an extremely powerful aura assaulting him.
Too strong, so strong that his whole body bristled.
He immediately bounced up, turned his head to look to his left, and saw a figure appear.
This was a... monkey?
Its height was comparable to an ordinary person, and it was dressed in golden plated armor, but it was already tattered. Upon a closer look, it should have been damaged.

This monkey was standing on its hind legs like a human, and there was a purple-gold staff slung over its shoulder. It was currently casting a sideways glance at Ling Han, exuding a powerful killing intent and viciousness.
Boom!
The monkey moved, and struck out with his staff.
’Holy f*ck!’
The Battle Saint Emperor!

Ling Han immediately thought to himself. He would never have imagined that he would encounter the Battle Saint Emperor when he had just arrived at the core area of the Primitive Abyss. Moreover, he had been thrashed for no reason at all.
Boom! The staff swept over, indescribably terrifying.
Even though Ling Han already possessed Emperor-level battle prowess, he still didn’t dare to face this attack head-on. He hurriedly retreated.
"Senior Battle Saint!" he called out, wanting to clarify things.
"You want to trick your Grandpa Monkey?" the Battle Saint Emperor roared. He swung his golden-purple staff again.
Hong long long, the heaven and earth changed, and the winds and clouds paled.

This was a true Great Emperor, unlike the Divine Beast Emperors, who had all kinds of problems, and the Lords of Death, who could only be helpless. He could completely unleash his Imperial Might, which was incredibly terrifying.
The highest tier of power, a complete Great Emperor!

Ling Han’s current strength was only in the fourth tier. Even if he used the Destructive Energy and the light of great dao, it would only allow him to reach the peak stage of the fourth tier of battle prowess, at most. It would only pose a threat to any Great Emperor in the first tier.
A Great Emperor of the first tier unleashed his might, and he also had the Imperial Weapon in hand. How could he block this attack?
He hurriedly summoned the Clear Bamboo Sword and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. The two Imperial Weapons channelled at the same time, clashing head-on with the purple-gold staff.

However, it was not like the more Imperial Weapons he had, the better it would be. He controlled two Imperial Weapons at the same time, and immediately felt strained. He could only activate the might of one to the fullest.
Boom!
The three Imperial Weapons exchanged a blow, and Ling Han and the two Imperial Weapons were both sent flying. The difference in strength could not be more obvious.
However, Ling Han discovered that the purple-gold staff was actually showing signs of cracking.
Yi?
Shouldn’t the Imperial Weapon be the sturdiest existence in the world?

He had not even finished the thought, when the Battle Saint Emperor had already charged over again, brandishing his golden-purple staff. His fighting spirit soared sky-high, and it was as if he had an addiction to fighting.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. This was indeed Brother Monkey’s family.
The line of the Battle Saint could only have one word when encountering an enemy: fight!
Who cares if they can win or not? Just fight first, and we’ll see.
He didn’t face it head-on anymore. Instead, he used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to continuously dodge.
"Senior, my name is Ling Han. I have received a message from Senior Wu Ya, and have deliberately come." As he dodged, he continued to explain.

He could just barely exchange blows with the Divine Beast Emperors, but the fact that he could face them head-on was because the Divine Beast Emperors had to be wary of his Destructive Energy and light of great dao, but the problem now was, could he use the Destructive Energy or light of great dao on the Battle Saint Emperor?
In the first place, his battle prowess was already at the fourth tier, and now that he had restrained himself, how could he possibly be a match for a first tier Great Emperor?
Boom!

The Battle Saint Emperor attacked aggressively, and the heaven and earth resonated with each other. Even if the heaven and earth here was extremely sturdy, so what? With a sweep of the staff, he still sent large rocks flying, and then they were shattered.
’So powerful!’

Ling Han thought to himself. If it was not for the fact that Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was the fastest movement technique in the world, he would probably be blasted into smithereens by the Battle Saint Emperorwithin ten moves.
However, it was not a good idea to keep dodging like this.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. Why was the first Great Emperor he encountered the Battle Saint Emperor?
Why was it this person who had the most explosive temper and loved to fight?
Couldn’t it be Great Emperor Wu Ya?
The Ancestral King Lingtian would do as well.
"Senior, forgive this junior for being rude!" Ling Han shouted loudly. Boom, he finally used Destructive Energy and light of great dao.
The present Destructive Energy was a strengthened version, and the feeling of danger of turning everything into nothing was even stronger.
However, the Battle Saint Emperor ignored this completely, brandishing his staff and attacking directly.
Er, it was indeed the same bloodline as Brother Monkey.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The metal rod struck directly, but as long as it was swept by the Destructive Energy, even the metal rod would be slightly damaged.

chapters.title: Chapter 4813: Fate arises
paragraphs: Pu!
Pu!
Pu!

Ling Han vomited blood continuously. The attacks of the Battle Saint Emperor were too terrifying. This was a first tier Great Emperor, the true strongest in the world, a supreme overlord that could only appear once in an era.
F***, I have come to save the world, not to be beaten up.
Ling Han decided to retreat first. The Battle Saint Emperor was a boorish character, and couldn’t be reasoned with at all.
However, before he could flee, he felt another supremely domineering aura appear. Then, he was shocked to see that another Battle Saint Emperor had appeared.
His face was also filled with violence, and he also had a metal rod in hand.
This!
"Gagaga." The two Battle Saint Emperors laughed loudly at the same time, yet stopped their attacks.
What was going on?
Ling Han’s expression darkened. It was as if... he had been played with!
"Brat, come with me," a Battle Saint Emperor said.
He turned around and left. The other Battle Saint Emperor also turned around. It was as if he didn’t care whether Ling Han followed him or not.
Er, let’s go.

Ling Han really could not contain his own curiosity. Furthermore, upon further thought, though every move of the Battle Saint Emperor was overbearing, the Battle Saint Emperor had held back, and would definitely not take his life.
Otherwise, he would not have been able to last so many moves.
Which also meant that the Battle Saint Emperor knew who he was from the very beginning, yet still fought with him.
Was he deliberately toying with him, or was it that he had been itching for a fight?
Ling Han felt that the possibility of the latter was higher. The line of the Battle Saint indeed all had this kind of personality.
—If you bully me like this, be careful that I will return and thrash your great-great-grandson!
After walking for a while, they entered into a cave.

"What a dense aura of life!" Ling Han exclaimed in shock. Previously, he had been hit by the Battle Saint Emperor, and had suffered a considerable number of injuries. However, after just walking into the cave for a short while, these injuries began to heal.
In fact, he discovered that his life force was presently strengthening.

It should be known that in order to break through his limits previously, he had almost expended all his life force. Afterwards, when his cultivation level increased, he had recovered some life force to a certain extent, but the loss was still greater than the replenishment.

"This is the Cave of Life," one of the Battle Saint Emperors said. "The foundations of Life among the four elements of heaven and earth, which can heal all your injuries and restore your body to perfection."
Ling Han was just about to speak, when he suddenly heard a loud bang. In fact, even the cave trembled a few times.
What!
He was shocked. How could it be that he was not aware of just how sturdy this place was?
Hence, what had happened that could actually cause the mountain cave to tremble along with it?
"Senior—"
However, the Battle Saint Emperor waved his hand, interrupting Ling Han.

"I know you have a lot of questions, and I will tell you everything from beginning to end." This Old Brother Monkey was truly an impatient character. Clearly, he was impatient with how Ling Han would ask one question, and he was to answer, and the process would be repeated.
Too annoying! Too slow! Too boring!
Hence, he directly started from the beginning.
"In the past, I entered the Primitive Abyss to search for the path to immortality.
"After experiencing great danger, I found my way to this island."
"However, when I arrived, a battle was presently taking place here."
"I found out about it. On one side are the Demon Emperors that achieved Dao before me, and on the other side... there is only one, and that is a Divine Beast from the Ancient Age!"

"This Divine Beast has already grasped the three great factors of Creation, Life and Destruction. As long as it can obtain the key factor of Death, it will become the strongest existence in this world. Even if all the Great Emperors and Divine Beasts of the past join forces, they would still be no match for it."
"Thus, I joined the battle against this Divine Beast."
But was that the end of it?
Ling Han looked at the Battle Saint Emperor. The old Saint Emperor already looked impatient, and looked like he couldn’t hold himself back from getting into a fight.
Hold on, hold on, after you say that, I’m still completely confused, all right?
"Senior Battle Saint, why are there two of you?" he asked.
Could it be that the Battle Saint Emperors were two brothers who had achieved Dao together?
"Oh, these are my two Dao Manifestations," a Battle Saint Emperor said. Peng! He pointed at the other Battle Saint Emperor, and the latter immediately vanished into thin air, turning into a hair.
"My Mystical Power, added with the essence of Life, took form."
Ling Han couldn’t help but stare in shock. This was too awesome, wasn’t it?
It was only a doppelganger, and the doppelgangers actually possessed the battle prowess of the first tier?
How could the Lords of Death endure this?
As long as the Battle Saint Emperor went out, and plucked a few of his hairs, wouldn’t they be able to sweep aside all those Lords of Death?
"Senior, the situation outside is also extremely urgent!" Ling Han hurriedly related the plot of the Lords of Death.
"Hmm?" The Battle Saint Saint raised a brow, and said, "That’s not right, that’s not right!"
His expression was filled with violence, as if he was a little anxious.

"The stability of Yin and Yang is the Dao of heaven and earth. If Yin and Yang are unbalanced, even the great dao would be impacted... I understand now!" The Battle Saint Emperor suddenly clapped his hands, "It must be that old Divine Beast’s doing. The two realms of Yin and Yang are unbalanced, and under such a powerful impact, what would be brought about is destruction and death!"
"In this way, he would be able to grasp the essence of Death as quickly as possible, and become the strongest."
Ling Han was quite confused, and asked, "Senior, who exactly is the old Divine Beast that you speak of?"

"I don’t know either." The Battle Saint Emperor shook his head, and said, "Among the Divine Beasts of the past eras, he also exists. However, judging by the time he’s experienced, it’s clearly the beginning of heaven and earth, the same era as the various Divine Beasts."
"Why is everyone targeting him?" Ling Han asked. From what the Battle Saint Emperor had said, the Divine Beast only wanted to become stronger.
Was it wrong to become stronger?
The Battle Saint Emperor faltered for a moment before replying, "He was the strongest, so I fought him."
This... could be considered a reason?
However, it was an extremely fitting reason for the Battle Saint Emperor.
"However, this Divine Beast is incredibly evil. If he were to grasp the essence of Death, he would definitely destroy the heaven and earth," the Battle Saint Emperor added.
Ling Han nodded. Though the Battle Saint Emperor was rash and bellicose, how could a Great Emperor be an idiot?
He was extremely smart, all right?
"Senior, senior, can you explain in more detail?" Ling Han only had a vague idea now.
"Why are you so noisy?" the Battle Saint Emperor asked impatiently.
Though he was still annoyed, this old Saint Emperor still answered Ling Han’s question in detail.
Simply put, this island was the core of the entire Primitive Abyss. It was also the true starting point of heaven and earth.
In this place, there were four major factors that formed heaven and earth: Creation, Destruction, Life, and Death.

At that time, the old Divine Beast should have also come for the sake of immortality. After arriving on the island, he broke through all the obstacles, and grasped the three elements of Creation, Life and Destruction.
But right at this moment, a very, very long time had already passed. Thus, another Great Emperor that sought immortality had arrived.
Because he was about to die, the first thing he had to grasp was naturally the essence of Life.
In this process, this Great Emperor discovered the evil that the old Divine Beast had hidden.
Thus, this Great Emperor did not hesitate in starting a battle with the old Divine Beast.

"Why is everyone targeting him?" Ling Han asked.
From what the Battle Saint Emperor had said, the Divine Beast only wanted to become stronger.
Was it wrong to become stronger?
The Battle Saint Emperor faltered for a moment before replying, "He was the strongest, so I fought him."
This... could be considered a reason?
However, it was an extremely fitting reason for the Battle Saint Emperor.
"However, this Divine Beast is incredibly evil.
If he were to grasp the essence of Death, he would definitely destroy the heaven and earth," the Battle Saint Emperor added.
Ling Han nodded.
Though the Battle Saint Emperor was rash and bellicose, how could a Great Emperor be an idiot?
He was extremely smart, all right?
"Senior, senior, can you explain in more detail?" Ling Han only had a vague idea now.
"Why are you so noisy?" the Battle Saint Emperor asked impatiently.
Though he was still annoyed, this old Saint Emperor still answered Ling Han’s question in detail.
Simply put, this island was the core of the entire Primitive Abyss.
It was also the true starting point of heaven and earth.
In this place, there were four major factors that formed heaven and earth: Creation, Destruction, Life, and Death.
At that time, the old Divine Beast should have also come for the sake of immortality.
After arriving on the island, he broke through all the obstacles, and grasped the three elements of Creation, Life and Destruction.
But right at this moment, a very, very long time had already passed.
Thus, another Great Emperor that sought immortality had arrived.
Because he was about to die, the first thing he had to grasp was naturally the essence of Life.
In this process, this Great Emperor discovered the evil that the old Divine Beast had hidden.
Thus, this Great Emperor did not hesitate in starting a battle with the old Divine Beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 4814: Four Elements
paragraphs: "Uh, Senior, can you use a name instead?" Ling Han couldn’t help but ask. At the same time, he couldn’t help but complain in his mind.
The Battle Saint Emperor gritted his teeth, and said, "The first Great Emperor that came here should be the Heaven Slashing Demon Emperor, right? His original form is a rabbit."
By the looks of it, he didn’t seem to like the Heaven Slashing Demon Emperor.
Alright, a monkey and a rabbit. Perhaps there was some familial enmity between them.
A thought suddenly occurred to Ling Han, and he asked, "Senior, what is that old Divine Beast like?"

The Battle Saint Emperor described it, and Ling Han couldn’t help but hiss in surprise, because this was exactly the same as the Divine Beast he had seen in the memories of the Azure Phoenix Great Emperor.
This was a Divine Beast that had not left its name in history. It was extremely strange, yet after the Divine Beasts had died, it had entered into their burial ground, and "stolen" their corpses.
Why did he steal them?
Was it for the sake of creating the present thirty-six Divine Beast Emperors?

However, the 36 Divine Beast Emperors had still been created "in recent times", and in the long passage of history, this Divine Beast had always been at war with the Battle Saint Emperor and the others, so why didn’t it revive the 36 Divine Beast Emperors as soon as possible?

It was clear that the 36 Divine Beasts were far from enough to deal with the Battle Saint Emperorand the others. Thus... the purpose of their creation wasn’t to target the Battle Saint Emperor and the others. Instead, it was to prevent him from entering.

This "him" was actually a backup plan that the Great Emperor Wuya and the others had set up. It could be Ling Han, Ding Shu and the others, or in fact, if Ling Han hadn’t been able to become the Genesis World’s Master at that time, it could even be Hysteria.
Ling Han related what he knew, which made the Battle Saint Emperor feel extremely curious.
As it turned out, there was such a thing.
In fact, they didn’t even know that there were another 36 Divine Beast Emperors in the outer region.

"That old Divine Beast has grasped the fundamentals of Creation and Life, and added with the corpses of the 36 Divine Beasts, the Divine Beasts can indeed be reproduced." The Battle Saint Emperor pondered for a moment. "However, the creation can actually also reach the level of a Great Emperor. This doesn’t make sense!"

If one had grasped the essence of Creation, they could create things out of thin air, and if they had grasped the essence of Life, they could bestow life. Thus, it was theoretically possible for the 36 Divine Beasts to reappear.
But as for Great Emperors?
If something like a Great Emperor could also be created... that would really be too terrifying.
What secrets did they not know?
Alright, Ling Han continued to ask.

The Heaven Slashing Demon Emperor and the old Divine Beast battled fiercely. However, the old Divine Beast had grasped the three major factors of Life, Creation and Destruction, and its battle prowess was inconceivably strong. The Heaven Slashing Demon Emperor was completely no match for it. Thankfully, there was a Cave of Life here. No matter how heavily injured the Heaven Slashing Demon Emperor was, he would be able to recover very quickly.
What he had to do was also very simple, and that was not to give the old Divine Beast enough time to break open the Cave of Death, and calmly comprehend Dao.

—Actually, he could be considered lucky, because the Cave of Life couldn’t be directly entered at the beginning, and thanks to the old Divine Beast, it had taken him who knew how many years to open it.
Otherwise, perhaps, the Heaven Slashing Demon Emperor would have already died of old age before he managed to open the Cave of Life.
This was not uncommon. It had already happened here.
Afterwards, even more Great Emperors entered, and resolutely stood on the side of the Heaven Slashing Demon Emperor, opposing the old Divine Beast.
Ling Han interrupted him, and said, "In other words, after arriving here, the strength of the Great Emperor can actually still increase?"

"That’s right." The Battle Saint Emperor nodded, "In the outside world, one can only cultivate to consummate level of Nine Star Regulations at most. This is something that practically any Great Emperor can do. However, after coming here, one can continue to grasp the four fundamental factors. With every aspect that one grasps, battle prowess would be qualitatively improved."
Hiss, in that case, there should be eight tiers in Emperor-level battle prowess.

The first tier of battle prowess was currently vacant. The second tier of battle prowess was the old Divine Beast, who had grasped the three elements of Life, Creation and Destruction. The third tier of battle prowess had grasped two elements, and the fourth tier of battle prowess had grasped one.

The fifth was the ordinary Great Emperor. The sixth was the Divine Beast Emperors, the seventh tier was the Lords of Death, and the eighth tier was the Imperial Weapon, battle prowess which had just broken through to Emperor-level.
Coming back to the Battle Saint Emperor, he continued to answer his questions.
Though more and more Great Emperors had come, and all of them wanted to stop the old Divine Beast, the old Divine Beast was too strong. They could only slow it down, but could not stop it.
After so many years, the old Divine Beast was close to opening the Cave of Death.
And once he succeeded... he would be able to kill all the Great Emperors in an instant. Even if they had grasped the essence of Life, it would be useless.
That was because in a clash of fundamental factors, it would depend on who was stronger.
Thankfully, in the Primitive Abyss, time was the least valuable. The so-called "very fast" would need hundreds of millions of years or even longer, even in the outside world.
And for the Great Emperors that had come here, because the island was filled with the essence of Life, even if they had not grasped it, their lifespan was still unlimited.
Of course, the prerequisite was that they had to stay here. Otherwise, their lifespan would have long since dried up, and they would definitely die immediately when they left.
Because they could only delay the old Divine Beast, but could not stop it, the Great Emperors began to make arrangements, and sent out the Stones of Life.

The so-called Stone of Life was a rock in the depths of the Cave of Life. Because it had always been nurtured by the essence of Life, it naturally possessed the mighty power of Life. Furthermore, it had also been placed in the Cave of Creation and the Cave of Destruction for a very long time, and now possessed a sliver of power of Creation and Destruction.
This rock had been obtained by Xuan Taiyu, but he had just used it to cultivate Destructive Energy, when he encountered misfortune and was ganged up on by the Lords of Death, and finally died.
Most of the events now matched, but the question was, what role did the Lords of Death have in this matter?

"According to our deductions, after those b@stards entered into the Primitive Abyss, they were bewitched by the old Divine Beast, and that’s why they turned themselves into half-human and half-ghost," the Battle Saint Emperor guessed.
"But isn’t the old Divine Beast, battling fiercely with you guys?" Ling Han asked.

"Since that old Divine Beast, Ling Han, was able to create 36 Divine Beasts without our knowledge at all, then it is not impossible for him to entice those b@stards with his divine sense," the Battle Saint Emperor speculated.
The Great Emperors here were setting up some plans, and the old Divine Beast was not idle either. Furthermore, his plans were even more frightening.

"Once the Living Realm develops to the extreme and begins to collapse, then the Netherworld would be expanding. The shockwave created would be enough to affect the Dao of Heaven and Earth, and even affect here..." The Battle Saint Emperor inhaled sharply, "That old geezer, he wants to use this method to open the Cave of Death, so he can see the secret of the essence of Death!"
Seeing the essence of Death did not mean that one could grasp it, but for the old Divine Beast, as long as he could glimpse this kind of profound mystery, would he still be far from grasping it?

"Those b@stards must have fallen for it. To say nothing of advancing further after achieving immortality, they would only meet a tragic end in the clash of the two Realms of Yin and Yang," the Battle Saint Emperor said disdainfully.
This was the collision of heaven and earth. Even a Great Emperor couldn’t withstand this.

chapters.title: Chapter 4815: Return
paragraphs: "Brat, hurry up and go back. You must stop those b@stards!" The Battle Saint Emperor said solemnly, "Otherwise, our efforts all these years would be wasted."
Yi, I have to go back just like that?
I have come to catch a glimpse of the ultimate secrets of the Primitive Abyss. Furthermore, I haven’t even seen the so-called old Divine Beast, so wouldn’t it be a bit of a pity for me to return now?

However, the situation outside was indeed precarious, and the Great Emperors in the Primitive Abyss could not leave, and would immediately die once them left. Thus, the situation now could only depend on Ling Han now.
Sigh, there was a lot of responsibility.
"Senior, is there no Great Emperor that has grasped the essence of Life or Creation?" Ling Han asked.
"Do you think that just because one has grasped the essence of Life, they would be able to live forever?" the Battle Saint Emperor said with a smile.
"That’s not the case?" Ling Han was surprised.

"Of course not." The Battle Saint Emperor shook his head, "Having grasped the fundamentals of Life, one would possess the ability to bestow life. However, this would not be able to stop the aging of life."
"But haven’t you guys attained immortality?" Ling Han asked curiously.

"Theoretically, that is indeed the case," the Battle Saint Emperor nodded, "However, it is only limited to this space, because even if we die, we would still be revived, but it would be different once we leave. Who would revive us?"

Therewas a Cave of Life here, and there were even Great Emperors that had grasped the essence of Life here. Thus, even if a Great Emperor died in battle, he could still be revived by the other Great Emperors — as long as his corpse was not too damaged.
But once they left, they would all die, and no one would have the chance to revive the other.
Thus, the activity area of the Great Emperors could only be limited to the Primitive Abyss. In fact, it could only be on this one island.
However, the battle that was taking place here was incredibly important, and would decide the future of the entire universe.
"All right. After I rest for a while, I will leave immediately." Ling Han nodded.
Only when he went to the outside world would he be able to come into contact with the Nine Star Regulations, and truly step onto the threshold of Pseudo-Emperor.
"Oh, that’s right, you’re also a Pseudo-Emperor!" It was as if the Battle Saint Emperor had just discovered this fact.
Er, Grandpa Monkey, your reaction takes a bit long, doesn’t it?
Ling Han mocked internally, and nodded, "I am indeed a Pseudo-Emperor, Five Stars."

"Then you must come here before you break through to Great Emperor Tier," the Battle Saint Emperor said solemnly. "If you break through to Emperor Tier here, it is very possible that you would be able to directly grasp one of the key factors."
Hiss, so awesome?
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, "However, in this era, heaven and earth already allows one to become Great Emperor. I’m afraid that someone will become a Great Emperor before me."

After all, Ding Shu and the others were all no weaker than him in terms of comprehension ability, and on the side of the Lands of Death, the fallen Imperial Sons had long since become Pseudo-Emperors, and Little Ye was even more freakish, the greatest enemy on the path to becoming Emperor.
"It’s fine," the Battle Saint Emperor said with a smile. "Can’t you see how many Great Emperors are here?"
Ling Han faltered, "In this place, there is no restriction on becoming Emperor?"

Otherwise, the existence of every Great Emperor would interfere with the heaven and earth, forming a terrifying collision, and that was why there was the saying that a Great Emperor would never meet another.
Years ago, the Lords of Death and Xuan Taiyu had a huge battle, resulting in the fortune of the entire North Heavenly Realm falling. This was the consequence of disturbing heaven and earth.
However, as early as the ancient times, the Divine Beasts had stood side by side.
Thus, as long as heaven and earth allowed it, Great Emperors could coexist.
However, heaven and earth had evolved, and the Regulations of heaven and earth had changed. Only one Great Emperor could appear in an era.
But in this place, the Regulations of heaven and earth were not all that good.
Without Regulations, how could there be any restrictions?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel overjoyed. If Brother Monkey, Ding Shu, the empress, and the others could all become Pseudo-Emperors, then they would have the chance to become Emperors here!

How to do it was naturally a big problem. To say nothing of the fact that there were 36 Divine Beast Emperors blocking the path, even in the latter half of the journey, a Pseudo-Emperor would still be easily destroyed by the storm of heaven and earth.
As for this, he could worry about it later. There would definitely be a way.
En, this was the only good news at present.
The Battle Saint Emperor explained the situation here to him again. Then, he impatiently ran off to fight.
Ling Han stayed in the cave to recuperate. The vitality here was exuberant, and it was the source and mother of all life, allowing his condition to continuously advance towards perfection.
Half a month later, Ling Han felt that he was almost done, because he could no longer feel any improvement.
He decided to leave.
But before leaving, no matter what, he had to take a look ahead.
This was a battle on the level of Great Emperors, and furthermore, it had surpassed the previous first tier. Just how world-shaking would it be?
However, just as he walked out of the cave, he saw the Battle Saint Emperor approach him head-on.
This time, the Saint Emperor was riddled with wounds. His wounds were so severe that it was as if he were about to die.
"Yi, why haven’t you left yet?" This was the Battle Saint Emperor’s first words.
Ling Han was a little speechless. ’Do you really want to chase me away so badly?’
"Senior, is this your true body?" He was suddenly shocked.
Though this Battle Saint Emperor was extremely heavily injured, his aura was as boundless as an ocean, far stronger than the previous one.
Thus, since that was a doppelganger at the time, this should be the real one.
"That’s right," the Battle Saint Emperor nodded. He then walked into the cave and said, "I need to heal my injuries, so hurry up and return."
Er... why had the Battle Saint Emperor returned to heal his wounds after so many days?
It was probably because this person was too fierce, and was howling as he charged at the front. Naturally, he was the one who had suffered the most serious injuries.
As expected of the line of the Battle Saint. It was not without reason that there were so few of them!
Thankfully, there was the element of Life here. Otherwise, this old Saint Emperor would have long since been finished.
Ling Han shook his head, and stopped complaining.
Since the Battle Saint Emperor emphasized this, he looked at the pillar of light in the distance, then turned around and left.

This time, he would not go and watch the excitement, but the next time he came, it would be the time for him to break through to Great Emperor Tier. At that time, he would become the main force, and battle with that old Divine Beast.
Ling Han walked back in a daze. He carefully passed through the sea that was filled with columns of death, and after several years, he finally returned to land.
He kept a low profile all the way, and did not cause any commotion.
His luck wasn’t bad this time, and after only a few months, he found the rock golem.
When it saw Ling Han, the rock golem couldn’t be any more excited. It rushed over and continuously arched its head at him, looking very much like a puppy that was inviting a pet.
"Haha, let’s go."
Ling Han still sat on the shoulder of the rock golem. In any case, this guy was also a Pseudo-Emperor, so it would not be too slow.

On the way, Ling Han still kept an extremely low profile. At this time, what he wanted most was to return to the outside world, and grasp the Nine Star Regulations, so that his battle prowess would improve further. Then, only if he went to stop the plans of the Lords of Death would he have a higher chance of success.
Trying to convince these people?
What a joke; would they believe him?
Even if they were a little suspicious, after setting up for millions and millions of years, they had to take a gamble no matter what.

With the temperament of a Great Emperor, the fact that they had been convinced then meant that they must have seen something, and found out something. That was why they were completely convinced, and made themselves half-human and half-dead, so that they could fight for the great opportunity in this era.
So, he wanted them to turn back from their plans?
Hehe.
He could only use his strength to subdue them!
