Half a month later, Ling Han felt that he was almost done, because he could no longer feel any improvement.
He decided to leave.
But before leaving, no matter what, he had to take a look ahead.
This was a battle on the level of Great Emperors, and furthermore, it had surpassed the previous first tier.
Just how world-shaking would it be?
However, just as he walked out of the cave, he saw the Battle Saint Emperor approach him head-on.
This time, the Saint Emperor was riddled with wounds.
His wounds were so severe that it was as if he were about to die.
"Yi, why haven’t you left yet?" This was the Battle Saint Emperor’s first words.
Ling Han was a little speechless. ’Do you really want to chase me away so badly?’
"Senior, is this your true body?" He was suddenly shocked.
Though this Battle Saint Emperor was extremely heavily injured, his aura was as boundless as an ocean, far stronger than the previous one.
Thus, since that was a doppelganger at the time, this should be the real one.
"That’s right," the Battle Saint Emperor nodded.
He then walked into the cave and said, "I need to heal my injuries, so hurry up and return."
Er... why had the Battle Saint Emperor returned to heal his wounds after so many days?
It was probably because this person was too fierce, and was howling as he charged at the front.
Naturally, he was the one who had suffered the most serious injuries.
As expected of the line of the Battle Saint.
It was not without reason that there were so few of them!
Thankfully, there was the element of Life here.
Otherwise, this old Saint Emperor would have long since been finished.
Ling Han shook his head, and stopped complaining.
Since the Battle Saint Emperor emphasized this, he looked at the pillar of light in the distance, then turned around and left.
This time, he would not go and watch the excitement, but the next time he came, it would be the time for him to break through to Great Emperor Tier.
At that time, he would become the main force, and battle with that old Divine Beast.
Ling Han walked back in a daze.
He carefully passed through the sea that was filled with columns of death, and after several years, he finally returned to land.
He kept a low profile all the way, and did not cause any commotion.
His luck wasn’t bad this time, and after only a few months, he found the rock golem.
When it saw Ling Han, the rock golem couldn’t be any more excited.
It rushed over and continuously arched its head at him, looking very much like a puppy that was inviting a pet.
"Haha, let’s go."
Ling Han still sat on the shoulder of the rock golem.
In any case, this guy was also a Pseudo-Emperor, so it would not be too slow.
On the way, Ling Han still kept an extremely low profile.
At this time, what he wanted most was to return to the outside world, and grasp the Nine Star Regulations, so that his battle prowess would improve further.
Then, only if he went to stop the plans of the Lords of Death would he have a higher chance of success.
Trying to convince these people?
What a joke; would they believe him?
Even if they were a little suspicious, after setting up for millions and millions of years, they had to take a gamble no matter what.
With the temperament of a Great Emperor, the fact that they had been convinced then meant that they must have seen something, and found out something.
That was why they were completely convinced, and made themselves half-human and half-dead, so that they could fight for the great opportunity in this era.
So, he wanted them to turn back from their plans?
Hehe.
He could only use his strength to subdue them!

chapters.title: Chapter 4816: Charge out
paragraphs: Ling Han brought the rock golem back.
He discovered that the Divine Beast Emperors still looking for him, and he would "meet" them from time to time.
However, because Ling Han was very low-key, and did not travel very fast, he carefully hid his tracks all the way. Thus, he was not discovered by those Divine Beast Great Emperors.
Now was not the time to come into conflict with these Great Emperors.
That was because... they were only minor characters.
Whether these Great Emperors died or not did not have much effect on the overall situation.
Of course, if Ling Han was powerful enough, he wouldn’t mind killing these Divine Beasts. After all, that would definitely be able to weaken that old Divine Beast somewhat.
Having grasped the essence of Life, could he really create life as he willed it?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel tempted. There were also people that he wanted to revive.
For example, Old Master Ge Qianqiu.

He was definitely thinking too much about this now. He had to first break through to become a Great Emperor, and then grasp the essence of Life. En, perhaps he had to grasp the essence of Creation as well. Who knows, he may be able to revive those who had died.
This was only a thought. Whether it would work or not would have to wait until he broke through to become a Great Emperor.
Ling Han had deliberately concealed his tracks, so as long as these Divine Beast Emperors did not encounter him head-on, how could they possibly discover him?
Thus, though he spent some time on the journey, he still successfully arrived at the exit of the Primitive Abyss.
In this place, the Azure Phoenix Great Emperor was still standing guard.
The other Great Emperors were all looking for Ling Han, yet this Great Emperor was still here... could it be that he was blocking the entrance, not allowing anyone to enter?
Ling Han was naturally unafraid. He directly appeared, and charged towards the Azure Phoenix Great Emperor.
He was in no mood to tangle with the other at all. At the first instant, he used Destructive Energy, and the light of great dao wrapped around it.
Faced with this kind of attack, even the Azure Phoenix Great Emperor could only retreat, not daring to face it head-on.
Even if he didn’t die, he would be severely injured.
He had no choice but to step aside to avoid facing Ling Han’s power head-on.
"Let’s go!" Ling Han issued a command to the rock golem.
By now, the rock golem was completely capable of obeying his commands. The large fellow immediately leaped away, not even turning its head.

The Azure Phoenix Great Emperor didn’t pay attention to this rock golem. This didn’t affect him at all. Moreover, he didn’t think that he could take it as hostage and use it as a tactic to force Ling Han to battle him to the death.
Obviously, he didn’t understand Ling Han.

However, a Great Emperor was still a Great Emperor in the end. He was in the sixth tier, and his battle prowess far surpassed Ling Han, who was in the eighth tier. Even if he had reservations, as long as he distanced himself, under the frenzied bombardment, Ling Han was still under great pressure.
In the fierce battle, Ling Han was slowly forced back.

The Azure Phoenix Great Emperor smirked coldly. He had already sent out a message, and very soon, all the Great Emperors would be arriving. At that time, they would gang up on Ling Han. Even if Ling Han possessed deadly weapons like Destructive Energy, only a Great Emperor would have to be sacrificed to severe injury or even death to block the attack, and they would definitely be able to kill this boy.
After all, the Divine Beast Great Emperors existed to intercept and kill people like Ling Han. Thus, it was worth it even if one of them died.
They could just be created again..

Ling Han retreated step by step. He was also buying time for the rock golem, but two days later, when he discovered that another Divine Beas Great Emperor was approaching, he no longer hesitated, and began to break out of the siege.
"You think you can come and go as you please?" the Azure Phoenix Great Emperor said with a sneer.
"Haha, so what? Can you stop me?" Ling Han laughed loudly, directly using the Cold Water of Death.
At this moment, the Azure Phoenix Great Emperor had no choice but to dodge. If he blocked the attack now, Ling Han would be able to leave calmly before the Great Emperor behind him arrived.
Thus, this was meaningless.
With his move, Ling Han took advantage of the opening to charge out. He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and his speed was indescribably fast.
The Azure Phoenix Great Emperor was in pursuit, but the distance between him and Ling Han was steadily widening.
He couldn’t catch up.
He sighed. If he had known that Ling Han would escape, he would have let all the Great Emperors block him here.
No way!
He couldn’t allow this brat to continue becoming stronger. Otherwise, it would really endanger "their" long-term plans.
He would gather all the Great Emperors, then charge out of the Primitive Abyss. They definitely had to kill that brat.
Ling Han’s speed was extremely fast. Merely half a day later, he had caught up to the rock golem.
At this point, he could completely ignore those glowing particles in the passageway, and directly crash into them. What damage could the might of a planet’s explosion cause to a Great Emperor?
Even the rock golem was unafraid. It was formed from this kind of particle, and it was even denser in quality. Its defense was incredibly tough.
Xiu, he and the rock golem rushed out of the Primitive Abyss, and the universe was pitch-black.
Though this place was completely empty, Ling Han felt a familiar aura that he hadn’t felt for a long time.
Additionally... he could again sense the Regulations.
In an instant, inspiration surged through him.
Thus, without any hesitation, Ling Han only travelled slightly further. Then, he sat down in a cross-legged position, and turned his appreciation into his own strength.
He was capturing Regulations.
In reality, Regulations were hidden in the heaven and earth, so it was extremely difficult to observe them.
However, Ling Han had stayed too long in the Primitive Abyss, so the moment he appeared, he naturally caused unusual movements in the heaven and earth, causing even Regulations to erupt.
In this way, it would be much easier for him to capture the Regulations.
Amidst the densely packed Regulations, Ling Han carefully searched through them, heading straight for the core.
Nine Star Regulations.

All the Regulations were manifested from the Nine Star Regulations. This was the source, and was a little like the Four Elements. However, the Nine Star Regulations served the Dao of Heaven and Earth, while the Four Elements formed the foundations of the Dao of Heaven and Earth, and there was a fundamental difference between the two.
Bit by bit, Ling Han extracted Regulations, and in this process, he discovered that his body that had experienced Silent Destruction actually had some slight fluctuations.
Realization dawned on him. The process of comprehending the Nine Star Regulations was the process of breaking through step by step of a Pseudo-Emperor.
When his body had completely awakened, he would have more or less grasped a complete Nine Star Regulation, and would be able to break through to become a Great Emperor.

However, this final step would have to depend on whether the heaven and earth had favoured him or not. Only one person could attain Dao in a single era. As for others, even if they were Pseudo-Emperors, with the existence of a Great Emperor, they would never be able to completely grasp the Nine Star Regulations, and thus would not be able to become a Great Emperor.

Ling Han continued to gain enlightenment. Unfortunately, this enlightenment alone was not enough to complete a revival of a body that had experienced Silent Destruction, advancing into the level of a six-star Pseudo Emperor.
He was not in a rush. This time, he was grasping the Nine Star Regulations. Even if it was just a sliver, it would allow his battle prowess to improve by leaps and bounds.
Weng! Right at this moment, an aura swept over, carrying a sliver of Imperial Might.
Roar!
The rock golem immediately stood up from its cross-legged position and looked into the distance, its viciousness on full display.
Ling Han sent out a thought, telling the rock golem to calm down.
In just an instant, a person appeared near Ling Han.
Zhang Yu, the son of the Sea Emperor, Pseudo-Emperor!
"Yi!" Zhang Yu was also slightly surprised. He had not thought that he would actually encounter Ling Han here. Furthermore, by the looks of it, he was clearly in seclusion to appreciate something.
This was a good opportunity!

A look of delight appeared on his face. Who knows, he may be able to capture Ling Han in a single stroke. To say the least, even if it was just to stop Ling Han from continuing his comprehension, that would still be a great merit.
Moreover, this was the edge of the universe, and the Galaxy Network of the Chang Clan couldn’t reach here. Even if he wanted to inform the others, he couldn’t.

chapters.title: Chapter 4817: Scared
paragraphs: Zhang Yu smirked coldly, "I really had not expected that I would encounter you here, when I could not find you anywhere! Ling Han, you have not expected it, right? You yourself are at the most crucial moment of your comprehension in seclusion, and I have actually encountered you here."
If one was comprehending Dao, they would definitely have to find an absolutely safe place. The higher the cultivation level, the more terrifying the backlash would be if they went mad.
Thus, he first used words to harrass Ling Han and mess with his mind.
Once one’s heart was disturbed, it would be even easier for one to go mad.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "We should be able to eat grilled octopus today!" He paused, then continued, "Your original form... is an octopus, right?"
Zhang Yu was instantly angered. You are clearly at a disadvantage, so why do you still dare to speak such arrogant words?
As expected, aside from being the strongest Saint, this guy was also a Despicable Saint. En, he was the second most despicable Saint.
He was very depressed. He clearly wanted to mess with Ling Han’s Dao Heart, but why was it that it was him that was so angry now that smoke was about to come out of his nostrils?
This guy was really despicable!
Forget it.

Zhang Yu decided not to attack verbally. After all, this was not something he was good at. Even if Ling Han was still in a state of comprehension, the destructive power of a few casual words from him was stronger than whatever he could say.
He stood up, and charged towards Ling Han.
"Ang!" The rock golem released a wave of divine sense, stepping out to greet Zhang Yu’s attack.
Yi... what was going on?
Zhang Yu was startled. He had not thought that a rock golem would suddenly appear out of nowhere.
Previously, though he had also seen it, he had not taken it to heart at all. He only had Ling Han in his eyes.
This was a great enemy.
However, the moment the rock golem made its move, he suddenly realized that something was off.
This guy was actually also a Pseudo-Emperor.
No, it wasn’t an ordinary Pseudo-Emperor, but at least eight stars.
Boom! The rock golem launched a strike, and the entire sky trembled.
Pseudo-Emperor!

This wasn’t the Primitive Abyss. The structure of heaven and earth in the Primitive Abyss was sturdy, and if it weren’t for the fact that this place was already the edge of the universe, the masses of stars would probably collapse.
The might of a Pseudo-Emperor was world-shaking.
Zhang Yu took this blow head-on, and was directly sent flying.
The rock golem howled in excitement as it charged forward to continue the battle.

In the Primitive Abyss, there were too many beings that were stronger than it. Whether it was the Divine Beast Great Emperors, or the storms of heaven and earth, they could cause it serious injury. In fact, they could even kill it easily.
But now? It had suddenly discovered the value of its life.
’F*ck! So I’m also this powerful!’
The more this guy fought, the more excited he became, firmly suppressing Zhang Yu.
Zhang Yu was both furious and dumbfounded.
Where had this rock golem come from?
Moreover, it was a Pseudo-Emperor!
It wasn’t like he didn’t know how difficult it was to become a Pseudo-Emperor.
If it was not for the treasure provided by the Lords of Death, he might still only be a Four-Star or Five-Star Saint by now, and would not have been able to become a Pseudo-Emperor.
Throughout the ages, just how many Pseudo-Emperors had there been?
Their numbers wouldn’t surpass the number of Great Emperors by much.
But now, a rock golem had suddenly appeared, and it was actually a Pseudo-Emperor, so how could he not be dumbfounded?
Why was anything that had the slightest relation to Ling Han all so strange?

Meanwhile, Ling Han didn’t take Zhang Yu to heart at all. When he was a Saint, he would be able to suppress him, what more when he now had battle prowess on the level of a Great Emperor. Suppressing a Pseudo-Emperor would really only be the matter of a single thought.
He was still comprehending the Nine Star Regulations, and with every second that passed, his strength would increase slightly.
This was a rare opportunity. This was the first time he had immersed himself in Regulations after becoming a Pseudo-Emperor. Thus, this state was hard to come by, and he couldn’t maintain it forever.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Under the mad barrage of attacks from the rock golem, Zhang Yu did not have the ability to fight back at all, which made him extremely depressed.
Not only Ling Han, but even the people by Ling Han’s side outmatched him!
This was too humiliating.
He gave a loud shout, and drew the Imperial Weapon.
This was a three-pronged halberd. It instantly revived, and an endless imperial might spread out, making for an incredibly terrifying sight.
The rock golem was already engrossed in the battle, and didn’t pay any heed to it at all. It roared and continued to attack.
Peng!
It immediately suffered a head-on blow from the Imperial Weapon, and its entire body was sent flying. Bits of rock fell from its body.
This!
Zhang Yu gritted his teeth as he watched. What kind of defense was this? It was too terrifying, wasn’t it?
Oh, after being struck by the Imperial Weapon, only a few scraps fell?
What worth would an Imperial Weapon have?
The rock golem didn’t care at all, and roared as it made a comeback. In any case, its body was a suit of armor, so it didn’t matter even if it was completely destroyed.
Zhang Yu had no choice, and could only continue to attack with the Imperial Weapon.
The Imperial Weapon could be considered the weakest Great Emperor, but no matter how weak it was, it was still a Great Emperor.
The rock golem was completely outmatched, and was continuously sent backwards, bits of it continuously falling off its body.
However, judging by its size, to expose its core, it would have to fight for at least ten days to half a month, or even longer than that.
How could that be allowed!
Zhang Yu thought internally. He definitely had to stop Ling Han from comprehending. Otherwise, once Ling Han joined the battle, it would only be his turn to flee in panic.

In terms of Imperial Weapon, Ling Han also had one. However, in terms of battle prowess, he was completely outmatched by Ling Han. Moreover, now that there was a rock golem, he was even more outmatched.
He used the Imperial Weapon to push back the rock golem, then charged towards Ling Han.
Capture the ringleader before defeating the enemy, and Ling Han was his main target.
How fast was a Pseudo-Emperor’s speed?
Without the interference of the rock golem, Zhang Yu instantly charged in front of Ling Han.
However, right at this moment, Ling Han suddenly opened his eyes and stood up.
Gods!
Zhang Yu immediately stopped, and then retreated rapidly.
Ling Han’s vicious reputation was already deeply ingrained in his mind. Thus, he didn’t dare to face him head-on at all.
"Yi, what are you doing?" Ling Han stretched lazily, then sat back down.
"You, what’s wrong with you!" Zhang Yu flew into a humiliated rage.
"Oh, I’m tired from sitting, so I stretched and changed my posture," Ling Han said casually.
Change your posture your sister.
You are only sitting, and not having s** with a woman, so switch positions my a*s.
Zhang Yu’s heart was filled with complaints, but ultimately, it was still because he was too wary of Ling Han, and that was why he had been shocked by Ling Han’s slightest move.
Boom!
Beside him, the rock golem made a comeback.
"Scram!" With a casual strike from Zhang Yu, the Imperial Weapon unleashed its might, sending the rock golem flying again.

On one hand, this proved just how powerful the Imperial Weapon was. Even a Nine Stars Pseudo-Emperor could not withstand a single blow, and on the other, it also proved just how strong the defense of the rock golem was. It would not be damaged even by the barrage of attacks from the Imperial Weapon.
Terrifying!
This time, Zhang Yu strengthened his resolve. With a loud shout, he charged towards Ling Han again.
Furthermore, after such a pause, the Imperial Weapon could once again unleash its might.
He was going to kill Ling Han with a single strike.
He controlled the three-pronged halberd and ruthlessly stabbed it at Ling Han. Endless imperial might spread out, capable of easily destroying an entire galaxy.
Close, close, close.
Die!

The three-pronged halberd stabbed down, and Zhang Yu smirked coldly. At such a close distance, it was impossible for Ling Han to dodge. Thus, this young man that even the Lords of Death was wary of was finally going to die.
Right at this moment, Ling Han stretched out a hand.

The rock golem launched a strike, and the entire sky trembled.
Pseudo-Emperor!
This wasn’t the Primitive Abyss.
The structure of heaven and earth in the Primitive Abyss was sturdy, and if it weren’t for the fact that this place was already the edge of the universe, the masses of stars would probably collapse.
The might of a Pseudo-Emperor was world-shaking.
Zhang Yu took this blow head-on, and was directly sent flying.
The rock golem howled in excitement as it charged forward to continue the battle.
In the Primitive Abyss, there were too many beings that were stronger than it.
Whether it was the Divine Beast Great Emperors, or the storms of heaven and earth, they could cause it serious injury.
In fact, they could even kill it easily.
But now?
It had suddenly discovered the value of its life.
’F*ck!
So I’m also this powerful!’
The more this guy fought, the more excited he became, firmly suppressing Zhang Yu.
Zhang Yu was both furious and dumbfounded.
Where had this rock golem come from?
Moreover, it was a Pseudo-Emperor!
It wasn’t like he didn’t know how difficult it was to become a Pseudo-Emperor.
If it was not for the treasure provided by the Lords of Death, he might still only be a Four-Star or Five-Star Saint by now, and would not have been able to become a Pseudo-Emperor.
Throughout the ages, just how many Pseudo-Emperors had there been?
Their numbers wouldn’t surpass the number of Great Emperors by much.
But now, a rock golem had suddenly appeared, and it was actually a Pseudo-Emperor, so how could he not be dumbfounded?
Why was anything that had the slightest relation to Ling Han all so strange?
Meanwhile, Ling Han didn’t take Zhang Yu to heart at all.
When he was a Saint, he would be able to suppress him, what more when he now had battle prowess on the level of a Great Emperor.
Suppressing a Pseudo-Emperor would really only be the matter of a single thought.
He was still comprehending the Nine Star Regulations, and with every second that passed, his strength would increase slightly.
This was a rare opportunity.
This was the first time he had immersed himself in Regulations after becoming a Pseudo-Emperor.
Thus, this state was hard to come by, and he couldn’t maintain it forever.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Under the mad barrage of attacks from the rock golem, Zhang Yu did not have the ability to fight back at all, which made him extremely depressed.
Not only Ling Han, but even the people by Ling Han’s side outmatched him!
This was too humiliating.
He gave a loud shout, and drew the Imperial Weapon.
This was a three-pronged halberd.
It instantly revived, and an endless imperial might spread out, making for an incredibly terrifying sight.
The rock golem was already engrossed in the battle, and didn’t pay any heed to it at all.
It roared and continued to attack.
Peng!
It immediately suffered a head-on blow from the Imperial Weapon, and its entire body was sent flying.
Bits of rock fell from its body.
This!
Zhang Yu gritted his teeth as he watched.
What kind of defense was this?
It was too terrifying, wasn’t it?
Oh, after being struck by the Imperial Weapon, only a few scraps fell?
What worth would an Imperial Weapon have?
The rock golem didn’t care at all, and roared as it made a comeback.
In any case, its body was a suit of armor, so it didn’t matter even if it was completely destroyed.
Zhang Yu had no choice, and could only continue to attack with the Imperial Weapon.
The Imperial Weapon could be considered the weakest Great Emperor, but no matter how weak it was, it was still a Great Emperor.
The rock golem was completely outmatched, and was continuously sent backwards, bits of it continuously falling off its body.
However, judging by its size, to expose its core, it would have to fight for at least ten days to half a month, or even longer than that.
How could that be allowed!
Zhang Yu thought internally.
He definitely had to stop Ling Han from comprehending.
Otherwise, once Ling Han joined the battle, it would only be his turn to flee in panic.
In terms of Imperial Weapon, Ling Han also had one.
However, in terms of battle prowess, he was completely outmatched by Ling Han.
Moreover, now that there was a rock golem, he was even more outmatched.
He used the Imperial Weapon to push back the rock golem, then charged towards Ling Han.
Capture the ringleader before defeating the enemy, and Ling Han was his main target.
How fast was a Pseudo-Emperor’s speed?
Without the interference of the rock golem, Zhang Yu instantly charged in front of Ling Han.
However, right at this moment, Ling Han suddenly opened his eyes and stood up.
Gods!
Zhang Yu immediately stopped, and then retreated rapidly.
Ling Han’s vicious reputation was already deeply ingrained in his mind.
Thus, he didn’t dare to face him head-on at all.
"Yi, what are you doing?" Ling Han stretched lazily, then sat back down.
"You, what’s wrong with you!" Zhang Yu flew into a humiliated rage.
"Oh, I’m tired from sitting, so I stretched and changed my posture," Ling Han said casually.
Change your posture your sister.
You are only sitting, and not having s** with a woman, so switch positions my a*s.
Zhang Yu’s heart was filled with complaints, but ultimately, it was still because he was too wary of Ling Han, and that was why he had been shocked by Ling Han’s slightest move.
Boom!
Beside him, the rock golem made a comeback.
"Scram!" With a casual strike from Zhang Yu, the Imperial Weapon unleashed its might, sending the rock golem flying again.
On one hand, this proved just how powerful the Imperial Weapon was.
Even a Nine Stars Pseudo-Emperor could not withstand a single blow, and on the other, it also proved just how strong the defense of the rock golem was.
It would not be damaged even by the barrage of attacks from the Imperial Weapon.
Terrifying!
This time, Zhang Yu strengthened his resolve.
With a loud shout, he charged towards Ling Han again.
Furthermore, after such a pause, the Imperial Weapon could once again unleash its might.
He was going to kill Ling Han with a single strike.
He controlled the three-pronged halberd and ruthlessly stabbed it at Ling Han.
Endless imperial might spread out, capable of easily destroying an entire galaxy.
Close, close, close.
Die!
The three-pronged halberd stabbed down, and Zhang Yu smirked coldly.
At such a close distance, it was impossible for Ling Han to dodge.
Thus, this young man that even the Lords of Death was wary of was finally going to die.
Right at this moment, Ling Han stretched out a hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 4818: Driving to despair
paragraphs: Haha, you still want to catch the Imperial Weapon with your bare hands?
Who do you think you are?
A Great Emperor?
What a joke!
Zhang Yu smirked coldly. Had he overestimated his own abilities, or was he feeling too good about himself?
’Die... F*ck!’
Zhang Yu’s eyes almost popped out of her head. His mouth was half-gaping, and even his tongue seemed to be tied in a knot.
’Holy f*ck!’
What had he seen?
The Imperial Weapon, the Sea Divine Halberd, was actually grasped by Ling Han.
Was this an illusion?
Right, right, right. It must be.
Before his death, Ling Han had used an illusion to confuse him. Thus, after a while, this guy would die, and the illusion would disappear.
Yi, why was it like this?
The corner of Zhang Yu’s mouth twitched. The aura of a Pseudo-Emperor was majestic, and he suddenly came back to his senses.
This wasn’t a f*cking illusion. It was a nightmare!
"You, you, how is this possible!" His voice was trembling.
How could it not be terrifying? To catch an Imperial Weapon with one’s bare hands, this was something that only a Great Emperor could do.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "Everything is possible."
What kind of answer was that?
Zhang Yu’s eyes darted around, and he resolutely abandoned the Imperial Weapon. He then turned around to flee.
It was fine. Without a corresponding control technique, no one would be able to control the Imperial Weapon, and he only had to summon it, and the Imperial Weapon would automatically return.
However, he had just moved, when he saw that another person had appeared in front of him.
Ling Han!
Hiss, how could your speed be so fast?
"Impossible! Absolutely impossible!" Zhang Yu refused to believe it, "This must be an illusion. I must still be hallucinating."
To be able to make a Pseudo-Emperor doubt reality so much, this merit alone was enough to make Ling Han proud.
Ling Han chuckled, "Actually, you already know the answer. You just don’t want to believe it."
Zhang Yu calmed down. After all, he was a Pseudo-Emperor, and the son of a Great Emperor. He had experienced countless eras, so how could he possibly not have the slightest bit of composure?
"You’ve become a Great Emperor!"
He gritted his teeth, filled with envy and jealousy.
Ling Han smiled and said, "If a new Great Emperor were to appear in the world, strange phenomena would appear in the universe. Do you think that’s possible?"
Zhang Yu also knew this fact, and that was why he was unwilling to believe it.
That’s right. There were no strange phenomena appearing in the universe, and as a Pseudo-Emperor, he could clearly know that the Dao of Heaven and Earth could prove it.
Then, Ling Han definitely had not become a Great Emperor.
But if you didn’t become Emperor, how could you be so awesome?
"I just broke through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor," Ling Han said with a smile, kindly solving the mystery for Zhang Yu.
Yet Zhang Yu still looked like he had been frightened.
He knew that Ling Han was freakish. When he was a Saint, he already possessed battle prowess that could match a Pseudo-Emperor.
However, Pseudo-Emperor was still Pseudo-Emperor, after all, couldn’t be compared to a real Great Emperor.
Thus, he firmly believed that even if Ling Han became a Pseudo-Emperor, he could only be categorized among the ranks of Pseudo-Emperors, and would still be far from an actual Great Emperor.
But now, he knew that he was wrong.
This incredibly freakish guy, even if he had advanced into the level of Pseudo-Emperor, still maintained his freakish nature.
A Pseudo-Emperor, yet possessed battle prowess on the level of Great Emperor.
This was proof enough of the fact that he was parrying the Imperial Weapon with his bare hands.
Heavens!
This kind of opponent was really enough to drive one to despair.
"Alright, do you have any last words to say?" Ling Han asked considerately.
Zhang Yu gritted his teeth. He did not beg for mercy. Their positions were different, and there was absolutely no possibility of reconciliation.
"Don’t be so smug. Even if you possess the battle prowess of a Great Emperor, there is still no way that you would be a match for the Great Emperors!"
"I’ll wait for you in the Netherworld!"
Ling Han sighed, and said, "It’s a shame that the Great Emperors would not enter the Netherworld after death. Otherwise, I could have sent you off to reunite."
He activated his power. Boom, under the terrifying impact, Zhang Yu was immediately killed.
’Hmm?’
Ling Han discovered that after Zhang Yu’s death, there was no fluctuation in the Dao of Heaven and Earth.

Theoretically speaking, a Pseudo-Emperor had also grasped a sliver of Nine Star Regulations, so when a Pseudo-Emperor died, it should have caused a certain extent of disturbance to the Regulations of heaven and earth.
"Unless, like those Pseudo-Emperors pf tje Pseudo-Emperor, they have not grasped the Nine Star Regulations."
"The difference lies in the fact that the fallen Imperial Sons still possess Imperial Source, but as for those in the Primitive Abyss, hehe, they are extremely weak."

Ling Han casually tossed Zhang Yu’s corpse to one side. Under the impact of his great power, even someone as strong as a Pseudo-Emperor was unable to leave behind a complete corpse. With this toss, it immediately turned into bits that scattered into the universe.
The rock golem was curious, and chased after these particles.
Ling Han ignored him as he started to search for Four Origin Planet.
’Huh? It’s not nearby?’
Ling Han was astounded. Just how powerful was his divine sense now? With a single thought, he could enclose and control the vast space around him.
However, Four Origin Planet was nowhere to be found.
Could it be?
Zhang Yu and the others were definitely not here to play. Instead, they were searching for the empress and the others. Thus, Ding Shu and the others put away the Four Origin Planet and ran elsewhere.
He frowned. It was easy to locate a planet, but to find a specific person in such a colossal universe?
That was really too difficult. Even he could not possibly accomplish that.
Moreover, it was possible that the whereabouts of the masters of the Genesis World could not be deduced, which would make it even more difficult.

Thus, Ling Han could only wait. As long as the Four Origin Planet was released from the body, Ling Han would be able to immediately sense it, because there was a mark that he had left on the Four Origin Planet.
Ling Han sat down cross-legged, and continued to comprehend Regulations.
In his mind, there was a gossamer-like line.
This was the Nine Stars Regulations.
Though it was pitifully thin, but because of the existence of this thing, Ling Han’s present battle prowess had improved by leaps and bounds.
Seventh tier!

Now, if a Pseudo-Emperor used the Imperial Weapon to attack him, he would be able to easily suppress him. That was because he had already leaped out of the eighth tier, and possessed the strength to crush the Imperial Weapon.

In other words, even against the Lords of Death, Ling Han wouldn’t be at a disadvantage at all. In fact, if he unleashed Destructive Energy and light of great dao, even the Lords of Death wouldn’t dare to face him head-on.
Of course, the Lords of Death may forcibly recover to their prime condition, and Ling Han would still be outmatched.

However, firstly, these fallen Great Emperors had not had many chances to revive their battle prowess in the first place, and secondly, every time they revived, they would have to devour a great amount of life essence, but now, the whole universe had basically been transformed into Netherworld, so how much life essence would there be left for them to devour?
Ling Han wanted nothing more than for them to revive. That way, he would be able to exhaust these Lords of Death to death with a few times.
Three years later, he suddenly stood up.
Four Origin Planet appeared.
Ling Han grabbed the rock golem, and a golden path appeared beneath his feet, pointing at an endless distance.
Xiu, it was only a step, and Ling Han appeared in the skies above Four Origin Planet.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Three incredibly powerful auras assaulted him, and the three Pseudo-Emperors, Buddha Doga, Qian Yanghao, and Xia Houping had already arrived.
When the rock golem saw this, it immediately cried out. Haha, it could fight again!
Shua, when Ling Han saw this, he hurriedly stretched out a hand, and grabbed the rock golem, tossing it into space.
This was the Four Origin Planet. If this guy came to blows, the entire planet would immediately collapse.
"Ling Han!" Buddha Doga and the others exclaimed in astonishment.
Only so many years had passed, and Ling Han had already returned?

chapters.title: Chapter 4819: Arriving at the Chang Clan
paragraphs: Ling Han smiled and said, "I’m back."
In an instant, Brother Monkey, the empress and the others also rushed over, all of them very excited.
"That was—" Qian Yanghao asked.
That rock golem actually gave him an incredibly strong pressure.
"Oh, I brought it back from the Primitive Abyss," Ling Han said. Then, with a wave of his hand, the rock golem appeared in the skies above the Four Origin Planet.
He did not dare to let it come to the Four Origin Planet, because this guy was too heavy.

In the Primitive Abyss, it didn’t matter. In any case, the heaven and earth structure there was extremely sturdy. However, it was different here. The weight of the entire Four Origin Planet added together couldn’t compare to the weight of a grain of sand on its body.
Then, with this big guy standing on the Four Origin Planet, would the Four Origin Planet immediately shatter?
"Pseudo-Emperor?" Xia Houping asked. He already had an answer.
"En." Ling Han nodded.
Hiss.
Everyone clicked their tongues in amazement. They had not thought that Ling Han would go out on a trip and actually manage to kidnap a Pseudo-Emperor to bring home.
"What about you?" Everyone was more concerned about Ling Han’s strength.
"I have not disappointed your expectations!" Ling Han said with a smile.
Everyone instantly exploded with excitement. Ling Han had finally become a Pseudo-Emperor. This meant that they had finally gained the qualifications to face the Lands of Death head-on.
"Can you rival a Great Emperor?" Buddha Doga asked. Even he was slightly nervous.
After all, the higher one’s expectations, the more one would fear disappointment.
Ling Han smiled, "Let’s go back first, and talk slowly. The situation is a little complicated."
He had the rock golem stay in space and definitely couldn’t come down. Then, he and the others arrived at the Four Origin Planet.
He began to talk about his experiences over the years.
As everyone listened, they couldn’t help but feel nervous. As it turned out, Ling Han had actually experienced so many dangers.
When Ling Han said that he had seen the Battle Saint Emperor, Brother Monkey couldn’t help but feel extremely excited, and somersaulted a dozen over somersaults in the air.
Although Brother Monkey had always guessed that his ancestor hadn’t died, it was ultimately just a guess. Now that Ling Han had personally confirmed it, he finally felt at ease.
When he talked about that old Divine Beast from the Ancient Age, everyone was surprised, and made various guesses.
Just what kind of existence was this old Divine Beast?
The Divine Beasts from the ancient times had all died, but why had he survived?
"Say, in the Primitive Abyss, we still have the chance to become Emperor?" Buddha Doga and the other Pseudo-Emperors were all excited.
They had already contended for the throne once. Logically speaking, even if they lived a second life, they would have lost the right to contend for the throne.
However, who didn’t want to become Emperor?
Thus, after learning that there was still a chance to become Emperor in the Primitive Abyss, these Pseudo-Emperors were naturally excited.
Ling Han nodded earnestly, "However, we have to go to that island in the core area, but it is fraught with danger."
Even he, who possessed Emperor-level battle prowess, almost died.
"It’s worth a try," the three Pseudo-Emperors said.
They would rather die on the path of breaking through to Great Emperor Tier than live "mediocrely".

Similarly, Ding Shu and the others were also overjoyed, because compared to Ling Han, there was absolutely no way they could surpass him. The highest accomplishment in this lifetime would only be Pseudo-Emperor.
However, they all had the chance to become Emperors now, and it was not ordinary Great Emperors either. In fact, they could even advance into the fourth tier, third tier, or even higher.

Ling Han decided that after the problem of the Lands of Death was resolved, he would bring the Pseudo-Emperors by his side, and they would charge into the Primitive Abyss and attempt to break through to become Emperors.
Of course, if one hadn’t become a Pseudo-Emperor, they wouldn’t need to take risks.
After all, it was too difficult to obtain the cultivation resources in the Primitive Abyss. It could easily kill a Great Emperor.
"Little Han, are we going to a Land of Death to show off next?" the large black dog asked in excitement.

Because Zhang Yu was already dead, the side of the Lands of Death did not know that Ling Han had already advanced into the level of Pseudo-Emperor, and possessed battle prowess on the level of Great Emperor Tier.
Thus, wasn’t this the best chance to show off?
Ling Han was speechless, "Can’t you use better words?"
A dignified Great Emperor was someone who had ruled his own era, so how could it be that his power was used to show off?
"Swaggering around?" Sure enough, the large black dog changed his words.
"And you are a dog who uses the power of others to bully!" Ling Han mocked.
This was a derogatory term, but the large black dog didn’t mind at all.
Wasn’t it a dog?
Ling Han sighed, but then smiled and said, "Aren’t these guys looking for us? Fine, we’ll deliver ourselves to their doorstep."

All these years, those like Zhang Yu and the other fallen Imperial Sons had all been searching for Four Origin Planet. Even if they couldn’t find Ling Han, they would still find the empress and the others to use to threaten Ling Han.

Thankfully, with Ding Shu and the others here, they could bring the planets along with them and escape, and with the presence of Buddha Doga and the others, it was not difficult for them to protect themselves.
After all, they were Pseudo-Emperors, and if they were intent on fleeing, even a Great Emperor would have to make some prior arrangements before they could detain them.

Going to a Land of Death now, that would definitely be showing off. Thus, those like the empress and Chi Menghan and the others definitely could not be bothered to go. Those who went were all show-offs.

For example, the large black dog and the little azure dragon. Brother Monkey didn’t want to join in on the excitement. He was going to cultivate in seclusion, cultivating to the level of a nine-star Saint as soon as possible, breaking through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, and then, be able to go to the Primitive Abyss to see his ancestor.
Thus, Ling Han brought the large black dog and little azure dragon with him, and added with the rock golem, the four of them entered the great universe that had transformed into the Netherworld.

Right now, he had battle prowess on the level of a Great Emperor. With the golden path unfurled, and with Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he arrived at the core area of the universe in just half a day’s time.
This place was filled with extinguished stars, and it was filled with an air of death.
Ling Han nodded. This corresponded to the essence of Death. However, this was only a branch of the essence of Death, and could not possibly be used to grasp the essence of Death.
If he had to be honest, this was a manifestation of the Regulations of Death. It would be better to call it the Regulations of Death.
What corresponded to the Living Realm was the Regulations of Life.
It was very difficult to locate a specific star in such a colossal universe. However, it was simple to just locate those stars that had life.
The Chang Clan.
The descendants of the Four Directions Great Emperor, and they had control of the Galaxy Network. They were the wealthiest force in the entire universe, and there was no other that could match them.
Ling Han’s first target was the Chang Clan, and it was naturally because of Galaxy Network.
He was going to retrieve the Galaxy Network.
An earthen-yellow star appeared in front of the three of them. Only this star was still exuding the aura of life, and appeared unique among the dead silent stars in the surroundings.
"Let’s go!" the large black dog said excitedly. He couldn’t wait to show off.
They set out, and the rock golem also wanted to follow, but was stopped by Ling Han.
"Big Rock, wait for a while."

If the rock golem also fell at the same time, then the Chang Clan’s star would be equivalent to being struck by hundreds of billions of stars at the same time. It was guaranteed that it would be instantly turned into nothing.
En, the biggest use of the rock golem was to smash people, right?
Xiu, xiu, xiu! The three of them broke through the outer defenses of the planet, and landed on the ground.
This place... was filled with song and dance, and was completely unaffected by the Netherworld.

Ling Han’s eyes sharpened. When he thought of the people who had died in vain in the entire universe, he felt an urge to shatter the skies here, so that the aura of the Netherworld would surge in, turning this place into a dead star as well.

sentences.text: Ling Han smiled and said, "I’m back."
In an instant, Brother Monkey, the empress and the others also rushed over, all of them very excited.
"That was—" Qian Yanghao asked.
That rock golem actually gave him an incredibly strong pressure.
"Oh, I brought it back from the Primitive Abyss," Ling Han said.
Then, with a wave of his hand, the rock golem appeared in the skies above the Four Origin Planet.
He did not dare to let it come to the Four Origin Planet, because this guy was too heavy.
In the Primitive Abyss, it didn’t matter.
In any case, the heaven and earth structure there was extremely sturdy.
However, it was different here.
The weight of the entire Four Origin Planet added together couldn’t compare to the weight of a grain of sand on its body.
Then, with this big guy standing on the Four Origin Planet, would the Four Origin Planet immediately shatter?
"Pseudo-Emperor?" Xia Houping asked.
He already had an answer.
"En." Ling Han nodded.
Hiss.
Everyone clicked their tongues in amazement.
They had not thought that Ling Han would go out on a trip and actually manage to kidnap a Pseudo-Emperor to bring home.
"What about you?" Everyone was more concerned about Ling Han’s strength.
"I have not disappointed your expectations!" Ling Han said with a smile.
Everyone instantly exploded with excitement.
Ling Han had finally become a Pseudo-Emperor.
This meant that they had finally gained the qualifications to face the Lands of Death head-on.
"Can you rival a Great Emperor?" Buddha Doga asked.
Even he was slightly nervous.
After all, the higher one’s expectations, the more one would fear disappointment.
Ling Han smiled, "Let’s go back first, and talk slowly.
The situation is a little complicated."
He had the rock golem stay in space and definitely couldn’t come down.
Then, he and the others arrived at the Four Origin Planet.
He began to talk about his experiences over the years.
As everyone listened, they couldn’t help but feel nervous.
As it turned out, Ling Han had actually experienced so many dangers.
When Ling Han said that he had seen the Battle Saint Emperor, Brother Monkey couldn’t help but feel extremely excited, and somersaulted a dozen over somersaults in the air.
Although Brother Monkey had always guessed that his ancestor hadn’t died, it was ultimately just a guess.
Now that Ling Han had personally confirmed it, he finally felt at ease.
When he talked about that old Divine Beast from the Ancient Age, everyone was surprised, and made various guesses.
Just what kind of existence was this old Divine Beast?
The Divine Beasts from the ancient times had all died, but why had he survived?
"Say, in the Primitive Abyss, we still have the chance to become Emperor?" Buddha Doga and the other Pseudo-Emperors were all excited.
They had already contended for the throne once.
Logically speaking, even if they lived a second life, they would have lost the right to contend for the throne.
However, who didn’t want to become Emperor?
Thus, after learning that there was still a chance to become Emperor in the Primitive Abyss, these Pseudo-Emperors were naturally excited.
Ling Han nodded earnestly, "However, we have to go to that island in the core area, but it is fraught with danger."
Even he, who possessed Emperor-level battle prowess, almost died.
"It’s worth a try," the three Pseudo-Emperors said.
They would rather die on the path of breaking through to Great Emperor Tier than live "mediocrely".
Similarly, Ding Shu and the others were also overjoyed, because compared to Ling Han, there was absolutely no way they could surpass him.
The highest accomplishment in this lifetime would only be Pseudo-Emperor.
However, they all had the chance to become Emperors now, and it was not ordinary Great Emperors either.
In fact, they could even advance into the fourth tier, third tier, or even higher.

Ling Han decided that after the problem of the Lands of Death was resolved, he would bring the Pseudo-Emperors by his side, and they would charge into the Primitive Abyss and attempt to break through to become Emperors.
Of course, if one hadn’t become a Pseudo-Emperor, they wouldn’t need to take risks.
After all, it was too difficult to obtain the cultivation resources in the Primitive Abyss.
It could easily kill a Great Emperor.
"Little Han, are we going to a Land of Death to show off next?" the large black dog asked in excitement.

Because Zhang Yu was already dead, the side of the Lands of Death did not know that Ling Han had already advanced into the level of Pseudo-Emperor, and possessed battle prowess on the level of Great Emperor Tier.
Thus, wasn’t this the best chance to show off?
Ling Han was speechless, "Can’t you use better words?"
A dignified Great Emperor was someone who had ruled his own era, so how could it be that his power was used to show off?
"Swaggering around?" Sure enough, the large black dog changed his words.
"And you are a dog who uses the power of others to bully!" Ling Han mocked.
This was a derogatory term, but the large black dog didn’t mind at all.
Wasn’t it a dog?
Ling Han sighed, but then smiled and said, "Aren’t these guys looking for us?
Fine, we’ll deliver ourselves to their doorstep."
All these years, those like Zhang Yu and the other fallen Imperial Sons had all been searching for Four Origin Planet.
Even if they couldn’t find Ling Han, they would still find the empress and the others to use to threaten Ling Han.

Thankfully, with Ding Shu and the others here, they could bring the planets along with them and escape, and with the presence of Buddha Doga and the others, it was not difficult for them to protect themselves.
After all, they were Pseudo-Emperors, and if they were intent on fleeing, even a Great Emperor would have to make some prior arrangements before they could detain them.
Going to a Land of Death now, that would definitely be showing off.
Thus, those like the empress and Chi Menghan and the others definitely could not be bothered to go.
Those who went were all show-offs.
For example, the large black dog and the little azure dragon.
Brother Monkey didn’t want to join in on the excitement.

He was going to cultivate in seclusion, cultivating to the level of a nine-star Saint as soon as possible, breaking through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, and then, be able to go to the Primitive Abyss to see his ancestor.
Thus, Ling Han brought the large black dog and little azure dragon with him, and added with the rock golem, the four of them entered the great universe that had transformed into the Netherworld.
Right now, he had battle prowess on the level of a Great Emperor.
With the golden path unfurled, and with Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he arrived at the core area of the universe in just half a day’s time.

Ling Han nodded.
This corresponded to the essence of Death.

If he had to be honest, this was a manifestation of the Regulations of Death.
It would be better to call it the Regulations of Death.
What corresponded to the Living Realm was the Regulations of Life.
It was very difficult to locate a specific star in such a colossal universe.
However, it was simple to just locate those stars that had life.

chapters.title: Chapter 4820: Acting around
paragraphs: "Come with Grandpa Dog!" The large black dog crossed its front paws behind its back as it walked at the forefront. This was a perfect example of how a dog would use the power of others to bully.
Er, this idiom could be said to be very appropriate.
If one looked again at the shining iron underwear, then the word ’sleazy’ would have to be added, making Ling Han and the little azure dragon unable to bear looking at it directly.
It was too blinding.
The three of them swaggered onwards just like that, heading straight for the ancestral grounds of the Chang Clan.
How fast were their speed? In just half a day, they had already arrived at their destination.
This was still because the large black dog deliberately walked slowly, paving the way for him to show off.
Originally, the ancestral grounds of the Imperial Clan were all protected by the imperial formation, but now, the imperial formation of the Chang Clan was not channelled.
Usually, no one would dare barge into the Imperial Clan, what more now. There were not many living people in the galaxy.
Moreover, the Chang Clan’s Great Emperor was still alive, so what need was there for an imperial formation?
However, without the protection of the imperial formation, it did not mean that anyone could enter into the ancestral grounds.

There were guards here, and normal people would have to undergo strict inspection when entering and exiting. However, if it was a core member of the Chang Clan, they could come and go as they liked, and no guards would step up to question them.
The large black dog pretended to walk over.

A large black dog walked on its hind legs. This was already very strange. After all, a Demonic Beast would take human form after cultivating to the Celestial Path. This was more in line with the Dao of heaven and earth.
However, this large black dog was actually wearing a pair of shiny iron underwear, so he was naturally even more eye-catching.
All of a sudden, everyone’s eyes were focused on the large black dog.
Faced with these strange gazes, not only did the large black dog not feel the slightest discomfort, he instead became excited, and said, "Open your stupid eyes, and admire your gods!"
"Hehe, a wild dog actually dares to speak conceited nonsense. Capture him, and we’ll have dog meat for dinner." A person immediately walked out with a smile, and grabbed out at the large black dog.
The large black dog was enraged. ’Can’t you see that I’m showing off?’
He actually dared to undermine Grandpa Dog!
"Eat dog meat your head!" It shot out a kick. Xiu, that person instantly flew into the skies, as if he had turned into a star.
This!
"How dare you! You actually dare to commit violence!" The people in the surroundings were all enraged.

This was the ancestral grounds of the Chang Clan. The people here were basically all members of the Chang Clan, and a small number of them were servants, as well as the descendants of their servants through the generations.
Thus, they naturally worked together, and were completely unanimous.
"Be careful, this demonic dog’s abilities are extraordinary," an old man said darkly.
"Hiss, even you do not have the confidence to apprehend him?" When the people in the surroundings heard this, they all inhaled sharply.
This old man’s name was Chang Jianyun, and he was a Spiritual Transformation True Lord. Among them, his cultivation level was the highest.
Thus, even Chang Jianyun had reminded them that the large black dog was not weak, which naturally stunned everyone.
"Let me give it a try." A man in a tight-fitting black suit walked out.
Chang Ruohe, a True Self Tier.
Chang Jianyun nodded, "Ruohe, you go and test out its strength. You cannot be careless."
"Understood." Chang Ruohe nodded, then walked towards the large black dog.
Boom, he unhesitatingly released the power in his body. He was going all out in this attack.

The large black dog acted as if he was facing a great enemy, then said, "You guys actually sent a True Self Tier to deal with Grandpa Dog. You guys are really cautious, and know how powerful Grandpa Dog is."
Seeing the large black dog’s expression, Chang Ruohe instantly breathed a sigh of relief.
By the looks of it, the other was also at the True Self Tier. It was because of this that he was so cautious and nervous.
"Come!" he shouted loudly, and charged towards the large black dog.
"Do you think I’m afraid of you?" The large black dog also roared, and charged towards Chang Ruohe.
Peng, peng, peng! The man and dog began fighting, and the scene was incredibly intense.
"Humph, I really don’t know where this wild dog came from. A mere True Self Tier cultivator dares to be impudent!" Seeing this, everyone was relieved.
As it turned out, the large black dog was only so-so. He had almost been scared off by it.

"Despicable dog, hurry up and give up resistance. Perhaps we can spare your wretched <anno data-annotation-id="4507a2de-2b3f-45c4-bbea-0ad1ecf9e9b2" data-title="life.">life.1</anno>" Chang Ruohe was also relieved, and showed an expression of pride.
"Pu!"
"This really is a dog’s life."
"Haha, that’s too vivid."
Everyone burst into laughter. Even Chang Ruohe couldn’t help but smile. He had not thought that his casual remark would actually become a golden line.
The large black dog bawled loudly, "Grandpa Dog is about to die from fury. Looks like Grandpa Dog will have to flip out!"
"Humph, so what if you flip out?" Chang Ruohe asked calmly.
"Look at Grandpa Dog’s amazing Overlord Technique, Three Lives Invincible Divine Claw!" The large black dog put on an act, then delivered a palm strike.
Peng, with just a single strike, Chang Ruohe was sent flying, turning into a small star in the skies.

Meanwhile, the large black dog plopped down, panting heavily, and said, "You actually forced me to use an amazing technique, causing Grandpa Dog’s vitality to be greatly damaged, and losing a dozen over years of my lifespan!"
The members of the Chang Clan looked at each other in confusion.

Logically speaking, they did not believe the large black dog’s words. What kind of amazing technique could have such explosive power? However, the large black dog was also an excellent actor, acting to the point that they could not help but suspect that there was such a possibility.
What exactly was it?

Chang Jianyun had no choice but to step out. Among the people present, his cultivation level was the highest. If he did not make a move, could it be that he would allow others to become cannon fodder?
Moreover, this was the ancestral grounds of the Chang Clan. A despicable dog actually dared to strut around here?
It wouldn’t be long before elites came over and suppressed him.
Thus, he only needed to hold up the fort and buy some time.
"Who exactly are you?" Chang Jianyun shouted at the large black dog.
"You don’t even know Grandpa Dog?" The large black dog pointed at himself, and said, "I’m the most powerful Ancestral King in history... Black Emperor!"
Chang Jianyun couldn’t help but look furious. This was clearly playing around with him.
Who would show off like this?
Great Emperor, ptui!
"So you’re just a pretentious dog!" he said <anno data-annotation-id="9c580223-b86b-4dec-8895-f6f5b628cfe2" data-title="disdainfully">disdainfully1</anno>.
P-pretentious dog!
The large black dog clutched his chest. Unfortunately, his heart had taken another blow.
As a dog, could it be a cardinal sin?
"Foolish human, you actually created so many malicious words. Grandpa Dog truly detests you deeply!" The large black dog bared his fangs and brandished his claws.
"Pretentious dog, surrender your life!" When Chang Jianyun saw this, he immediately charged out.
At this moment, the large black dog’s emotions were fluctuating. If he made a move now, it was almost certain that he would succeed.
Boom, his palm arrived. A Spirit Transformation True Lord’s full strength burst forth, and Regulations appeared.
"So powerful, you are forcing Grandpa Dog to use another amazing move." The large black dog let out a strange cry, "Look at Grandpa Dog’s Ten Lives Dominating Heaven Kick!"
Peng!
The large black dog unleashed a sneaky kick at Chang Jianyun’s crotch.
That sound caused everyone to feel a phantom pain.

Chang Jianyun’s face instantly became incredibly pale. His hands couldn’t help but cover his crotch, and his legs were also clamped tightly together. After trembling a few times, peng, he collapsed onto the ground. His forehead was covered with cold sweat, and only low moans could be heard from his throat.
It wasn’t that it didn’t hurt, but that it hurt so much that he couldn’t even cry out in pain.
Everyone looked at the large black dog. Hiss, this guy was really ruthless.

<annotations style="display: none;">Actually, ’wretched life’ can also be literally translated to ’dog’s life’.Someone who likes to show off might be referred to as a pretentious dog, but does not literally mean that they are a dog.</annotations>

chapters.title: Chapter 4821: Number one in all eternity
paragraphs: Everyone had only seen the large black dog’s despicable side, yet had overlooked it because of this. What qualified him to cripple a Spirit Transformation True Lord with a single kick?
"What a despicable dog!"
Everyone rebuked. This dog was really too mean. He actually kicked someone’s b@lls, and had even shattered them.
Meanwhile, the large black dog snickered. He was the type to disgust others.
"Humph, who dares to be impudent here?" A cold voice rang out, and a young man strode over from the sky.
He looked to be only in his twenties, yet he was shockingly already at the level of Sect Master. As he stood there, his aura surged, like a vast ocean.
Everyone hurriedly paid their respects, "Greetings, Young Master Qi!"
This person’s name was Ma Jianqi, and he was not a member of the Chang Clan. Instead, he was the descendant of a servant of the Chang Clan.
But why did a servant have such a high status?

That was because that ancestor of Ma Jianqi’s was too extraordinary. Though he had come from the background of servants, his natural talent in cultivation was astonishing. He had actually broken through all the way to become a Saint.
Saints would be treated with high standards no matter which Imperial Clan they went to.

Thus, this ancestor of the Ma Clan had also changed from a servant to a guest official of the Chang Clan, and the line of the Ma Clan had also changed from servants to guards, and their status had risen <anno data-annotation-id="a9b3d8d1-20f3-4bb8-873e-0b6b85f48bfa" data-title="greatly">greatly1</anno>.
Though Ma Jianqi’s status could not be compared to the Imperial Son, but compared to an ordinary member of the Chang Clan, his status was not just a little bit higher.
And now, Ma Jianqi had arrived. This was a Sect Master, so how could it be that he could not deal with a despicable dog?
Ma Jianqi was extremely arrogant, and merely humphed. Then, he turned to look at the large black dog, and said calmly, "Kneel."
"Onionhead, your mouth is really despicable!" The large black dog picked his nose.
This caused everyone to scoff. Just how despicable was your own mouth? Don’t you have any idea?
And he still dared to say that another person was despicable!
"At first, I wanted to take you in as a demon pet, but you are seeking your own death!" Ma Jianqi declared coldly.
He had never been a good-tempered person.

For those Imperial Sons, Imperial Sons in reserve, and so on of Imperial Clans, though they were incredibly proud, and looked down on everyone in the world, when dealing with others, they would give off an amiable feeling.
This was self-restraint.
However, Ma Jianqi didn’t have such self-restraint, because he felt that it was hypocritical.
He was that noble, so why did he have to treat such a lowly person warmly?
"Die!" Ma Jianqi roared as he lashed out at the large black dog.
"Goodness, even a Sect Master is here. Then Grandpa Dog has to use my trump card." The large black dog called out strangely, "Look at Grandpa Dog’s Hundred Lives Glorious Kick."
Peng!

chapters.title: Chapter 4822: Crushed B@lls
paragraphs: Ling Han remained silent.
The Seven Origin Saint couldn’t help but look furious, "Ling Han, although you are the strongest Saint of all eternity, don’t you think you are too arrogant?"
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, "You are not yet qualified to speak to me."

The large black dog continued, "Old brat, you are not qualified to speak with my Little Han. You are only worthy of being my dog — ptui!" He suddenly flew into a rage, and said to Ling Han, "Little Han, what you mean is that Grandpa Dog is inferior to you?"
Ling Han spread his hands and said, "You were the one who said it. It has nothing to do with me."
"F***, Grandpa Dog will bite you to death!" The large black dog pounced over.
Seeing the man and dog exchange blows, the members of the Chang Clan were all dumbfounded.
’Are you people... here to show off?’
But this was the Chang Clan!
"You guys... have you had enough!" the Seven Origin Saint said through gritted teeth. He felt that this kind of act as if there was no one around was the greatest humiliation to the Chang Clan.
"Old brat, are you asking for a beating?" The large black dog leaped out, and had already arrived in front of the Seven Origin Saint. He waved his paw in a strike.
The Seven Origin Saint was only apprehensive of Ling Han, so he naturally wasn’t afraid of the "Despicable Saint". He immediately launched a palm strike.
"Watch as One Life Heavenly Pride!" The large black dog’s giant black dog launched another sneaky kick, aimed directly between the legs of the Seven Origin Saint.
However, the Seven Origin Saint was a Saint, after all. Even if he was two minor levels lower than the large black dog, he could not possibly be so weak that he would be hit with a single strike.
The old Saint hurriedly used his palms to block this strike. Peng! This sneaky kick landed on his palm.
With a bang, the Seven Origin Saint was sent flying.
Everyone gaped in shock. That was the Seven Origin Saint! In their eyes, this was practically equivalent to being invincible!
But now?
He was sent flying with a single kick.
In an instant, the Seven Origin Saint had already stepped into the sky and returned. However, both of his hands were slightly misshapen.
Saints were hard to kill, but it could not be helped that this was a lower-level Saint clashing head-on with a higher-level Saint.

In the first place, the large black dog’s battle prowess was slightly stronger than Saints of the same cultivation level, what more when he had a lead of two minor levels over the Seven Origin Saint. Yet, the Seven Origin Saint still insisted on facing it head-on. This was actually an action of courting death.
It was already very fortunate that he had not been killed, and only had both his arms crippled.
The old Saint’s expression was extremely livid. He had actually been wounded by a despicable dog in a single move. This was a great humiliation to him.
But more importantly, this despicable dog was actually aiming for his b@lls.
This was what was even more intolerable.
If it was not for the fact that he had protected himself in time, he would probably have become the first Saint in history to have his b@lls crushed.
How could he tolerate this? How could he not be furious?
"Despicable dog!" he shouted loudly, his killing intent blazing.
The large black dog waved his paw and corrected, saying, "No, no, no, it’s the number one Despicable Saint of all eternity! Don’t forget the word ’eternity’ and the words ’number one’."
’Holy f*ck!’
The Seven Origin Saint roared in fury, and charged towards the large black dog.
This time, he knew that his strength was inferior to the large black dog, so he did not attack from close quarters. Instead, he drew out the distance between them and began a bombardment.
The large black dog didn’t pay any heed to this, and he simply continued to exchange blows with his opponent.
"Old brat, your abilities are not good enough."
"You’re already so old, so how could it be that your cultivation has all been for nothing?"
"Hey, hey, hey, what are you glaring at me for? Could it be that you think that Grandpa Dog is wrong?"
The large black dog spat as he continued to pummel his opponent.
At first, the Seven Origin Saint was still bickering with the large black dog, but after a few words, he gave up on this idea.
This was even more tiring than battle, causing him to rack his brains. In fact, even his movements were slowed down by this.

It couldn’t be helped. The large black dog’s ability to curse and battle was instinctive, and there was no need for him to use his brain at all. However, he was different. He had to respond seriously, or how could he refute the large black dog’s words? After all, he was a Saint, so how could he speak so easily?
After battling for a while, more elites from the Chang Clan appeared.
This time, it was awesome.
Chang Yu, a nine-star Saint!

Excluding the Primitive Abyss Saints, there were actually very few Saints in the great world, and nine-star Saints were even rarer. If one were to exclude those that lived in seclusion, there would probably only be as many as to be counted on the fingers of a single hand.
Thus, Chang Yu, a nine-star Saint, was naturally very impressive.
"Stop!" he shouted softly.
The Seven Origin Saint hurriedly stepped back in response. Before a nine-star Saint, he was nothing more than a junior.
Meanwhile, the large black dog lazily asked, "Didn’t I tell you to summon the Great Emperor who’s old but doesn’t die?"
"How dare you!" Chang Yu humphed, and immediately delivered a palm strike at the large black dog.
However, he had just raised his hand, when Ling Han moved as well. With a light wave of his hand, Chang Yu’s attack was dispersed.
"Ling Han!" Chang Yu looked over, his white brows raised, "I have long heard that there is a Saint that is known as the strongest in all eternity. I was really filled with doubt."
As a nine-star Saint, he could be said to have a very strong say about the power level of Saints. Thus, he thought that Ling Han’s strength must have been exaggerated.
The strongest in all eternity. Hehe, did he really think that that was a title that he could simply bestow on himself?
The large black dog coughed, "Little Han, it’s your turn to show off."
"Let’s invite the Show-off King to make a grand entrance!" The little azure dragon, who had been left hanging on the sidelines for a long time, suddenly said.
These two idiots!
Ling Han sighed, and couldn’t be bothered to pay any heed to the two of them. He turned to Chang Yu, and said, "Come and try. I’ll torture you to the point of doubting life!"
"Tsk, these words are filled with dominance," the large black dog remarked.
"However, the sense of showing off is even stronger," the little azure dragon also said.

Chang Yu’s expression changed drastically. He was a Nine-Star Saint. Before the Lords of Death and the sons of the Great Emperors appeared, he had represented the strongest. What kind of authority did he have?
And now, he was actually being mocked repeatedly, so how could he not be furious?
When one had reached a height that he had, he would kill at the slightest provocation. All life was like ants to him, and he would not take them to heart at all.
"You’re seeking death!" He moved again, and delivered a palm strike at the large black dog and little azure dragon.
Ling Han shook his head, and also sent out a palm strike.
"You think you can stop me?" Chang Yu asked with a cold chuckle. He unleashed his full strength as a nine-star Saint.
Peng!
Ling Han delivered a slap, and Chang Yu was instantly sent rolling on the ground.
What!
All of a sudden, the members of the Chang Clan were all dumbfounded.
In their eyes, though the Great Emperor was invincible, and the Imperial Son was freakish, in truth, the person they were most familiar with was still this ancestor of theirs.
For hundreds of thousands of years, this ancestor had been standing guard over the Chang Clan like a boulder.
Thus, when they saw Chang Yu being sent flying with a single slap, they were practically beginning to doubt their own lives.
How was this possible?
Then, they looked towards Ling Han.
The show-off king, this was the show-off king.

Previously, he had allowed the despicable dog to rampage around, drawing enough aggro, which led to Chang Yu making a move. At first, he had thought that he would be able to sweep aside all opposition, but what happened in the end?
He was sent flying with a single slap.
Sure enough, the show-off king had deep schemes.
Right at this moment, a black shadow streaked out at an extraordinarily fast speed.
It was... the large black dog.
Peng!
The large black dog rushed in front of Chang Yu, and shot out a kick, which landed between Chang Yu’s legs.
At first, Chang Yu had already passed out, but with this kick, he forcefully regained consciousness. He directly sat up straight, his whole head of white hair exploding.
’Holy f*ck! As expected of the Despicable Saint!’
