All life was like ants to him, and he would not take them to heart at all.
"You’re seeking death!" He moved again, and delivered a palm strike at the large black dog and little azure dragon.
Ling Han shook his head, and also sent out a palm strike.
"You think you can stop me?" Chang Yu asked with a cold chuckle.
He unleashed his full strength as a nine-star Saint.
Peng!
Ling Han delivered a slap, and Chang Yu was instantly sent rolling on the ground.
What!
All of a sudden, the members of the Chang Clan were all dumbfounded.
In their eyes, though the Great Emperor was invincible, and the Imperial Son was freakish, in truth, the person they were most familiar with was still this ancestor of theirs.
For hundreds of thousands of years, this ancestor had been standing guard over the Chang Clan like a boulder.
Thus, when they saw Chang Yu being sent flying with a single slap, they were practically beginning to doubt their own lives.
How was this possible?
Then, they looked towards Ling Han.
The show-off king, this was the show-off king.
Previously, he had allowed the despicable dog to rampage around, drawing enough aggro, which led to Chang Yu making a move.
At first, he had thought that he would be able to sweep aside all opposition, but what happened in the end?
He was sent flying with a single slap.
Sure enough, the show-off king had deep schemes.
Right at this moment, a black shadow streaked out at an extraordinarily fast speed.
It was... the large black dog.
Peng!
The large black dog rushed in front of Chang Yu, and shot out a kick, which landed between Chang Yu’s legs.
At first, Chang Yu had already passed out, but with this kick, he forcefully regained consciousness.
He directly sat up straight, his whole head of white hair exploding.
’Holy f*ck!
As expected of the Despicable Saint!’

chapters.title: Chapter 4823: Second Elder is Invincible!
paragraphs: The members of the Chang Clan were all furious.
This was too despicable. A few outsiders had come to the ancestral grounds of the Chang Clan to strut around, and had even pressed and ground their ancestor into the ground..
The pitiful old ancestor was forcefully kicked out of his coma.
Definitely, even the b@lls had been shattered.
This despicable dog was just that ruthless.
But the problem was, even their ancestor had been defeated in an instant, so what could they do?
"Second Elder!" they all called out.
Second Elder, Chang Tingjian, Pseudo-Emperor!
Boom! A terrifying aura swept over, and as expected, Chang Tingjian appeared.
He had no choice but to step out. Aside from himself, who else could match Ling Han?
"Ling Han, you are really outrageously bold!" Chang Tingjian said calmly. He was filled with confidence.

This was the ancestral grounds of the Chang Clan, where the Four Directions Great Emperor was hidden. Thus, even if Ling Han possessed Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess, so what? Since he had walked right to their doorstep, his only fate was death.
"Hehe, I have indeed always been very bold," Ling Han admitted bluntly.
"However, you’re seeking death this time!" Chang Tingjian immediately added.
"Oh?" Ling Han shook his head, then looked towards the large black dog, "At this time, how should I answer to be able to show off fully?"
"Hiss!" The large black dog sucked in a sharp breath, appearing extremely stunned, "As a great show-off, you actually have to ask Grandpa Dog for guidance on how to show off?"
"This is too much of a show-off!" The little azure dragon also nodded.
Sigh, these two guys!
Chang Tingjian’s expression was filled with fury, and he shouted, "Ling Han, have you forgotten? This is the ancestral grounds of our Chang Clan, and my father... is still alive!"

"Yi, do you have the hobby of acknowledging a ghost as your father?" Ling Han asked curiously, "Or do you not know? Your old man has long since died, and now he is neither human nor ghost. If he went out in the middle of the night, he would definitely scare someone to death."
Chang Tingjian couldn’t hold himself back any longer. With a battle cry, he charged towards Ling Han.
The authority of a Great Emperor could not be sullied.
He charged over, and delivered a palm strike, as if it was a divine saber.
Ling Han couldn’t help but chuckle, saying, "You’re truly bold. Aren’t you afraid that your planet will be obliterated if you battle here?"
Only then did Chang Tingjian’s heart shudder, and he hurriedly withdrew his hand.
However, forcibly stopping under such conditions also caused a considerable impact on him, causing his chest to boil, and he almost spat out a mouthful of blood.
"Despicable!"
"Shameless!"
"How filthy!"
The members of the Chang Clan were all enraged. They could naturally see how much impact Chang Tingjian’s forceful withdrawal of his attack had on him.
As expected of Despicable Saints, both of them were.
Chang Tingjian forcefully suppressed his urge to attack, and said balefully, "Let’s battle in the sky!"
"Why should I listen to you?" Ling Han said with a smile. "What a joke. I’m here to crash the party. Once I’m in the sky, how am I supposed to crash the party?"
This... was very logical.
Just like if he went to the Four Origin Planet to fight Ling Han, would he have any scruples?
He would not, so how could he possibly ask Ling Han to do the same?

However, a Pseudo-Emperor was too strong. Even if Great Emperors moved, it was impossible that they could force a Pseudo-Emperor to the point of not being able to unleash the slightest move. In that case, if only the slightest sliver of a shockwave seeped out, it could not be too easy for them to destroy a planet.
This!
’Are you aware of this fact? Is that why you’ve come so boldly, so that the Four Directions Great Emperor could be forced to hold back?’

"Ling Han, I’ve always thought that you were an upright person. I never thought that you would be so despicable! Humph, what do you mean by the strongest Saint of all eternity? You only have an empty reputation!" Chang Tingjian tried to goad him into action.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "You are absolutely right. I am not some strongest Saint in all eternity."
Yi!
Everyone was rendered speechless. ’You’re already so shameless? That’s truly despicable to the point of being invincible. There’s no angle that others could attack.’
However, Ling Han continued, "I am the strongest Great Emperor of all eternity!"
’Holy f*ck!’
Everyone couldn’t help but grimace. Was he made from the same mold as the large black dog?
It was all because he had f****** displayed his shamelessness to the extreme.

Just look, everyone had thought that he was self-centred and not the strongest Saint of all eternity, but in the end? His skin was so thick that he was already claiming to be the strongest Great Emperor.
Faced with this kind of person, would verbal attacks be effective?
Others would be the ones who would be dying from fury!

Chang Tingjian was also at his wit’s end. Though his cultivation level had improved, he did not have the slightest confidence that he could defeat Ling Han. Once the battle began, it was very likely that the two of them would be locked in a stalemate.
In this way, would this star still exist?
Even if it had been reinforced by the power of a Great Emperor, it could only withstand the attacks of Saints. Pseudo-Emperors were completely different concepts.
At this moment, Chang Tingjian didn’t know how to respond.
But how could it be that it would allow the three of them to act arrogant and insolent here?
What face would the Imperial Clan have left? What face would he, a Pseudo-Emperor, have? What face would the Four Directions Great Emperor have left?
"Alright, since you want to fight me so much, then come fight me." Ling Han leaped out, and had already arrived in space.
Although Chang Tingjian didn’t know why Ling Han was yielding, this was something he wanted more than anything else. He naturally couldn’t refuse, and he hurriedly rose into the sky as well.
"For the sake of this, I’ll try my best to leave your corpse intact," he said calmly.
"You think you can?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
These words were filled with contempt, but Chang Tingjian was unable to refute them.
He indeed did not have the confidence to defeat Ling Han, what more kill him.
"Don’t forget, there’s also a Great Emperor here!" Chang Tingjian said proudly.
"Er, aren’t we going to use quotation marks on that?" Ling Han’s expression was filled with confusion.
Chang Tingjian shouted loudly, and charged towards Ling Han. He could not tolerate Ling Han insulting his father.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
A Pseudo-Emperor unleashed his might, boundlessly terrifying.

A terrifying power surged, and the surrounding stars exploded one after another. Thankfully, they were far enough away from where the Chang Clan was located. Otherwise, even if they were battling in space, so what? They would still be unable to escape the fate of shattering.
"Yo, your abilities have improved quite a bit," Ling Han remarked as he casually parried.
Though this was a compliment, Chang Tingjian wasn’t happy at all. Instead, he was furious.
What kind of tone was that?
’Do you think you’re my senior?’
"Do you think I’ve wasted all these years?" Chang Tingjian said with a cold chuckle. His attacks became even more rapid.
He had already advanced into Three Star Pseudo-Emperor. After reviving his body three times, his grasp of Nine Star Regulations had improved greatly, and his battle prowess was astonishing.
He aggressively charged forward, beating down on Ling Han.
"Second Elder is mighty!"
"Second Elder is so domineering!"
Below, the members of the Chang Clan could see clearly through the Galaxy Network, and they were all incredibly excited, shouting in excitement.
This was a Pseudo-Emperor-level battle; how many times could they see a battle like this in a lifetime?
Moreover, their Second Elder was at an absolute advantage.
This naturally made them numb with excitement.
"Second Elder is invincible!"
"Second Elder has hemorrhoids!"
Right at this moment, a calm voice rang out. It was clearly not loud, but it was incredibly clear, as if it could penetrate one’s brain.
F***, who was causing trouble here?
Everyone turned to look, only to see the large black dog had his back to them, and one of his paws was scratching at his iron underwear.
"I’ve been a little constipated recently. Is it because of hemorrhoids?"
D-d*mn dog!

chapters.title: Chapter 4824: Pseudo-Emperor as Servant
paragraphs: Now, Chang Tingjian was suppressing Ling Han. He was mighty and domineering, and everyone was excited. However, a despicable dog had spoken rudely, completely ruining the atmosphere.
Who could tolerate this?
Yet, this despicable dog was actually a Saint!
The heavens must be blind.

Most people only dared to feel furious, and did not dare to speak. Even the Seven Origin Saint felt lingering fear in his heart. This despicable dog specialized in kicking people in their cr*tch. Just look, his ancestor was still covering his cr*tch now. He had no wish to repeat the same mistake.
He had to endure it first!
As long as Ling Han was killed, they would be able to deal with this despicable dog as they pleased.
"Old Black, if looks could kill, you’d have died a few hundred times already," the little azure dragon said sarcastically.
"Pei!" The large black dog spat, "They are worshipping me. You are just a child, so you don’t understand!"
Seeing how shameless the large black dog was, the members of the Chang Clan felt an urge to go all out again.
This was too despicable.
In space, Chang Tingjian was still battling fiercely with Ling Han.
Of course, the so-called fierce battle was only his own wishful thinking.
He was very pleased now. He was completely on the upper hand here, beating down on Ling Han and rebuilding the invincible confidence as the son of a Great Emperor.
After all, they were all mortals!

After so many years, he was walking further and further on the path of Pseudo-Emperor. He had already cultivated a sliver of Nine Star Regulations, and finally possessed the might of Pseudo-Emperor. He was no longer that person who only had Pseudo-Emperor power.
Thus, Ling Han was no match for him.
"Ling Han, I have to admit that I am impressed by your courage!" he said calmly, "Unfortunately, you have come to the wrong place. This is the Chang Clan!"
These words were broadcasted live on the Galaxy Network, and were heard by every member of the Chang Clan. They were all numb with excitement.
The Chang Clan was invincible!

At the very top, there was an invincible Great Emperor standing guard, while below, there was a Pseudo-Emperor. As long as the heaven and earth allowed it, a second Great Emperor could appear at any time.
To have two Great Emperors in one clan, this was something that had never happened before in history!
Their pride as members of the Chang Clan rose up, causing their faces to flush red, and they felt an indescribable madness.
At this moment, they were willing to go through fire and water for the sake of their clan!
"Yi, look, what is that!" Someone suddenly exclaimed in shock.
Through the Galaxy Network, they saw that there was a small black dot rapidly approaching the battle between Ling Han and Chang Tingjian.
The Seven Origin Saint hurriedly adjusted the angle of the "Heaven’s Eye" in space, aiming directly at the small black dot.
In an instant, the little black dot instantly enlarged, turning into a massive... rock golem.
Everyone was astonished. Why had a rock golem suddenly appeared out of nowhere?
"Ao, ao, ao!" The rock golem had already arrived, and as it released a wave of divine sense-level fluctuation, it launched an attack in excitement.
It had sensed the commotion caused by the battle here, and when it saw that Ling Han was presently engaged in an intense battle, how could it tolerate it any longer!
—It was not the type to care about the strength of its opponent. If even Ling Han was no match for it, then what was the point of it charging in?
For this big guy, there was no need for a reason to fight.
Boom!
It threw a punch, and just like that, it directly smashed towards Chang Tingjian.
’Holy f*ck!’
Chang Tingjian’s hair instantly stood on end. What kind of f*cking monster was this? Why was his battle prowess so explosive?

He hurriedly leaped aside to dodge. In his eyes, the might of this attack had reached the level of an eight-star Pseudo-Emperor. If he took it head-on, he definitely wouldn’t die, but he might be injured, or even severely wounded.
"Ao!" The rock golem was so excited that it couldn’t even stop itself, and charged towards Chang Tingjian again.
This time, Chang Tingjian felt gloomy.
’F*ck! Can’t you see that Ling Han is closer to you? Why don’t you fight those who are closer to you? Why do you insist on chasing me?’
’By the way, where did you pop out from?’
A Pseudo-Emperor wasn’t something that could be found anywhere!
He was filled with confusion and shock.
Ling Han was also taken aback, and said with a smile, "Big Rock, how am I supposed to show off if you do this?"
The rock golem immediately stopped, then rubbed its massive head with its massive hand, looking silly.
However, its weight was too terrifying. Even if it was only friction between its own limbs, it still created a powerful shockwave, disturbing the surrounding space.
’F*ck!’
Chang Tingjian’s mouth instantly gaped open, as if he had seen a ghost.
What, this rock golem, a Pseudo-Emperor, was actually in the same group as Ling Han?
Furthermore, he seemed to be very obedient to Ling Han’s words.
How could he believe this?
A Saint had actually subdued a Pseudo-Emperor-level rock creature?
Wasn’t this a fantasy story?
All of a sudden, his mind was in a mess.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, then said with a smile, "Alright, since you’re already here, then just continue the fight."
The rock golem immediately howled again, and charged towards Chang Tingjian.
This rendered Chang Tingjian extremely speechless.
Are you a f****** dog? Why are you so obedient?
As a dignified Pseudo-Emperor, you actually still have to obey the commands of others. Don’t you have the slightest bit of pride?
However, he soon did not have the spare energy to think about these problems.
The rock golem charged over, every move fierce. The might of a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor was fully displayed, making it difficult for Chang Tingjian to parry, so how could he dare to be distracted?
Ling Han felt bored after watching for a while. He now had Great Emperor-level battle prowess. In his eyes, a Pseudo-Emperor-level battle was actually not much different from children playing around.
However, in the distance, the members of the Chang Clan all looked like they had lost both their parents.
Just now, their Second Elder had still been mighty and domineering, beating down on Ling Han, but now?
He was actually unable to fight back against a rock monster, and was in such a sorry state.
This, this, this, Ling Han actually had such a helper?
"Let me introduce. That’s called Big Rock, the servant of our Little Han." The large black dog was most skilled in psychological attacks, and began to show off for Ling Han.
W-what!
Among the members of the Chang Clan, though there were pitifully few Saints, it did not stop them from confirming the fact that the rock golem was a Pseudo-Emperor.
—Didn’t they see that even Second Elder was being beaten down on?
However, a great Pseudo-Emperor, who had the word "Emperor" in his name, had actually become someone else’s servant and obeyed his every command. How could they accept this?
However, the truth was right in front of their eyes. They had no choice but to believe it even if they didn’t want to.
Heavens, someone could actually subdue a Pseudo-Emperor. Could even a Great Emperor do the same?
Yet it just so happened that Ling Han was still a Saint.
Could it be that it was his destiny?
All of a sudden, the morale of the Chang Clan was very low.
It could not be helped. Second Elder was presently being beaten, and Ling Han’s freakish talent had actually surpassed a Great Emperor.
"Damn it!" Chang Tingjian finally unleashed his trump card.
Imperial Weapon, Eternal Dragon Hammer.

Weng! He activated the Imperial Weapon, unleashing a boundless burst of light from the Eternal Dragon Hammer. The might of the Imperial Weapon permeated into the surroundings. This was genuinely Great Emperor-level.
Peng, it was only a short while, and the rock golem was sent flying with a strike.
However, its physique was too tough. Even after being hammered head-on by the Imperial Weapon, it was still unscathed, and only some scraps fell.
This time, even Chang Tingjian was stunned by what he saw.
’W-what kind of body is this?’
This was too freakish.

It threw a punch, and just like that, it directly smashed towards Chang Tingjian.
’Holy f*ck!’
Chang Tingjian’s hair instantly stood on end.
What kind of f*cking monster was this?
Why was his battle prowess so explosive?
He hurriedly leaped aside to dodge.
In his eyes, the might of this attack had reached the level of an eight-star Pseudo-Emperor.
If he took it head-on, he definitely wouldn’t die, but he might be injured, or even severely wounded.
"Ao!" The rock golem was so excited that it couldn’t even stop itself, and charged towards Chang Tingjian again.
This time, Chang Tingjian felt gloomy.
’F*ck!
Can’t you see that Ling Han is closer to you?
Why don’t you fight those who are closer to you?
Why do you insist on chasing me?’
’By the way, where did you pop out from?’
A Pseudo-Emperor wasn’t something that could be found anywhere!
He was filled with confusion and shock.
Ling Han was also taken aback, and said with a smile, "Big Rock, how am I supposed to show off if you do this?"
The rock golem immediately stopped, then rubbed its massive head with its massive hand, looking silly.
However, its weight was too terrifying.
Even if it was only friction between its own limbs, it still created a powerful shockwave, disturbing the surrounding space.
’F*ck!’
Chang Tingjian’s mouth instantly gaped open, as if he had seen a ghost.
What, this rock golem, a Pseudo-Emperor, was actually in the same group as Ling Han?
Furthermore, he seemed to be very obedient to Ling Han’s words.
How could he believe this?
A Saint had actually subdued a Pseudo-Emperor-level rock creature?
Wasn’t this a fantasy story?
All of a sudden, his mind was in a mess.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, then said with a smile, "Alright, since you’re already here, then just continue the fight."
The rock golem immediately howled again, and charged towards Chang Tingjian.
This rendered Chang Tingjian extremely speechless.
Are you a f****** dog?
Why are you so obedient?
As a dignified Pseudo-Emperor, you actually still have to obey the commands of others.
Don’t you have the slightest bit of pride?
However, he soon did not have the spare energy to think about these problems.
The rock golem charged over, every move fierce.
The might of a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor was fully displayed, making it difficult for Chang Tingjian to parry, so how could he dare to be distracted?
Ling Han felt bored after watching for a while.
He now had Great Emperor-level battle prowess.
In his eyes, a Pseudo-Emperor-level battle was actually not much different from children playing around.
However, in the distance, the members of the Chang Clan all looked like they had lost both their parents.
Just now, their Second Elder had still been mighty and domineering, beating down on Ling Han, but now?
He was actually unable to fight back against a rock monster, and was in such a sorry state.
This, this, this, Ling Han actually had such a helper?
"Let me introduce.
That’s called Big Rock, the servant of our Little Han." The large black dog was most skilled in psychological attacks, and began to show off for Ling Han.
W-what!
Among the members of the Chang Clan, though there were pitifully few Saints, it did not stop them from confirming the fact that the rock golem was a Pseudo-Emperor.
—Didn’t they see that even Second Elder was being beaten down on?
However, a great Pseudo-Emperor, who had the word "Emperor" in his name, had actually become someone else’s servant and obeyed his every command.
How could they accept this?
However, the truth was right in front of their eyes.
They had no choice but to believe it even if they didn’t want to.
Heavens, someone could actually subdue a Pseudo-Emperor.
Could even a Great Emperor do the same?
Yet it just so happened that Ling Han was still a Saint.
Could it be that it was his destiny?
All of a sudden, the morale of the Chang Clan was very low.
It could not be helped.
Second Elder was presently being beaten, and Ling Han’s freakish talent had actually surpassed a Great Emperor.
"Damn it!" Chang Tingjian finally unleashed his trump card.
Imperial Weapon, Eternal Dragon Hammer.
Weng!
He activated the Imperial Weapon, unleashing a boundless burst of light from the Eternal Dragon Hammer.
The might of the Imperial Weapon permeated into the surroundings.
This was genuinely Great Emperor-level.
Peng, it was only a short while, and the rock golem was sent flying with a strike.
However, its physique was too tough.
Even after being hammered head-on by the Imperial Weapon, it was still unscathed, and only some scraps fell.
This time, even Chang Tingjian was stunned by what he saw.
’W-what kind of body is this?’
This was too freakish.

chapters.title: Chapter 4825: You have become a Great Emperor?
paragraphs: Peng! Peng! Peng!
The rock golem continued to attack Chang Tingjian, yet Chang Tingjian kept pushing it back.
If a Pseudo-Emperor was facing an Imperial Weapon head-on, how could he possibly win?
If it was not for the fact that the rock golem’s physique was unbelievably tough, it would have long since been blasted into smithereens.

However, the rock golem’s physique was actually even tougher than the Skeleton Saint Tool, and even the Imperial Weapon could only block it. To kill it with just an Imperial Weapon, the difficulty level was really too high.
Chang Tingjian was extremely speechless.
He was also a Pseudo-Emperor, and he also had the Imperial Weapon in his hands. Yet, he was actually unable to do anything against another Pseudo-Emperor!
It should be known that the rock golem was fighting him head-on, and not delivering guerilla strikes.
Thus, this dealt a huge blow to Chang Tingjian’s confidence.
So there was actually such a freakish existence in this world.
However, he was the son of a Great Emperor, after all, so his temperament was naturally outstanding. After being dispirited for a while, he immediately pulled himself together.
He couldn’t kill the rock golem, but what about Ling Han?
’It can’t be that your physique is also this freakish, right?’

Even if Ling Han had an Imperial Weapon, could a measly Saint keep an Imperial Weapon in a constant state of revival? Even if he could, in a clash of Imperial Weapon against Imperial Weapon, he would still be able to suppress Ling Han.
As long as he could capture Ling Han, there would be no problem.
"Die!" He had already made up his mind, and without any further hesitation, he immediately charged towards Ling Han.
The Imperial Weapon cleared the way, and was invincible in all aspects.
"Second Elder!" Below them, the members of the Chang Clan were all excited as they watched.
As long as he killed Ling Han, then no matter how strong the rock golem was, it would still be an ownerless existence. Would it still fight to the death with the Chang Clan?
Moreover, if the Chang Clan was really angered, they still had a Great Emperor.
"Kill Ling Han!"
"Die!"
The large black dog and little azure dragon looked at each other, revealing a mocking smile.
’You people are far too young and naive.’
Boom! Chang Tingjian charged over, swinging his hammer at Ling Han.
Pseudo-Emperor and Imperial Weapon, just how terrifying was their might?
Peng!
Ling Han waved his hand, and Chang Tingjian was sent flying along with his hammer.
’F*ck!’
All of a sudden, the heads of the members of the Chang Clan were all muddled.
What, what was going on?
’Hmm?’
That’s not right!

That was Second Elder! Previously, he had beaten Ling Han to the point that he could not even fight back. How could it be that in the blink of an eye, the Imperial Weapon that he had used was sent flying with a wave of Ling Han’s hand?
Were they dreaming? Or was there something wrong with their eyes?
That’s right, it must be an illusion.
But when they looked again, it was still the same. Chang Tingjian flew all the way here. Peng, peng, peng!. He shattered one star after another, and actually did not stop.
They could see wrongly, but Galaxy Network’s Heaven’s Eye couldn’t!
This was broadcasted live on Galaxy Network, so how could it possibly be affected by illusions?
Heavens!
The members of the Chang Clan all wanted to grab their heads and exclaim in shock. This was f*******....
A mere Saint was actually capable of sending a Pseudo-Emperor and Imperial Weapon flying with a slap. What justice was there left in this world? What law was there left in this world?
"Gagaga, are you shocked?" The large black dog cackled, "This is Grandpa Dog’s underling. Even his underling is so powerful. You guys can imagine just how powerful Grandpa Dog is, right?"
This was a rare opportunity, so he naturally had to show off to his heart’s content.
No one paid any attention to it. The impact on the members of the Chang Clan was too strong.
How was this possible?
How was this possible!
In space, Ling Han didn’t continue to attack, but the rock golem chased after him.
At this moment, Chang Tingjian was already in a semi-unconscious state.

—The Imperial Weapon was only in the eighth tier, but Ling Han’s strength was already in the seventh tier. If an existence in the eighth tier faced someone in the seventh tier head-on, it would already be very impressive if you didn’t die.
Under the observation of the Galaxy Network, the rock golem raised its foot and ruthlessly kicked Chang Tingjian’s crotch.
Even though they were so far away, everyone involuntarily clamped their legs together.
That was a Pseudo-Emperor, so how terrifying was the force of this kick?
Even the sun could be easily destroyed with a single kick.
"Ah!" Chang Tingjian was forcefully awoken by the pain, and they could see that both of his eyes were bulging out of their sockets, which showed how hard this kick had been.
His b@lls had been shattered.
He, a dignified Pseudo-Emperor, the son of a Great Emperor, actually had his b@lls crushed with a kick?
Chang Tingjian had gone crazy. Brandishing the Eternal Dragon Hammer, he launched a mad barrage of attacks at the rock golem.
Meanwhile, the large black dog murmured, "Yi, when did this Big Rock secretly learn Grandpa Dog’s ultimate move?"

It was filled with envy. Though it had kicked a nine-star Saint’s b@lls, and it was very possible that it had created a record, in the blink of an eye, the rock golem had kicked the b@lls of a Pseudo-Emperor, and the record had been broken.
Sigh, he really wanted to become stronger. He wanted to wear the Origin Gold underwear and kick a Great Emperor’s b@lls.
Meanwhile, the little azure dragon grimaced. ’You’ve been wearing iron underwear all this while, and it’s actually to prevent your b@lls from being kicked, right?’
Just what kind of enmity do you have with b@lls? Is that really necessary?
Once Chang Tingjian woke up, the situation would be completely different.

Even if his b@lls had been kicked, and he had suffered some minor injuries, he still possessed the Imperial Weapon, after all. Thus, he was still able to immediately turn the tables and suppress the rock golem.
With a single step, he had already returned to a spot 500km away from Ling Han.
"Y-you’ve become a Great Emperor!" he said in a terrified voice.
Otherwise, how could he have sent him and the Imperial Weapon flying with a single strike?
A Great Emperor was invincible!
What!
Upon hearing this, the members of the Chang Clan were all astounded. They felt a cold chill run down their spines.
Previously, though they had seen Second Elder being sent flying, none of them were willing to face this reality.
Hehe, how could that be possible? A new Great Emperor had suddenly appeared in the heaven and earth.
However, even Second Elder had said so, so how could it be false?
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "If I became a Great Emperor, I would’ve already smashed your father into smithereens."
"Pseudo, Pseudo-Emperor!" Chang Tingjian said with a bitter expression. He actually didn’t reprimand Ling Han for disrespecting his father.
He was too shocked.
Ling Han was the same as him. He was also a Pseudo-Emperor, but just how awesome was this Pseudo-Emperor?
This slap sent him and the Imperial Weapon flying. This was a genuine Emperor-level battle prowess.
They were both Pseudo-Emperors, but why are you so outstanding?
"That’s right." Ling Han nodded.
After receiving an affirmative answer from Ling Han, Chang Tingjian’s expression became even uglier.
Really, Ling Han was only a Pseudo-Emperor.
There was actually such a powerful Pseudo-Emperor in this world.
He suddenly recalled that Ling Han had previously said that he was the strongest Great Emperor of all eternity.
This... if Ling Han became a Great Emperor, it was really possible that he would be bestowed this title.
In this instant, his killing intent blazed. He definitely could not allow Ling Han to take that last step. Otherwise, who would be able to be a match for Ling Han?
He released his divine sense, and began to awaken his father.
The Four Directions Great Emperor slumbered all year round, and this was to maintain his strength. Otherwise, with every step he took in the world, his strength would decrease slightly.
But now, in order to kill Ling Han, he had no choice but to awaken the Four Directions Great Emperor.
Boom, instantly, a frightening aura surged out, endless Imperial Might.
A Great Emperor had appeared!
"It’s the Great Emperor!"
"Imperial Ancestor!"
All of a sudden, the members of the Chang Clan were incredibly excited, and instantly regained their confidence.
No matter how strong you, Ling Han, are, so what? Could you be a match for a Great Emperor?
The Chang Clan was an Imperial Clan!

chapters.title: Chapter 4826: Great Emperor in his strongest state
paragraphs: The Four Directions Great Emperor appeared.
However, his whole body was enshrouded in a gray mist, and his appearance could not be seen clearly at all.
Ling Han didn’t need to see clearly. He knew that the other party was a dried corpse.

No matter how extraordinarily handsome you were when you were alive, no matter how mighty and majestic you were, once you became a dried corpse, who would still have the appetite to take another look?
"As expected, you have become our greatest problem!" The Four Directions Great Emperor said. His voice boomed like thunder.

Ling Han stood with his hands clasped behind his back, and said calmly, "If I told you that the millions and millions of years that you Great Emperors have been waiting for was all for naught, and all of you have been played like monkeys, I don’t know if you would believe me or not."
"Heh, do you think I’ll believe you?" the Four Directions Great Emperor asked calmly.
As expected.

Ling Han immediately knew. Previously, it was very, very difficult to convince these Great Emperors to believe that when the Living Realm was transformed into the Netherworld, they could then pluck the chestnut from the fire, and not only could it allow one to live forever, it could also allow one’s cultivation level to advance further.
But once these Great Emperors believed it, and after millions and millions of years of scheming, wanting them to change their minds was even harder than ascending the heavens.
How could a Great Emperor not have his own opinions?
Not only did he have it, he was also incredibly stubborn.
Thus, once they were certain, even nine True Dragons wouldn’t be able to drag them back.

Ling Han cracked a smile, "I was just saying casually, and did not have the determination to make you believe me. Hehe, I really have some conflicts. On one hand, I very much want to see your disappointed expressions, but on the other, I cannot allow you to destroy this world."
"With just you?" the Four Directions Great Emperor said. Though his tone was normal, it was exuding a powerful disdain.
’With just you? Are you even qualified?’
He was a Great Emperor, and in their case, he was one of twelve Great Emperors.
Ling Han nodded, "Just me!"
His words were also powerful and resonating, his majesty soaring to the heavens.
Though the members of the Chang Clan were displeased with Ling Han, faced with such lofty aspirations, they had no choice but to write the word ’admiration’ in their hearts.
Unfortunately, they were destined to become enemies, so Ling Han’s only fate would be death.

"Since you’ve delivered yourself to my doorstep, I’ll send you on your way!" The Four Directions Great Emperor moved. A colossal hand stretched out from within the gray mist, grabbing out at Ling Han.
"Scram!" Ling Han rebuked. Peng, this large hand immediately crumbled.
What!
The members of the Chang Clan were all numb with shock. A good few of them directly passed out, their limbs icy cold.
The attack of the Great Emperor was actually unsuccessful as well?
This!
You are only a Pseudo-Emperor, are you really going to defy the heavens?
The Four Directions Great Emperor also hadn’t expected this. Which person who could become a Great Emperor wasn’t a supreme prodigy?
But when he was still a Pseudo-Emperor, how could he have such battle prowess?
Thus, he couldn’t help but feel stunned, and a little disbelieving.
The might of a Pseudo-Emperor was actually extremely powerful to this extent!
Then what if Ling Han became a Great Emperor? Even if they, the twelve Emperors, advanced further, and obtained true immortality, and could go all out, would they be able to suppress this freak?
At this moment, the Four Directions Great Emperor could not make a judgement either.
After all, he had absolutely no idea how strong the fourth tier was.
The Four Directions Great Emperor attacked again. Being able to become a Great Emperor, he was naturally incomparably resilient.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

One after another, colossal hands descended from the skies, but Ling Han merely clasped his hands behind his back, and did not take them to heart at all. He only had to open his mouth and shout, and those giant hands would automatically crumble.
Upon seeing this, everyone had no choice but to admit that Ling Han truly possessed the battle prowess of a Great Emperor.
"Don’t worry, the Imperial Ancestor hasn’t gone all out yet," someone consoled.
"That’s right. This is not the true strength of a Great Emperor at all." Everyone nodded.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and began his counterattack.

"Four Directions, do you only have this little bit of battle prowess?" Ling Han asked with a smile. He charged over aggressively, and as he threw a punch, 99 eight-star Regulations appeared at the same time, and were then fused together by a sliver of nine-star Regulations.

Originally, no matter how many eight-star Regulations there were, they would not be able to match a Great Emperor, but with this sliver of nine-star Regulations fused together, the effects were completely different.
Peng!
Ling Han exchanged a blow with the Four Directions Great Emperor... they were evenly matched!
In a head-on confrontation, the Pseudo-Emperor was not inferior to the Great Emperor at all.
Heavens!
Everyone was grabbing their heads. Even if they knew that this was not the Four Directions Great Emperor’s strongest state, they were still dumbfounded with shock.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two parties with Emperor-level battle prowess clashed, not using any Imperial Technique at all. That was because they were both Emperors, and every move and style was filled with Great Emperor Tier power.

In such a battle, even a Pseudo-Emperor was not qualified to approach. Even the Heaven’s Eye could only retreat to a very far place, fearing that it would be implicated by the battle. If that happened, it would definitely explode.

Everyone naturally could not see clearly. In fact, they could not even catch sight of the figures. They could only deduce that the battle was still continuing from the number of stars that had been destroyed.

"You’re truly extraordinary!" the Four Directions Great Emperor said sincerely. He had to admit that this young man was truly freakish. He was only a Pseudo-Emperor, yet he was already capable of matching a Great Emperor.
—Though he was not in his strongest state at present.
This was unprecedented, and it was also possible that it would never happen again.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and increased his battle prowess again.
Destructive Energy, light of great dao!
Boom! After unleashing these two trump cards, even a Great Emperor didn’t dare to face them head-on.
If he did, he would be severely wounded, or even killed directly!
The Four Directions Great Emperor retreated, while Ling Han continued to close in. With Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he was even slightly faster than the Great Emperor.
Even if it was just a sliver, it was enough. This meant that the Four Directions Great Emperor couldn’t possibly escape.
W-what?

Because the chase had begun, the Heaven’s Eye could once again capture relatively clear images, and though the Great Emperor was fast, there were the Chang Clan’s Heaven’s Eyes everywhere in the universe, and he would always be able to capture one or two images from time to time.
When news of this spread to the Chang Clan, every member of the Chang Clan looked gloomy.
Their Imperial Ancestor was actually no match for Ling Han!
Heavens!

In truth, the Four Directions Great Emperor was only temporarily dodging the attacks, and had not lost. However, a Great Emperor was being chased around by a Pseudo-Emperor. Wasn’t this enough to shock the entire universe?
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ling Han controlled the Destructive Energy, and as he threw a punch, a shockwave of darkness surged out, forcing the Four Directions Great Emperor to have no choice but to veer in another direction.
With this turn, Ling Han naturally caught up with him. The two of them immediately started to fight.
The Four Directions Great Emperor forcefully broke free from Ling Han’s grasp, drawing out the distance between them and unleashing a barrage of attacks.

However, his present battle prowess was only equal to Ling Han’s, and added with the fact that he still had to be wary of Destructive Energy and light of great dao, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han?
He was battered and exhausted from dodging.
This was a Great Emperor!
The Four Directions Great Emperor finally flew into a rage.
Imperial Might could not be violated!

Boom, the fog that wrapped around his body suddenly disappeared, revealing a shriveled body. However, in the next instant, this body seemed to have been pumped full of energy and filled with water, becoming sturdy and moist.
A middle-aged man with unparalleled grace appeared in front of Ling Han. He had an indescribable domineering aura, as if he only had to raise a brow, and a whole galaxy would collapse in half.
This was the true Four Directions Great Emperor.
Boom!
The Four Directions Great Emperor unleashed a punch, and it was as if all the stars of the entire universe were concentrated in this punch. It was indescribably terrifying.
Fifth tier!

sentences.text: The Four Directions Great Emperor appeared.
However, his whole body was enshrouded in a gray mist, and his appearance could not be seen clearly at all.
Ling Han didn’t need to see clearly.
He knew that the other party was a dried corpse.

No matter how extraordinarily handsome you were when you were alive, no matter how mighty and majestic you were, once you became a dried corpse, who would still have the appetite to take another look?
"As expected, you have become our greatest problem!" The Four Directions Great Emperor said.
His voice boomed like thunder.

Ling Han stood with his hands clasped behind his back, and said calmly, "If I told you that the millions and millions of years that you Great Emperors have been waiting for was all for naught, and all of you have been played like monkeys, I don’t know if you would believe me or not."
"Heh, do you think I’ll believe you?" the Four Directions Great Emperor asked calmly.
As expected.
Ling Han immediately knew.

Previously, it was very, very difficult to convince these Great Emperors to believe that when the Living Realm was transformed into the Netherworld, they could then pluck the chestnut from the fire, and not only could it allow one to live forever, it could also allow one’s cultivation level to advance further.
But once these Great Emperors believed it, and after millions and millions of years of scheming, wanting them to change their minds was even harder than ascending the heavens.
How could a Great Emperor not have his own opinions?
Not only did he have it, he was also incredibly stubborn.
Thus, once they were certain, even nine True Dragons wouldn’t be able to drag them back.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I was just saying casually, and did not have the determination to make you believe me.
Hehe, I really have some conflicts.
On one hand, I very much want to see your disappointed expressions, but on the other, I cannot allow you to destroy this world."
"With just you?" the Four Directions Great Emperor said.
Though his tone was normal, it was exuding a powerful disdain.
’With just you?
Are you even qualified?’
He was a Great Emperor, and in their case, he was one of twelve Great Emperors.
Ling Han nodded, "Just me!"
His words were also powerful and resonating, his majesty soaring to the heavens.
Though the members of the Chang Clan were displeased with Ling Han, faced with such lofty aspirations, they had no choice but to write the word ’admiration’ in their hearts.
Unfortunately, they were destined to become enemies, so Ling Han’s only fate would be death.
"Since you’ve delivered yourself to my doorstep, I’ll send you on your way!" The Four Directions Great Emperor moved.
A colossal hand stretched out from within the gray mist, grabbing out at Ling Han.
"Scram!" Ling Han rebuked.
Peng, this large hand immediately crumbled.
What!
The members of the Chang Clan were all numb with shock.
A good few of them directly passed out, their limbs icy cold.
The attack of the Great Emperor was actually unsuccessful as well?
This!
You are only a Pseudo-Emperor, are you really going to defy the heavens?
The Four Directions Great Emperor also hadn’t expected this.
Which person who could become a Great Emperor wasn’t a supreme prodigy?
But when he was still a Pseudo-Emperor, how could he have such battle prowess?
Thus, he couldn’t help but feel stunned, and a little disbelieving.
The might of a Pseudo-Emperor was actually extremely powerful to this extent!
Then what if Ling Han became a Great Emperor?
Even if they, the twelve Emperors, advanced further, and obtained true immortality, and could go all out, would they be able to suppress this freak?
At this moment, the Four Directions Great Emperor could not make a judgement either.
After all, he had absolutely no idea how strong the fourth tier was.
The Four Directions Great Emperor attacked again.
Being able to become a Great Emperor, he was naturally incomparably resilient.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
One after another, colossal hands descended from the skies, but Ling Han merely clasped his hands behind his back, and did not take them to heart at all.
He only had to open his mouth and shout, and those giant hands would automatically crumble.
Upon seeing this, everyone had no choice but to admit that Ling Han truly possessed the battle prowess of a Great Emperor.
"Don’t worry, the Imperial Ancestor hasn’t gone all out yet," someone consoled.
"That’s right.
This is not the true strength of a Great Emperor at all." Everyone nodded.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and began his counterattack.
"Four Directions, do you only have this little bit of battle prowess?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
He charged over aggressively, and as he threw a punch, 99 eight-star Regulations appeared at the same time, and were then fused together by a sliver of nine-star Regulations.

Originally, no matter how many eight-star Regulations there were, they would not be able to match a Great Emperor, but with this sliver of nine-star Regulations fused together, the effects were completely different.
Peng!
Ling Han exchanged a blow with the Four Directions Great Emperor... they were evenly matched!
In a head-on confrontation, the Pseudo-Emperor was not inferior to the Great Emperor at all.
Heavens!
Everyone was grabbing their heads.
Even if they knew that this was not the Four Directions Great Emperor’s strongest state, they were still dumbfounded with shock.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two parties with Emperor-level battle prowess clashed, not using any Imperial Technique at all.
That was because they were both Emperors, and every move and style was filled with Great Emperor Tier power.
In such a battle, even a Pseudo-Emperor was not qualified to approach.
Even the Heaven’s Eye could only retreat to a very far place, fearing that it would be implicated by the battle.
If that happened, it would definitely explode.
Everyone naturally could not see clearly.
In fact, they could not even catch sight of the figures.
They could only deduce that the battle was still continuing from the number of stars that had been destroyed.
"You’re truly extraordinary!" the Four Directions Great Emperor said sincerely.
He had to admit that this young man was truly freakish.
He was only a Pseudo-Emperor, yet he was already capable of matching a Great Emperor.
—Though he was not in his strongest state at present.
This was unprecedented, and it was also possible that it would never happen again.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and increased his battle prowess again.
Destructive Energy, light of great dao!
Boom!
After unleashing these two trump cards, even a Great Emperor didn’t dare to face them head-on.
If he did, he would be severely wounded, or even killed directly!
The Four Directions Great Emperor retreated, while Ling Han continued to close in.
With Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he was even slightly faster than the Great Emperor.
Even if it was just a sliver, it was enough.
This meant that the Four Directions Great Emperor couldn’t possibly escape.
W-what?

Because the chase had begun, the Heaven’s Eye could once again capture relatively clear images, and though the Great Emperor was fast, there were the Chang Clan’s Heaven’s Eyes everywhere in the universe, and he would always be able to capture one or two images from time to time.
When news of this spread to the Chang Clan, every member of the Chang Clan looked gloomy.
Their Imperial Ancestor was actually no match for Ling Han!
Heavens!
In truth, the Four Directions Great Emperor was only temporarily dodging the attacks, and had not lost.
However, a Great Emperor was being chased around by a Pseudo-Emperor.
Wasn’t this enough to shock the entire universe?
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Ling Han controlled the Destructive Energy, and as he threw a punch, a shockwave of darkness surged out, forcing the Four Directions Great Emperor to have no choice but to veer in another direction.
With this turn, Ling Han naturally caught up with him.
The two of them immediately started to fight.
The Four Directions Great Emperor forcefully broke free from Ling Han’s grasp, drawing out the distance between them and unleashing a barrage of attacks.

However, his present battle prowess was only equal to Ling Han’s, and added with the fact that he still had to be wary of Destructive Energy and light of great dao, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han?
He was battered and exhausted from dodging.
This was a Great Emperor!
The Four Directions Great Emperor finally flew into a rage.
Imperial Might could not be violated!
Boom, the fog that wrapped around his body suddenly disappeared, revealing a shriveled body.
However, in the next instant, this body seemed to have been pumped full of energy and filled with water, becoming sturdy and moist.
A middle-aged man with unparalleled grace appeared in front of Ling Han.
He had an indescribable domineering aura, as if he only had to raise a brow, and a whole galaxy would collapse in half.
This was the true Four Directions Great Emperor.
Boom!
The Four Directions Great Emperor unleashed a punch, and it was as if all the stars of the entire universe were concentrated in this punch.
It was indescribably terrifying.
Fifth tier!

chapters.title: Chapter 4827: The Great Emperor fled
paragraphs: Setting aside the Great Emperors in the Primitive Abyss, the fifth tier was the strongest level of power.
In the outside world, a Great Emperor would only be able to cultivate the Nine Star Regulations to the consummate level. This was the limit of heaven and earth.
If he wanted to break through to the fourth tier, he could only enter into the Primitive Abyss and grasp one of the four elements—Life, Death, Creation, and Destruction.

However, the Great Emperors in the Primitive Abyss had all long since exceeded the limit of their lifespans, and could only continue to live by depending on the essence of Life there. It was impossible for them to leave the Primitive Abyss.
Thus, the strongest battle prowess in the outside world was the fifth tier.
Boom! This punch was incredibly domineering.
Without the slightest hesitation, Ling Han turned around and left.

Xiu, he arrived at the Chang Clan’s ancestral planet in a single step. He grabbed the large black dog, the little azure dragon, and the stone golem in space. Then, a golden path spread out beneath his feet, and he left quickly.
’I’m done fighting.’
The Four Directions Great Emperor was enraged. He had returned to his prime condition, yet Ling Han had actually fled?
How could that be allowed!
He instantly understood Ling Han’s strategy—Ling Han was purposefully forcing him to enter his strongest state, and then exhaust himself for nothing.

One had to realize that the whole Living Realm was already close to transforming into Netherworld. Moreover, he couldn’t absorb any more life essence. Once he exited this state, just how far would his battle prowess fall?
Even if he could still hold on for a while longer, entering his strongest state a few times in a row, there was ultimately a limit to the number of times he could do so.
Once he used up all the times that he could "transform", then what would he, a Great Emperor, be worth?
The Four Directions Great Emperor let out a furious roar as he chased after Ling Han.
He had already paid a heavy price, so he definitely had to kill Ling Han.
However, though he had entered into his strongest state, and his speed had increased, it was only just a sliver. Compared to Ling Han... it was more or less the same.
He couldn’t catch up to Ling Han, and Ling Han couldn’t shake him off either.
The two great Emperor-level battle prowess were shuttling through the galaxy, and the colossal galaxy became tiny in their extreme speed.
From the edge of one side to the other, it actually only took half a day’s time!
With such speed, it was impossible for the Four Directions Great Emperor to notify the other Great Emperors to attack together.
There was no way to say the exact location, all right?
And just like that, the Four Directions Great Emperor had no choice but to give up after pursuing for three days.
—He was about to reach his limit, and could no longer maintain this state.
Ling Han didn’t turn around to chase after him. Instead, he found a star to sit down and recover his energy.
After all, he was being hunted by a Great Emperor, and they would definitely exchange a few blows in the process, which caused him to suffer a great impact.
After resting, Ling Han once again headed to the Chang Clan’s ancestral planet.
Yi?
He discovered that this place had actually become a land of death.
There were dried corpses everywhere. They had all had their life essence sucked dry.
However, he didn’t see the corpses of Chang Tingjian, Chang Yu and the others.
He understood.

After the Four Directions Great Emperor returned, in order to maintain his vitality, he had no choice but to devour the life on this planet. Of course, the most important members of the Chang Clan were all spared.
After recovering for a short while, the Four Directions Great Emperor left with his clansmen, resolutely abandoning this ancestral planet.
It could not be helped. He feared that Ling Han would make a comeback.
He only had to be forced into his strongest state by Ling Han a few times, and what awaited him would be death.
Those who could become Great Emperors were naturally resolute.
Ling Han was slightly disappointed. He had indeed planned to exhaust the Four Directions Great Emperor to death, but he wouldn’t fall for his trick.

"Little Han, you have already forced a Great Emperor to flee. This battle merit is practically enough to surpass the past and dazzle the present. So, don’t look so distressed anymore. Otherwise, even Grandpa Dog would think that you have been showing off too much," the large black dog said from the sidelines.
Er... alright.
Ling Han perked up his spirit, and said, "Let’s loot the place!"
Upon hearing this, the large black dog and little azure dragon were both excited.
The Chang Clan possessed the Galaxy Network, and just how much wealth had they accumulated over millions and millions of years?
The wealthiest in the universe definitely was the Chang Clan.

The three of them excitedly ransacked the Chang Clan Residence. Because there was too little time, the Chang Clan did not manage to move too many things, and still left Ling Han and the others with a huge amount of wealth.
There were innumerable Celestial medicines and precious materials.
The large black dog couldn’t help but sigh at this. If they had come earlier, and prevented the Chang Clan from taking away even the slightest bit of treasure, just how great would their gains be?
Ling Han couldn’t be bothered to examine it slowly, and directly stored the Chang Clan’s ancestral planet into his body. Then, he returned to the Four Origin Planet.

He naturally did not release the Chang Clan’s ancestral planet on the Four Origin Planet. Instead, he kept a considerable distance between them, to prevent the two stars from colliding and causing great casualties.
The empress and the others came out to receive him. When they found out about Ling Han’s battle merits, they were all excited.

This was a Great Emperor, someone who had been invincible for an entire era, and now? He had actually been forced by Ling Han to the point that he could only bring his whole family with him, pack up, and flee.

Of course, this was also because the Four Directions Great Emperor wasn’t an ordinary Great Emperor. Otherwise, if he could maintain his power at the fifth tier, Ling Han wouldn’t be able to rival him at all.
Ling Han started to search for his next target.

It was very simple. Find the ancestral planet of a fallen Great Emperor, and force him to appear for a battle, so that he would enter his strongest state. After a few times, this Great Emperor would be crippled even if he did not die. How would he be able to endanger the world then?
"It can’t be helped. Right now, I’m only a five-star Pseudo-Emperor, so I can only do this." Ling Han sighed.
This caused everyone to roll their eyes at him. He had really gone too far in showing off.
However, when Ling Han attacked and began to search around, he only found one abandoned Imperial Clan and ancestral planet after another.
—The ancestral planets of the Lands of Death that could be discovered had all been abandoned.
This time, even Ling Han couldn’t do anything.
It was simple for him to find a living star in the vast universe. After all, the Living Realm had transformed into the Netherworld, and living stars were as dazzling as the sun.
However, it was almost impossible to find a specific living being in such a large universe.
A Great Emperor was a Great Emperor, after all, so he immediately found a solution.

I’ll ignore you. I’ll just wait until the Living Realm begins to collapse. Then, Great Emperors like them would snatch that sliver of fated opportunity. Not only would they obtain eternal life, but their abilities would also advance further.
At that time, what would Ling Han be worth?
Being able to become a Great Emperor, how could it be that they did not even have this little bit of patience?
Since that was the case, Ling Han simply gave up the idea of continuing to search for the Lords of Death.
If a Great Emperor was completely focused on concealing himself, how could he possibly be found?
Since he had nothing to do, he began to do what he could.
Resuscitate the Living Realm.
Wherever he went, the Yin souls would naturally disperse, and one after another star would be easily revived, and the sun would reignite.
However, it was not something that could be done overnight if one wanted to restore vitality to a planet.
After all, destruction was easy, but creation was difficult.
There was a way.
Including Ding Shu and the others, they had also extracted Genesis World from their bodies, so just how many lives were contained within?
As long as these beings cultivated until Meridian Opening Tier, they could completely walk out of these dimensions and start a new life on these planets.
Thus, there was absolutely no shortage of people.
In a situation when the world was at peace, it was estimated that in just a few tens of thousands of years, the whole universe would recover its vitality.
More importantly, did they have so much time?

chapters.title: Chapter 4828: Discussion
paragraphs: With the present state of heaven and earth, it was possible that a new Emperor would emerge at any time. Thus, the plot of the Lords of Death was also imminent. It was possible that they would reveal their true intentions at any time, and launch the final and strongest wave of attack.
In his prime condition, Ling Han was no match for a Lord of Death, what more when there were 12 of them.

What Ling Han could do now was firstly, to search for the whereabouts of the Lords of Death, and secondly, to revive planets as much as possible, and strengthen the power of the Living Realm to resist the Netherworld.
In this way, even if time was really not on his side, it would definitely be of some help in stopping the plans of the Lords of Death.
Most importantly, the plot of the Lords of Death was completely useless. They had been tricked.
What was the background of that old Divine Beast?

Ling Han had never seen it before, but all the Great Emperors were standing on opposing sides of him, which showed just how evil this guy was, that there was not a single Great Emperor that supported him.
Multiple stars revived, and multiple suns lit up again, illuminating the ground and embellishing the dark universe.
However, in the end, Ling Han was only one person. Even with the help of Buddha Doga and the other Pseudo-Emperors, progress wasn’t very fast.
As for the rock golem?
Hehe, it would already be good enough if it didn’t help and instead made things worse.
During the migration process, the great Imperial Clans also voiced their strong objections.
Their advantage lay in their agility. Even if a Lord of Death charged over personally, Ding Shu and the others would still be able to wrap them up and take them away easily.
However, once the number of stars increased, even if Ling Han was here now, how could all these stars be absorbed into their bodies?
This pertained to their safety. Thus, even though they were facing Ling Han, they still raised their objections.
“Er, has no one told them that Little Han has already become a Pseudo-Emperor?” The large black dog smiled, “If these guys knew, they probably wouldn’t be so worried.”

“Not necessarily.” The little azure dragon shook its head. “In their hearts, the Great Emperor is invincible. Thus, even if they knew that Little Han has become a Pseudo-Emperor, they would only think that Little Han is the strongest Pseudo-Emperor, but definitely wouldn’t be able to match a Great Emperor.”
“Makes sense,” the pervert pig added, yet everyone rolled their eyes at him.
Just look at your ancestor, who is still battling hard in the Primitive Abyss. And what about you?
He was a glutton and a lazy bum; he was practically ruining the family’s reputation.

Those descendants of Great Emperors like Brother Monkey and the little azure dragon were all Saints by now, and the perverted pig was actually only a Venerate Tier. The slowness of his advancement was practically chilling.
Faced with everyone’s gazes, the pervert pig smiled awkwardly, and did not say another word.
—Uncle Pig only wanted to roll around in a pile of beauties. Why did you guys have such high expectations of Uncle Pig, b@stards?
“All right, then we will have a meeting, and discuss democratically,” Ling Han said with a smile.
They sent out a message, and all the Imperial Clans sent people over.

There was still a considerable number of surviving Imperial Clans, and they all sent two representatives. Most of them were the son of a Great Emperor and an old Saint. However, for some Imperial Clans, the son of the Great Emperor had already died, so they could only send an Imperial Son instead.
All of a sudden, the Four Origin Planet shone brilliantly.

The discussion was held on a plaza, and there were no seats. In any case, there was only one matter. Ling Han thought that it would be resolved very quickly. He had to settle the matter quickly. Should he still sit down and brew a pot of tea, and slowly discuss the matter?

After everyone had arrived, Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back and walked into the middle of the crowd. He said with a smile, “I heard that you guys have different opinions about my immigration plan. Today, I’ll beat you guys into submission, oh, no, convince you guys.”
Hearing these words, everyone couldn’t help but look at each other.
You f****** must have said it on purpose.
This was a show of strength. His threat could not be more obvious.
However, it had to be said that everyone felt a chill in their hearts.
Who was Ling Han?
The strongest Saint in all eternity, and furthermore, he had the backing of three Pseudo-Emperors.
Thus, without the appearance of the Pseudo-Emperor, the Imperial Clan was naturally wary of Ling Han. They could only rely on the support of the Imperial Weapon.
“I object!” However, this was ultimately a matter that concerned the lives of their entire clan, so no matter what, they could not possibly yield. There were still people who stood up.
“My clan also objects,” another Saint said as he stood up.
“My clan agrees.” That was the Donglin Imperial Clan. As Chi Menghan’s maternal family, they naturally had to support Ling Han as he was their son-in-law.
However, even more Imperial Clans expressed their disagreement.

The Donglin Imperial Clan’s Chi Taiming and Chi Feihong were both extremely worried. Previously, there was already a strong wave of objections, and they still had to hold such a discussion. Wasn’t it clear that they were seeking their own humiliation?
‘Ling Han, what on earth are you trying to do?’

Thus, they wanted to hear Ling Han’s explanation.

Everyone was just nodding, but they immediately gritted their teeth.
‘You f*cking... do you want to become a dictator?’
Since everyone was against it, then your plan should have been scrapped.
Do you think that you have become a Great Emperor, so you can rule your era?

The present Ling Han was practically like a maniac.
Following a maniac, then wouldn’t they all go crazy together?
“That’s right, we have no reason to die with you!”

“Ling Han, have you ever considered that our advantage is in agility? However, you’re currently conducting a large-scale migration of people, forcing us to have no choice but to fight on the front lines. If the Lands of Death attack, how will we block it?”
Everyone shouted one after another.

That’s right, why?
Those Lords of Death... were all former Great Emperors!

Hiss, a Great Emperor could break through again? What was that? A Transcendent Emperor?
Everyone exchanged looks. This was information that they had never known before.
Yet Ling Han immediately shook his head, “However, this is bullsh*t.”
Yi?
Everyone was surprised. This turn of events was really too fast.

“In truth, the expansion of the universe is about to reach its end, and the next step would be to collapse. Furthermore, the transformation of the Netherworld would cause a hedging effect on the collapse, and the result would be... the destruction of the two Realms!”
Ling Han said seriously, “Everyone, once this day comes, this universe will no longer exist.”
“The only place that can survive is the Primitive Abyss.”
“But I can enter into the Primitive Abyss. Can you guys do it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4829: Persuasion
paragraphs: Ling Han’s words caused everyone to go numb with shock.
According to him, wasn’t the universe about to be destroyed?
Thus, Ling Han wanted to revive the Living Realm. This was the only way to resolve the conflict between the two Realms.

That’s right. The Primitive Abyss was where heaven and earth originated. It was incredibly mysterious, and definitely couldn’t be destroyed by the collision of two realms. At most, it would only cause some impact.
Moreover, everyone knew that Ling Han had already entered the Primitive Abyss several times. He wasn’t exaggerating.
The problem was, how could the threat of the Lands of Death be ignored?
If a Great Emperor unleashed his might, who in the world could stop him?

“Ling Han, even if you’re telling the truth,” the Ancient Prosperity Saint from the Ten Thousand Thunder Imperial Clan said. “However, we’ve appeared with such great fanfare, so it’s equivalent to exposing ourselves to the public. What if the Lands of Death arrive? How will we block it?”

“That’s right!” Liu Xinhe, the son of the Great Emperor of the Seven Luminaries Clan, also nodded. “To say nothing of the Great Emperor, just in terms of the number of Pseudo-Emperors, we are also far inferior.”
“Your plan is to build a castle on the sand. It’s completely impossible,” the Ancient Prosperity Saint said resolutely. “At that time, we’ll all be dead before the two realms even collide.”
Thus, he would rather choose to flee. At least, he would be able to live a few more days.
Ling Han sighed, and walked up to the Ancient Prosperity Saint. “Are you opposing me?”
“I just don’t want your madness to kill everyone!” the Ancient Prosperity Saint said.
Though Ling Han was the strongest Saint in all of history, there were so many people now, so he was unafraid.
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and grabbed out at the Ancient Prosperity Saint.
Hiss, this guy really dared to make a move?
The son of the Great Emperor of the Ten Thousand Thunder Imperial Clan, Hang Shushan, immediately moved, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han, “Brother Ling, you have gone too far!”
Peng!

Ling Han did not dodge or evade at all, and allowed Hang Shushan’s palm strike to land. However, a frightening force rebounded, and peng, Hang Shushan was sent flying, and the Ancient Prosperity Saint also fell into Ling Han’s hands.
“I’ll give you another chance to speak again,” Ling Han said with a smile. He placed the Clear Bamboo Sword on the neck of the Ancient Prosperity Saint.
This was an Imperial Weapon, and killing a Saint would be as easy as the turn of a palm.
How could the Ancient Prosperity Saint dare to be stubborn? He hurriedly said, “I agree! I agree!”
Seeing this scene, everyone grimaced.
‘Are you planning to become a tyrant?’
With how you have “persuaded” others, aren’t you afraid of betrayal and isolation?
Meanwhile, the empress, the large black dog, and the others all smiled. They naturally knew that Ling Han was only here to perform.
“This guy, he’s showing off even in front of his own people!” The large black dog shook his head, then raised a paw, “He has the bearing of Grandpa Dog!”

Hang Shushan immediately stepped into the sky and returned. By now, he was already a Seven Star Saint. Boom, his saintly might was completely unleashed. He roared in fury, “Ling Han, have you really gone mad?”
Ling Han reached over and grabbed him, then smashed him onto the ground.
Peng, peng, peng! In just a few moments, Hang Shushan had been forcefully knocked unconscious.
He smiled slightly, “Another person has no objections, what about you guys?”
All the Imperial Clans were cursing in their minds. They had never imagined that Ling Han would suddenly become so unreliable.
You are only the strongest Saint, so why are you so arrogant?
“All right, stop playing around.” Buddha Doga stepped out. He couldn’t just stand by and watch as Ling Han played them all to death.
Seeing that Buddha Doga had stepped out, all the Imperial Clans felt their hearts jolt. This was a Pseudo-Emperor, and he was Ah Han’s Junior Brother. He was overwhelmingly awesome.
“Ling Han is right. This time, we have to persist.” However, when Buddha Doga spoke, everyone’s hearts sank.
‘F*ck! Why did you also go crazy?’

Buddha Doga knew what everyone was thinking, and immediately said, “However, it’s not like we don’t have a sliver of a chance of winning on our side. Ling Han didn’t tell you that he has actually broken through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor.”
What!
Everyone was shocked. Ling Han had broken through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor?
No wonder he could casually trample on the son of a Great Emperor; this was a Pseudo-Emperor.
Furthermore, Ling Han was the strongest Saint of all eternity among Saints. Then, after becoming a Pseudo-Emperor, wouldn’t he be the strongest Pseudo-Emperor of all eternity?
“But, Buddhist Race, and there are Great Emperors standing guard in the Lands of Death,” a member of the Imperial Clan voiced his worries.
No matter how awesome your Pseudo-Emperor is, can you compare to a Great Emperor?
Buddha Doga smiled, and said, “I forgot to tell everyone. Not too long ago, Ling Han forced the Chang Clan to give up on the ancestral planet.”
That couldn’t be, right?
Everyone’s minds were in complete chaos. The Chang Clan must be the Chang Clan of the Four Directions Imperial Clan, and had a Lord of Death on standby.
“That’s right.” Buddha Doga nodded, and said, “Ling Han and the Four Directions Great Emperor exchanged blows, and neither side won!”
When these words fell, the masses erupted.
Ling Han... had become Emperor?
Yi, that’s not right. Just now, didn’t Buddha Doga say that he had become a Pseudo-Emperor?
Could it be that this freak was capable of matching a Great Emperor when he himself was only a Pseudo-Emperor?
This!
He was a monster!
The other Imperial Clan elites were all stunned. Meanwhile, the two Saints from the Donglin Imperial Clan were all smiles, extremely pleased with themselves.
This son-in-law was really too right.

It was not every Imperial Clan that had the son of a Great Emperor sealed away. For example, the Donglin Imperial Clan was like this. Furthermore, their most outstanding descendant was Chi Menghan, and now, she had also married out of the clan, and could no longer be considered a member of the Chi Clan.
However, in terms of which Imperial Clan had a higher status, the Donglin Imperial Clan was definitely not inferior to any Imperial Clan that had a son of a Great Emperor keeping watch.
They had Ling Han as a son-in-law.
A Pseudo-Emperor that could match a Great Emperor, then what about when he became a Great Emperor?
The strongest Great Emperor in history?
Buddha Doga described the battle situation in detail, and there was no add or subtract anything.
This convinced everyone, and while they felt slightly at ease, they were still a little worried.
That was because... Ling Han was still no match for an awakened Great Emperor. Furthermore, there were 12 of them.
“We have no option but to revive the Living Realm!” Buddha Doga said. “Otherwise, heaven and earth will definitely be destroyed.”
He once again emphasized, and the Imperial Clans finally took it to heart.
However, the reality was very grim. If the Lords of Death came together, then how would Ling Han be able to block them!

“Cough, I’ve always liked to convince others with virtue,” Ling Han said. “If anyone doesn’t yield, I’ll personally ‘speak’ to convince them. Come, come, come. If anyone has any objections, raise your hand for me to see.”
When these words fell, everyone instantly fell silent.
Right now, Buddha Doga was still very amicable. However, Ling Han’s expression was as if he were saying, “If you don’t yield, I’ll beat you into submission!” How could they reason with him?
This Ling Han was playing bad cop, and Buddha Doga was playing bad cop, forcing all the members of the Imperial Clans to have no objections.
It wasn’t that they didn’t have any. In fact, they didn’t dare to express them. They were truly exasperated.
It could not be helped. Who asked Ling Han to be too strong?
The Imperial Clan elites left in displeasure.
Ling Han didn’t think that there was anything wrong with this. The current situation was special, and these people couldn’t have any malicious thoughts.
It was possible that the whole world would be destroyed, so who could keep themselves out of trouble?
Thus, no matter what method he used, Ling Han was determined to unite these powers around him.
After this, everyone worked together to revive the Living Realm as quickly as possible.

The resources that Ling Han had confiscated from the Chang Clan were of great use, causing the people of Genesis World to rapidly increase their cultivation level, reaching the extent that they could walk out of the dimensions.
All of a sudden, the entire universe quietly glowed with vitality.

chapters.title: Chapter 4830: Deal
paragraphs: With Ling Han doing this, it was impossible that there would be no reaction from the Lands of Death.
The Lords of Death did not move out, but the fallen Imperial Sons did move out, causing trouble everywhere.
These Imperial Sons were all Pseudo-Emperors, and they would leave after a single strike, without the slightest hesitation.
In a short few days, Ling Han’s side had already lost a considerable number of planets.
Fortunately, this was the outermost area. Although the planets had been revived, no one had relocated to them yet. Thus, the casualties were negligible, and there were pitifully few.

Previously, it had been Ling Han’s guerilla warfare, attacking the territories that the Lands of Death had occupied from all directions. Now, the situation was reversed. The fallen Imperial Sons were attacking from all directions, attacking Ling Han’s revived planets.
Ling Han had been concocting alchemical pills at first, but now that such a thing had happened, he naturally could no longer sit still.

Buddha Son, Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping, the three Pseudo-Emperors all moved out, and they would intercept them at the first instance. Ling Han also released his divine sense and paid attention to the surroundings.
The fact that they would be targeted meant that this move had indeed stung them.
Ling Han waited for the Lords of Death to appear. Then, he only had to store all the stars into his body, turn around and flee.
No matter what, he had to exhaust these fallen Great Emperors.
‘Here they come!’
Ling Han raised a brow. With a single step, he had appeared above a star.
“Come out!” He stretched out a hand to grab it. Boom, the Void was torn apart, and a youth fell out.
“Hehe, you even discovered that!” Of course, this was Little Ye. However, he was unafraid, and was still as cheeky as before.
Ling Han looked at Little Ye and asked, “Who exactly are you?”
“You guess!” Little Ye giggled, but immediately turned around and left.
He exerted time acceleration effects on himself, and instantly exploded with a terrifying speed.
It was comparable to a Great Emperor!
However, Ling Han’s speed was even slightly faster than the Great Emperor. If the True Phoenix didn’t appear, who could compete with him?
The great golden path spread out, and with a flash of the wings of fire, Ling Han had already stood in front of him.

“You’re the trouble!” Ling Han said. Just Little Ye alone could pose a huge threat to everyone except him.
