This mysterious young man was indeed very freakish, but compared to Ling Han... he was still no match.
“Ling Han, why don’t we make a deal?” Little Ye suddenly said.
“Go ahead.” Ling Han was in no rush to make a move.

“Don’t interfere in the matters here. Correspondingly, I can bestow you with eternal life. In fact, I can even help you grasp the four elements, and become the true ruler of heaven and earth,” Little Ye said.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel surprised.
How did Little Ye know about the four elements?
To say nothing of him, logically speaking, even the Lords of Death wouldn’t know.
Otherwise, they should have gone to the Primitive Abyss. That island at the end similarly could grant immortality to a Great Emperor, or even allow them to surpass the normal level of Great Emperors.
“You came from the Primitive Abyss?” Ling Han asked.
“That’s right.” Little Ye nodded.
“Have you been to that island at the core?” Ling Han asked again.

Little Ye smiled and said, “Don’t you think you’re asking too many questions? As long as you obediently go to the Primitive Abyss, I can guarantee that no one will make a move on you again. In fact, you can also become a city lord, and when the time is ripe, you’ll be able to grasp the four key elements.”
Ling Han was even more confused. The Lords of Death didn’t even know about the 36 Divine Beasts, but Little Ye was very familiar with them.
Moreover, from his tone, it was as if he could command the Divine Beast Great Emperors.

Hold on, the birth of the Divine Beast Great Emperors should be inextricably linked to that mysterious old Divine Beast, and now there was an incredibly young, yet powerful and mysterious Little Ye. The two obviously had a close relationship.
Ling Han raised a brow, “What relation do you have with that old Divine Beast in the Primitive Abyss?”
“Hehe, old Divine Beast?” Little Ye smiled. “Since he has obtained immortality, why should he be called ‘old’?”
He did not deny it!

Ling Han felt like the Lords of Death had really been screwed over very badly. Not only had that old Divine Beast bewitched them, but after millions and millions of years, it had also planted a traitor by their side.
More importantly, those who could become Great Emperors could not possibly be idiots. On the other hand, they were all prodigies of their eras, so how could they possibly be played so badly?
There must be some hidden story that he did not know.
“Ling Han, what do you think?” Little Ye said with a smile.
Ling Han shook his head, “I don’t think so.”
Little Ye finally stopped smiling, “Killing me won’t do you any good at all! Moreover, I can guarantee that if I die, the so-called Lords of Death will spare no expense to kill you.”
“Oh?” Ling Han smiled, completely unconcerned.

“I have the Mark of Destiny on me,” Little Ye said. “As long as I become a Great Emperor when the heaven and earth collapses, I can expose the essence of the heaven and earth, allowing the Great Emperors to glimpse the great dao and take another step forward.”

“Pu!” Ling Han laughed in spite of himself, “Your words can only deceive those Lords of Death. You have already said just now that only the Primitive Abyss possesses four fundamental elements, and now you are talking to me about the essence of heaven and earth. Isn’t that a joke?”
Little Ye slanted his head to one side, “It is precisely because the Lords of Death believe it that you cannot kill me.”
“Don’t you think that killing you would be a good opportunity to cut off the plans of the Lords of Death?” Ling Han asked calmly.
“Wrong, wrong, wrong.” Little Ye shook a finger. “The mark of destiny can’t be erased, and can only be transferred. So, if I die, the greatest possibility is that it will be transferred to you.”

“And it is very obvious that the Lords of Death could not possibly allow you to become Emperor. Thus... they could only use all means at their disposal to kill you, so that the mark of destiny would once again be transferred.”

Ling Han didn’t believe Little Ye’s words at all. However, the Lords of Death didn’t doubt it at all, because they had only obtained the path of “immortality” after enduring hundreds of millions of years of hardships and dangers. Naturally, they would continue this path resolutely.
Thus, Little Ye’s threat was very real.
At present, the Lords of Death were unwilling to make a move because they feared that they would be overly exhausted. However, once Little Ye died, they would definitely kill Ling Han at all costs.
No matter what, Ling Han couldn’t be allowed to become Emperor.
“So how about it?” Little Ye asked with a smile. He believed that Ling Han would make the “right” choice.
Boom!
His iron fist moved, and struck out at him.
Little Ye yelped in surprise and hurriedly stepped back.
He was a Pseudo-Emperor, and belonged to the category of freaks, so his reaction speed could not be said to be slow.
However, Ling Han’s battle prowess was on the level of a Great Emperor.

When a Pseudo-Emperor encountered a Great Emperor, the former could only flee at the first instant. Only then would he have the slightest chance of escaping. In a situation when the two were so close, how could he possibly do that?
Peng, with just one punch, Little Ye was sent flying.
“I don’t think so.” Ling Han shook his head, his killing intent blazing.

chapters.title: Chapter 4831: Bestowing life
paragraphs: Little Ye covered his chest, and with a ‘wa’, he spat out blood madly.
He had only been scraped by the aftermath, but just how terrifying was the might of a Great Emperor?
Actually, this was still because it was him. If it was any other Pseudo-Emperor, he would have been insta-killed.
“Damn guy!” Little Ye revealed a twisted expression, “Ling Han, do you think you can stop me? After I obtain the essence of Death, killing trash like you will only take one move!”
Ling Han couldn’t help but be startled, “F***, you are that old Divine Beast!”
No, he should be called a doppelganger of the old Divine Beast.
Sure enough, that old geezer didn’t just set things up in the Primitive Abyss, but also stretched out his hand to the outside world.
“There will definitely not be a day when you become Emperor!” Little Ye said balefully, almost as if he was speaking a curse.
“Hehe.” Ling Han didn’t say anything, and simply threw a punch.
Little Ye blocked, but how could he block Ling Han’s Emperor Tier-level battle prowess?
After several punches, he was beaten to burst.
Yi?
Ling Han suddenly discovered that after Little Ye died, an indescribable power had actually fused into his body.
No, it shouldn’t be called power, nor Regulations. It was very strange.
The Stone of Life!
Ling Han suddenly recalled that he, Ding Shu and the others had all originated from the Genesis World. Meanwhile, the Genesis World had been split from the Stone of Life.
Origin, Heaven Crushing and the other Genesis World overlords were all killed. Then, Little Ye appeared, possessing Destructive Energy.
This meant... that he had stolen the Genesis Worlds or some other substance from the bodies of Origin and the others.
In short, Little Ye could also be considered a Genesis World master, and was the replacement for Origin and the others.
Now, Little Ye died, and this portion of power of the Stone of Life was absorbed by Ling Han.
“Element of Life!”

“Not only that, but the Battle Saint Emperor also said that this is a stone that was found in the Cave of Life. It’s also been placed in the Cave of Destruction and the Cave of Creation for a long time. Thus, only us Genesis World Masters can easily grasp Destructive Energy.”
Ling Han ignored this for the moment, and merely absorbed this kind of “energy”.
Half a day later, he suddenly opened his eyes.
His figure descended, and arrived on a planet. He stretched out a hand and placed it on a rock.

A miracle happened, and the rock actually jumped up. Pa, pa, pa! Like the rock golem from the Primitive Abyss, the nearby rocks were all absorbed by it, and it turned into a rock golem that was as tall as three people.
“Master!” This rock golem sent out a wave of divine sense, and stood respectfully beside Ling Han.
Giving life!
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel excited. He had grasped an astonishing ability.
This rock golem’s strength couldn’t compare to that of the rock golem from the Primitive Abyss, as it was only in Mystery Realm Tier. However, this was life that Ling Han had only casually bestowed.
As long as he was willing to spend a little more effort, he was completely capable of bestowing a stronger life force.
Did this mean that he had grasped the essence of Life?
He had not.
Ling Han shook his head. He could use this ability, but it seemed to be instinctive, and he did not know why it could be used.
This was because he had been nurtured by the Stone of Life, so he had grasped the ability to bestow life.

“Inside the Primitive Abyss, the 36 Divine Beast Great Emperors should have been created and bestowed with life by that old Divine Beast,” Ling Han murmured. With this comparison, it was clear what his shortcomings were.

He could only bestow life, and not only could the old Divine Beast Beast bestow life, the abilities of the life it bestowed would also be stronger, and could even reach the level of Great Emperor. Furthermore, the old Divine Beast could also create things.
If Ling Han faced the old Divine Beast now, he would definitely be insta-killed with a single move.
Wasn’t it courting death to have a seventh tier and a second tier clash head-on?
“What is my limit?”
Ling Hanb bestowed life on a second rock. With his full effort, he bestowed the strength of Core Formation Tier on the rock.
However, this also made Ling Han feel as if his body had been hollowed out.
“The gap is so wide!” Ling Han frowned. The old Divine Beast could create Divine Beast Great Emperors.
“If I borrow the power of the Genesis World from Ding Shu and the others, how much would it increase?”
Ling Han immediately rushed back to find Ding Shu and the others.
After discussing for a while, Ding Shu and the others all agreed to “lend” the power of the Genesis World to Ling Han.
—In the future, when they entered into the Primitive Abyss, they would go to the island and cultivate some life essence, which could replenish their loss.
However, while Ding Shu and the others agreed, extracting this power was another matter altogether.
Ling Han kept trying, but he was completely unsuccessful.
Could it be that he could only absorb it after Ding Shu and the others had died?
Although Ling Han yearned to become stronger, he had never thought of using this method.
Thus, he gave up on trying.
Right at this moment, the Lands of Death charged over.
Sure enough, Little Ye was right. For the sake of the Mark of Destiny, the Lords of Death would kill him at all costs and transfer the mark to another.
Even if it had to be the sons of Great Emperors like Liu Xinhe and Shi Tianlu that became Emperor, it could not be Ling Han.
Ling Han was far too freakish. If he became Emperor, perhaps even the Lords of Death would be no match for him.
Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest, and immediately drew all the stars into his body.
At present, he had the strength of a Great Emperor, so it was completely no problem for him to store more than a hundred stars.
“Die!”

The Lords of Death had all arrived, and they all attacked Ling Han. The blood sea boiled, and the Yin River pierced through the skies. Demonic mist swirled around them, but none of them had awakened to their strongest state.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and moved. Then, he replied with a punch of his own. Destructive Energy shot out, turning into an incredibly dark ball of light that was filled with destructive power.
Even the Lords of Death didn’t dare to face such an attack head-on, and they could only step aside one after another.
Ling Han possessed speed that surpassed the Lords of Death. Thus, even though there were many of them, he had the initiative.
Are you guys going to revive or not?

‘If you people don’t revive, then I’ll exhaust the time. These Lords of Death have disobeyed the Dao of heaven and earth, so their existence is unreasonable. It’s impossible for them to attack for a long time.’
As expected, after a long battle, even the Lords of Death were powerless to continue.

They were no longer living beings, and they were unable to replenish their power from the Living Realm. Thus, they could only rely on absorbing life essence to forcefully resonate with heaven and earth, thereby restoring their power.
But now?
How could there be life for them to absorb?
Hence, the choice that was laid out in front of the Lords of Death was very simple. They could either retreat, or revive their bodies and fight with all their might.
The Lords of Death chose... the latter!
They definitely had to kill Ling Han. Otherwise, if Ling Han became Emperor, there would be no need to mention anything else.
They had endured for so long, and they would really rather die in battle than accept defeat.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Immediately, one of the Lords of Death revived and entered his prime condition.
The twelve of them did not “transform” together; that was obviously a very stupid move.
When Ling Han saw this, he immediately turned around and fled.
He was no match for a Great Emperor in his prime condition.
“Humph!” With a cold laugh, the other eleven Lords of Death had already activated the Pouch Formation, surrounding Ling Han.
“Hehe.” Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 4832: Pincer Strike
paragraphs: Seeing Ling Han summon the Imperial Weapon, the Lords of Death sneered.
Although the Imperial Weapon possessed Emperor Tier-level battle prowess, it was the weakest existence.
Who were they?
Even if they didn’t awaken to their strongest state, they would still be able to suppress the Imperial Weapon.
Thus, if you want to rely on the Imperial Weapon to break out of the siege, you are really thinking too much.
“Die!” The 12 Lords of Death attacked from all corners, blasting towards Ling Han.
One strike, a fatal strike!
Ling Han smiled, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower suddenly unfurled. Shua, a mist spread out, spraying towards the Lords of Death.
What the heck was this?
The Lords of Death didn’t even know what the Cold Water of Death was. However, as Great Emperors, how sensitive were their senses?
Not good, there was a great danger!
They all began to dodge at the first instant. If they were touched, it was guaranteed that even they would be in big trouble.
In this way, Ling Han naturally found an opening and escaped.
He was secretly thanking his luck. Although the Cold Water of Death was terrifying, it could still be blocked by the Imperial Weapon.
However, these Great Emperors had personally come, and each of their battle prowess had surpassed the Imperial Weapon. Thus, they naturally didn’t need to rely on external items.
As a result, when faced with the Cold Water of Death, they could only be forced to dodge. Otherwise, if they blocked it with an Imperial Weapon, they would be able to penetrate deeply.
For a Great Emperor that possessed an Imperial Weapon, the Cold Water of Death could only catch him off guard. It couldn’t possibly succeed in striking him.

“Don’t even think about running!” The Lords of Death immediately set off in pursuit. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Light flashed in the skies, and one after another, Imperial Weapons flew through the Void and landed in the hands of these Great Emperors.
Which person who could become a Great Emperor was not extraordinarily intelligent?
Thus, they immediately made their judgement. The Imperial Weapon should be able to block this lifeless liquid, because the Imperial Weapon had no life, and could face it head-on.
However, Ling Han had already charged out of the siege. With the speed of Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, which powerful enemy could catch up to him?
Even that revived Great Emperor could only manage to hang onto Ling Han and not be thrown off his tail.
“Everyone, we’ll meet again!” Ling Han let out a battle cry. There was something he didn’t say, and that was the next time they met would be when he killed these Lords of Death.
However, who knew if he would have the strength of the sixth tier or even the fifth tier the next time they met? Thus, it was best not to be too certain, to avoid slapping himself in the face.
Boom!
A terrifying aura suddenly surged over from ahead, causing Ling Han to involuntarily feel shocked.
Emperor Tier aura.
What was going on here? Another, no, a group of Great Emperors had come?

But it should be known that there were only twelve Great Emperors in this world, and they were existences that had transformed into Yin souls on their own volition. Strictly speaking, they could no longer be called Great Emperors.
However, a group of Emperor Tier auras had suddenly appeared. What the hell was going on?
That was definitely not Pseudo-Emperor!
In an instant, Ling Han discovered that the source of this Emperor Tier aura was... the 36 Divine Beasts.
They were all mobilized. The True Dragon, True Phoenix, Black Tortoise, White Tiger, Qiong Qi and so on. The 36 Divine Beasts rode the great path of golden light over, exuding endless dominance.
Though they were all in the sixth tier, there were still thirty-six of them.
F***, why did the forces inside the Primitive Abyss also charge over?
That’s right. They must be looking for him, but they had not been able to find him previously. It was only when the battle between Emperors broke out that they “smelled” the smell, and rushed over.
Ling Han naturally couldn’t face that head-on. In a one-on-one battle, he was no match for a Divine Beast Great Emperor, what more when it was one against 36.
Let’s go.
He changed direction, and continued to run madly.
“Ling Han, die!” the 36 Divine Beast Great Emperors roared in fury, their voices shaking the heavens.
At this time, the members of the two great Emperor Tier forces finally met.

The Lords of Death were also very shocked. They already knew that such a force existed, but one was in the Primitive Abyss, while the other was outside. There was no conflict of interest between the two, so they each minded their own business.
And now... the Great Emperors from the Primitive Abyss had appeared.
Their target was also Ling Han?
Then there would be no problem.

The Lords of Death knew themselves well. Although their explosive power was strong, they couldn’t battle for long, but the Divine Beast Great Emperors didn’t have such scruples. If they hunted Ling Han, the effects would definitely be even better.
Thus, they deliberately slowed down, allowing the Divine Beast Great Emperors to catch up and pursue ahead of them. Meanwhile, they hung back.

However, they definitely had to witness Ling Han’s death with their own eyes — if the Divine Beast Great Emperors were unable to kill Ling Han, then they would take their place. No matter what, they could not possibly allow Ling Han to continue living.
All of a sudden, there were actually forty-eight Great Emperors that were hunting down Ling Han at the same time.
This!
Throughout history, Ling Han was definitely the first person to be hunted down by so many Great Emperors at the same time.

Aside from when the heaven and earth first formed, only one Great Emperor would be allowed to appear in the heaven and earth at the same time. Thus, there was no need to even think about this kind of scene, and in the Primitive Age, how could it be so lively?
Merely from this aspect, Ling Han had set a new record.
More importantly, with so many Great Emperors attacking, they were actually still unable to kill him.
A mere Pseudo-Emperor!
However, among the army of 36 Divine Beasts, there was the True Phoenix!
Xiu, the True Phoenix flapped its wings, and stood out from the thirty-six Divine Beasts, as it rapidly set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
So fast!
However, Ling Han discovered that though the True Phoenix was fast, there was a limit to how fast it was compared to him. It was far from the legendary extreme speed of the True Phoenix.

He knew, because this True Phoenix was the creation of that mysterious old Divine Beast. Even if it had similarly reached the pinnacle level of Emperor Tier, how could it compare to the creations of heaven and earth?
The True Phoenix chased after him. He was presently slowly approaching Ling Han.
Ling Han was not stingy at all. With a toss of his hand, the Cold Water of Death once again spilled out.
The True Phoenix had no choice but to stop and dodge this deadly weapon.
Ling Han took advantage of the opening to rapidly soar, greatly increasing the distance between himself and the True Phoenix.
The other Divine Beasts, or the Lords of Death, were already falling behind quite a bit. Only the True Phoenix and the awakened Lord of Death were still following behind.
Ling Han wasn’t worried about the Lord of Death. After awakening, he would only be able to last three to four days, at most. He definitely wouldn’t be able to hold on any longer.
This was the limitation of the Lord of Death.
Thus, the only thing that could truly threaten Ling Han was the True Phoenix.
Chase, flee, flee, chase.
Three days later, as expected, the Lord of Death couldn’t hold on any longer, and stopped.
Right now, only the True Phoenix was still pursuing Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t let his guard down. As long as he was caught up by the True Phoenix, it wouldn’t be long before the army of Divine Beasts would appear and surround him.

He fought a battle of wits and courage with the True Phoenix Great Emperor. He held the Cold Water of Death in his hand. This was something that posed a great threat to the Divine Beast Great Emperors. If he used it well, he would be able to use it to escape.
The pursuit continued. Ling Han tried his best, but since the True Phoenix had locked down on him, he was always a hair’s breadth away. He was unable to throw him off his tail.
What were they to do now?
With the other party chasing him like this, would he still have the time to comprehend the great dao, revive his body, and increase his cultivation level?

chapters.title: Chapter 4833: Returning to the Imperial Island
paragraphs: Since he couldn’t throw the True Phoenix Great Emperor off his tail, he would take the risk.
Ling Han adjusted his course, and headed towards the Primitive Abyss.
There were storms of heaven and earth there, and even the Great Emperor would have to be wary. In fact, he would have to dodge them, or he would be blasted into smithereens.
Thus, in the Primitive Abyss, it became possible to throw off the True Phoenix Great Emperor.
However, Ling Han did not make his thoughts so obvious, because he was worried that after he revealed his intentions, he would be pincered by the other Divine Beast Great Emperors.
This could not possibly kill him, but what need was there for him to deliberately take risks?
After circling around, Ling Han finally arrived near the Primitive Abyss. Then, with a leap, he entered the passage.

The True Phoenix Great Emperor chased after him without any hesitation. Although the passageway was filled with starlight particles, and the might of each explosion could pose a huge threat to a Nine-Star Saint, this was naturally no big deal for a Great Emperor.
As he gave chase, he also sent out a message, informing the other Divine Beast Great Emperors to gather here and form an encirclement.
Otherwise, if Ling Han was completely focused on fleeing, it would really be very difficult for him to kill him.
After all, they both had battle prowess on the level of Great Emperors.
Ahead of them, the Dragon Head City was already within sight.
Ling Han charged over in a straight line. Though there were guards there, how could they possibly block Emperor Tier battle prowess?
Boom! The True Phoenix Great Emperor also swept past, its fiery wings flapping through the air. In an instant, the city beneath them was burned to ashes, and all life was exterminated.
Ling Han turned around to take a look, and couldn’t help but reveal a murderous expression.
So ruthless!

These people were clearly their own, yet in the eyes of the True Phoenix Great Emperor, they were worth no more than a piece of grass. They were no different from ants, and he didn’t hesitate at all. In fact, he didn’t even slow down in the slightest. Otherwise, as long as he controlled his speed slightly, he wouldn’t have caused such a massacre at all.

“What is it? Have you become soft-hearted?” The True Phoenix Great Emperor’s voice reverberated through Ling Han’s divine sense, and he said, “Then blame it on yourself. Who asked you to implicate them?”
Ling Han’s killing intent became even more intense. Although most elites didn’t care about life, being so cruel to their own people still made him feel that he had gone too far.
It was no wonder that the Great Emperors that had entered this space throughout the generations had all stood against the old Divine Beast without the slightest hesitation.
The whole could be divined from a part.
Ling Han wasn’t a rash person, that couldn’t help but turn around and start a fight after suffering such provocation.
He continued to charge madly, completely unaffected.

“Those who can become Emperor only have the Dao of Heaven and Earth in their hearts, so what need is there for them to take mere ants to heart?” The True Phoenix Great Emperor switched tactics, “You are so wishy-washy, so how can you still wholeheartedly pursue Dao?”
Ling Han still didn’t speak. He simply roamed this vast heaven and earth, hoping to encounter a storm of heaven and earth.
It would be best if it was a sandstorm. Not only could it not pose a life-threatening threat to the Great Emperor, it could also form a visual and divine sense deception on the Great Emperor.
However, unfortunately, after close to three months, there was actually not the slightest bit of storm of heaven and earth here.
Ling Han mocked internally. Was there any need to make things so difficult for him?
Their journey was surprisingly smooth.
There were some small twists and turns that were enough to block Ling Han when he had battle prowess on the level of a Pseudo-Emperor. However, for the current him, this was no big deal.
Thus, Ling Han continued to advance, yet he couldn’t find any storms of heaven and earth that could help him break free from the True Phoenix Emperor.
Right until a very, very long time later, that sea of death appeared in front of them.
This was a place where even Great Emperors could possibly be buried!
Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest, and directly charged over.

The True Phoenix also set off in pursuit. However, columns of water would occasionally soar into the sky from the sea, and they were incredibly quick. Even though the two of them were at the level of Great Emperors, they still had to be extremely careful, not daring to be careless in the slightest.
This was too dangerous, forcing the two of them to focus more of their energy on guarding against the water pillars below them.
There was no rhythm to the rise of the pillars of water. Thus, as they ran, Ling Han and the True Phoenix Great Emperor were getting further and further away from each other.
After running for a while longer, Ling Han turned around to look, and could no longer see the True Phoenix Great Emperor.
He thought for a moment, then decided to continue onwards.

Buddha Doga, Qian Yanghao and Xia Houping, the three Pseudo-Emperors would be suppressed by heaven and earth outside, and could not fathom the Nine Star Regulations and take another step, but if they cultivated on the island at the core area, there were endless possibilities.
With their natural talent, they all had hopes of becoming Emperors. In the past, it could only be said that they were unlucky, and had not received the blessing of heaven and earth.
But it was different here. There was no Dao of Heaven and Earth, and there were only four main elements.
With this, he could become a Great Emperor!
Then, he would return.
His battlefield was in the outside world. Only he could stop the Lords of Death, and those like the Battle Saint Emperor were unable to leave.
On the other side, the True Phoenix Great Emperor also gave up his pursuit and returned to land.

A cold smile tugged at the corners of his lips, and he murmured, “Though I did not manage to kill this brat, I have successfully trapped him in this space. As long as those twelve idiots can shatter the heaven and earth, the outcome would be decided!”
Turning around, with a flap of his wings, he had already left without a trace.
Ling Han carefully advanced with great difficulty.
After around nine years, Ling Han finally arrived at the core island.

He went up to the island, then released the three Pseudo-Emperors, Buddha Doga, Xia Houping and Qian Yanghao. He could not release the others, as they would be instantly crushed into smithereens by the terrifying gravity fields, even if they were wearing Battle Armors.
In reality, even Pseudo-Emperors would have to wear Battle Armor. Otherwise, they would be sprawled out on the ground, unable to move.

—After achieving the battle prowess of a Great Emperor, Ling Han would be able to take in Pseudo-Emperors into his body. He could not do the same for Imperial Weapons. A sliver of divine sense from a Great Emperor lay within them, unless he had obtained the method to control them like he could control the Clear Bamboo Sword.

However, it didn’t matter which corner of the universe the Imperial Weapon was abandoned. As long as it was summoned with a secret technique, it wouldn’t take long to break through the Void and arrive.
No matter what, the Imperial Weapon could still be considered an eighth tier Emperor-level battle prowess.
Buddha Doga and the others were all extremely stunned. Even they could barely walk on this island. It could completely be called the Imperial Island.
En, this name was not bad. This place was indeed filled with Great Emperors.
Ling Han brought the three Pseudo-Emperors to the Cave of Life.
“S-Senior!” Ling Han arrived at the cave, and actually saw the Battle Saint Emperor again.
This old Saint Emperor was severely wounded, and was presently soaking in a pool of water, absorbing the Source Power of Life within.
Ling Han was extremely speechless. Why was it that every time he came, he would see the Battle Saint Emperor injured?
‘The line of the Battle Saint Emperor should change its name to the line of Easily Injured? Or the line of Pummeled?’
Sigh!
Ling Han only felt that if he stayed too long with the Battle Saint Emperor, or Brother Monkey, his urge to ridicule them would also become incredibly strong.
“Greetings, Senior Battle Saint!” Buddha Doga and the others also paid their respects.

Firstly, the Battle Saint Emperor had achieved dao long before them, and secondly, the Battle Saint Emperor was fighting in the Abyss. This was bleeding for all life in the universe, and deserved their respect.
The Battle Saint Emperor squinted his eyes at him, and said with a smile, “Brat, you’re quite good. You’ve brought three decent saplings with you, and they’ll be of some help to us in the future.”
Decent saplings?
In this world, who could pass such judgement on Buddha Doga and the other Pseudo-Emperors?
Only the Battle Saint Emperor... and the other Great Emperors could do so.

Sigh!
Ling Han only felt that if he stayed too long with the Battle Saint Emperor, or Brother Monkey, his urge to ridicule them would also become incredibly strong.
“Greetings, Senior Battle Saint!” Buddha Doga and the others also paid their respects.
Firstly, the Battle Saint Emperor had achieved dao long before them, and secondly, the Battle Saint Emperor was fighting in the Abyss.
This was bleeding for all life in the universe, and deserved their respect.
The Battle Saint Emperor squinted his eyes at him, and said with a smile, “Brat, you’re quite good.
You’ve brought three decent saplings with you, and they’ll be of some help to us in the future.”
Decent saplings?
In this world, who could pass such judgement on Buddha Doga and the other Pseudo-Emperors?
Only the Battle Saint Emperor... and the other Great Emperors could do so.

chapters.title: Chapter 4834: Reading Imperial Scrolls
paragraphs: If Buddha Doga and the others were in the outside world, they would all be standing at the pinnacle of the world. Who would dare to comment on them?
But when they came here, they had all become juniors.

Even if there were those like Ancestral King Lingtian, who was from a later generation than Buddha Doga, those who could become a Great Emperor and rule over an era were absolute overlords, naturally superior to Pseudo-Emperors.
Only after becoming Emperor, would everyone be able to stand on equal footing.
After feeling stunned and rueful for a moment, Buddha Doga and the others immediately immersed themselves in cultivating.

After they became Emperors, they could both join the camp that was opposing the old Divine Beast, and could also leave the Primitive Abyss, giving Ling Han some help. Thus, their battle prowess was still quite something to look forward to.

The three Pseudo-Emperors adjusted themselves, and began to resonate with the essence of Life, attempting to directly use the essence of heaven and earth to attain Dao, and skip over the stage of Nine Star Regulations.
If they became Emperors like this, there would definitely be flaws. Compared to the Battle Saint Emperor and the others, they lacked the Nine Star Regulations.

This was something that could not be helped. The heaven and earth already did not allow figures of the older generation like them to become Emperors, and now they could go through the back door, and circle around the heaven and earth. This was already a miracle among miracles.
Moreover, their limitation would only be stopping at the second tier, and they would not be able to charge up to the first tier.
It should be known that even the old Divine Beast was only in the second tier, so it didn’t matter.

However, after observing for a while, the Battle Saint Emperor whispered to Ling Han. Among the three Pseudo-Emperors, it was only Buddha Doga that had a chance of becoming Emperor, while Xia Houping and Qian Yanghao were slightly inferior.

It could not be helped. They had not been able to cultivate to the level of Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor after such a long time, which meant that their potential was more or less exhausted, and now they still wanted to improve further?
It was practically impossible!

Ling Han sighed. Xia Houping and Qian Yanghao weren’t from this era, and they had traversed the ages to come here. Thus, their foundations of cultivation had definitely been shaken. This was their disadvantage when compared to Buddha Doga, who had directly lived a second life and started over.
Forget it. Man proposes, and God disposes.
Ling Han told the Battle Saint Emperor about Brother Monkey, making the old Saint Emperor extremely happy.
"He is like me, like me!" The old Saint Emperor smiled like a child.
’Holy f*ck!’

Ling Han wanted to complain again. The reason why this old Saint Emperor was overjoyed was not because he had descendants, or because his descendant was about to become Pseudo-Emperor, but rather because he also had an explosive temper, and would itch to fight whenever he saw a fight.
The number of members in the line of the Battle Saint has already decreased to this extent. Please, can you guys take it easy?
Ling Han decided that when he returned, he would quickly find a female monkey for Brother Monkey, and quickly increase the number of members in the line of the Batle saint.
He crossed the sea, and spent more than eight years, returning to the shore, and then returned.
This time, he was out of luck. The storms of heaven and earth continued, and it took him a whole twenty seven years to finally arrive at the passageway.
Goodness!
Ling Han was astonished. This was because an Inescapable Net had already been set up here.

The 36 Divine Beast Great Emperors were all standing guard here, and a massive stronghold had also been built. With the sturdy structure of the heaven and earth here, even if Ling Han attacked it with Destructive Energy, it would still take some time for it to be breached.
And with the 36 Divine Beast Great Emperors impeding him, how could Ling Han possibly break out of the siege?
They were planning to keep him trapped here.
Realization immediately dawned on Ling Han. This was because they didn’t want him to go out and ruin the plot of the Lords of Death.
Rather than calling it the scheme of the Lords of Death, it would be more accurate to call it the scheme of the old Divine Beast, which had been laid out millions and millions of years ago.
Hence, when the Lords of Death were about to collapse, the old Divine Beast stretched out a helping hand.
This was really helping oneself.
What could they do?
Ling Han didn’t want to barge in. This wouldn’t work at all.

—Without this stronghold, Ling Han could still break out of the siege with the Cold Water of Death. Now, the time gained through using that method was far from enough for him to break through the stronghold.
He turned around resolutely and started to travel around in the Primitive Abyss.
There were very few cultivation resources here, but once found, it would be a Great Herb that would be of help to Saints, at least.
And in the case of Genesis Substance, it was also beneficial for the cultivation of Pseudo-Emperors.
Thus, Ling Han searched everywhere. He wouldn’t be trapped here and be unable to improve further.

When he was further away, Ling Han released a portion of the Saints inside his body — they were all Saints that were wearing Battle Armors. There was no other Saint aside from the past Ling Han that could walk here without depending on the Battle Armor.
Although Ding Shu and the others were also the Genesis World’s leaders, they hadn’t cultivated the True Dragon Body Art yet. Thus, their physique was far from being powerful enough.
Ling Han and the little azure dragon discussed for a while, and decided to popularize the True Dragon Body Art.
The shockwaves caused all the Imperial Clan Saints to be dumbfounded.

For them, the Imperial Scroll was their foundation. If the Imperial Scrollwas taught to outsiders, it was equivalent to handing over control of the Imperial Weapon. Would this Imperial Clan still be called the Imperial Clan?
However, Ling Han boldly took out the Imperial Scroll, allowing everyone to cultivate it together.
How open-minded was he?
Was this the generosity of a Great Emperor?
Some Imperial Clans had also taken out their Imperial Scroll after a long period of discussion, allowing Ling Han to comprehend it.

—If Ling Han couldn’t cultivate to become a Great Emperor as soon as possible, then they would be trapped in this space forever. Even if heaven and earth collapsed outside, they would not be affected as long as they stayed inside the Primitive Abyss, but the old Divine Beast would soon succeed, and the whole universe would be destroyed.
So, what was the point of guarding the Imperial Scroll?
If they couldn’t pass this stage, everything would be for naught.
And in Ling Han’s case, he was already a Great Emperor-level battle prowess, so would he still care about their Imperial Weapon?
As a Great Emperor, which one of them wasn’t prouder than the heavens?
With someone taking the lead, even more Imperial Clans followed suit.

Most importantly, there were a great many sons and daughters of Great Emperors here, and they had the spirit and magnanimity that their fathers had once had. At this time, they did not keep their skills to themselves.
Thus, Ling Han had a great many Imperial Scrolls in his possession.

For Ling Han, Imperial Scroll could no longer increase his battle prowess. However, every Imperial Scroll was the Great Emperor’s appreciation of Regulations. For the present Ling Han, this was extremely valuable for reference.
What he was strong in was his battle prowess, and what he lacked was his cultivation level.
Ling Han comprehended the Imperial Scrolls while the others explored and searched in the vast Primitive Abyss.

Right now, the Divine Beast Great Emperors were all standing guard at the entrance of the passageway. They had absolutely no intention of searching for Ling Han. This caused the abyss to become relatively safe. They only had to guard against the storms of heaven and earth.

For the old Divine Beast, as long as the Lords of Death successfully followed the plan, the clash of the two Realms would affect the Imperial Island, and the element of Death would appear in front of him.
Once he cultivated the essence of Death, he would become the first Great Emperor in history to advance into the first tier. Just how great would his power be?
No one could stop him.
Thus, whether Ling Han lived or died actually didn’t have much effect, as long as he couldn’t go out.
Everyone moved separately. Meanwhile, Ling Han was comprehending the Imperial Scrolls every day.
He couldn’t help but feel rueful. Every single Great Emperor was a supreme prodigy, and their thoughts were filled with flashes of brilliance.
In terms of comprehension ability and creativity, there was no Great Emperor that was inferior to him.
The reason why Ling Han was so strong was because he had been born from the Stone of Life, and had practically grasped Destructive Energy and light of great dao without any effort.
He carefully comprehended, and his comprehensions continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 4835: Six Star Pseudo-Emperor
paragraphs: In the Primitive Abyss, there was no Dao of Heaven and Earth or Regulations.
Thus, if one wanted to cultivate here, they could only depend on Celestial medicines. The best thing was naturally Genesis Substance.

However, at Ling Han’s level, there was already no need for him to touch the Regulations at all times. Instead, after seeing the Regulations once, he would be able to silently comprehend them. Of course, it would be best if he could keep touching the Regulations.
When reading the Imperial Scrolls, Ling Han felt as if he could see those Great Emperors expounding on the great dao, detailing the Regulations.
To him, the Regulations seemed to have become three-dimensional, and were incredibly vivid.
Three years later, Ling Han put down the Imperial Scrolls and entered seclusion.
Endless comprehension appeared in front of his eyes, and he could casually pluck it.

In his mind, the nine-star Regulation that was as thin as gossamer was exuding a weak light, and countless tiny spots of light approached, adhering to this thin thread, causing it to slowly become thicker.
This meant that Ling Han’s comprehension of Regulations was advancing rapidly.

There were no natural treasures. This time, it was a summary of Ling Han’s experience after reading through the Imperial Scrolls. He had fused the comprehension of the Imperial Scrolls into himself, accumulating comprehension for a breakthrough.
Seven years passed, and in the place where Ling Han was sitting cross-legged, grains of sand suddenly trembled, as if an earthquake was happening.
This was extremely terrifying.
It should be known that just how terrifying was the gravity field here?

And a grain of sand was equivalent to the weight of a planet. Ling Han did not move at all. Merely the fluctuation of his aura was enough to cause the sand around him to fly. What kind of concept was that?
Not only that, but as Ling Han exuded waves of energy, the area where the sand was "dancing" was also becoming larger and larger.
A radius of 30 meters, a radius of 90 meters, a radius of 150 meters!
This was too terrifying.
Hu!

An even stronger aura suddenly surged out of Ling Han’s body, causing these grains of sand to dance in the air, as if they had formed a sandstorm. They swirled around him, and also completely concealed his figure.
Boom, a powerful aura of life surged out of the sand, and then, all the grains of sand fell onto the ground in an instant.
Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open. Astonishing vitality surged from his body, and he looked as if he had become a few years younger.
He revived his body once, and advanced to become a six-star Pseudo-Emperor.
Invigorating!
Ling Han casually moved his arms and legs, and felt that his power had increased greatly again.
His path of advancement was completely different from other Pseudo-Emperors.

The other Pseudo-Emperors would stimulate a resonation with the heaven and earth after reviving their bodies, and through these means, allow the Nine Star Regulations to appear so they could comprehend them.
Thus, it was very possible that even though the Pseudo-Emperor’s cultivation level had increased, the Regulations that he had grasped had not changed in the slightest.
—In that short period of time, it was too difficult to complete the process of capturing Regulations, appreciating Regulations, and grasping Regulations.
In the end, it was extremely shocking to be able to grasp even the slightest bit more.
Thus, even a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor could not possibly grasp a complete nine-star Regulation. He had to wait until he had completed the last leap.
However, Ling Han was different. He first grasped the Nine Star Regulation, and then turned around to stimulate the recovery of his body.
This meant that as long as his cultivation level increased, his grasp of Regulations would definitely improve, and it would be a very great improvement at that.
"When I reach Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor, I should be able to grasp a complete Nine Star Regulation."
"Perhaps, there is no need to become a Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor!"
"In this way, if I break through to Emperor Tier on the Imperial Island, it would not affect my battle prowess."
Otherwise, without going through the Nine Star Regulations, it would decrease the number of tiers of a Great Emperor, and that would definitely affect the limit of battle prowess in the future.
If he wanted to match the old Divine Beast, he naturally had to become the strongest.
"Six-star Pseudo-Emperor!"
"However, compared to Emperor Tier, the increase in my battle prowess is limited."
Ling Han sighed. His starting point was too high, causing the improvement brought by an advancement in minor level to be very limited.
"However, as long as I cultivate a complete Nine Star Regulation, I should be able to raise my battle prowess to the sixth tier."
In that case, once he broke through to Emperor Tier, he would be able to advance through the fifth tier in a single go, and directly reach the fourth tier.

He was presently so strong, which was equivalent to possessing some of the might of the fourth tier in advance, such as the light of great dao, Destructive Energy, and so on. These were all domains that belonged above the fifth tier.

This kind of battle prowess was still not enough to break through the blockade of the Divine Beast Great Emperors. Ling Han naturally would not act rashly. He was not from the line of the Battle Saint.
—Er, when he thought of Brother Monkey and the Battle Saint Emperor, Ling Han couldn’t help but feel an urge to complain.
He continued to comprehend the Imperial Scrolls. However, after accumulating enough experience, the Imperial Scrolls were no longer of much help to him.
The only good news was that the flow of time in the Primitive Abyss was 100 times faster. Thus, relatively speaking, Ling Han still had a lot of time to "waste".
As he appreciated, he roamed every corner of the Primitive Abyss, searching for Genesis Substance.
The Great Emperors had all diligently come out to search, so how could they not have gained something?
In the following 20,000 years, Ling Han gained quite a bit, obtaining three Genesis-level Great Herbs.
And after such a long time, there was basically no one that had died of old age on the stars that he had stored in his body.
It was as if once it entered his body, it would become a world of its own, just like Genesis World, where Celestial King Tier-level beings could truly be indestructible.
Was this because of the Stone of Life?
For Ling Han, this was a piece of good news. Otherwise, after as long as twenty thousand years, his parents, as well as Liu Yutong and the others would definitely die of old age.
He returned, and received a few pieces of good news.
Ding Shu, Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang had already become Pseudo-Emperors!
In reality, it wasn’t just them. Many of the children of the Great Emperors had also improved significantly. They were either eight-star Saints or nine-star Saints.
It was as if heaven and earth had opened their eyes. Everyone’s gains were not too bad. They had found Genesis-level materials, which allowed their cultivation levels to improve greatly.
In comparison, though Ling Han’s gains weren’t too bad, compared to his strength, the gap was too wide.
Since the Divine Beast Great Emperors did not pursue him, then fine. Ling Han simply began constructing a stronghold like the Dragon Head City.
Firstly, one would have to choose a place where the gravity field was normal, or much weaker.
This was naturally the mineshaft.
In the Primitive Abyss, there were still many such mineshafts.
After finding it, it would be easy to build a base here.
At this time, living beings below the level of Saints could also walk in this space, but the stars could not be released. They were too big.
With so many people, they naturally could not be wasted. What could they do?
Mining!
Ling Han also wanted to extract the Metal of Creation and upgrade the Imperial Weapon.
If he wanted to charge out, firstly, Ling Han’s battle prowess had to be at least sixth tier, and secondly, he could forge a Transcendent Weapon. He could directly destroy the stronghold.

Everything was done in an orderly manner. However, this was the Primitive Abyss, after all, so the resources were too scarce. Although it seemed like the heavens had opened their eyes previously, it quickly returned to normal.
Every single one of them had made very little progress.
This place was truly unsuitable for cultivating—apart from taking that final step.
Ling Han once again set out on the path of training. He didn’t know what was going on outside, but he definitely had to reach Eight Star or Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor as soon as possible.

In the following 20,000 years, Ling Han gained quite a bit, obtaining three Genesis-level Great Herbs.
And after such a long time, there was basically no one that had died of old age on the stars that he had stored in his body.
It was as if once it entered his body, it would become a world of its own, just like Genesis World, where Celestial King Tier-level beings could truly be indestructible.
Was this because of the Stone of Life?
For Ling Han, this was a piece of good news.
Otherwise, after as long as twenty thousand years, his parents, as well as Liu Yutong and the others would definitely die of old age.
He returned, and received a few pieces of good news.
Ding Shu, Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang had already become Pseudo-Emperors!
In reality, it wasn’t just them.
Many of the children of the Great Emperors had also improved significantly.
They were either eight-star Saints or nine-star Saints.
It was as if heaven and earth had opened their eyes.
Everyone’s gains were not too bad.
They had found Genesis-level materials, which allowed their cultivation levels to improve greatly.
In comparison, though Ling Han’s gains weren’t too bad, compared to his strength, the gap was too wide.
Since the Divine Beast Great Emperors did not pursue him, then fine.
Ling Han simply began constructing a stronghold like the Dragon Head City.
Firstly, one would have to choose a place where the gravity field was normal, or much weaker.
This was naturally the mineshaft.
In the Primitive Abyss, there were still many such mineshafts.
After finding it, it would be easy to build a base here.
At this time, living beings below the level of Saints could also walk in this space, but the stars could not be released.
They were too big.
With so many people, they naturally could not be wasted.
What could they do?
Mining!
Ling Han also wanted to extract the Metal of Creation and upgrade the Imperial Weapon.
If he wanted to charge out, firstly, Ling Han’s battle prowess had to be at least sixth tier, and secondly, he could forge a Transcendent Weapon.
He could directly destroy the stronghold.
Everything was done in an orderly manner.
However, this was the Primitive Abyss, after all, so the resources were too scarce.
Although it seemed like the heavens had opened their eyes previously, it quickly returned to normal.
Every single one of them had made very little progress.
This place was truly unsuitable for cultivating—apart from taking that final step.
Ling Han once again set out on the path of training.
He didn’t know what was going on outside, but he definitely had to reach Eight Star or Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor as soon as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 4836: Sixth Tier!
paragraphs: Either Ling Han’s battle prowess had advanced into the sixth tier, or he had created the Transcendent Weapon. He only had to achieve either one, and Ling Han would dare to break through the siege of the Divine Beast Great Emperors.
The creation of the Transcendent Weapon required the Metal of Creation. This could only be done through mining and see if one got lucky. Ling Han couldn’t do much about that either.
Thus, he focused on improving his own strength.
This time, he didn’t bring anyone with him. He simply roamed around in the Primitive Abyss.
Many years later, he arrived at the side of the Sea of Death.
Should he go and take a look at Buddha Doga and the others?
Had they become Emperors yet?
The Primitive Abyss was not the outside world. Even if someone became Emperor here, there were no Regulations in this world at all, so how could there possibly be various unusual phenomena?
However, after arriving here, Ling Han’s divine sense suddenly lit up. He sat by the sea and started to comprehend Dao.
Occasionally, he would use his power as a hand to touch the seawater.

There was a terrifying power of death in this sea. The moment his hand, formed out of power, touched it, it would immediately kill the sliver of Ling Han’s divine sense that had been fused into it. However, in this process, Ling Han was also continuously able to glimpse the true meaning of death.

Limited by his cultivation level, it was impossible for him to directly grasp the essence of death. Furthermore, it was also impossible to grasp the element of Death like this. Otherwise, the old Divine Beast would really be an idiot.
The power of death in the seawater was like a manifestation of the element of Death, just like Destructive Energy.
Destructive Energy definitely wasn’t the element of Destruction. It was merely a form of display of the element of Destruction.
It was the same in this space.
Ling Han was studying this power of death, trying to use it to advance his grasp of Regulations, so that he could once again awaken his body.
Regulations were the embodiment of great dao, and great dao... also originated from the four main elements.
Thus, Ling Han was standing at a higher position, trying to grasp Regulations.
This was very hurtful.
Every time he came into contact with the seawater, a sliver of his divine sense would be destroyed. One or two was fine, but once there were too many, even Ling Han was slightly unable to bear it.
However, he was firm in his belief, and would not waver in the slightest.
His divine sense continued to weaken, but his grasp of the Dao of Death was also improving step by step. In fact, his divine sense had also become more resilient.
He saw it as a kind of training.
One year, two years, three years... As time passed, when his divine sense became severely damaged, and Ling Han would stop to recover. Then, he would continue.
Genesis Substance was too rare. To cultivate in the Primitive Abyss, he could only take risks.
One hundred years, three hundred years, seven hundred years.

Ling Han wasn’t comprehending the Regulation of Death. On the other hand, the thin thread of Regulation in his mind was the Regulation of Life. This was the Regulation he used the most, and it was used to revive the rock golem and numerous stars.

He had come from the Stone of Life, and was naturally close to the Regulation of Life. Thus, even if he had not completely grasped this nine-star Regulation, he could already use an ability that surpassed the nine-star Regulation.
The essence of Death and the essence of Life were opposites. They were absolute opposites, but also served as excellent reference.
Two thousand years had passed, and Ling Han finally had a major gain.
Boom, the life force in his body surged like the tide.
Why did he prioritize the Regulation of Life?
That was because the process of cultivating Pseudo-Emperor Tier was the process of reviving the body, and to revive the body, wasn’t Regulation of Life the best?
They complemented each other.
Resuscitate!
Ling Han roared internally. Boom! A powerful aura of life suddenly surged out of his body, soaring steadily. In fact, he had even forced back a portion of the seawater around him.
A seven-star Pseudo-Emperor!
Ling Han opened his eyes, his gaze piercing the skies.
He was still a sliver away from grasping the complete Regulation of Life.
Eight stars, he had to become an eight star Pseudo-Emperor.
Ling Han thought internally, but now that things had come to this, it was already useless to use the seawater of death as a counter-reference.
He still had to depend on Genesis Substance.

Ling Han set out, continuing to search for Genesis Substance. He still had three such Celestial medicines on him, but they should not be enough to support him to advance into eight-star Pseudo-Emperor.
Thus, he still had to find a few more.
This search took another 30,000 years.
Thankfully, thankfully, the 30,000 years in the Primitive Abyss was only over 300 years in the outside world.
It should... not have caused a great calamity.
Ling Han already had seven Celestial medicines in his possession.
He started to refine them. He felt that this was more or less enough.
Weng, the pillar of light of great dao appeared. This was a manifestation of the four elements, surpassing Regulations.
Ling Han fully focused on comprehension. There was too little Genesis Substance, so he couldn’t waste even the slightest bit.
Refining the Celestial medicine didn’t need too much time. In just five days, the seven Celestial medicines were all refined by Ling Han.
This wasn’t enough to support Ling Han’s recovery. Thus, he was still a seven-star Pseudo-Emperor. However, his grasp of the Regulations of Life had improved further.
The complete Regulation of Life!
This was something that had never happened before.

It should be known that no Great Emperor could possibly grasp the complete Nine Star Regulations when they were only a Pseudo-Emperor. At most, they would only be close to grasping it, because there was heaven and earth suppressing them.
In an era, only one Great Emperor could grasp the Nine Star Regulations.
This required both the permission of heaven and earth, as well as the blessing of great fortune. Neither could be missing.
However, Ling Han broke through this restriction.

In terms of Regulations, he was already a true Great Emperor, but in terms of physique, he was still a seven-star Pseudo-Emperor. He still needed to awaken his body two more times before he could truly become Emperor.
It didn’t matter.
Cultivation level was only secondary in importance. What was important was ability.
Ling Han stood up. This time, he was determined to break through the lines of Great Emperors.
Without the obstruction of the storms of heaven and earth, only a few days later, Ling Han had returned to base.
"Good news! Good news!" The large black dog immediately approached, "Little Han, guess what Grandpa Dog has found?"
Ling Han looked at its iron underwear, and the corner of his mouth involuntarily twitched.
Such a large piece of Metal of Creation, but it was actually inlaid on this guy’s underpants.
Just how afraid are you of having your b@lls kicked?
"Old Black, just how far can you push your bottom line?" Ling Han sighed, and placed his hand on his forehead.
"As long as I’m alive, Grandpa Dog will never stop trying," the large black dog said. It was as if he wanted to pursue this for the rest of his life.
’Fine, you win.’
However, their luck was off the charts. They had only been digging for tens of thousands of years, and they had already dug out an extremely pure, very large Metal of Creation.
However, after taking off the large black dog’s iron underwear, Ling Han’s expression was filled with disdain.
"Old Black, can you not be so mischievous?"
He wondered if there was something unclean on it.
The large black dog rolled his eyes, "Grandpa Dog has a good bath every day!"
Forget it.
Ling Han instilled the Metal of Creation into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. However, this was still not enough to cause a qualitative change in the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Forget it, let’s break out of the siege!
Ling Han wasn’t in a rush to move, as many people were still searching for Genesis Substance outside. Of course, he had to wait for them to return.
Since he had nothing else to do, Ling Han entered the mine, planning to search for it himself.

Right now, he possessed the battle prowess of the sixth tier. In a head-on clash against even a Divine Beast Great Emperor, he wasn’t at a disadvantage. Add to that the Destructive Energy, and in terms of destructive power alone, even the Great Emperor in his prime was far inferior to him.
Thus, he was filled with confidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 4837: Transcendent Weapon
paragraphs: Because multiple large pieces of the Metal of Creation had been mined here, Ling Han wondered if there would be any more gains.
He arrived at the depths of the mine, then continued to dig downwards.

Using a special miner’s hoe, he could slowly excavate. After all, the heaven and earth structure here was slightly different, but for Ling Han, once the Destructive Energy appeared, his excavation speed was ridiculously fast.
It was as if he hadn’t entered the ground layer, but rather the lake waters, with how very casually he was digging..
Vision was obstructed here, so they could only rely on their divine sense. Otherwise, they could only try their luck.

In the past, Ling Han’s divine sense wasn’t strong enough, and the area he could spread his divine sense over was limited. However, it was different now. He had Great Emperor-level divine sense, and a sixth tier at that. This was naturally terrifying.
However, even if he was a Great Emperor, he could only cover an area of around 300 meters.
Ling Han searched in the cave for seven days, and it was as if the entire underground had become a beehive. He dug out countless secret passages.
Unfortunately, there was no gain.
Ling Han was not discouraged. He set out, and left this mining area, searching for other mining areas.
With his current destructive power, he was qualified to search deeper.
After searching one mining area after another, Ling Han finally began to gain something, and it was not a small gain either.
He obtained more and more Metal of Creation, and he had integrated them all into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
He had a feeling that as long as there was another small amount of Metal of Creation, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower would have a qualitative change.
Transcendent Weapon!

Once he forged the Transcendent Weapon, he would not only be able to easily break through the blockade of the Divine Beast Great Emperors, he would also be able to stand against the fully awakened Lords of Death. In fact, he would even be able to suppress them.
Most importantly, the Transcendent Weapon could elevate his battle prowess by a significant amount.
Because the Imperial Weapon was in the eighth tier, then even if it was upgraded to become a Transcendent Weapon, its improvement shouldn’t be too exaggerated, right?
He would have to forge it to find out.
But no matter what, it would definitely be better to create the Transcendent Weapon. After all, Great Emperor Wu Ya had deliberately left a message for Ling Han to forge the Transcendent Weapon.
1000 years, 2000 years, and when the time came to the 272nd year of the 3000th years, Ling Han finally dug up another extremely heavy ore, which contained abundant Metal of Creation.
He extracted it and immediately assimilated it into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
It was time for a qualitative change.
When the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower absorbed this piece of Metal of Creation, a qualitative change took place!
This Imperial Weapon was exuding a brilliant light, and it was as if it could breathe. It was inhaling and exhaling an indescribable power.
The four key elements?
Ling Han nodded. It was only in the Primitive Abyss that the Imperial Weapon could complete this step.
Otherwise, the maximum limit of Regulations outside would be nine stars, at most, so how could the Imperial Weapon complete a qualitative change?
Boom!

The incomparably powerful Imperial Might seeped out of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Ling Han carefully distinguished that this was still Imperial Might, but it was even more majestic, as vast as the sea.
Transcendent Weapon?

It had indeed surpassed the ordinary Imperial Weapon, which was only in the eighth tier. But now, with a thought from Ling Han, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower immediately unleashed its might, blasting out a terrifying attack.
Fifth tier!
Only comparable to a Great Emperor at his prime?
This was already very impressive, all right?
There was more!

Ling Han discovered that the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower now had an additional ability to accumulate energy. Accumulating power could completely become a burst of power, and could unleash the might of the fourth tier.

However, after one attack, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower would need to accumulate energy again. Time was... boom, Ling Han had the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower deliver this powerful attack, then observe the recovery situation.
Ten days.
He came to this conclusion.

This was really a great burst of power. He could only launch an attack once every ten days. Furthermore, unless it was a sudden attack, even with the battle prowess of the fourth tier, it was still impossible to insta-kill a fifth tier.
Whom among those that could cultivate to become Great Emperors were not prodigies among prodigies, and geniuses among geniuses?
Therefore, without battle prowess, it was absolutely impossible to insta-kill.
"So, good steel should be used on the cutting edge. I believe that I can give the Lords of Death a surprise," Ling Han murmured.

It was no wonder that the Divine Beast Great Emperors wanted to take charge of mining. If the Transcendent Weapon could be forged, then it would pose an additional threat to the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others. Of course, it was only a threat. Thus, the Divine Beast Great Emperors did not personally take part.
On the other hand, it was naturally because the Divine Beast Great Emperors hadn’t grasped the Destructive Energy at all. They weren’t as efficient as Ling Han at all.
Ling Han returned. This time, those who had gone out had all returned.
All right, let’s go.
Ling Han drew everyone into his body. Then, he set out, heading towards the passageway.
Though close to another 100,000 years had passed, the many Divine Beast Great Emperors were still standing guard here, and did not have the slightest intention of leaving.
Ling Han was astonished. As a mighty Great Emperor, how could they be so obedient?
It should be known that where could the Great Emperor not go? Why were the Divine Beast Great Emperors so completely devoted to that old Divine Beast?
Ling Han pushed this question back into his mind. He summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, aiming it at the stronghold.
With his current strength, he was indeed comparable to a Divine Beast Great Emperor. After unleashing the Destructive Energy, he might even have a chance of winning.
However, the problem was that there were 36 of them!
Ling Han didn’t think that he could challenge 36 opponents at this moment.
Moreover, as long as the other party restrained him and prevented him from blasting open the stronghold, Ling Han still wouldn’t be able to leave.
Thus, the first step was naturally to destroy the stronghold. Then, Ling Han would be able to do as he pleased.
Hong, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower shot out a pillar of light towards the stronghold ahead.
At the same time, Ling Han also adjusted the angle, bringing the Divine Beast Great Emperors with him.
However, in the instant that the pillar of light shot out, all the Divine Beast Great Emperors instantly looked stunned, and then rapidly retreated.
This was instinctive, and it allowed them to avoid danger at the first instant.
Then, they roared at the same time, and moved together, greeting that pillar of light.
However, it was already too late.
Boom!
The column of light descended, sinking into that massive stronghold.
There was no movement at all.
After only a short instant, boom, the whole stronghold trembled, and then shattered loudly.
"Everyone, long time no see!" Ling Han also strode out.
"Ling Han!" The thirty-six Divine Beasts were all brimming with killing intent, and at the same time, there was also a strong sense of wariness.
Crushing a stronghold with a single strike?
This required the battle prowess of the fourth tier.
If that was really the case, then even if there were thirty-six of them, they would still be unable to stop Ling Han. It was very possible that they would be defeated one by one.

This was not the Imperial Island, where there were a great many Great Emperors that had grasped the essence of life. Worse come to worst, they could still be sent to the Cave of Life, and very soon, they would be able to come back to life.
Thus, if they died here, they could only wait to be re-created.
How was this possible?
Only tens of thousands of years had passed, and this brat actually possessed the battle prowess of the fourth tier.
Absolutely impossible!
"You created the Transcendent Weapon!" Qiong Qi Great Emperor said, revealing the truth with a single word.
Ling Han laughed loudly, "You guys guess."
The Divine Beast Great Emperors were all suspicious. With Ling Han’s words, they were no longer so certain.
"Come, I’ll beat you guys up!" Ling Han roared as he charged forward.
