Fifth tier!
Only comparable to a Great Emperor at his prime?
This was already very impressive, all right?
There was more!
Ling Han discovered that the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower now had an additional ability to accumulate energy.
Accumulating power could completely become a burst of power, and could unleash the might of the fourth tier.
However, after one attack, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower would need to accumulate energy again.
Time was... boom, Ling Han had the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower deliver this powerful attack, then observe the recovery situation.
Ten days.
He came to this conclusion.
This was really a great burst of power.
He could only launch an attack once every ten days.
Furthermore, unless it was a sudden attack, even with the battle prowess of the fourth tier, it was still impossible to insta-kill a fifth tier.
Whom among those that could cultivate to become Great Emperors were not prodigies among prodigies, and geniuses among geniuses?
Therefore, without battle prowess, it was absolutely impossible to insta-kill.
"So, good steel should be used on the cutting edge.
I believe that I can give the Lords of Death a surprise," Ling Han murmured.
It was no wonder that the Divine Beast Great Emperors wanted to take charge of mining.
If the Transcendent Weapon could be forged, then it would pose an additional threat to the Great Emperor Wu Ya and the others.
Of course, it was only a threat.
Thus, the Divine Beast Great Emperors did not personally take part.
On the other hand, it was naturally because the Divine Beast Great Emperors hadn’t grasped the Destructive Energy at all.
They weren’t as efficient as Ling Han at all.
Ling Han returned.
This time, those who had gone out had all returned.
All right, let’s go.
Ling Han drew everyone into his body.
Then, he set out, heading towards the passageway.
Though close to another 100,000 years had passed, the many Divine Beast Great Emperors were still standing guard here, and did not have the slightest intention of leaving.
Ling Han was astonished.
As a mighty Great Emperor, how could they be so obedient?
It should be known that where could the Great Emperor not go?
Why were the Divine Beast Great Emperors so completely devoted to that old Divine Beast?
Ling Han pushed this question back into his mind.
He summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, aiming it at the stronghold.
With his current strength, he was indeed comparable to a Divine Beast Great Emperor.
After unleashing the Destructive Energy, he might even have a chance of winning.
However, the problem was that there were 36 of them!
Ling Han didn’t think that he could challenge 36 opponents at this moment.
Moreover, as long as the other party restrained him and prevented him from blasting open the stronghold, Ling Han still wouldn’t be able to leave.
Thus, the first step was naturally to destroy the stronghold.
Then, Ling Han would be able to do as he pleased.
Hong, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower shot out a pillar of light towards the stronghold ahead.
At the same time, Ling Han also adjusted the angle, bringing the Divine Beast Great Emperors with him.
However, in the instant that the pillar of light shot out, all the Divine Beast Great Emperors instantly looked stunned, and then rapidly retreated.
This was instinctive, and it allowed them to avoid danger at the first instant.
Then, they roared at the same time, and moved together, greeting that pillar of light.
However, it was already too late.
Boom!
The column of light descended, sinking into that massive stronghold.
There was no movement at all.
After only a short instant, boom, the whole stronghold trembled, and then shattered loudly.
"Everyone, long time no see!" Ling Han also strode out.
"Ling Han!" The thirty-six Divine Beasts were all brimming with killing intent, and at the same time, there was also a strong sense of wariness.
Crushing a stronghold with a single strike?
This required the battle prowess of the fourth tier.
If that was really the case, then even if there were thirty-six of them, they would still be unable to stop Ling Han.
It was very possible that they would be defeated one by one.
This was not the Imperial Island, where there were a great many Great Emperors that had grasped the essence of life.
Worse come to worst, they could still be sent to the Cave of Life, and very soon, they would be able to come back to life.
Thus, if they died here, they could only wait to be re-created.
How was this possible?
Only tens of thousands of years had passed, and this brat actually possessed the battle prowess of the fourth tier.
Absolutely impossible!
"You created the Transcendent Weapon!" Qiong Qi Great Emperor said, revealing the truth with a single word.
Ling Han laughed loudly, "You guys guess."
The Divine Beast Great Emperors were all suspicious.
With Ling Han’s words, they were no longer so certain.
"Come, I’ll beat you guys up!" Ling Han roared as he charged forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 4838: True Slaughter of an Emperor
paragraphs: "How dare you!"
The 36 Divine Beasts were all enraged. Though there was a problem with their cultivation levels, they were still Great Emperors, after all.
A Pseudo-Emperor like you actually dares to fight all of them alone?
’You’re seeking death!’
Boom, the 36 Divine Beasts all moved, launching an attack at Ling Han.
Multiple attacks streaked across the sky, incredibly dazzling.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and forcefully barged in.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Ling Han and the thirty-six Divine Beasts clashed head-on, instantly exchanging tens of thousands of blows.

However, his battle prowess was only at the sixth tier, after all, which was equivalent to the Divine Beast Great Emperors. In a one-on-one battle, Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be at a disadvantage, but in a one-on-thirty six battle, the gap was too obvious.
Ling Han was instantly sent flying, unable to do anything to this wall of Great Emperors.
"A mere Pseudo-Emperor!" the thirty-six Divine Beasts exclaimed in unison. They were surprisingly in unison.
A strange feeling instantly rose up in Ling Han’s mind. However, he couldn’t put his finger on what exactly was strange.
"So what if I am Pseudo-Emperor? I can still ensure that you can do nothing to me and cause you to be injured and bleed. In fact..." He looked at the True Dragon Emperor and said, "I can kill you!"
The True Dragon Emperor’s expression instantly became ugly.

Previously, he had been killed by Great Emperor Senluo. Though he had been created again, his cultivation level had started from Pseudo-Emperor. In the end, he just happened to encounter Ling Han, and was killed by the latter.
This was naturally a great humiliation.
—If he knew that his body was still being eaten, his expression would definitely be a dozen times worse.
"Shameless boasting!"
"Today, you delivered yourself to our doorstep, so accept your death!"
The 36 Divine Beasts had already tested Ling Han’s strength, so they naturally had no more reservations as they all charged over.
Ling Han was astonished. ’You people are all Great Emperors, so why are you so uncouth?’
This was 36 Great Emperors fighting against a Pseudo-Emperor; if word got out, would you guys still have any face?
He gave a loud shout, and confronted the Divine Beast Great Emperors head-on.
Although he was alone and weak, his physique was extremely tough. So what if he was at a disadvantage? For the moment, he didn’t have to worry about his life.
However, the 36 Divine Beasts cooperated well, and their battle prowess became more and more terrifying.
After all, there were 36 of them!
In the past, Xuan Taiyu had only been able to battle against the twelve Lords of Death alone. Now, however, there were 36 Divine Beasts, and the numbers had directly increased threefold.
Of course, after the Lords of Death revived, their battle prowess would be in the fifth tier, which was a whole lot stronger than the Divine Beast Great Emperors.
Ling Han sighed internally. He had still wanted to take advantage of this opportunity to kill one or two Divine Beasts, but from the look of things now, that should not be possible.
"Old beasts, I’m not going to play with you guys anymore," he said with a smile. "However, the next time we meet, you guys will be my food. Remember to wash yourself clean!"
"Humph!" The Divine Beast Great Emperors all sneered, "A human that only knows how to boast!"
They increased the strength of their attacks, wanting to take down this only variable as soon as possible.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Weng! A majestic aura surged out.
Fifth tier!
This was equivalent to a Great Emperor at his prime, so how powerful was it?
Ling Han used his own body to control his weapon. Boom, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower paved the way, and he stuck close to it.
The Divine Beast Great Emperors hurriedly tried to stop him, giving it their all.

If they were facing an ordinary Great Emperor, so what if he possessed fifth tier battle prowess? There was no way he could face thirty-six Great Emperors with battle prowess at the sixth tier head-on. After all, he would only be made of flesh and blood.
However, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower wasn’t a normal Great Emperor. It was an Imperial Weapon, and it was a Transcendent Weapon that had fused with the Metal of Creation.
Thus, did the Imperial Weapon need to be wary of the attack of the Great Emperor?
There was absolutely no need for that!
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower unleashed an air of Primal Chaos to protect Ling Han, forcibly carving out a path of blood.
The Divine Beast Great Emperors all set off in hot pursuit, but aside from the True Phoenix Emperor, who else could catch up to Ling Han?
The problem was that the True Phoenix Emperor didn’t dare to get too close now, because Ling Han already possessed strength that could match him. In fact, Ling Han could even kill him!
However, he was still hanging behind Ling Han. Obviously, as long as Ling Han went to deal with the Lords of Death, he would gather the other Divine Beasts to gang up on Ling Han.
Ling Han’s strength had once again advanced further. However, in terms of speed, he did not have much improvement, and was unable to throw the True Phoenix Emperor off his tail.
’I can’t get rid of him?’
Then he would just kill him.
Ling Han ran for more than nine days before suddenly stopping. Then, he counterattacked the True Phoenix Emperor.
His counterattack had turned his defensive stance into an offensive one, yet the True Phoenix Emperor didn’t dare to face this attack head-on. He hurriedly retreated.
Ling Han aggressively charged over, brandishing his fists repeatedly, completely unleashing his battle prowess of sixth tier.
The True Phoenix Great Emperor had no intention of fighting Ling Han at all. He had already sent out a message, summoning the other Divine Beasts over.
This was a Great Emperor! Just how long would it take to travel from one end of the galaxy to the other?
Ling Han knew very well that he did not have much time left.
He unleashed his full power, throwing punch after punch. Destructive Energy and light of great dao all surged, causing the True Phoenix Emperor to dodge left and right. He was in a very sorry state.
Even the Lords of Death at their prime wouldn’t dare to touch such destructive power, let alone him.
Now was the time!
Ling Han suddenly channelled the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and instantly, a pillar of light blasted towards the True Phoenix Great Emperor.
Fourth tier!

This attack just happened to blast out after the True Phoenix Great Emperor had dodged Ling Han’s Destructive Energy and light of great dao attacks twice in a row. Even if the True Phoenix Great Emperor possessed extreme speed, he was still unable to change his course in time.
Previously, the reason why Ling Han had done so much work was to pave the way for this attack.
The True Phoenix Great Emperor couldn’t dodge, at least not completely.
Pu!
The column of light surged past, destroying half of the True Phoenix Emperor’s body.
Fourth tier versus sixth tier, that would really be a crushing advantage.
Right at this moment, Emperor Tier fluctuations traveled over from the distant galaxy.
The other Divine Beast Great Emperors were about to arrive.
How could Ling Han miss such an opportunity? With a battle cry, he charged towards the True Phoenix Emperor. No matter what, he had to deal with this greatest problem.
As long as he killed the True Phoenix Emperor, then even if he could be created again, it would be a very long time before he could regain his Emperor Tier battle prowess.
Thus, for a very long time, Ling Han wouldn’t have have to worry about anyone being able to match his speed.
’Die!’
Ling Han attacked aggressively, Emperor Tier power surging. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also shot out lightning continuously, pincer attacking the True Phoenix Emperor.
It should be known that the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was a Transcendent Weapon, and its attacks had reached the fifth tier, which was even more powerful than Ling Han himself.
If the True Phoenix Emperor hadn’t suffered such heavy injuries, with his extreme speed, he would have been able to calmly retreat even if he were no match for Ling Han.
But it was a different story now.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
He continued to sustain attacks, and more and more wounds appeared on the bloody side of his body.
Boom! One after another, colossal claws shot over. The Divine Beast Great Emperors all moved, wanting to stop Ling Han from killing the True Phoenix Great Emperor.
"Humph!" Ling Han used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to protect himself as he swung his fists repeatedly.
Today, the True Phoenix Emperor had to die!
"Ah, brat, when I revive, I’ll definitely tear you into pieces!" the True Phoenix Emperor released his final roar.
"Humph, you’ll only be eaten by me once more!" Ling Han said coldly. He punched the True Phoenix Emperor to death, then directly stowed the corpse away.
Let’s go.

chapters.title: Chapter 4839: Sealing the passageway of the two realms
paragraphs: Ling Han forcefully broke through the siege.
With the protection of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, which Divine Beast Great Emperor would be able to stop Ling Han?
They could only watch helplessly as he broke through the siege, leaving them behind in his dust as they disappeared into the universe
The 35 Divine Beasts all wore grim expressions.
The death of the True Phoenix did not cause them to feel the desolate grief of seeing one of their peers die in this manner. There was only darkness and indifference.
"This boy has succeeded, and it would be extremely difficult to stop him again."
"Damn it, we guarded the Primitive Abyss for so many years, yet still made a mistake."
"The Living Realm is about to collapse. At this time, no accidents can be allowed to happen."
"Come, let’s go and meet those twelve fools."
Multiple voices rang out, but it was as if they were the voices of a single person.
After Ling Han broke free from the Divine Beast Great Emperors, he released all the stars inside his body.

This had been in the Primitive Abyss for several hundred years, and he had been bearing so many stars every day. Even if Ling Han already possessed the strength of a Great Emperor, he was still under a lot of pressure.
Now that all the stars had been released, Ling Han instantly felt a strong sense of relief.
And at this time, every star welcomed a wave of breakthrough.

After being separated from this heaven and earth for a long time, once they came into contact again, it was as if the Regulations of heaven and earth had materialized, which naturally led to a widespread wave of breakthroughs.
Ling Han started to revive the stars again.

In truth, even if they killed all of the Lords of Death, it would still be impossible to stop the great conflict between the Living Realm and Netherworld. The only way was to revive the Living Realm, and push the Netherworld back to its original position.
On the other hand, as long as Ling Han was reviving stars, the Lords of Death definitely wouldn’t sit by and watch.
Moreover, he also had some kind of mark on him. This was also the reason why the Lords of Death wanted to kill him.
With Ling Han’s current strength, and added with the fact that he had grasped Regulations of Life, it was naturally a piece of cake for him to revive a planet.
As the suns burned brightly, the aura of the Netherworld was slowly dissipating.
Ling Han grasped the Regulations of heaven and earth, and continued to strengthen himself.
There were a total of nine Nine Star Regulations. Thus, the Great Emperor’s limit was grasping nine Regulations.

Ordinarily, a Great Emperor would be able to cultivate four to five Nine Star Regulations in his lifetime, and while the Lords of Death were presently neither human nor ghost, after living for so many years, they must have long since grasped nine Regulations. Once they fully awakened their battle prowess, they would be the strongest in the fifth tier.
Among those who could become Emperors, which one of them was not a prodigy of their generation?

However, he wasn’t the only one at this moment. After becoming Pseudo-Emperor, those like Ding Shu, Jing Haoran and the others could also revive stars, though their rate of efficiency was far inferior to Ling Han.

This time, Ling Han and the others only revived the suns to dispel the Yin Qi. Meanwhile, they didn’t move the planets to avoid attracting the combined attack of the Divine Beast Great Emperors and the Lords of Death.
There were a total of 47 Great Emperors, so how were they supposed to block this?
Meanwhile, Ling Han aimed at the Mountain Sea Heaven.
Though there were many connecting points between the Netherworld and Living Realm, there was no doubt that the Mountain Sea Heaven was the largest passageway.
Ling Han decided to close this passageway. If they didn’t block the source, no matter how much they did, they wouldn’t be able to eradicate the chaos caused by the Netherworld.

He had set up a formation on the planets to cut off Great Emperor Tier-level divine senses. Unless they appeared close enough, it was completely impossible to discover these planets with just a sweep of divine sense.
After doing all this, Ling Han set out towards the Mountain Sea Heaven. Ding Shu and the others continued to revive suns.
How fast was Ling Han’s current speed? The golden path spread out, and in an instant, he had arrived at the Mountain Sea Heaven Heaven.
This place was lifeless, and it was no different from the Netherworld.
The power of the Netherworld originated from this place, so the transformation into the Netherworld here was also the most complete.
"Big Rock." Ling Han snapped his fingers, and the rock golem tore off the rocks that formed itself and threw them towards Mountain Sea Heaven.
To this passageway of the two realms, even a colossal creature like the rock golem was still insufficient. It was extremely insignificant.

However, the rock golem’s body was made from the rocks of the Primitive Abyss. The weight of a single grain of sand was comparable to a star, so how terrifying was a single grain? What more when there were hundreds or thousands of them.
When the rock golem was almost done throwing, Ling Han shot out a punch and detonated these rocks.
Boom!
A terrifying explosion took place, and these huge rocks were all shattered, shooting out in all directions, causing a destructive blow to the Two Realm Passageway.
Ling Han stimulated these shattered particles to expand again, turning them into multiple stars that blocked this passageway.
He grasped the Regulations of heaven and earth, and went to sew up the remaining gaps in the Two Realm Passageway.
One after another, Yin souls released sharp cries, and pounced towards him.
"Destroy!" Ling Han said softly, but his words were immediately effective. With him at the centre, all the Yin souls in the galaxy were instantly turned into dust.
This was Imperial Might!
After three months, Ling Han finally blocked this passageway completely.
The power of heaven and earth had self-healing abilities. Thus, as long as it did not suffer any further damage, this passageway would ultimately close forever.
After doing all this, Ling Han returned.
Right now, there were 47 Great Emperors in the universe, so how could Ling Han leave with peace of mind?
Thankfully, everything was fine when he returned to the Four Origin Planet.
Ling Han decided to rest for a while and adjust his condition. Then, he would charge towards the level of Eight Star Pseudo-Emperor.
Peaceful days had not passed many days, when a sudden change took place.
A colossal star suddenly appeared out of nowhere, right next to the Four Origin Planet.
Ling Han sensed it at the first instant, and hurriedly moved, pushing this star to the side.
Yi, had this star come by bursting through the Void?
Stars could also traverse the Void?
Weng, right at this moment, a powerful aura actually seeped out of that great star, boiling like the tide.
Imperial Might!
Ling Han was surprised. There was actually a Pseudo-Emperor on this planet.
It was only an instant, and several figures flew out from that star, descending towards Four Origin Planet.

Ling Han swept an eye over them. There were a total of nine people, and they were led by a Saint. The other eight people were all very young, and there were both men and women. All of them had soaring pride.
"We are from the Mysterious Spirit Race. Who is in charge here? Hurry up and come out to meet me!" That Saint spoke up.
"Yo, what big talk!" The little azure dragon scoffed.
"Where did this little brat come from? He actually dares to act in front of us?" The large black dog rubbed his paws, "Just see Grandpa Dog subdue them."
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, and said, "Use civility before resorting to force. Lead them over."
"All right." The large black dog volunteered to take on this task.
Ling Han was very curious about this star that had suddenly appeared. Could it be that there were even more Emperor Tier-level forces in the universe?
It wasn’t long before the large black dog led nine people over.
However, Ling Han took another look, and saw that the faces of those nine people were all livid, their breathing heavy, and their footsteps slightly light.
Looks like they were really quite angered.

"So you’re the person in charge here?" Upon seeing Ling Han, a young man immediately chided. He was dressed in a tight-fitting green suit, and even in such a state, he was still as arrogant as before.
"Kneel!" the empress commanded coldly.
To dare to be rude to her man, in the eyes of the empress, this was the greatest sin.

After Ling Han broke free from the Divine Beast Great Emperors, he released all the stars inside his body.
This had been in the Primitive Abyss for several hundred years, and he had been bearing so many stars every day.
Even if Ling Han already possessed the strength of a Great Emperor, he was still under a lot of pressure.
Now that all the stars had been released, Ling Han instantly felt a strong sense of relief.
And at this time, every star welcomed a wave of breakthrough.

After being separated from this heaven and earth for a long time, once they came into contact again, it was as if the Regulations of heaven and earth had materialized, which naturally led to a widespread wave of breakthroughs.
Ling Han started to revive the stars again.
In truth, even if they killed all of the Lords of Death, it would still be impossible to stop the great conflict between the Living Realm and Netherworld.
The only way was to revive the Living Realm, and push the Netherworld back to its original position.
On the other hand, as long as Ling Han was reviving stars, the Lords of Death definitely wouldn’t sit by and watch.
Moreover, he also had some kind of mark on him.
This was also the reason why the Lords of Death wanted to kill him.
With Ling Han’s current strength, and added with the fact that he had grasped Regulations of Life, it was naturally a piece of cake for him to revive a planet.
As the suns burned brightly, the aura of the Netherworld was slowly dissipating.
Ling Han grasped the Regulations of heaven and earth, and continued to strengthen himself.
There were a total of nine Nine Star Regulations.
Thus, the Great Emperor’s limit was grasping nine Regulations.

Ordinarily, a Great Emperor would be able to cultivate four to five Nine Star Regulations in his lifetime, and while the Lords of Death were presently neither human nor ghost, after living for so many years, they must have long since grasped nine Regulations.
Once they fully awakened their battle prowess, they would be the strongest in the fifth tier.
Among those who could become Emperors, which one of them was not a prodigy of their generation?
However, he wasn’t the only one at this moment.
After becoming Pseudo-Emperor, those like Ding Shu, Jing Haoran and the others could also revive stars, though their rate of efficiency was far inferior to Ling Han.
This time, Ling Han and the others only revived the suns to dispel the Yin Qi.
Meanwhile, they didn’t move the planets to avoid attracting the combined attack of the Divine Beast Great Emperors and the Lords of Death.
There were a total of 47 Great Emperors, so how were they supposed to block this?
Meanwhile, Ling Han aimed at the Mountain Sea Heaven.
Though there were many connecting points between the Netherworld and Living Realm, there was no doubt that the Mountain Sea Heaven was the largest passageway.
Ling Han decided to close this passageway.
If they didn’t block the source, no matter how much they did, they wouldn’t be able to eradicate the chaos caused by the Netherworld.
He had set up a formation on the planets to cut off Great Emperor Tier-level divine senses.
Unless they appeared close enough, it was completely impossible to discover these planets with just a sweep of divine sense.
After doing all this, Ling Han set out towards the Mountain Sea Heaven.
Ding Shu and the others continued to revive suns.
How fast was Ling Han’s current speed?
The golden path spread out, and in an instant, he had arrived at the Mountain Sea Heaven Heaven.
This place was lifeless, and it was no different from the Netherworld.
The power of the Netherworld originated from this place, so the transformation into the Netherworld here was also the most complete.
"Big Rock." Ling Han snapped his fingers, and the rock golem tore off the rocks that formed itself and threw them towards Mountain Sea Heaven.
To this passageway of the two realms, even a colossal creature like the rock golem was still insufficient.
It was extremely insignificant.
However, the rock golem’s body was made from the rocks of the Primitive Abyss.
The weight of a single grain of sand was comparable to a star, so how terrifying was a single grain?
What more when there were hundreds or thousands of them.
When the rock golem was almost done throwing, Ling Han shot out a punch and detonated these rocks.
Boom!
A terrifying explosion took place, and these huge rocks were all shattered, shooting out in all directions, causing a destructive blow to the Two Realm Passageway.
Ling Han stimulated these shattered particles to expand again, turning them into multiple stars that blocked this passageway.
He grasped the Regulations of heaven and earth, and went to sew up the remaining gaps in the Two Realm Passageway.
One after another, Yin souls released sharp cries, and pounced towards him.
"Destroy!" Ling Han said softly, but his words were immediately effective.
With him at the centre, all the Yin souls in the galaxy were instantly turned into dust.
This was Imperial Might!
After three months, Ling Han finally blocked this passageway completely.
The power of heaven and earth had self-healing abilities.
Thus, as long as it did not suffer any further damage, this passageway would ultimately close forever.
After doing all this, Ling Han returned.
Right now, there were 47 Great Emperors in the universe, so how could Ling Han leave with peace of mind?
Thankfully, everything was fine when he returned to the Four Origin Planet.
Ling Han decided to rest for a while and adjust his condition.
Then, he would charge towards the level of Eight Star Pseudo-Emperor.
Peaceful days had not passed many days, when a sudden change took place.
A colossal star suddenly appeared out of nowhere, right next to the Four Origin Planet.
Ling Han sensed it at the first instant, and hurriedly moved, pushing this star to the side.
Yi, had this star come by bursting through the Void?
Stars could also traverse the Void?
Weng, right at this moment, a powerful aura actually seeped out of that great star, boiling like the tide.
Imperial Might!
Ling Han was surprised.
There was actually a Pseudo-Emperor on this planet.
It was only an instant, and several figures flew out from that star, descending towards Four Origin Planet.
Ling Han swept an eye over them.
There were a total of nine people, and they were led by a Saint.
The other eight people were all very young, and there were both men and women.
All of them had soaring pride.
"We are from the Mysterious Spirit Race.
Who is in charge here?
Hurry up and come out to meet me!" That Saint spoke up.
"Yo, what big talk!" The little azure dragon scoffed.
"Where did this little brat come from?
He actually dares to act in front of us?" The large black dog rubbed his paws, "Just see Grandpa Dog subdue them."
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, and said, "Use civility before resorting to force.
Lead them over."
"All right." The large black dog volunteered to take on this task.
Ling Han was very curious about this star that had suddenly appeared.
Could it be that there were even more Emperor Tier-level forces in the universe?
It wasn’t long before the large black dog led nine people over.
However, Ling Han took another look, and saw that the faces of those nine people were all livid, their breathing heavy, and their footsteps slightly light.
Looks like they were really quite angered.
"So you’re the person in charge here?" Upon seeing Ling Han, a young man immediately chided.
He was dressed in a tight-fitting green suit, and even in such a state, he was still as arrogant as before.
"Kneel!" the empress commanded coldly.
To dare to be rude to her man, in the eyes of the empress, this was the greatest sin.

chapters.title: Chapter 4840: Mysterious Spirit Planet
paragraphs: The man in green looked at the empress, and a hint of surprise involuntarily flashed across his eyes.
An exquisite beauty, unparalleled in the world... f***!
To his shock, he discovered that there was also an innocent-looking young girl beside the empress. She was also inconceivably beautiful.
However, the difference was that the first woman was noble in beauty, while this one was delicate and innocent, as pure as water.
He shifted his gaze again, and couldn’t help but feel shocked.
How could there be more! There was more!
There were a total of four exquisite beauties, each with their own unique traits, so he did not know which one he should stare at.
The other three women were naturally Hu Niu, Chi Menghan, and Song Lan.
Then, he came back to his senses, humphed, and said, "How dare you, to actually make me kneel! Do you know who I am?"
"Who knows who you are." On Hu Niu’s shoulder, the little red bird said, filled with disdain.
Showing off in front of Ling Han and his family, wasn’t that just asking for death?
The show-off king was sitting right there, and he didn’t even bother to consider his actions carefully.
The man in green was furious. What was going on?
All of them did not take him seriously at all?
"I am Pu Jingming of the Mysterious Spirit Race!" he called out loudly.
"Never heard of it." The large black dog spread out his paws.
"What remote corner of the universe have you guys popped out from?" The little azure dragon also waggled its tail.
Pu Jingming was in a towering rage, his hands clenched into fists. He was about to go crazy.
"Jingming, calm down!" That Saint from the other side spoke up, and clapped a hand on Pu Jingming’s shoulder, his expression gentle.
Though it was the Saint who had spoken, it seemed like Pu Jingming did not take that Saint seriously at all. He humphed, and turned his head away.

"I am Gong Yeliang." That Saint introduced himself, then continued, "Today, our Mysterious Spirit Race has appeared, and the whole universe will obey. As witnesses of the emergence of our Mysterious Spirit Race, we allow you to join us."
Yi?
The large black dog couldn’t help but sneer, and said, "Old geezer, where do you get such confidence from?"
Gong Yeliang looked at the large black dog, and couldn’t help but feel a surge of anger.
This was a despicable dog!
Just the time they had spent on their way here just now, he was almost angered to the point of making a move.

If it was not for the fact that this was the first appearance of the Mysterious Spirit Race, and they did not wish for blood to be spilled, he would definitely make this despicable dog shut up forever.
"Our Mysterious Spirit Race has a Pseudo-Emperor standing guard, and he will attain Dao in this lifetime!" Gong Yeliang declared proudly.
Pseudo-Emperor had the word ’Emperor’, and that was the strongest existence in this universe.
Only one Great Emperor could appear in each era, and in the case of Pseudo-Emperors, there similarly could not be many.
Thus, Gong Yeliang had every reason to be arrogant, and it was no wonder that this group of people was so arrogant.
However, these nine people shockingly discovered that none of Ling Han and the others looked shocked.
F***, he had already mentioned a Pseudo-Emperor, and his original intention was to scare them. Who would have thought that it would be him that was shocked instead.
’Are you... all idiots?’
That’s right. This was nothing than a tiny, remote planet. Being able to produce a Sect Master was already impressive enough, so how could they possibly know the might of Pseudo-Emperor?
Thinking of this, the nine of them became even more arrogant, and looked down on the natives here even more.
Coming out of the Void and arriving at this small place was really unlucky. This was practically lowering their own status.
Gong Yeliang waved his sleeve, and said, "I have to go back and report to the Lord Pseudo-Emperor. I’ll leave this place to you."
How could he lower himself to personally deal with such desolate commoners?
"However, you definitely have to kill that despicable dog," he added, and then left.
This!
The large black dog wore a gloomy expression. Why was he targeting him?
Did I offend you?
’Is it my fault that I’m handsome?’
Pu Jingming humphed, and said, "Mortals, kneel down immediately!"
Boom, he released his own aura, which was shockingly Venerate Tier-level.
Before Ling Han and the many children of Great Emperors had appeared, he had already become a Venerate Tier when he was only a few thousand years old. He was indeed freakishly powerful.
However, there were dozens of Great Emperors in the universe now, so what was a mere Venerate Tier cultivator worth?
Yi?
Pu Jingming was surprised. Not one of these people was affected by his aura.
How was this possible?
They were merely vulgar people!
"Hehe, even our pet pig more powerful than you," Hu Niu said with a snicker, appearing very naive and innocent.
Seeing this, Pu Jingming couldn’t help but feel his heart flutter. Then, he humphed. This little girl actually compared him to a pig, and thought that he was no match for a pig!
"What a country bumpkin. After I take you in, I will definitely teach you proper etiquette!" he said with slight disdain.
"Stupid pig, kill him for Niu!" Hu Niu was furious. He actually dared to covet her? Didn’t he know that she was Ling Han’s Niu?
Shua, with a wave of her hand, she threw the perverted pig out.
The pervert pig let out an innocent scream.
What did it have to do with it? Why did it have to be thrown out, b@stard?
This was really getting shot while lying down.
Seeing a pig being tossed over, Pu Jingming instantly moved instinctively, and delivered a palm strike at the perverted pig.
He smirked coldly in his mind. ’What a poor little girl! She’s actually trying to stop me with a pig!’
But right at this moment, the pervert pig moved. Pa, a hoof smashed over.
W-what!
Pu Jingming immediately paled in shock. This was Venerate Tier-level power, and a nine-star one at that.
And as for him?
Two-star Venerable Tier.
Although they were both Venerate Tiers, just how far was the gap between two stars and nine stars?
There were a whopping seven minor levels of difference. Just how overwhelming was this?
Peng!
It was only a single strike, and Pu Jingming was sent flying.
"If this old pig doesn’t show its might, you’ll think I’m a sick cat!" The perverted pig howled, and chased after Pu Jingming, its hooves striking endlessly.

A nine-star Venerate Tier was beating up a two-star Venerate Tier, so it was naturally like a father beating his son. How could Pu Jingming resist? He was pressed and pummeled into the ground endlessly.
Did he think that everyone was Ling Han, someone who could battle above his cultivation level?
The eyes of the seven people from Mysterious Spirit Planet were glazed over, as if they were dead fish.
Was this really a backward small star?
Why was it that any random pig that came out had the strength of a Venerate Tier, and could easily push Pu Jingming onto the ground and pummel him?
If this was a small star, then what was their Mysterious Spirit Planet worth?
What was going on?
How was this possible?
Just what kind of iron plate had they kicked?

"Stop!" After a long while, someone stepped out, and said in a trembling voice, "Young Master Pu is the most beloved grandson of Lord Pseudo-Emperor. If you hurt him, Lord Pseudo-Emperor will definitely fly into a thunderous rage!"
"Grandpa Pig is also the beloved grandson of the Canopy Demon King. In terms of background, would Grandpa Pig be afraid?" the perverted pig cried out.

The people from the Mysterious Spirit Planet were all in disbelief. How was this possible? Any random pig was the descendant of the Canopy Demon Emperor, so could this four-legged snake be the descendant of the Flying Snake? Was the monkey that was running over the descendant of the Battle Saint Emperor?
Peng, peng, peng! The pervert pig pummeled Pu Jingming.
"What’s going on?" Brother Monkey had just arrived and asked Ling Han.
"I’m not sure yet, but I’ll find out after asking around," Ling Han said with a smile.
Brother Monkey nodded, and looked towards the seven people from the Mysterious Spirit Planet. The aura of a Saint fluctuated slightly, "Where have you all come from?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4841: Who’s a country bumpkin?
paragraphs: Pa, pa, pa, pa! Pu Jingming and the others all collapsed to the ground.
They all wore expressions of shock and disbelief.
Saint!
This monkey was actually a Saint.
Er, though they had been complaining previously, a Saint Tier monkey was really qualified to be the descendant of the Battle Saint Empero.
But this was a remote and desolate place, located at the edge of the universe. How could a Saint suddenly appear here?
It should be known that these people didn’t even know what a Pseudo-Emperor was.
Strange!
However, they immediately recalled that there was a Pseudo-Emperor standing behind them.
With the word ’Emperor’, wouldn’t that Saint be like an ant?
With this in mind, they were filled with confidence.

"No wonder you dare to be so arrogant. As it turned out, there is a Saint standing guard here," Pu Jingming declared proudly. Previously, he did not have much respect for their own Saint, what more when it was other Saints.
"However, my ancestor is a Pseudo-Emperor!" he said loudly, "You dare to disrespect a Pseudo-Emperor?"
Brother Monkey couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. He turned to Ling Han and asked, "How can there be such a person who doesn’t know what’s good for him?"
Ling Han shrugged and said, "I suspect that they’ve always been living in seclusion, so their news is already seriously out-of date."

Otherwise, who didn’t know that Ling Han was already able to defeat Pseudo-Emperors when he was still a Saint, and after breaking through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, he was even able to slaughter Great Emperors at the sixth tier!
In front of this kind of battle prowess, even Pseudo-Emperor would shiver.
Seeing Brother Monkey and Ling Han talking cheerfully and without any intention of paying any attention to him, Pu Jingming couldn’t help but be enraged. He shouted, "I was talking to you guys!"

He was the descendant of a Pseudo-Emperor, and this Pseudo-Emperor was presently in his prime. Not only had he suppressed this area for a considerable number of years, there was even a chance that he could advance further, and remove the word "Pseudo" from his title, becoming a genuine Great Emperor that would rule the universe.
Thus, he naturally had a reason for his pride.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "At first, I wanted to spare your life. However, you spoke rudely, and your thoughts are filthy. You’re truly seeking death."
He stretched out a hand, and tapped lightly. Pa, Pu Jingming instantly exploded, turning into a shower of blood.
The remaining seven people were drenched in blood. Their eyes were wide with fear, and even their hands and feet were trembling.
That was a descendant of a Pseudo-Emperor, yet he was killed just like that.
’Are these people maniacs?’
Oh no! Were they going to die as well?
These seven people were all scared to death. Two of the more cowardly ones even fainted in reality.
However, there were also some braver people who secretly sent out a communication signal to summon Gong Yeliang over.
Something big had happened, something big had happened.
Pu Jingming was Lord Pseudo-Emperor’s favorite descendant, yet he was now lying dead here. Once the Pseudo-Emperor knew about this, would Lord Pseudo-Emperor kill them as well in his fury?
When a Pseudo-Empero was angered, corpses would cover 500km.

"You’ve... gotten into big trouble!" one of them said bitterly. "Young Master Pu is Lord Pseudo-Emperor’s most beloved descendant. Now that he’s dead, the Pseudo-Emperor will definitely fly into a thunderous rage. Not only will you guys die, but we might even die with him."
The seven of them shook their heads, looking like they had nothing left to live for.
"Hey, hey, hey. Which desolate place have you guys come from?" The large black dog couldn’t help but ask, "How could it be that you guys haven’t heard of Little Han’s mighty name?"

"You people are the country bumpkins!" the seven people retorted. "You have no idea how powerful a Pseudo-Emperor is, that is the strongest person besides a Great Emperor! And a single Great Emperor can only appear in a whole era, reigning supreme over the universe with strength that could not be described!"
"Our Lord Pseudo-Emperor is only one step away from achieving Dao!"
Oh, then that would be a Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor.

Ling Han and the others all smiled faintly. They really didn’t care. To say nothing of that person being only a Pseudo-Emperor, even if he had broken through, he would only have sixth tier battle prowess at most. He would have to cultivate several Nine Star Regulations to be able to reach fifth tier battle prowess.
Meanwhile, Ling Han’s battle prowess was currently at the sixth tier, while the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was at the fifth tier. Once it burst out in power... so, hoho.
The large black dog was in high spirits. He wanted to clarify with these people who were the country bumpkins here.

In the argument between the large black dog and the people from the Mysterious Spirit Planet, Ling Han and the others also found out that the Mysterious Spirit Planet had been sent into the Void by that Pseudo-Emperor from a very, very long time ago, and lived isolated from the rest of the universe.
That Pseudo-Emperor had been in a deep slumber all this while, and only appeared recently, pushing the Mysterious Spirit Planet into the great world, intending to attain Dao in the present era.
Ling Han’s interest was piqued, and he wanted to meet this Pseudo-Emperor.
Weng, a powerful saintly might spread out, and Gong Yeliang reappeared.
His eyes swept over them, and couldn’t help but look surprised, "Where’s Pu Jingming?"
This was Lord Pseudo-Emperor’s most beloved descendant.
"He’s, he’s dead," the seven people from the Mysterious Spirit Planet hurriedly replied, as if they had found their savior.
Just kill them!

Debating with the large black dog was too maddening. It was practically enough to make one want to die. That guy’s reasoning was completely twisted. He would first pull them into the lowest level, and then use his abundant experience to defeat them.
This was a comprehensive ravaging from the body to the heart.
Thus, even if they were to be killed, they would still be happy that they could die quickly.
Gong Yeliang looked towards Ling Han and the others, his eyes cold, as if these people were already dead.
"Do you all know just how great a crime you have committed?"
"Oh, what crime?" the large black dog asked with a smile. He was naturally unconcerned.
"Death penalty!" Gong Ye Liang raised his voice, and boom, it was instantly like the rumble of thunder.
Boom, the soundwave swept past, visible to the naked eye, like a tsunami wave.
He was truly enraged. When this soundwave surged out, it would at least cause half of the living beings on Four Origin Planet to be killed.
This was the might of a Saint!
With a casual swipe of Ling Han’s hand, a terrifying scene appeared. These sound waves actually stopped.
My, my goodness!
Gong Yeliang’s eyes almost popped out of his head in shock. Even though he had only said this casually, just how powerful was a Saint? The might of his shout was earth-shattering.
And what about the other?
With a light press of his palm, his attack was frozen in place.
Note that it was freezing and not dispersing. The two were completely different. The former was undoubtedly ten times more difficult than the latter, or even a hundred times more difficult.
Heavens! This was also a Saint? Moreover, it was a high-level Saint?
"Old geezer, didn’t you say you wanted to kill Grandpa Dog?" The large black dog jumped out, "Come, Grandpa Dog will play with you!"
Boom!
The large black dog attacked without any reservations, unleashing his full battle prowess.
Have you f****** gone mad?

He was so crazy even on his own planet?

Since when had Saints become so cheap? Even a mere despicable dog could attain that level?
Boom!

Saint-level battle prowess turned into waves that rolled out in all directions.

Pu Jingming and the others all collapsed to the ground.
They all wore expressions of shock and disbelief.
Saint!
This monkey was actually a Saint.
Er, though they had been complaining previously, a Saint Tier monkey was really qualified to be the descendant of the Battle Saint Empero.
But this was a remote and desolate place, located at the edge of the universe.
How could a Saint suddenly appear here?
It should be known that these people didn’t even know what a Pseudo-Emperor was.
Strange!
However, they immediately recalled that there was a Pseudo-Emperor standing behind them.
With the word ’Emperor’, wouldn’t that Saint be like an ant?
With this in mind, they were filled with confidence.
"No wonder you dare to be so arrogant.
As it turned out, there is a Saint standing guard here," Pu Jingming declared proudly.
Previously, he did not have much respect for their own Saint, what more when it was other Saints.
"However, my ancestor is a Pseudo-Emperor!" he said loudly, "You dare to disrespect a Pseudo-Emperor?"
Brother Monkey couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself.
He turned to Ling Han and asked, "How can there be such a person who doesn’t know what’s good for him?"
Ling Han shrugged and said, "I suspect that they’ve always been living in seclusion, so their news is already seriously out-of date."

Otherwise, who didn’t know that Ling Han was already able to defeat Pseudo-Emperors when he was still a Saint, and after breaking through to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, he was even able to slaughter Great Emperors at the sixth tier!
In front of this kind of battle prowess, even Pseudo-Emperor would shiver.
Seeing Brother Monkey and Ling Han talking cheerfully and without any intention of paying any attention to him, Pu Jingming couldn’t help but be enraged.

He was the descendant of a Pseudo-Emperor, and this Pseudo-Emperor was presently in his prime.

Not only had he suppressed this area for a considerable number of years, there was even a chance that he could advance further, and remove the word "Pseudo" from his title, becoming a genuine Great Emperor that would rule the universe.

You’re truly seeking death."

Were they going to die as well?
These seven people were all scared to death.
Two of the more cowardly ones even fainted in reality.

Something big had happened, something big had happened.
Pu Jingming was Lord Pseudo-Emperor’s favorite descendant, yet he was now lying dead here.
Once the Pseudo-Emperor knew about this, would Lord Pseudo-Emperor kill them as well in his fury?
When a Pseudo-Empero was angered, corpses would cover 500km.

Now that he’s dead, the Pseudo-Emperor will definitely fly into a thunderous rage.

And a single Great Emperor can only appear in a whole era, reigning supreme over the universe with strength that could not be described!"
"Our Lord Pseudo-Emperor is only one step away from achieving Dao!"

Once it burst out in power... so, hoho.

chapters.title: Chapter 4842: Pseudo-Emperor Pu Jingtian
paragraphs: After fighting for a while, Gong Yeliang couldn’t help but find it strange.
When Saints battled, the shockwaves would be able to easily destroy a star.
But he had already exchanged close to a hundred moves with that Despicable Saint, so why had this star still not exploded?
Amidst his busy schedule, he took the time to take a look.
The large black dog was exerting far too much pressure on him, so he didn’t have any spare time at all. However, he was still extremely curious at this moment.
What he saw almost scared him out of his wits.

That was because he had seen that Ling Han had only raised his hand and pressed down, and the shockwaves created by his exchange with the large black dog had been limited to a single area, and could not spread out at all.
This... this was too strong, wasn’t it?

He was about to go crazy. The Mysterious Spirit Planet had been in seclusion for millions and millions of years, and had just appeared today. It was just about to prove its Dao in the world, and become the strongest force in the world. Why had they encountered such a group of monsters?
He was panicking.

"Old geezer, didn’t you want to kill Grandpa Dog? Come on, come on!" the large black dog said despicably. Then, he turned around and faced Gong Yeliang with his behind, "Look at Grandpa Dog’s ultimate move, I’ll blind you!"
A ray of light immediately shot out from Iron underwear, indescribably dazzling.
It should be known that this was a Saintly Material, and the large black dog was a Saint, so it naturally could forge a Saint Tool.
In the first place, Saintly Material possessed powerful defenses. Thus, the large black dog only needed to forge its offensive attributes.
And because of the despicable nature of the large black dog, the only function of this Saint Tool was to emit light.
Ordinary light naturally would not have much effect on a Saint. However, it was completely different if this function was forged from Saintly Material, and forged into a Saint Tool.
Even Saints would be dazzled by such brilliance!
"Ah!" Gong Yeliang released a cry, and then rapidly retreated.
’Motherf*cker!’
Tears were streaming down his face. It wasn’t because he was in pain or grief, but simply because he felt terrible from being illuminated by the light.
—To be able to illuminate a Saint to the point of tears, it was clear just how blinding this light was.
Gong Yeliang was both angered and speechless. Such a good Saintly Material was actually used to forge such a function in your hands!
Just how wasteful was this?
Just how bored are you?
That’s right. He had indeed shed tears, but it did not have much effect on his battle prowess.
Have you ever seen a Saint’s battle prowess drop drastically just because he was crying?
There was none!
Thus, the fact that this Saint Tool had been deliberately forged, illuminating others to the point of tearing up, was completely aiming to disgust others.
"Despicable, despicable dog!" Gong Yeliang trembled in fury. Such a Saint? Pei!
The large black dog laughed loudly, "As expected of Grandpa Dog, forging the strongest Saint Tool in the world!"
It continued to sway its behind. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Multiple streaks of blinding light shot out.
Could there be a second person in this world that had such a battle style?
Even Ling Han and the others couldn’t bear to look at it. They felt as if their worldview had been dragged down another level.
Ling Han couldn’t help but think. Previously, he had asked the large black dog about how far it could lower its bottom line.
This was Old Black’s answer!

Ling Han placed a hand on his forehead. On the path of despicableness, the large black dog had already left them in the dust. No one could catch up to him, and there was no sign of him turning back at all.
On the other side, Gong Yeliang was also about to throw up blood.

Though he was a Three Star Saint, he was still considerably inferior to the large black dog. Furthermore, he was now so infuriated that he had lost his sense of propriety. His battle prowess had naturally been weakened further, and it was even more impossible that he would be a match for the large black dog.

"Despicable, despicable dog, this Saint is going to kill you, kill you!" His fury surged, and finally, he could no longer bear it. Pu, he spluttered out a mouthful of blood, and directly collapsed to the ground, facing upwards.

The large black dog stopped attacking, and he raised his head to look at the sky. His head was at a 45-degree angle, and his paws were clasped behind his back. There was a desolate expression on his face, and he said, "Who else could infuriate a Saint to the point of vomiting blood and passing out? Counting the heroes of the past and present, who else could it be but Grandpa Dog?"
This... was too shameless!
However, upon further thought, only the large black dog had managed to incite a Saint to the point of vomiting blood and fainting.
"You’re despicable enough!" Ling Han said sincerely.
He was almost omnipotent, but in this aspect, he was indeed admitting defeat.
"Despicable Saint, true to his name." The little azure dragon also sighed in admiration.
"Ang." The pervert pig also nodded.
"In future, you should stay away from Old Sun." The corners of Brother Monkey’s mouth also twitched, as if he was very wary of the large black dog.
Being able to make the fearless line of the Battle Saint shiver in fear, Old Black really had not lived this life for nothing.
The large black dog shook his head sheepishly. Why did everyone in the world not understand him?
It should be known that it was easy to be despicable for one moment, but difficult to be despicable for a whole lifetime.
Was it easy?
The seven people from Mysterious Spirit Planet all felt their hands and feet go cold. They could not believe their eyes at all.
Their Saint... had actually been killed!
No, no, no, no, he hadn’t died. However, if the large black dog followed up with another strike, it was guaranteed that Gong Yeliang would immediately die.
Thus, the large black dog was completely capable of killing Gong Yeliang.
It should be known that that monkey was also a Saint.
There were actually two Saints standing guard on a small planet in a remote and desolate place.
This, this, this, this, if it wasn’t for the fact that they still had Lord Pseudo-Emperor, they would really be country bumpkins.
Weng, right at this moment, a terrifying aura swept out.
Instantly, Gong Yeliang was startled awake.
"Lord!" He half-knelt, feeling ashamed and unable to show his face.
"It is not your fault. You may rise." A voice filled with authority rang out.
"Thank you, Lord!" Gong Yeliang’s expression was filled with gratitude.
"Lord!" The other seven people from Mysterious Spirit Planet also wore fanatical expressions.
It didn’t matter. Even if you have ten Saints, so what? They have a Pseudo-Emperor.
With the word ’Emperor’, he could insta-kill all Saints.
A golden pathway stretched over from the planet in the distance. Then, a man in a golden embroidered robes stood proudly, appearing in front of everyone.
He looked to be in his thirties, tall and sturdy, exuding an indescribably majestic aura.
Pseudo-Emperor, Pu Jingtian.
He stood, arms crossed behind his back. As his eyes swept over them, it was as if he could look directly into the hearts of others. There was no secret that could be concealed.
"Who killed my descendant?" he asked calmly. It was clearly a very casual question, yet it seemed like a supreme decree, making one want to kneel down and answer.
However, who were the people on the Four Origin Planet?
How many Pseudo-Emperors have they seen?
Moreover, Ling Han possessed the battle prowess of a Great Emperor.
Thus, none of them showed any reaction to Pu Jingtian’s aura, and had no interest to pay him any attention.
This!
A Pseudo-Emperor had spoken, and was actually completely ignored?
The seven people from the Mysterious Spirit Planet were all furious, "How dare you all, to actually dare show disrespect to our Lord!"
"You should be executed!"
"Being torn into ten thousand pieces, and having your whole clan executed would not be enough to offset your crime!"
Meanwhile, Pu Jingtian raised his hand, and instantly, those seven people fell silent.
His eyes focused on Ling Han. Instinct told him that this was everyone’s center.
"Who are you?" he asked.
Ling Han shook his head, and said with a smile, "This is the best era, and also the worst era."
’F*ck! You are not answering my question!’
Pu Jingtian stared at Ling Han, and after a long while, he finally asked solemnly, "A Pseudo-Emperor?"
F***, even with his calm temperament, he couldn’t help but complain.

chapters.title: Chapter 4843: Shaking hands and making peace
paragraphs: Pseudo-Emperors were rare, and definitely would not outnumber Great Emperors by much.
Only one Great Emperor could appear in each era, but how many Pseudo-Emperors could appear in each era?
However, the moment Pu Jingtian appeared in this universe, he actually encountered another Pseudo-Emperor. How could he not be shocked?
Ling Han smiled faintly, "That’s right."
At his current height, was there any need for him to hide his cultivation level?
En, aside from when he was showing off.
What!
The seven people from Mysterious Spirit Planet were all numb with shock, and there was a strong sense of disbelief in them.
They had just appeared in this universe, and on the first planet they saw, they actually encountered a Pseudo-Emperor?
Yi, when did Pseudo-Emperors become so common?
Pu Jingtian took a deep breath, "Battle?"
"Sure," Ling Han said with a smile. Those who could become Pseudo-Emperors were definitely proud people. Hence, he first had to beat the other into submission.
It was just a matter of spending a little effort.
Xiu, xiu! The two of them stepped out at the same time, and stepped into space.

The large black dog and the others hurriedly followed. If it was a Pseudo-Emperor-level battle, they naturally wanted to watch, though it was definite that it would be Pu Jingtian one-sidedly being pummelled.
Gong Yeliang hurriedly followed behind. Meanwhile, he was filled with confidence in Pu Jingtian. Even if Ling Han was a Pseudo-Emperor, the victor would definitely be Pu Jingtian.
In the distant galaxy, Ling Han and Pu Jingtian stood 50 kilometers away from each other.
For elites like them, a distance of 50km was actually just a matter of lifting a foot.

"Only one Great Emperor is allowed to emerge in an era," Pu Jingtian stated calmly, "Thus, allowing me to meet you here is also the arrangement of the heaven and earth, to see which of us would be more qualified to become Emperor."
"Come on." Ling Han crooked a finger at him.

There was something that he did not say. If he went through the normal channels, there would indeed only be one Great Emperor in an era, but he could go through the unusual channels, and go to the Primitive Abyss to prove his Dao.
Thus... there was actually no conflict between them, so they could not be considered competitors.
However, only Ling Han and Ling Han could travel to the Imperial Island as Pseudo-Emperor, and even bring others with him. Otherwise, even the Great Emperor could not accomplish this!
Only Ling Han could open this back door.
—If it was Ding Shu and the others, they could indeed bring others to the Imperial Island, but the prerequisite was that they had to become Emperors first.
Hence, it was back to square one.
Pu Jingtian showed a hint of displeasure. He was a Pseudo-Emperor, and even against a real Great Emperor, there was no need for him to be humble.
’You’re playing it down so easily?’
’Fine, I’ll show you my strength first, and you’ll know what kind of attitude you should use to deal with me.’

Boom, this palm was earth-shattering, as if it had covered half the galaxy.
Ling Han casually snapped his fingers. Pa! His palm shattered into pieces.
Sixth tier battle prowess wasn’t just empty boasting!

This formed a qualitative change.
It could crush all Saints!

This person was a Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor, and the Nine Star Regulations that he had grasped... had practically reached the complete state.
Thus, this person was truly only a single step away from becoming a Great Emperor.

As long as the heaven and earth blessed him, and allowed him to come into contact with the Nine Star Regulations a few more times, he would be able to cross over the final threshold, and attain Dao in the present era!
However, in front of Ling Han, this was completely inadequate.
Ling Han casually waved his hand, and the God Tool that slashed over was easily shattered.

He naturally knew how powerful Pu Jingtian was, but such a powerful existence was actually unable to suppress Ling Han.
Hiss, could it be that this could also be a Pseudo-Emperor that was about to attain Dao?
Meanwhile, the large black dog shook his head, "Sigh, Little Han is showing off again."
"A dog can’t change its habit of eating sh*t!" The little azure dragon was also disdainful.
Otherwise, Ling Han would have been able to suppress Pu Jingtian with a single move.
"Four-Legged Snake, who are you insulting!" The large black dog was displeased. What did he mean by a dog can’t change its habit of eating sh*t?
Have you seen Grandpa Dog eat sh*t before?
"The insult is for whoever answers." The little azure dragon wasn’t afraid either.
The two of them immediately looked at each other with bloodshot eyes.
In the distance, Pu Jingtian continuously channelled powerful moves, pouring out a storm of attacks towards Ling Han.

Yet Ling Han only casually flicked his hand and waved his palm, as if he was not facing a Pseudo-Emperor, but was just some random person who could not be anymore ordinary, and there was absolutely no need for him to go all out.

As a Pseudo-Emperor, Pu Jingtian’s willpower was naturally tenacious, and definitely could not shake his fighting spirit. However, faced with an opponent like Ling Han, he felt an indescribable chill rise up in him.
How could he be so powerful?
They were both Pseudo-Emperors, and he was a Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor at that. He had walked to the end of the level of Pseudo-Emperor, so why was he still unable to suppress Ling Han?
The feeling that Ling Han gave him was only one word: unfathomable.
After several hundred more exchanges, Pu Jingtian finally stopped in disappointment.
"Yi, why have you stopped fighting?" Ling Han asked in surprise.
’You did it on purpose, didn’t you?’
Pu Jingtian sighed, "I cannot defeat you."
However, as a Pseudo-Emperor, he was also incredibly proud.
’I can’t defeat you, but I won’t lose either.’
Ling Han smiled, not bothering to argue with him at all.
He was a mighty sixth tier battle prowess elite, so what need was there for him to lower himself to the level of a Pseudo-Emperor?
This was demeaning!
"Come, let’s exchange information," Ling Han said.
Pu Jingtian thought for a moment, "All right."
His story was relatively simple.
Several hundred million years ago, he had already advanced into the level of Pseudo-Emperor. In fact, he had even charged all the way to nine stars, and was invincible in this world!
However, the Great Emperor of that era had just died, and the heaven and earth still did not allow the birth of a new Great Emperor.
Pu Jingtian was dissatisfied. He had travelled the world, and had coincidentally obtained the Primordial Source Clay and a mysterious stone slab. He had foreseen a little bit of the future.

Thus, he pushed the entire Mysterious Spirit Planet into the Void, and used the power of a Pseudo-Emperor to protect it. Then, he used the Primordial Source Clay to seal himself, and only appeared not too long ago.
Ling Han wanted to take a look at this stone slab, but was told by Pu Jingtian that the stone slab had already turned into dust.
He could only give up.
And when Pu Jingtian found out about the present situation from Ling Han, he was also stunned for a moment.
What was going on here? There were actually 47 Great Emperors in the current era?
Furthermore, it was highly possible that it would very soon become forty-eight.
Since when did Great Emperors appear by the batches?
However, a Pseudo-Emperor was a Pseudo-Emperor, and after a slight shock, he immediately strengthened his resolve.
If he became Emperor, he would definitely sweep aside all evil and restore order.
Ling Han nodded internally. As expected, those who could become Pseudo-Emperors had no lack of intelligence and decisiveness.

The two Pseudo-Emperors had already shook hands and made peace, so the others naturally dared not have any objections. However, the people of the Mysterious Spirit Planet still had some resentment about Four Origin Planet.
After all, Pu Jingming had died in Ling Han’s hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 4844: Taking the initiative to attack
paragraphs: Pu Jingming had been killed by a Pseudo-Emperor. Hence, even Pu Jingtian had not sought Ling Han out for an accounting, so naturally, no one dared to say anything.
However, in their daily interactions, the people of the Mysterious Spirit Planet all clearly revealed animosity, and deliberately distanced themselves from the people of Four Origin Planet.
It was inevitable that both sides would be boasting.

The people of Mysterious Spirit Planet said that in Pu Jingtian’s era, he was invincible in the world. If it was not for the fact that he was born at the wrong time, he would have long since become a Great Emperor that had suppressed an era.

And those from the Four Origin Planet scoffed. Their Lord Ling Han was still a Pseudo-Emperor, yet he could already match a Great Emperor. Even if your Pseudo-Emperor had really attained Dao, it would only be a tie.
This was naturally mocked by the people of the Mysterious Spirit Planet. What kind of joke was this? A Pseudo-Emperor could match a Great Emperor?
You’ve read too many novels.

The people of Mysterious Spirit Planet had a very good reason to be proud, because the heaven and earth was about to allow a Great Emperor to attain Dao, and Pu Jingtian had long since cultivated to become a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor. Thus, he undoubtedly grasped the initiative, and stood at the forefront.

As long as the heaven and earth allowed it, Pu Jingtian would be able to attain Dao and become a Great Emperor. Then, all the other mediocre cultivators, such as Pseudo-Emperors, would only be able to bow down in front of him.

"Little Han, are we really going to just let them be?" The large black dog pointed at the galaxy from afar, and that was where the Mysterious Spirit Planet was located, "That Jingtian or whatever is clearly just temporarily holding back. Once he becomes Emperor, I’m afraid that the first one to be dealt with would be you."
This was an Imperial Might, so who dared to provoke it?
Thus, now that Pu Jingtian’s most beloved descendant had died, how could it be that he would sit by and watch the murderer jump around in front of him?
He had not turned hostile now, because he had no chance of winning.
Moreover, they were both Pseudo-Emperors. If one was determined to flee, how coudl the other stop him?
Thus, even if Pu Jingtian was filled with killing intent towards Ling Han, he could only endure it for now.
When he became a Great Emperor, he would be able to sweep aside all opposition in the world. What enemy could he not kill?

Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, "Those who can become Emperor should know which should be the priority between personal enmity and the calamity of the world. Thus, if he discovers that he’s no match for me, he’ll still obediently target the external enemy."

Otherwise, even though he had become a Great Emperor, there was already no one in this world that he could rule over. In that case, what difference did it make whether he was the strongest or the weakest?
The lofty status of a Great Emperor was only proven when the weak existed.

"Little Han, you’re still too soft-hearted. Otherwise, if it were Grandpa Dog, I’d kill him first. In any case, this kind of person won’t be of much help in the end," the large black dog said with pursed lips.
Becoming Emperor was difficult, and if one wanted to grow to the level of opposing the old Divine Beast, that would be even more difficult.

There was already not much time left. Thus, if he wanted to wait until Pu Jingtian had succeeded Dao and become Emperor, and further advanced into the third tier, the battle prowess of the second tier was even further out of reach. In fact, it was something that he would never be able to realize.

Just look at the Battle Saint Emperor and the others. Just how long had they stayed in the Primitive Abyss? However, the strongest had only advanced into the fourth tier, and there was no hope for them to even advance into the third tier. Thus, with so many Great Emperors joining forces, they would only be suppressed and beaten by the old Divine Beast.
The only thing that the Great Emperors could do was delay the old Divine Beast for a while.
Thus, even if Pu Jingtian could become Emperor, the help he could bring would still be limited.
After all, he wasn’t such a freakish being, also having the ability to challenge those above his cultivation level even among Great Emperor.

Ling Han smiled. Standing at his current height, he would no longer fuss over such trivial matters. Most importantly, he had not lost out on this matter, and his abilities were completely superior. Thus, he was naturally detached from the rest.
The danger of destruction could arrive at any time, so everyone made the most of their time to cultivate.
Perhaps, just a little bit stronger, and he would be able to survive this most dangerous tribulation.
The people on the Mysterious Spirit Planet were still relatively polite toward the cultivators from the Four Origin Planet. However, they appeared extremely proud before the other Imperial Clans.
My family has a Pseudo-Emperor, whereas you guys are merely depending on the fact that you have an Imperial Weapon. This was a completely different concept.
—In the past, when the Buddha Doga appeared, which member of the Imperial Clan would not shiver in fear? Even if a Saint died, would they dare to make a peep at the Buddha Doga?
Thus, even if the Pseudo-Emperor couldn’t face the Imperial Weapon head-on, he was still superior to the Imperial Clans.
This rendered those Imperial Clans speechless. They had been tyrannical for so long, and now, they were actually being bullied!
They brought up Ling Han, and said that Ling Han had long since possessed the battle prowess of a Great Emperor. Pu Jingtian was nothing at all.
In the eyes of the people from the Mysterious Spirit Planet, this was naturally nonsense.
If a Pseudo-Emperor had the battle prowess of a Great Emperor, then what would be left of the order of martial arts?
Even if they were bragging, they couldn’t be so extravagant.
Why are you all like this?
With this kind of concept, no matter who later boasted about Ling Han’s battle merits, the people of Mysterious Spirit Planet all thought that they were boasting, and scoffed even more.
Ling Han didn’t spend his energy on such trivial matters. He left the rock golem behind to keep watch while he continued to revive suns.
With the rock golem standing guard, he was not afraid that Pu Jingtian would suddenly become hostile.

However, Pu Jingtian also had self-awareness. At present, there was a 99% chance that he was no match for Ling Han. Thus, he focused all his energy on cultivating in seclusion. Once the great fortune of heaven and earth was revealed, he would take that final step.
After waiting for hundreds of millions of years, he was extremely eager to become Emperor.
The Great Emperor ruled his own era.

In these few years, Ding Shu Jing Haoran and Shui Qingchang were all attacked several times. However, Ling Han also passed on the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to them, and added with the fact that they still had the Imperial Weapon, with their intelligence, they immediately broke out of the siege. Naturally, they couldn’t be detained by the Great Emperors.
Ling Han, on the other hand, kept wanting to encounter the Lords of Death, but he never had the chance.
In the blink of an eye, seventy years had passed.
Ling Han walked around the world as usual, continuously reviving suns.

Under the full sunlight, the aura of the Netherworld would quickly dissipate. On the other hand, if one wanted to kill an entire galaxy, they couldn’t simply obliterate the stars. Instead, they had to fill the entire galaxy with the aura of the Netherworld. Only then would they be able to transform the Living Realm into the Netherworld.
Why was there so much of a difference in the difficulty level between the positive and the negative?
It was very simple, because this was the Living Realm in the first place, and with the Regulations of the Living Realm as support, it was naturally easier to recover than to convert.
Ling Han walked alone. Behind him, the dark galaxy was illuminated by the blazing sun, as if it was paying respects to him.
’Hmm?’
Ling Han suddenly paused. He could sense a powerful aura approaching.
Boom!
Behind him, a sun exploded, and a powerful shockwave swept over at a terrifying speed.
Ling Han couldn’t help but raise a brow, turning to look.
A Great Emperor had arrived.
Whether it was the Lord of Death or the Divine Beast Great Emperor, he was unafraid. Thus, Ling Han took the initiative to greet them.
Ahead of him, a black mist appeared, even larger than the galaxy itself.

Wherever the black mist passed, the sun would be instantly extinguished, and innumerable Yin souls would also fly out of the black mist, spewing out the air of death. Not only did they stop the Living Realm from recovering, it was also transforming the Living Realm into the environment of the Netherworld.
"Humph!" Ling Han dashed over in a single stride, then threw a punch.
Boom, a terrifying power surged. This was sixth tier battle prowess!
The Great Emperor in the black mist didn’t dare to face this attack head-on, and he hurriedly retreated.
However, the Great Emperor managed to dodge this strike, so how could Yin souls possibly do so?
The Imperial Might swept over, and all the Yin souls were turned into ashes.
"Tell me your name, and I’ll send you on your way!" Ling Han said calmly. So what if this was a Great Emperor? He had killed more than one of them.
