It was very simple, because this was the Living Realm in the first place, and with the Regulations of the Living Realm as support, it was naturally easier to recover than to convert.
Ling Han walked alone.
Behind him, the dark galaxy was illuminated by the blazing sun, as if it was paying respects to him.
’Hmm?’
Ling Han suddenly paused.
He could sense a powerful aura approaching.
Boom!
Behind him, a sun exploded, and a powerful shockwave swept over at a terrifying speed.
Ling Han couldn’t help but raise a brow, turning to look.
A Great Emperor had arrived.
Whether it was the Lord of Death or the Divine Beast Great Emperor, he was unafraid.
Thus, Ling Han took the initiative to greet them.
Ahead of him, a black mist appeared, even larger than the galaxy itself.
Wherever the black mist passed, the sun would be instantly extinguished, and innumerable Yin souls would also fly out of the black mist, spewing out the air of death.
Not only did they stop the Living Realm from recovering, it was also transforming the Living Realm into the environment of the Netherworld.
"Humph!" Ling Han dashed over in a single stride, then threw a punch.
Boom, a terrifying power surged.
This was sixth tier battle prowess!
The Great Emperor in the black mist didn’t dare to face this attack head-on, and he hurriedly retreated.
However, the Great Emperor managed to dodge this strike, so how could Yin souls possibly do so?
The Imperial Might swept over, and all the Yin souls were turned into ashes.
"Tell me your name, and I’ll send you on your way!" Ling Han said calmly.
So what if this was a Great Emperor?
He had killed more than one of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 4845: Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor
paragraphs: The black mist billowed, and it was as if it were expressing the fury of that Great Emperor.
What Great Emperor had not ruled an era on their own?
Now that someone was actually provoking him like this, he was naturally furious.
Boom, a large hand swatted out of the black mist, pressing down on Ling Han.
"Scram!" Ling Han roared. He swung his iron fist. Peng! Not only did he shatter the large hand, but his power didn’t decrease either. It continued to attack the black mist.
The Void vibrated, and that Lord of Death’s body was actually blasted back more than 30,000 miles. As it swept by, stars shattered one after another.
Why was it that after the Primitive Age, no Emperor would see another Emperor?
This was because the Great Emperor was far too powerful!
Once they started fighting, they could obliterate stars at any moment.
Hence, from now onwards, a Great Emperor would never see another Great Emperor. Naturally, there was no longer any battle between Great Emperors, and peace returned to the world.
Now, the two great Emperor Tier-level battle prowess clashed, instantly causing massive damage.
Thankfully, these stars were all dead stars now, so there was absolutely no need to worry about causing any casualties.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and had already caught up to him. He threw another punch.

"Brat!" The Lord of Death seemed to have been angered, but what use was that? His present battle prowess was only in the seventh tier, while Ling Han was in the sixth tier. Even if Ling Han could not crush him, he could at least suppress him in all aspects.
Thus, no matter how furious this Lord of Death was, it was useless. He could only be sent flying left and right by Ling Han’s attacks.
"Yi, so this is the Great Emperor?"
"So-so!"
Pa, pa, pa! Ling Han continued to throw punches, treating the Lord of Death like a punching bag.
There was a gap of a level, and the gap in battle prowess was really irreparable.
"You guys made yourselves become neither human nor ghost, just to be thrashed by me?"
"Too weak! Really too weak!"
As Ling Han fought, he continued to mock and ridicule him.
It should be known that his verbal prowess had been taught personally by the large black dog. Just how terrifying was this might?
Which Great Emperor could withstand this?
Boom!
This Lord of Death finally went all out. With a loud roar, a large amount of black mist was absorbed into his body, revealing a dried corpse.
It was completely impossible to tell which Great Emperor in history could match him.
However, an instant later, this Great Emperor’s body exuded an aura of life. His body became plump, his skin became smooth and plump, and his black hair billowed in the wind.
Very quickly, a captivating middle-aged man appeared in front of Ling Han.
An indescribable might. It was as if he only had to raise a brow, and even the heavens would collapse.
This was the true Imperial Might.
Ling Han’s eyes narrowed. Under his coercion and ridicule, he finally forced this Great Emperor to use his true power.
He didn’t know how many times the Lords of Death could enter their strongest state, but it was definitely limited.
Hence, he only had to mock them a few more times, and threaten them a few more times, and these Lords of Death would collapse by themselves.
Destroying a group of Great Emperors was quite fun just thinking about it.
"I am Ten Thousand Shadows Thousand!" the middle-aged man said calmly. However, the heavens and earth were rumbling, and it was as if they were trembling under his might.
Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor!
Ling Han immediately matched this name with a Great Emperor in history. He shook his fists, "Come battle!"
At this moment, his fighting spirit finally blazed.
If he bullied the weak, it was absolutely impossible that he would be filled with fighting spirit.
"Die!" The Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor moved, delivering a palm strike at Ling Han.
It was also a palm strike, but the might this time was incomparable to before.
Fifth tier!
This was the battle prowess of a peak stage fifth tier Great Emperor in his prime condition.

This was the strongest level that could be attained in the universe. The Great Emperor was the greatest prodigy of his generation. As long as one lived long enough, who could not rush to this kind of height?
Emperor Tier represented invincibility!
Boom, with this palm strike, nine Nine Star Regulations appeared.
Ling Han discovered that he was actually unable to move.
An Emperor’s words would take solid form and be realized.
Thus, after the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor said the word ’die’, the heaven and earth seemed to carry out this willpower, locking down on Ling Han and making it difficult for him to move.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and a terrifying power surged. Peng, the shackles of heaven and earth instantly shattered. He brandished his fists to greet the attack.
Peng!
Instantly, his body turned into a speck of light, and was instantly blasted into an endless distance.

Previously, Ling Han had used his advantage of one tier to suppress the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor. Now, however, the tables had turned. The Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor had an advantage of one tier, and could similarly crush Ling Han.
Xiu, Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor caught up to him, and delivered another palm strike.
Ling Han stopped, and with a battle cry, he exchanged blows with Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
With every exchange of blows, Ling Han would be sent flying once. The power gap between them was really too wide.

However, Ling Han’s physique was also freakish. At that time, the True Dragon was known as the leader of the Divine Beasts, and that was due to its invincible physique. Now, though Ling Han was slightly inferior, he was only inferior by a single tier to the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor.
Relying on the toughness of his physique, he was completely capable of taking it head-on.

On the surface, Ling Han was completely outmatched, but in truth, he didn’t suffer any injuries at all. Of course, his blood and Qi would definitely be boiling, and his chest would feel slightly uncomfortable, as if he had motion sickness.
Why was Ling Han doing this?
Simple, he was wasting time here.

Though Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor had now burst out with fifth tier battle prowess, in essence, he was not a true Great Emperor. Thus, as long as he continued to drag things out, he was sure that the latter would very soon fall out of the level of Great Emperor Tier in terms of battle prowess.
At that time, he would be able to do as he liked.
—If he summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, wouldn’t he also be able to exhaust him?
This was indeed the case. However, once he displayed the strength that could rival Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor, would he still battle him to the death?
He would definitely choose to flee.
Thus, Ling Han could only give the other some benefits first, and give him hope that he could kill him. Only then would he be able to kill this ancient Great Emperor here.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor unleashed his full battle prowess, unleashing his devastating Imperial Might. Wherever he passed, planets would be obliterated.
Going by his method of destruction, it would probably only take one to two months, and there would not be a single complete star in the whole galaxy.
Ling Han frowned at this. Although obliterating stars couldn’t transform the Living Realm into the Netherworld, it could slow down the recovery process.
Just like now, he only had to awaken a sun, and under the full light of the sun, he would soon be able to expel all darkness and evil, and return a bright and clear world to the universe.
They couldn’t go on like this.

Moreover, the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor was embroiled in a battle here. Even if he was too embarrassed to send out a signal, he was sure that the other Great Emperors would also sense that something was off, and rush over to provide reinforcements.
He had to deal with this as soon as possible.
Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and the precious tower instantly lit up. Zi, zi, zi, lightning flashed, intertwining with blazing white.
Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor couldn’t help but stop attacking. His eyes focused on Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and a hint of suspicion appeared on his face.
Why did this Imperial Weapon give him a feeling of pressure?
It should be known that though the Imperial Weapon had the word ’Emperor’, just like the Imperial Formation, it belonged to the bottom tier of Emperor-level power.
But now, it actually made him, a Great Emperor, feel a sense of pressure. Just how inconceivable was this?
"What kind of Imperial Weapon is this?" he couldn’t help but ask.

chapters.title: Chapter 4846: Ten million doppelgangers
paragraphs: "You guess," Ling Han said with a smile.
Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor humphed. After becoming a Great Emperor, who would dare to talk back to him?

However, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower hovered above Ling Han’s head, pouring down an air of Primal Chaos and lightning, making him have a premonition that it was extremely likely that he wouldn’t be able to break through the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower’s defenses and would be struck by lightning.
"Tool, no matter how strong it is, it is still a Tool," this Great Emperor stated calmly, showing his invincible confidence.
No matter how strong a Tool was, it was still a Tool. It had been forged by a human, and on the level of humans, was there anyone that could match a Great Emperor?

Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor made his move again. However, though his words sounded relaxed, he was actually not careless at all. With a single step, he actually split into two, and each figure charged towards Ling Han respectively.
Er... one of them should be a fake, right?
To block the attack of a Great Emperor, Ling Han would have to go all out. This meant that Ling Han would have to make a choice, and could only block one of the two Great Emperors.
Otherwise, if he blocked both of them, it was destined that his power would be divided, and he would definitely be defeated.
Ling Han did not experience a dilemma. He had the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower face off against a Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor, while he chose the other.
It should be known that he was not weak either.
Peng! Peng!
There were two loud explosions, and the two Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperors were both obliterated.
Yi?
Ling Han looked into the distance, only to see another Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor standing there.
They were fake. The two Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperors were both illusions, and this was the real deal.

The Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor smiled faintly, and from within his body, Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperors walked out one after another. Ten, a hundred, a thousand, gods, there were thousands of them!
No wonder he was called Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor. He really transformed into thousands of shadows.
There were so many Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperors surrounding Ling Han, and every single one of them was exuding the same aura, which could not be distinguished at all.
—If it was easy to distinguish, then the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor would not be worthy of the title of "Ten Thousand Shadows".
Every Great Emperor had been invincible for so long, so they definitely had their own unique skills.
The True Dragon’s strength was physique, the True Phoenix possessed speed, and in the case of this Great Emperor, he possessed shadow doppelgangers.
Ling Han activated his eye technique, but this time, the eye technique couldn’t help him much.
It was hard to tell, but it seemed like every single Great Emperor was real.
Xiu, right at this moment, all the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperors charged over, launching an attack at Ling Han.
Only one was real.
Which one was it?
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and brandished his iron fists repeatedly.
Under such circumstances, he was also forced to unleash his full potential, instantly throwing countless punches.
Peng, peng, peng! Each punch landed on the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperors. In an instant, there were 10,000 punches, and it was guaranteed that every single Great Emperor would be struck once.
However, after launching so many punches in an instant, Ling Han was also under immense pressure. His face had turned pale, and his limbs were trembling.
"There you are!" Ling Han said with a smile. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower shot out to greet a Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor.
Peng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower unleashed its might and sent the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor flying.

"Hahaha!" All the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperors were laughing loudly, "I have to admit that I am impressed with you. You have thought of a way to deal with it in such a short amount of time. However, under sucha high burden of repeatedly attacking, how many moves can you last?"
"A hundred moves? Or a thousand moves?" He shook his head, "At that time, it would be the time of your death."
Ling Han laughed loudly, "No matter how many moves it has to be, I will still kill you!"
He was filled with anticipation.
Though he had already killed Emperors before, those were created by the old Divine Beast, and could not be considered true Great Emperors.
And only if he could kill a Great Emperor in his prime, would that be considered his true accomplishment.
"What an arrogant guy!" The Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor sneered. In such a situation, Ling Han still dared to speak tough?
"Die!" he roared. His 10,000 clones attacked Ling Han again.
However, Ling Han didn’t attack like he had before. Instead, he remained still and motionless like a hunting panther.
However, countless attacks were about to arrive, so if you didn’t move, wouldn’t that be courting death?
Shua, right at this moment, Ling Han suddenly moved.
He set his eyes on one of the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperors, and pounced directly at him.
"En?" That Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor let out a surprised exclamation, as if he was shocked.
Peng!

Ling Han and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower combined forces to attack this Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor. Instantly, this Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor was forced back, and the other Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperors were unable to break through the air of Primal Chaos.
They were all fakes!

Although the doppelganger possessed Emperor Tier aura, and could suppress even Pseudo-Emperors, against the defenses of the fifth tier-level Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, it was useless no matter how many of them there were.
Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor frowned and said, "You actually managed to find my true self!"
A puzzled expression appeared on his face. Had Ling Han simply guessed randomly, or had he accurately guessed it?
If he had guessed correctly, then this guy’s luck was really too good, and he was really too bold.
But if it was the latter, how would he be able to determine it?
He could guarantee that every doppelganger possessed the same aura as the real one.
Again!
Tens of thousands of doppelgangers attacked again, and he was also among them, like the most outstanding assassin in the world.
However, after Ling Han sensed for a while, he immediately threw a punch, and together with the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, they launched an attack, aimed directly at his true self.
Peng!
Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor was once again sent backwards. A puzzled expression appeared on his face, and he asked, "How did you discover my true self?"
Ling Han smiled, "My eyesight is good."
Good, good eyesight?
Good your sister!
Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor wanted to curse. Was this a matter of good eyesight?
’If you don’t want to say, then don’t say. Is it very fun to tease others?’
However, he was truly curious. This shadow doppelganger skill of his was one of the best, and it was guaranteed that even other Great Emperors would not be able to see through it.
This was also one of the reasons why he dared to be so forceful with Ling Han. If he wanted to flee, there were millions of shadow doppelgangers, so which one would Ling Han chase?
Of course, this was his trump card. His greatest hope was still to kill Ling Han.

Ling Han took the initiative to attack. Though Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor once again summoned tens of thousands of clones, he could always aim directly at the real Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor. He was completely unaffected.
After several times, the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor had no choice but to admit that Ling Han had really cracked his shadow doppelganger move.

He was a Great Emperor, after all, so he quickly came to a realization. "I understand now. Previously, you didn’t hesitate to expend a lot of energy and clashed with all my doppelgangers. You were doing some kind of appraisal."
Ling Han laughed loudly, "As expected of the Great Emperor. I can’t hide it from you!"
Previously, he had attacked all the shadow doppelgangers, not because he had acted rashly and without thought, but because he had memorized the power fluctuations of all the shadow doppelgangers.

In order to cause disturbance, the power fluctuations of these shadow doppelgangers varied greatly. Thus, it was practically impossible to find the true self in an instant. Even other Great Emperors would find it very difficult to do so.
However, Ling Han managed to do so, though it was very straining, and he also had to make a judgement before he made a move.
Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor didn’t retract his shadow doppelgangers. Instead, he continued to expend his energy, continuing to attack Ling Han with his tens of thousands of doppelgangers.
How could he not tell? Though Ling Han could neutralize his powerful move, it was not an easy feat either.
And as long as he could seize a chance, he would be able to kill Ling Han.

You have thought of a way to deal with it in such a short amount of time.
However, under sucha high burden of repeatedly attacking, how many moves can you last?"
"A hundred moves?
Or a thousand moves?" He shook his head, "At that time, it would be the time of your death."
Ling Han laughed loudly, "No matter how many moves it has to be, I will still kill you!"
He was filled with anticipation.
Though he had already killed Emperors before, those were created by the old Divine Beast, and could not be considered true Great Emperors.
And only if he could kill a Great Emperor in his prime, would that be considered his true accomplishment.
"What an arrogant guy!" The Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor sneered.
In such a situation, Ling Han still dared to speak tough?
"Die!" he roared.
His 10,000 clones attacked Ling Han again.
However, Ling Han didn’t attack like he had before.
Instead, he remained still and motionless like a hunting panther.
However, countless attacks were about to arrive, so if you didn’t move, wouldn’t that be courting death?
Shua, right at this moment, Ling Han suddenly moved.
He set his eyes on one of the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperors, and pounced directly at him.
"En?" That Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor let out a surprised exclamation, as if he was shocked.
Peng!
Ling Han and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower combined forces to attack this Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor.
Instantly, this Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor was forced back, and the other Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperors were unable to break through the air of Primal Chaos.
They were all fakes!

Although the doppelganger possessed Emperor Tier aura, and could suppress even Pseudo-Emperors, against the defenses of the fifth tier-level Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, it was useless no matter how many of them there were.
Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor frowned and said, "You actually managed to find my true self!"
A puzzled expression appeared on his face.
Had Ling Han simply guessed randomly, or had he accurately guessed it?
If he had guessed correctly, then this guy’s luck was really too good, and he was really too bold.
But if it was the latter, how would he be able to determine it?
He could guarantee that every doppelganger possessed the same aura as the real one.
Again!
Tens of thousands of doppelgangers attacked again, and he was also among them, like the most outstanding assassin in the world.
However, after Ling Han sensed for a while, he immediately threw a punch, and together with the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, they launched an attack, aimed directly at his true self.
Peng!
Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor was once again sent backwards.
A puzzled expression appeared on his face, and he asked, "How did you discover my true self?"
Ling Han smiled, "My eyesight is good."
Good, good eyesight?
Good your sister!
Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor wanted to curse.
Was this a matter of good eyesight?
’If you don’t want to say, then don’t say.
Is it very fun to tease others?’
However, he was truly curious.
This shadow doppelganger skill of his was one of the best, and it was guaranteed that even other Great Emperors would not be able to see through it.
This was also one of the reasons why he dared to be so forceful with Ling Han.
If he wanted to flee, there were millions of shadow doppelgangers, so which one would Ling Han chase?
Of course, this was his trump card.
His greatest hope was still to kill Ling Han.
Ling Han took the initiative to attack.
Though Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor once again summoned tens of thousands of clones, he could always aim directly at the real Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor.
He was completely unaffected.
After several times, the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor had no choice but to admit that Ling Han had really cracked his shadow doppelganger move.
He was a Great Emperor, after all, so he quickly came to a realization.
"I understand now.
Previously, you didn’t hesitate to expend a lot of energy and clashed with all my doppelgangers.
You were doing some kind of appraisal."
Ling Han laughed loudly, "As expected of the Great Emperor.
I can’t hide it from you!"
Previously, he had attacked all the shadow doppelgangers, not because he had acted rashly and without thought, but because he had memorized the power fluctuations of all the shadow doppelgangers.
In order to cause disturbance, the power fluctuations of these shadow doppelgangers varied greatly.
Thus, it was practically impossible to find the true self in an instant.
Even other Great Emperors would find it very difficult to do so.
However, Ling Han managed to do so, though it was very straining, and he also had to make a judgement before he made a move.
Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor didn’t retract his shadow doppelgangers.
Instead, he continued to expend his energy, continuing to attack Ling Han with his tens of thousands of doppelgangers.
How could he not tell?
Though Ling Han could neutralize his powerful move, it was not an easy feat either.
And as long as he could seize a chance, he would be able to kill Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4847: Comprehension of the Netherworld
paragraphs: Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor was waiting for Ling Han to make a mistake, and wasn’t Ling Han the same?
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower could unleash the might of the fourth tier, but it was only a tier’s difference, so it was almost impossible to achieve an absolute kill.
After the attack, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower needed to recover for a whole 10 days. This was enough time for Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor to flee, or for reinforcements to arrive.
Thus, Ling Han had to wait for an opportunity, or create an opportunity to deliver an explosive, fatal strike.
Among those who could become Emperor, which one of them was not an outstanding talent among men?

Ling Han and Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor were both waiting for the other to make a mistake, and were also actively creating opportunities. However, both sides were cautious enough, and neither made a mistake nor fell into the other’s trap.
Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh with emotion. The Great Emperor that had reached this level through cultivation to become was completely different from a Great Emperor that was created.
The difference was really too great.

Previously, when he had killed the True Phoenix Emperor, though Ling Han had also expended some effort, it could not be considered as exhausting, but faced with Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor, no matter what he did, he had no way to lure him into taking the bait, or create an opportunity for himself.
Of course, it was the same for the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor, adn the two of them could be considered to be stuck in a tie.
In a situation when battle prowess was more or less equal, an Emperor wanted to kill an Emperor?
That was impossible.
However, Ling Han still had the initiative in the end.

Firstly, he had a chance for the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to release a burst of explosive power, and secondly, Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor couldn’t possibly stay in this state forever.
However, after a long battle, Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor’s reinforcements also arrived.
Three Lords of Death, as well as seven Divine Beast Great Emperors.
Faced with such a lineup, how could Ling Han possibly linger in battle?
"Ten Thousand Shadows Old Demon, I’ll come and take your dog head next time!" Ling Han laughed loudly. Then, without hesitation, he turned around and left quickly.

The other Great Emperors arrived, yet they were already unable to catch up to Ling Han. Ling Han possessed the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and even the True Phoenix Emperor could only stand on equal footing with him.
At this time, Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor suddenly targeted the seven Divine Beast Great Emperors.

After he entered his prime condition, he needed to absorb a great amount of life essence. Otherwise, he could only expend his own life essence, and that meant that he was walking step by step towards death.
Thus, he needed to absorb the essence of life now. For this reason, he was willing to kill his "allies".
To him, the Divine Beast Great Emperors could not be considered allies. They could only be considered a temporary cooperation, and the goal was to get rid of Ling Han.
However, when it concerned oneself, he naturally could forget about it without the slightest hesitation.
"There’s no need to make a move. We can provide you with some life essence," the seven Divine Beast Great Emperors said at the same time.
Yi?
The Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor was slightly surprised. He had not thought that the seven Divine Beast Great Emperors would actually be so "generous".

However, this was something that he could not refuse. Immediately, he opened his mouth and sucked. Instantly, the life essence of the seven Divine Beast Great Emperors surged out, and was absorbed by Ten Thousand Shadows Saint Emperor.

After a while, the Ten Thousand Shadows Saint EMperor stopped. He had clearly absorbed a large amount of life essence, yet his body had instead become shriveled and thin. His body was once again enveloped in black mist, and it was hard to see him in the slightest.
"Thanks," he said calmly.
"Heh, we have a common goal, so there’s no need to thank us," Bi Fang Emperor said. "The problem now is that brat is becoming more and more powerful. How can we eradicate him?"

This caused the four Lords of Death to fall silent. At this time, Ling Han already possessed the power of a Great Emperor, so it would not be easy to find him, and it would be even more difficult to detain him.
Even Saints would find it difficult to kill Saints, what more when a Great Emperor wanted to kill another Great Emperor.
Furthermore, aside from the ancient times, when had there ever been two Great Emperors that were alive at the same time in this world?
So what if they were as powerful as Great Emperors? They couldn’t think of any good solution at all.
Ling Han circled around, and did not return to Four Origin Planet.
Right now, the safest option for the Four Origin Planet was to stay as far away as possible.

The target of the Lords of Death and the Divine Beast Great Emperors was him, so they would only spend a lot of effort to search for him. Thus, as long as he didn’t return to the Four Origin Planet, the Four Origin Planet would be safe.
He continued to revive suns, sweeping through Yin souls.
The Living Realm was slowly recovering.

After all, this was the Living Realm. With the power of heaven and earth actively expelling it, once the Yin souls were destroyed, the environment would naturally transform faster back to the Living Realm.
During this process, Ling Han continuously experienced the Regulations of Death.
The Regulations of Death should belong to the Netherworld, but Ling Han didn’t feel like he couldn’t grasp it.
That was because above the Regulations of Death was the essence of death.
Elements of heaven and earth could be grasped, so why couldn’t Regulations be grasped?
The other side of life was death. Ling Han had mastered the Regulations of Life, so it was actually the easiest to master the Regulations of Death.

The current star was in a state of death, and Ling Han revived it. This was the effect of the Regulations of Life, but at the same time, it also allowed him to see a sliver of the profoundness of the Regulations of Death.
As time passed, Ling Han revived more and more stars, and his understanding of the Regulations of Death also became deeper and deeper. However, he was still a little bit away from grasping it.
This was a Regulation that did not belong to the Living Realm, so it was naturally difficult to grasp it. In fact, it was theoretically impossible.
But who asked this universe to be shattered?
The invasion of the Netherworld caused the power of heaven and earth of the Living Realm to become weaker, and the suppression on Ling Han was also pitifully small, giving him this possibility.
The Lords of Death and the others naturally wouldn’t sit by and watch. They continously opened passageways to the Netherworld, allowing large amounts of Yin souls to enter.
Ling Han decided that he would enter the Netherworld again.

Firstly, it was to strengthen his understanding of the Regulations of Death, and secondly, if he killed all the Yin souls, where would the Lords of Death find Yin souls to assimilate the Living Realm?
Having made up his mind, he immediately found a weak point of the two realms and entered the Netherworld.

Yin souls actually came from the dead beings of the Living Realm, and now that almost all the stars of the Living Realm had died out, it naturally added countless Yin souls to the Netherworld for a short period of time. However, this was killing the goose that lays the golden egg. In the future, without the Living Realm to supply Yin souls, the number of Yin souls would decrease with each death.
Ling Han shuttled through the Netherworld. He didn’t even need to attack. Once his flaming wings soared into the sky, Yin souls of all levels would die at the slightest touch.
The Netherworld could go to the Living Realm to commit a massacre, so how could it be that he couldn’t do the same?
Originally, Yin and Yang were in order, and would not interfere with each other. Now that the Netherworld had broken the rules, there was naturally no need for him to adhere to any more rules.
However, the Netherworld was too large. Even with Ling Han’s Emperor Tier abilities, it would still take an incredibly long time for him to cover every inch of land.

After several hundred years, Ling Han’s comprehension of the Regulations of Death had deepened greatly, and the most direct reflection was that what was spread out beneath his feet was no longer the great golden path, but rather incredibly pitch-black.
The end of life was death, but the end of death was life.
Ling Han stopped in his tracks. All of a sudden, enlightenment dawned on him.
He sat down in a cross-legged position and began to cultivate.
The aura of life exuding from his body became extremely weak, as if it was dead silent.
He sat there for 900 years.

chapters.title: Chapter 4848: Consummate level of Pseudo-Emperor
paragraphs: At the 969th year, Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open.
Boom, a powerful vitality suddenly exploded from his body.
His body had revived once more, and he stepped into the level of EIght Star Pseudo-Emperor!
However, this was not the end. In Ling Han’s body, the Regulations of Life and Death were opposed to each other, and were breeding each other, turning into a cycle that would never stop.
Life and death, in a single thought.
Weng, inside Ling Han’s body, the last part of his body that had experienced Silent Destruction also welcomed a great explosion, filled with vitality.
Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor.
He had created a miracle, breaking through two minor levels in a single go.
This was inconceivable.

He had already reached the height of Pseudo-Emperor Tier. Advancing one step further was already extremely difficult, and required a boundless amount of time, but Ling Han actually rushed up two minor levels in one go. If this was told to others, there was definitely no one who would believe it.
"Pseudo-Emperor consummate level!" Ling Han smiled. He had finally come this far.
Moreover, he had also mastered two Nine Star Regulations!
The Regulations of Life and Death.
This was unfathomable!
Before this, even for those who could become Great Emperors, when they were a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor, they would only be able to grasp close to one Regulations.
It was close, and it was impossible to reach the complete level.
As for Ling Han?
There were a total of two streaks, and furthermore, there was one for life and one for death, one yang and one yin.

It should be known that these two Regulations could be traced back to the essence of heaven and earth. Once Ling Han advanced further, he would break through to the fourth tier, or even the third tier, and catch up to the old Divine Beast.
Of course, the essence of death was too hard to grasp. Even after so many years, the old Divine Beast had still not succeeded.
He could return now.
Ling Han rapidly returned, and when he arrived at the passageway of the two realms, he charged out.

The Living Realm... still had a vast area that was in the state of being transformed into the Netherworld. After all, Ling Han had only killed Yin souls in the Netherworld, but a great many Yin souls had already come to the Living Realm.
It was fine.
With a single thought from Ling Han, a large number of Yin souls instantly died completely.
Multiple suns were reignited, illuminating the world.

Not too many years later, heaven and earth would slowly recover, and this time, there were not many Yin souls left in the Netherworld. If they still wanted to transform the Living Realm into the Netherworld, that would not be an easy thing to do.
However, Ling Han’s actions immediately attracted the attention of the Lords of Death and the Divine Beast Great Emperors.

Ling Han didn’t linger in battle. Although he had reached the level of a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor, and cultivated two nine-star Regulations, his battle prowess hadn’t advanced from the sixth tier to the fifth tier—no matter what, he had to master four to five nine-star Regulations before he could be considered to possess battle prowess of the fifth tier, and he would be the weakest of the fifth tier at that.
The Great Emperors in their prime had all grasped nine supreme Regulations.
Let’s go.
Ling Han let out a battle cry and left.
The Great Emperors all set off in pursuit, but without the True Phoenix Emperor, how could they possibly catch up to Ling Han?
They could only watch helplessly as Ling Han disappeared into the galaxy.
Ling Han returned to the Four Origin Planet. He immediately started to head to the Primitive Abyss again.

Unfortunately, Ding Shu and the others had not reached the level of Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor, so there was no meaning in bringing them to Imperial Island at this time. It was impossible for them to break through to become Emperors there.

Brother Monkey and the others were the same. They hadn’t even reached the level of Pseudo-Emperor, so it was even more meaningless for them to go to Imperial Island — moreover, if they didn’t become Pseudo-Emperor, they wouldn’t be qualified to go to Imperial Island.
Thus, Ling Han decided to only bring the empress and his wives with him.
When he left, he would attain Dao on the Imperial Island. Then, when he returned, he would completely pacify the two great turmoils of the Lords of Death and the Divine Beast Great Emperors.
Finally, it was the old Divine Beast.
However, even if Ling Han possessed fourth-tier battle prowess, he could not possibly match the old Divine Beast. This was still a drawn-out battle.
Once he had made his decision, Ling Han set out.

The empress and the others were all drawn into his body. Ling Han took a step forwards, and the great path of gold and black appeared beneath his feet. In an instant, he had arrived at the entrance to the Primitive Abyss.
He entered aggressively, and there was no need for him to dodge at all.
There were no longer thirty-six Divine Beasts standing guard here, and Ling Han swept past.
He released his wives, who had reached the level of Saint, and brought them, advancing on their journey.

In this period of time, they encountered the storm of heaven and earth, so they naturally dodged as much as they could. Even if Ling Han already possessed Emperor Tier battle prowess, and even if he actually possessed the Transcendent Weapon, Ling Han still didn’t want to face the storm of heaven and earth here head-on.
—At least, it was much more difficult to deal with than a fifth tier Great Emperor.
They journeyed and stopped, and finally, they arrived at the True Phoenix City.
Ling Han used his divine sense to scan the surroundings, and he actually sensed Imperial Might.
Disciple of the Great Emperor? Or... had the True Phoenix Emperor been revived and was cultivating here?
Ling Han first drew the empress and the others into his body for protection, then charged over.
Peng!
He had absolutely no intention of hiding himself, and just barged right in.
"How dare you!"
One of them charged over, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
Pseudo-Emperor, only a disciple of the Great Emperor.
Ling Han didn’t even look him in the eye. He simply stretched out a hand and pressed down. Then, his figure rapidly streaked away.
"You are too arrogant—"
Peng!
The Pseudo-Emperor wanted to sneer, but the power of Ling Han’s palm strike had already reached him, instantly shattering him.
This was sixth-tier battle prowess, so how could a Pseudo-Emperor rival it?
Boom! Right at this moment, a column of fire soared into the sky.
The True Phoenix Emperor directly tore through the air and fled.
"Can you escape?" Ling Han smirked coldly.

In the past, when the True Phoenix Emperor was at the level of Great Emperor, his speed was only about the same as his. Now, the True Phoenix Emperor was only at the level of Pseudo-Emperor, so how could he compete with him in speed?
Boom!
Ling Han also flapped his flaming wings. With a few flaps of his wings, he had caught up to the True Phoenix Emperor, and shot out a punch.
A humiliated and furious expression appeared on the True Phoenix Great Emperor’s face.
He had already been killed by Ling Han once, so could it be that Ling Han wanted to kill him again?
How could he accept this!

"Yi, you actually have memories of your last life!" Ling Han was surprised. Logically speaking, after the Divine Beast died, it would be the same as the Great Emperor. Its soul would not enter into the Netherworld, and would directly merge with the Heavenly Dao.
Thus, unless one obtained a great opportunity, and lived a second life with the treasures in the Primitive Abyss, once the Great Emperor was dead, he would completely cease to exist.
And now, the True Phoenix Great Emperor had revived, and actually still had the memory of being killed by him. The hatred in his eyes clearly could not be faked.
This was strange!
The old Divine Beast was too powerful, wasn’t it? Even memories could be "revived".

It should be known that the old Divine Beast had never left the Primitive Abyss before. Thus, it was naturally impossible for him to use his experiences to create memories for the True Phoenix Emperor.
A look of shock appeared on the True Phoenix Great Emperor’s face. He had not thought that his unconscious reaction would actually cause Ling Han to make such a connection.
"Brat, you won’t be able to escape death!" he said through gritted teeth.
Boom!
Ling Han had already arrived. How could a mere Pseudo-Emperor withstand his iron fists?
With just a single punch, the True Phoenix was killed.
With a thought from Ling Han, he took out another True Phoenix corpse from within his body.
Apart from the difference in cultivation level, the other aspects were completely the same.

If one had grasped the essence of creation, they would be able to create things out of thin air, and if they had grasped the essence of life, they would be able to bestow life on all beings. The combination of the two gave the old Divine Beast the ability to revive the True Phoenix.
However, rather than calling it a resurrection, it would be better to call it a reincarnation.
What Ling Han couldn’t figure out was that his body and even cultivation level could be recreated, but where did his memories come from?
Could this be the key?

He had created a miracle, breaking through two minor levels in a single go.
This was inconceivable.
He had already reached the height of Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
Advancing one step further was already extremely difficult, and required a boundless amount of time, but Ling Han actually rushed up two minor levels in one go.
If this was told to others, there was definitely no one who would believe it.
"Pseudo-Emperor consummate level!" Ling Han smiled.
He had finally come this far.
Moreover, he had also mastered two Nine Star Regulations!
The Regulations of Life and Death.
This was unfathomable!
Before this, even for those who could become Great Emperors, when they were a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor, they would only be able to grasp close to one Regulations.
It was close, and it was impossible to reach the complete level.
As for Ling Han?
There were a total of two streaks, and furthermore, there was one for life and one for death, one yang and one yin.
It should be known that these two Regulations could be traced back to the essence of heaven and earth.
Once Ling Han advanced further, he would break through to the fourth tier, or even the third tier, and catch up to the old Divine Beast.
Of course, the essence of death was too hard to grasp.
Even after so many years, the old Divine Beast had still not succeeded.
He could return now.
Ling Han rapidly returned, and when he arrived at the passageway of the two realms, he charged out.
The Living Realm... still had a vast area that was in the state of being transformed into the Netherworld.
After all, Ling Han had only killed Yin souls in the Netherworld, but a great many Yin souls had already come to the Living Realm.
It was fine.
With a single thought from Ling Han, a large number of Yin souls instantly died completely.
Multiple suns were reignited, illuminating the world.
Not too many years later, heaven and earth would slowly recover, and this time, there were not many Yin souls left in the Netherworld.
If they still wanted to transform the Living Realm into the Netherworld, that would not be an easy thing to do.
However, Ling Han’s actions immediately attracted the attention of the Lords of Death and the Divine Beast Great Emperors.
Ling Han didn’t linger in battle.

Although he had reached the level of a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor, and cultivated two nine-star Regulations, his battle prowess hadn’t advanced from the sixth tier to the fifth tier—no matter what, he had to master four to five nine-star Regulations before he could be considered to possess battle prowess of the fifth tier, and he would be the weakest of the fifth tier at that.
The Great Emperors in their prime had all grasped nine supreme Regulations.
Let’s go.
Ling Han let out a battle cry and left.
The Great Emperors all set off in pursuit, but without the True Phoenix Emperor, how could they possibly catch up to Ling Han?
They could only watch helplessly as Ling Han disappeared into the galaxy.
Ling Han returned to the Four Origin Planet.
He immediately started to head to the Primitive Abyss again.
Unfortunately, Ding Shu and the others had not reached the level of Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor, so there was no meaning in bringing them to Imperial Island at this time.
It was impossible for them to break through to become Emperors there.
Brother Monkey and the others were the same.

They hadn’t even reached the level of Pseudo-Emperor, so it was even more meaningless for them to go to Imperial Island — moreover, if they didn’t become Pseudo-Emperor, they wouldn’t be qualified to go to Imperial Island.
Thus, Ling Han decided to only bring the empress and his wives with him.
When he left, he would attain Dao on the Imperial Island.
Then, when he returned, he would completely pacify the two great turmoils of the Lords of Death and the Divine Beast Great Emperors.
Finally, it was the old Divine Beast.
However, even if Ling Han possessed fourth-tier battle prowess, he could not possibly match the old Divine Beast.
This was still a drawn-out battle.
Once he had made his decision, Ling Han set out.
The empress and the others were all drawn into his body.
Ling Han took a step forwards, and the great path of gold and black appeared beneath his feet.
In an instant, he had arrived at the entrance to the Primitive Abyss.
He entered aggressively, and there was no need for him to dodge at all.
There were no longer thirty-six Divine Beasts standing guard here, and Ling Han swept past.
He released his wives, who had reached the level of Saint, and brought them, advancing on their journey.
In this period of time, they encountered the storm of heaven and earth, so they naturally dodged as much as they could.

Even if Ling Han already possessed Emperor Tier battle prowess, and even if he actually possessed the Transcendent Weapon, Ling Han still didn’t want to face the storm of heaven and earth here head-on.
—At least, it was much more difficult to deal with than a fifth tier Great Emperor.
They journeyed and stopped, and finally, they arrived at the True Phoenix City.
Ling Han used his divine sense to scan the surroundings, and he actually sensed Imperial Might.
Disciple of the Great Emperor?
Or... had the True Phoenix Emperor been revived and was cultivating here?
Ling Han first drew the empress and the others into his body for protection, then charged over.
Peng!
He had absolutely no intention of hiding himself, and just barged right in.
"How dare you!"
One of them charged over, and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
Pseudo-Emperor, only a disciple of the Great Emperor.
Ling Han didn’t even look him in the eye.
He simply stretched out a hand and pressed down.
Then, his figure rapidly streaked away.
"You are too arrogant—"
Peng!
The Pseudo-Emperor wanted to sneer, but the power of Ling Han’s palm strike had already reached him, instantly shattering him.
This was sixth-tier battle prowess, so how could a Pseudo-Emperor rival it?
Boom!
Right at this moment, a column of fire soared into the sky.
The True Phoenix Emperor directly tore through the air and fled.
"Can you escape?" Ling Han smirked coldly.
In the past, when the True Phoenix Emperor was at the level of Great Emperor, his speed was only about the same as his.
Now, the True Phoenix Emperor was only at the level of Pseudo-Emperor, so how could he compete with him in speed?
Boom!
Ling Han also flapped his flaming wings.
With a few flaps of his wings, he had caught up to the True Phoenix Emperor, and shot out a punch.
A humiliated and furious expression appeared on the True Phoenix Great Emperor’s face.
He had already been killed by Ling Han once, so could it be that Ling Han wanted to kill him again?
How could he accept this!
"Yi, you actually have memories of your last life!" Ling Han was surprised.
Logically speaking, after the Divine Beast died, it would be the same as the Great Emperor.
Its soul would not enter into the Netherworld, and would directly merge with the Heavenly Dao.
Thus, unless one obtained a great opportunity, and lived a second life with the treasures in the Primitive Abyss, once the Great Emperor was dead, he would completely cease to exist.
And now, the True Phoenix Great Emperor had revived, and actually still had the memory of being killed by him.
The hatred in his eyes clearly could not be faked.
This was strange!
The old Divine Beast was too powerful, wasn’t it?
Even memories could be "revived".
It should be known that the old Divine Beast had never left the Primitive Abyss before.
Thus, it was naturally impossible for him to use his experiences to create memories for the True Phoenix Emperor.
A look of shock appeared on the True Phoenix Great Emperor’s face.
He had not thought that his unconscious reaction would actually cause Ling Han to make such a connection.
"Brat, you won’t be able to escape death!" he said through gritted teeth.
Boom!
Ling Han had already arrived.
How could a mere Pseudo-Emperor withstand his iron fists?
With just a single punch, the True Phoenix was killed.
With a thought from Ling Han, he took out another True Phoenix corpse from within his body.
Apart from the difference in cultivation level, the other aspects were completely the same.
If one had grasped the essence of creation, they would be able to create things out of thin air, and if they had grasped the essence of life, they would be able to bestow life on all beings.
The combination of the two gave the old Divine Beast the ability to revive the True Phoenix.
However, rather than calling it a resurrection, it would be better to call it a reincarnation.
What Ling Han couldn’t figure out was that his body and even cultivation level could be recreated, but where did his memories come from?
Could this be the key?

chapters.title: Chapter 4849: Attaining Dao
paragraphs: It was not that Ling Han had not seen the other creations of the old Divine Beast, such as those disciples of the True Dragon Emperor. They had all been killed by him once.
However, when they "revived", they completely didn’t recognize Ling Han, and treated him as a stranger.
Thus, it was strange. Why did the True Phoenix Emperor possess memories after being recreated?
Logically speaking, it was even more impossible for the soul of a Great Emperor to be preserved.
"There’s definitely something strange about this!" Ling Han murmured.
However, now was not the time to consider this. He needed to go to the Imperial Island and complete the final leap.
Ling Han put away the corpse of the True Phoenix. Not bad, not bad. More of this kind of nutritious bird could be delivered to him, and give it to the empress and the others.
After walking for a few years, they arrived at the Sea of Death.
Ling Han stopped and made some adjustments.
He began to cook the True Phoenix for the women to consume.
He didn’t need it. With his current height as a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor, he couldn’t make up for it no matter what he ate. In the future, he could only walk on his own.
Whatever Celestial medicine would not have any effect on him.
At the beach, the women ate for a total of four months, and only then did they finish eating the two True Phoenixes.
It was mainly the Great Emperor-level one. It was in the sixth tier, and the energy it contained was incredibly astonishing. Even Saints like them would have to digest it for a very long time.
Afterward, the women all went into seclusion. Afterward, their cultivation level greatly increased.
Just ask, who in the world could use the Great Emperor as a cultivation resource?
There was definitely none!
That was the Great Emperor, who had ruled his own era, and grasped the highest Regulations.
Eating the meat of a Great Emperor?
What kind of joke was this!
Thus, it could be imagined that the women were improving rapidly. After all, this kind of great fortune was like a dream.
Unfortunately, the threshold of Pseudo-Emperor was too hard to breach, so Ling Han took all the women back into his body.

This was very amazing. Once they were taken into his body, no matter how many years had passed, the state would remain just like the moment they entered into his body, as if they were still in the Genesis World.
Otherwise, Ling Han wouldn’t have brought the women in. At present, no one could attain immortality. If he went into seclusion, the women would have all died of old age.
He began to cross the sea.

This was extremely dangerous. The slightest move could cause the death of a Great Emperor. Even Ling Han had to be very careful. After spending more than eight years, he came to the Imperial Island for the third time.
He first came to the Cave of Life... he wasn’t familiar with other places either.
"Senior Battle Saint!" Ling Han sighed. He saw the Battle Saint Emperor again.
The old Saint Emperor was bathing in the Pool of Life, an expression of satisfaction on his face.
’Can’t you suffer a little less?’
"Yi, you’ve reached Nine Star Pseudo-Emperor?" The Battle Saint Emperor glanced at Ling Han. With the Fiery Golden Eyes, Ling Han’s cultivation level was completely exposed.
Of course, this was also because he hadn’t channeled the Soul Forming Technique.
"Yes." Ling Han nodded, "I have come this time to attempt breaking through to the imperial throne."
"All right!" The Battle Saint Emperor nodded, revealing a satisfied expression. "How’s the situation outside?"
Ling Han gave a brief explanation, causing the Battle Saint Emperor to frown again.

"Though the present situation is slightly better, the Lords of Death themselves can also be considered Yin souls. If there is no other choice, they would definitely step out personally," the old Saint Emperor said.
That made sense.
Though Ling Han had eliminated most of the low-level Yin souls, the Lords of Death could also step forward personally and continue to transform the Living Realm into the Netherworld.
However, this would definitely require them to pay a very heavy price. It would also be very troublesome and time-consuming.
"Then I will break through to Emperor Tier as soon as possible, and make another trip outside." Ling Han nodded.
"Yes," the Battle Saint Emperor nodded.
"Oh, that’s right. Senior, Buddha Doga and the other seniors, how’s the situation now?" Ling Han asked.

"They are cultivating in seclusion in different caves," the Battle Saint Emperor said as he pointed. "There will always be people healing their wounds here, so it’s inevitable that they will be disturbed."
It had already been so long, and they were still in seclusion?
Although restrictions had been lifted here, and Pseudo-Emperors all had chances of attaining Dao, the completion of this final step was still as difficult as ascending the heavens.

After all, there weren’t any Nine Star Regulations here, allowing Pseudo-Emperors to go the normal route to ascend to the next level, but directly transitioned to the elements of heaven and earth, so the difficulty was naturally astonishing.
In the outside world, it was already difficult to become Emperor but here, it was naturally even more difficult.
Ling Han didn’t greet Buddha Doga and the others. Instead, he found a cave and entered seclusion.
There were no Nine Star Regulations here. However, there were vital signs of life here, and they filled the entire cave.
Ling Han continued to extract the essence of life, resonating with the Regulations of Life that he had grasped, so that he could complete a qualitative leap and become a Great Emperor.

He had grasped the complete Nine Star Regulations, and there were two of them at that. Thus, he could completely walk the normal path and advance into Great Emperor Tier first, and then calmly grasp the essence of life, raising to fourth tier in a single stroke.

In the fourth tier, he was no weaker than the Battle Saint Emperor, and could become the main force of resistance against the old Divine Beast — though the battle prowess of the fourth tier was still not enough in front of the old Divine Beast and he could only be beaten.
Ling Han sat quietly, experiencing Regulations and the key elements.
Without the Dao of Heaven and Earth in this world, it was equivalent to having no Regulations. Without the help of external forces, it was extremely difficult to advance another step.

However, there was nothing that could be done. If Ling Han became Emperor in the outside world, he would expend the chance of proving Dao of this era, but if he became Emperor here, a Pseudo-Emperor could still be allowed to prove Dao in the outside world.
At that time, it would be relatively easy for the two Great Emperors to suppress the darkness together. In future, there would also have one more reinforcement force to resist the old Divine Beast.

Of course, more importantly, if one became Emperor here, they would have a chance of breaking through two minor levels in one go. Furthermore, time passed quickly here, so even if they needed to spend more time on comprehension, that was completely acceptable.
Ten thousand years, thirty thousand years, a hundred thousand years!
This was slightly beyond Ling Han’s expectations. The path of breaking through was extraordinarily difficult.
Even if he was a nine-star Pseudo-Emperor, and had astonishingly high comprehension ability, his progress was still very slow, and he was unable to take that last step for a long time.
It was no wonder that Buddha Doga and the others had entered "more than 100,000 years" before him and still hadn’t broken through. This was truly difficult.

One needed to comprehend the Nine Star Regulations to become a Great Emperor, but there was no Nine Star Regulations here at all. Theoretically speaking, this was a paradox. Thankfully, there were still the four elements.
However, the four main elements were really too difficult to grasp. Even prodigious figures like Buddha Doga, Xia Houping and Qian Yanghao improved slowly.
Even in the outside world, five thousand years had already passed, causing Ling Han to frown slightly.

Previously, he had already made his calculations. There was still about 10,000 years left for the Living Realm, and the heaven and earth would begin to collapse. If the Living Realm was further transformed into the Netherworld, then once it began, the great world would definitely be destroyed by the massive collision of heaven and earth.

And this would also affect the Imperial Island, where the old Divine Beast would use it to open the Cave of Death, allowing him to clearly understand the essence of death, and become the first existence in history to grasp all four essences at the same time.
At that time, it would be too late.
Fast, he had to hurry up!
Finally, Ling Han grasped the trigger for his breakthrough.
He began to attain Dao.
To walk one’s own path, and from then on, the great dao would be in the skies, and he would walk his own path.

chapters.title: Chapter 4850: Great Emperor Ling Han
paragraphs: Humans lived under the Dao of Heaven and Earth.
Thus, only if the heaven and earth allowed it, would a Pseudo-Emperor be able to prove his Dao. This was the fundamental reason why only one Great Emperor could appear in an era.
But in the Primitive Abyss, the great dao did not exist. Thus, it was theoretically possible that ten, a hundred or even more Great Emperors could appear.
Ling Han had been comprehending the essence of life all this while.

For him, this should be the simplest and fastest way to become Emperor, because he had already grasped the Regulations of Life, and he had also been born from the Stone of Life, so he had a natural affinity with the essence of life.
Even so, this still took him 800,000 years.
From this, it could be seen how difficult it was to achieve dao in the Primitive Abyss!
Ling Han believed that if he were in the outside world, he definitely wouldn’t need such a long time. In fact, he wouldn’t even need a fraction of this time.
Of course, spending a few thousand years in the outside world would be several hundred thousand years in the Primitive Abyss. Thus, there was actually not much difference between the two.
Boom!

Ling Han’s body continued to exude a terrifying aura, yet it was also brimming with vitality. Countless golden lotuses bloomed around him. Upon closer look, these weren’t illusions, but rather rocks that seemed to have gained life.
Giving life, Regulations of Life.
No.

Previously, when Ling Han had bestowed life, he could only bestow one life at a time. Furthermore, there was a limit to his abilities. Even if he tried his best, he would only be able to bestow Core Formation Tier-level life, but now, he could bestow hundreds or even thousands of lives at the same time.
And these golden lotuses were all Five Star Celestial medicines!

However, in this place, there was absolutely no possibility for Five Star Celestial medicines to survive. Once they broke away from the protection of Ling Han’s power, these Celestial medicines would immediately wilt.
Too bad.
However, it was only five-star level, after all, so it didn’t matter.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The aura exuding from his body became more and more majestic, and there were more and more golden lotuses surging around him. There were thousands, tens of thousands of them. In fact, the grade of the golden lotuses were also improving, reaching six stars, and were even advancing towards seven stars.
What, a Seven Star Celestial medicine could actually be created out of thin air?
Even a Great Emperor couldn’t possibly possess such might!
If the Battle Saint Emperor was here, he would definitely nod in delight. This was because Ling Han had already made a breakthrough in grasping the fundamentals of life.
Success was at hand!
Even so, another 90,000 years later, Ling Han finally obtained a qualitative breakthrough.

Around him, the rippling golden lotuses had long since reached Saint-level, but when it had reached nine hundred thousand years, there were no golden lotuses rippling around him. Instead, it was incredibly calm. In fact, he had even become a black hole, endlessly devouring energy.

The aura exuding from his body was extremely unstable, as if it could explode at any moment, and with the amount of energy he was accumulating now, once it exploded, it would definitely be boundlessly terrifying.
Thankfully, though he had always been walking on the verge of collapse, he had always maintained a fragile balance.

Now was the most crucial moment. Breaking through in the Primitive Abyss, although without the suppression of the Heavenly Dao, any Pseudo-Emperor could possibly attain Dao, but without the Heavenly Dao, it would also be extremely dangerous.
In a moment of carelessness, all his previous efforts would be wasted, and he would be consigned to eternal damnation.
Ling Han was neither sad nor happy, and merely played out the changes of life in his mind. This had already crossed over the level of Regulations of Life, and reached the height of "Dao".
Any one of the four elements could be considered Dao, though it was not complete.
Ling Han was forming his own great dao. Once the great dao formed, he would become his own existence.
As an Emperor.
Boom!
His whole person was exuding endless golden light, indescribably bright, and after reaching the pinnacle level, the golden light turned into black and white, evolving into the yin and yang of Taiji.
In the end, the black and white colors turned back into four streaks of divine light, which then suddenly disappeared without a trace.
Xiu, Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open. Twin streaks of light shot out, and even the thick cave walls of the Primitive Abyss couldn’t hide them, as they shot into the sky.
An indescribable feeling rose up in Ling Han’s heart, making him realize just how powerful he was now.
This was Emperor Tier.
He had become a Great Emperor.
Yi, why was there no multicolored light that filled the skies? Why was there no resonance between heaven and earth?
Because this was the Primitive Abyss, without the existence of the great dao, how could it resonate?
Sigh!
Ling Han sighed. This was a little like wearing embroidered clothes at night.
’I’ve clearly become the most powerful being, yet not a single person knows about this. This is simply unbelievable!’
Forget it, he could still show off when he got out.
So be it if it was on the Imperial Island. What this place lacked the least was Great Emperors.
Ling Han walked out, only to discover... that the Battle Saint Emperor was immersed in the Pool of Life again.
F***, just how many times had he done this?
"Senior—" Ling Han spoke up, revealing a strong feeling of helplessness.
The Battle Saint Emperor glanced at him before nodding and saying, "Since you’ve already become an Emperor, we’re all on the same path. There’s no need to address me as senior anymore."
Are you serious?
Ling Han wore a strange expression as he gazed at the old Saint Emperor.
—He addressed the old Saint Emperor as brother. If he treated the old Saint Emperor as an equal, then when Brother Monkey saw the old Saint Emperor in future, how should he address him?
Should he address him as Ancestor, or as Old Brother?
"Hehe, you have an objection?" The Battle Saint Emperor bared his teeth, slightly displeased.
"Alright, as long as you’re happy."
Ling Han nodded and said, "Friend, how are Buddha Doga and the others?"

Only then did the Battle Saint Emperor smile and say, "That old brat, Doga, has already attained Dao. His aptitude is quite good. Unfortunately, he was unable to grasp a complete nine-star Regulations before attaining Dao. In future, even if he went to the outside world, the four elements would still repel the Regulations, and there would be no chance for him to make up for it."

Thus, only if the heaven and earth allowed it, would a Pseudo-Emperor be able to prove his Dao.
This was the fundamental reason why only one Great Emperor could appear in an era.

Thus, it was theoretically possible that ten, a hundred or even more Great Emperors could appear.
Ling Han had been comprehending the essence of life all this while.

For him, this should be the simplest and fastest way to become Emperor, because he had already grasped the Regulations of Life, and he had also been born from the Stone of Life, so he had a natural affinity with the essence of life.

From this, it could be seen how difficult it was to achieve dao in the Primitive Abyss!
Ling Han believed that if he were in the outside world, he definitely wouldn’t need such a long time.
In fact, he wouldn’t even need a fraction of this time.
Of course, spending a few thousand years in the outside world would be several hundred thousand years in the Primitive Abyss.
Thus, there was actually not much difference between the two.
Boom!
Ling Han’s body continued to exude a terrifying aura, yet it was also brimming with vitality.
Countless golden lotuses bloomed around him.
Upon closer look, these weren’t illusions, but rather rocks that seemed to have gained life.
Giving life, Regulations of Life.
No.
Previously, when Ling Han had bestowed life, he could only bestow one life at a time.

Even if he tried his best, he would only be able to bestow Core Formation Tier-level life, but now, he could bestow hundreds or even thousands of lives at the same time.
And these golden lotuses were all Five Star Celestial medicines!
However, in this place, there was absolutely no possibility for Five Star Celestial medicines to survive.
Once they broke away from the protection of Ling Han’s power, these Celestial medicines would immediately wilt.
Too bad.
However, it was only five-star level, after all, so it didn’t matter.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The aura exuding from his body became more and more majestic, and there were more and more golden lotuses surging around him.
There were thousands, tens of thousands of them.
In fact, the grade of the golden lotuses were also improving, reaching six stars, and were even advancing towards seven stars.
What, a Seven Star Celestial medicine could actually be created out of thin air?
Even a Great Emperor couldn’t possibly possess such might!
If the Battle Saint Emperor was here, he would definitely nod in delight.
This was because Ling Han had already made a breakthrough in grasping the fundamentals of life.
Success was at hand!
Even so, another 90,000 years later, Ling Han finally obtained a qualitative breakthrough.
Around him, the rippling golden lotuses had long since reached Saint-level, but when it had reached nine hundred thousand years, there were no golden lotuses rippling around him.
Instead, it was incredibly calm.
In fact, he had even become a black hole, endlessly devouring energy.

The aura exuding from his body was extremely unstable, as if it could explode at any moment, and with the amount of energy he was accumulating now, once it exploded, it would definitely be boundlessly terrifying.
Thankfully, though he had always been walking on the verge of collapse, he had always maintained a fragile balance.
Now was the most crucial moment.

Breaking through in the Primitive Abyss, although without the suppression of the Heavenly Dao, any Pseudo-Emperor could possibly attain Dao, but without the Heavenly Dao, it would also be extremely dangerous.
In a moment of carelessness, all his previous efforts would be wasted, and he would be consigned to eternal damnation.
Ling Han was neither sad nor happy, and merely played out the changes of life in his mind.
This had already crossed over the level of Regulations of Life, and reached the height of "Dao".
Any one of the four elements could be considered Dao, though it was not complete.
Ling Han was forming his own great dao.
Once the great dao formed, he would become his own existence.
As an Emperor.
Boom!
His whole person was exuding endless golden light, indescribably bright, and after reaching the pinnacle level, the golden light turned into black and white, evolving into the yin and yang of Taiji.
In the end, the black and white colors turned back into four streaks of divine light, which then suddenly disappeared without a trace.
Xiu, Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open.
Twin streaks of light shot out, and even the thick cave walls of the Primitive Abyss couldn’t hide them, as they shot into the sky.
An indescribable feeling rose up in Ling Han’s heart, making him realize just how powerful he was now.
This was Emperor Tier.
He had become a Great Emperor.
Yi, why was there no multicolored light that filled the skies?
Why was there no resonance between heaven and earth?
Because this was the Primitive Abyss, without the existence of the great dao, how could it resonate?
Sigh!
Ling Han sighed.
This was a little like wearing embroidered clothes at night.
’I’ve clearly become the most powerful being, yet not a single person knows about this.
This is simply unbelievable!’
Forget it, he could still show off when he got out.
So be it if it was on the Imperial Island.
What this place lacked the least was Great Emperors.
